private lemma sum_tensorProduct_factor
    {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [Fintype ι₂]
    (b₁ : OrthonormalBasis ι₁ ℂ H₁) (b₂ : OrthonormalBasis ι₂ ℂ H₂)
    (x₁ : H₁) (y₁ : H₂) (x₂ : H₁) (y₂ : H₂) :
    ∑ ij : ι₁ × ι₂,
      (starRingEnd ℂ ((b₁.toBasis.tensorProduct b₂.toBasis).repr (x₁ ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y₁) ij)) *
      ((b₁.toBasis.tensorProduct b₂.toBasis).repr (x₂ ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y₂) ij) =
    ∑ ij : ι₁ × ι₂,
      (starRingEnd ℂ (b₁.repr x₁ ij.1)) * (starRingEnd ℂ (b₂.repr y₁ ij.2)) *
      (b₁.repr x₂ ij.1) * (b₂.repr y₂ ij.2) := by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro ij _
  rw [basis_tensorProduct_repr_tmul b₁ b₂ x₁ y₁ ij,
      basis_tensorProduct_repr_tmul b₁ b₂ x₂ y₂ ij]
  simp only [map_mul]
  ring

/-! ## Section 3: Basis Independence -/

/-- Helper: `innerProductTensorProductBasis` is additive in the first argument for any basis. -/
private theorem innerProductTensorProductBasis_add_left
    {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [Fintype ι₂]
    (b₁ : OrthonormalBasis ι₁ ℂ H₁) (b₂ : OrthonormalBasis ι₂ ℂ H₂)
    (v₁ v₂ w : TensorProduct ℂ H₁ H₂) :
    innerProductTensorProductBasis H₁ H₂ b₁ b₂ (v₁ + v₂) w =
    innerProductTensorProductBasis H₁ H₂ b₁ b₂ v₁ w +
    innerProductTensorProductBasis H₁ H₂ b₁ b₂ v₂ w := by
  unfold innerProductTensorProductBasis
  simp only
  have h_add : (b₁.toBasis.tensorProduct b₂.toBasis).repr (v₁ + v₂) =
               (b₁.toBasis.tensorProduct b₂.toBasis).repr v₁ +
               (b₁.toBasis.tensorProduct b₂.toBasis).repr v₂ := map_add _ _ _
  rw [h_add]
  simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, map_add, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

/-- Helper: `innerProductTensorProductBasis` is additive in the second argument for any basis. -/
private theorem innerProductTensorProductBasis_add_right
    {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [Fintype ι₂]
    (b₁ : OrthonormalBasis ι₁ ℂ H₁) (b₂ : OrthonormalBasis ι₂ ℂ H₂)
    (v w₁ w₂ : TensorProduct ℂ H₁ H₂) :
    innerProductTensorProductBasis H₁ H₂ b₁ b₂ v (w₁ + w₂) =
    innerProductTensorProductBasis H₁ H₂ b₁ b₂ v w₁ +
    innerProductTensorProductBasis H₁ H₂ b₁ b₂ v w₂ := by
  unfold innerProductTensorProductBasis
  simp only
  have h_add : (b₁.toBasis.tensorProduct b₂.toBasis).repr (w₁ + w₂) =
               (b₁.toBasis.tensorProduct b₂.toBasis).repr w₁ +
               (b₁.toBasis.tensorProduct b₂.toBasis).repr w₂ := map_add _ _ _
  rw [h_add]
  simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

/-- Helper: `innerProductTensorProductBasis` is conjugate-homogeneous in the first argument. -/
private theorem innerProductTensorProductBasis_smul_left
    {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [Fintype ι₂]
    (b₁ : OrthonormalBasis ι₁ ℂ H₁) (b₂ : OrthonormalBasis ι₂ ℂ H₂)
    (c : ℂ) (v w : TensorProduct ℂ H₁ H₂) :
    innerProductTensorProductBasis H₁ H₂ b₁ b₂ (c • v) w =
    (starRingEnd ℂ c) * innerProductTensorProductBasis H₁ H₂ b₁ b₂ v w := by
  unfold innerProductTensorProductBasis
  simp only
  have h_smul : (b₁.toBasis.tensorProduct b₂.toBasis).repr (c • v) =
      c • (b₁.toBasis.tensorProduct b₂.toBasis).repr v := map_smul _ _ _
  rw [h_smul]
  simp only [Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum]

/-- Helper: `innerProductTensorProductBasis` is linear in the second argument. -/
private theorem innerProductTensorProductBasis_smul_right
    {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [Fintype ι₂]
    (b₁ : OrthonormalBasis ι₁ ℂ H₁) (b₂ : OrthonormalBasis ι₂ ℂ H₂)
    (c : ℂ) (v w : TensorProduct ℂ H₁ H₂) :
    innerProductTensorProductBasis H₁ H₂ b₁ b₂ v (c • w) =
    c * innerProductTensorProductBasis H₁ H₂ b₁ b₂ v w := by
  unfold innerProductTensorProductBasis
  simp only
  have h_smul : (b₁.toBasis.tensorProduct b₂.toBasis).repr (c • w) =
      c • (b₁.toBasis.tensorProduct b₂.toBasis).repr w := map_smul _ _ _
  rw [h_smul]
  simp only [Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  simp [← Finset.mul_sum, mul_left_comm]

/-- Pure tensor formula for arbitrary orthonormal basis. -/
private theorem innerProductTensorProductBasis_tmul
    {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [Fintype ι₂]
    (b₁ : OrthonormalBasis ι₁ ℂ H₁) (b₂ : OrthonormalBasis ι₂ ℂ H₂)
    (x₁ : H₁) (y₁ : H₂) (x₂ : H₁) (y₂ : H₂) :
    innerProductTensorProductBasis H₁ H₂ b₁ b₂ (x₁ ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y₁) (x₂ ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y₂) =
    @inner ℂ H₁ _ x₁ x₂ * @inner ℂ H₂ _ y₁ y₂ := by
  unfold innerProductTensorProductBasis
  simp only
  rw [show (∑ ij : ι₁ × ι₂,
        (starRingEnd ℂ)
          ((b₁.toBasis.tensorProduct b₂.toBasis).repr (x₁ ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y₁) ij) *
        (b₁.toBasis.tensorProduct b₂.toBasis).repr (x₂ ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y₂) ij) =
      (∑ ij : ι₁ × ι₂,
        (starRingEnd ℂ (b₁.repr x₁ ij.1)) * (starRingEnd ℂ (b₂.repr y₁ ij.2)) *
        (b₁.repr x₂ ij.1) * (b₂.repr y₂ ij.2))
      from sum_tensorProduct_factor b₁ b₂ x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂]
  have h_rearrange : ∀ ij : ι₁ × ι₂,
    (starRingEnd ℂ (b₁.repr x₁ ij.1)) * (starRingEnd ℂ (b₂.repr y₁ ij.2)) *
    (b₁.repr x₂ ij.1) * (b₂.repr y₂ ij.2) =
    ((starRingEnd ℂ (b₁.repr x₁ ij.1)) * (b₁.repr x₂ ij.1)) *
    ((starRingEnd ℂ (b₂.repr y₁ ij.2)) * (b₂.repr y₂ ij.2)) := by
    intro ij; ring
  simp_rw [h_rearrange]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [← inner_eq_sum_orthonormalBasis b₁ x₁ x₂,
      ← inner_eq_sum_orthonormalBasis b₂ y₁ y₂]

/-- The inner product formula gives the same result for any orthonormal basis.

theorem trace_re_le_one {ρ : E →ₗ[ℂ] E}
    (hρ : IsPartialDensityOperator ρ) :
    ((LinearMap.trace ℂ E) ρ).re ≤ 1 :=
  hρ.trace_re_le_one

/-! ## Combined bound: re(tr(A ∘ₗ ρ)) ≤ re(tr(ρ)) ≤ 1 -/

/-- **Proposition 4 (Expectation Bounded by Trace) [Ying, Section 5]**

    For a quantum effect A and partial density operator rho, the expectation
    value is bounded above by the trace of the state and ultimately by 1:

      Re(tr(A . rho)) <= Re(tr(rho)) <= 1

    The first inequality follows from Proposition 3 applied to the complement
    effect (I - A): since 0 <= Re(tr((I - A) . rho)) = Re(tr(rho)) - Re(tr(A . rho)),
    we get Re(tr(A . rho)) <= Re(tr(rho)). The second inequality is the
    sub-normalization condition on partial density operators.

    This bound is essential for the soundness of QHL+: it ensures that
    expectation values used in Hoare triple validity are well-behaved
    real numbers in [0, 1]. -/

preview.content_html:
What This Declaration Is Doing

`QHL.classSubstFormula` turns a classical state predicate `φ` into the predicate obtained after substituting an assignment `x := e`. Mathematically, it is the pullback of `φ` along the state-update map: a state `σ` satisfies `classSubstFormula sem x e φ` exactly when `φ` holds after updating `σ` by assigning to `x` the value of expression `e`. Its inputs are the program semantics `sem` (which knows how assignments change states), the variable `x`, the expression `e`, and the original formula `φ`; the output is a new formula on states. This is the standard device used in Hoare-style reasoning to express weakest-precondition style substitution for classical assertions.

    (Fin (pcats.predClassicalArity K) → Exp) →
    (Fin (pcats.predQuantumArity K) → QVar) →

    (Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp) →
    (Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar) →
    Fin (pcats.krausRank F) → (ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all)

      `∑ Eᵢ ∘ Eᵢ† ≤ I` (eq-pre-normal in the paper).

      (F_U = U†, F_M = M†), so this condition ∑ FF† ≤ I is equivalent to the standard

/-! ## Interpretation of Quantum Predicate Formulas

The interpretation `σ(A)` is defined by structural recursion on the formula `A`:
(1) Atomic: `σ(K(t̄)[q̄]) = atomInterp(K, σ, t̄, q̄)`
(2) Complement: `σ(¬B) = I - σ(B)`
(3) Tensor: `σ(A₁ ⊗ A₂) = σ(A₁) ∘ σ(A₂)` (composition on `H_all`;
    for operators on disjoint tensor factors, `(A₁ ⊗ I)(I ⊗ A₂) = A₁ ⊗ A₂`)
(4) Kraus: `σ(F(t̄)[q̄]({Bᵢ})) = ∑ᵢ Eᵢ ∘ σ(Bᵢ) ∘ Eᵢ†`
-/

    a classical state `σ`, returning a linear operator on the total Hilbert space `H_all`.

    - **Complement**: `σ(¬B) = I - σ(B)`.
    - **Tensor**: `σ(A₁ ⊗ A₂) = σ(A₁) ∘ σ(A₂)`, which equals `σ(A₁) ⊗ σ(A₂)` on `H_all`

    - **Kraus**: `σ(F(t̄)[q̄]({Bᵢ})) = ∑ᵢ Eᵢ ∘ σ(Bᵢ) ∘ Eᵢ†`, the Kraus action
      (Definition 6) applied to the sub-formula interpretations.

    Paper reference: Definition 4.4 (interpretation of quantum predicates) of [Ying,
    "A Practical Quantum Hoare Logic with Classical Variables, I", 2025]. -/

structure ProgramSemantics (CVar : Type*) (Exp : Type*) (BExp : Type*)
    (QVar : Type*) (Gate : Type*) (Meas : Type*)
    [cats : QWhileSyntaxCats CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas]
    (ctx : ProgramContext) where
  /-- Classical state update for assignment `x := e`: returns `σ[x := σ(e)]`. -/
  classicalUpdate : ClassicalState ctx → CVar → Exp → ClassicalState ctx
  /-- Boolean expression evaluation: `σ ⊨ b` iff `boolEval σ b` holds. -/
  boolEval : ClassicalState ctx → BExp → Prop
  /-- Boolean evaluation is decidable. -/
  boolEval_dec : ∀ σ b, Decidable (boolEval σ b)
  /-- Quantum initialization transform: given classical state σ, quantum variable q,
      transforms ρ to `Σₙ |0⟩_{σ(q)}⟨n| ρ |n⟩_{σ(q)}⟨0|`. -/
  qInitTransform : ClassicalState ctx → QVar →
    (ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all) → (ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all)
  /-- The init transform preserves partial density operators. -/
  qInitTransform_pdo : ∀ σ q ρ, IsPartialDensityOperator ρ →
    IsPartialDensityOperator (qInitTransform σ q ρ)
  /-- The unitary operator `U_σ ∈ L(H_all)` for a gate application: given the gate symbol,
      classical state (for parameter evaluation), classical parameters, and quantum variables,
      returns the operator that acts as the gate on the relevant tensor factor and
      as identity elsewhere. -/
  unitaryOp : (U : Gate) → ClassicalState ctx →
    (Fin (cats.gateClassicalArity U) → Exp) →
    (Fin (cats.gateQuantumArity U) → QVar) →
    (ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all)
  /-- The unitary transform `ρ ↦ U_σ ρ U_σ†` preserves partial density operators. -/
  unitaryTransform_pdo : ∀ (U : Gate) (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
    (params : Fin (cats.gateClassicalArity U) → Exp)
    (qvars : Fin (cats.gateQuantumArity U) → QVar)
    (ρ : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all),
    IsPartialDensityOperator ρ →
    IsPartialDensityOperator
      ((unitaryOp U σ params qvars).comp (ρ.comp (unitaryOp U σ params qvars).adjoint))
  /-- The measurement operator `Mₘ^σ ∈ L(H_all)` for a given measurement symbol,
      classical state, quantum variables, and outcome `m`. -/
  measOp : (M : Meas) → ClassicalState ctx →
    (Fin (cats.measQuantumArity M) → QVar) →
    (cats.measOutcomeType M) →
    (ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all)
  /-- The measurement transform `ρ ↦ Mₘ^σ ρ (Mₘ^σ)†` preserves partial density operators. -/
  measTransform_pdo : ∀ (M : Meas) (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
    (qvars : Fin (cats.measQuantumArity M) → QVar)
    (m : cats.measOutcomeType M)
    (ρ : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all),
    IsPartialDensityOperator ρ →
    IsPartialDensityOperator
      ((measOp M σ qvars m).comp (ρ.comp (measOp M σ qvars m).adjoint))
  /-- Classical state update for measurement `x := M[q̄]` with outcome `m`:
      returns `σ[x := m]`. -/
  measClassicalUpdate : ClassicalState ctx → CVar →
    (M : Meas) → (cats.measOutcomeType M) → ClassicalState ctx
  /-- **Unitarity**: The gate operator satisfies `U†U = I`, i.e., U is an isometry.
      This is the defining property of unitary gates (Definition 2.1 in the paper). -/
  unitaryOp_isUnitary : ∀ (U : Gate) (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
    (params : Fin (cats.gateClassicalArity U) → Exp)
    (qvars : Fin (cats.gateQuantumArity U) → QVar),
    (unitaryOp U σ params qvars).adjoint ∘ₗ (unitaryOp U σ params qvars) = LinearMap.id
  /-- **Kraus sub-normalization**: The measurement operators form a sub-normalized family,
      i.e., `∑_m M_m† M_m` is a quantum effect (0 ≤ S ≤ I).
      This is part of the semantic interpretation in Definition 12. -/
  measOp_sum_isQuantumEffect : ∀ (M : Meas) (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
    (qvars : Fin (cats.measQuantumArity M) → QVar),
    IsQuantumEffect (∑ m : cats.measOutcomeType M,
      LinearMap.adjoint (measOp M σ qvars m) ∘ₗ (measOp M σ qvars m))
  /-- **Init as Kraus channel**: The quantum initialization transform `q := |0⟩` is
      expressible as a Kraus quantum operation, i.e., there exist operators `K_n = |0⟩⟨n|`
      with `∑ K_n† K_n ≤ I` such that `qInitTransform σ q ρ = ∑ K_n ρ K_n†`.
      In the original proof, `K_n = |0⟩⟨n|` and `∑ K_n† K_n = ∑ |n⟩⟨n| = I`. -/
  qInitTransform_kraus : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (q : QVar),
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (ops : Fin k → (ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all)),
      IsKrausFamily k ops ∧
      ∀ (ρ : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all),
        qInitTransform σ q ρ = krausApply k ops ρ
  /-- **Measurement classical update injectivity**: `measClassicalUpdate σ x M` is
      injective in the outcome `m`. This holds because the classical update
      stores the measurement outcome `m` in the variable `x`. -/
  measClassicalUpdate_injective : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (x : CVar) (M : Meas),
    Function.Injective (fun m => measClassicalUpdate σ x M m)

lemma expectationValue_complement (A ρ : E →ₗ[ℂ] E) :

/-- The complement of a quantum effect is again a quantum effect. -/
private lemma complement_isQuantumEffect {A : E →ₗ[ℂ] E}
    (hA : IsQuantumEffect A) :
    IsQuantumEffect (1 - A) := by
  constructor
  · exact hA.complement_isPositive
  · simpa [sub_sub_cancel] using hA.isPositive

/-- Rewrite the expectation of the complement effect as a trace difference. -/
private lemma expectationValue_complement_eq_trace_sub
    (A ρ : E →ₗ[ℂ] E) :
    expectationValue (1 - A) ρ =
      (LinearMap.trace ℂ E) ρ - expectationValue A ρ := by
  rw [← expectationValue_one ρ, ← expectationValue_complement]

/-! ## Step 1: re(tr(A ∘ₗ ρ)) ≤ re(tr(ρ)) -/

/-- **Proposition 4, Step 1 (abstract)**: For a quantum effect A and partial density
operator ρ, `re(tr(A ∘ₗ ρ)) ≤ re(tr(ρ))`.

Proof: `(1 - A)` is positive (from IsQuantumEffect), and ρ is positive
(from IsPartialDensityOperator), so by Prop 3, `0 ≤ re(tr((1 - A) ∘ₗ ρ))`.
Since `tr((1 - A) ∘ₗ ρ) = tr(ρ) - tr(A ∘ₗ ρ)`, we get the result. -/

private lemma expectationValue_sub_eq
    (A B ρ : E →ₗ[ℂ] E) :
    expectationValue (B - A) ρ =
      expectationValue B ρ - expectationValue A ρ :=
  expectationValue_sub B A ρ

/-- **Proposition 5 (Expectation Monotonicity) [Ying, Section 5]**

    If A <= B in the Loewner order (i.e., B - A is positive semidefinite)
    for quantum effects A, B, and rho is a partial density operator, then
    the expectation values are ordered:

      Re(tr(A . rho)) <= Re(tr(B . rho))

    This monotonicity property is crucial for the Consequence Rule of QHL+:
    when strengthening a precondition or weakening a postcondition via the
    Loewner order, the expectation inequality in the Hoare triple is preserved.

    Proof: Since A <= B, the difference (B - A) is a quantum effect, so by
    Proposition 3, 0 <= Re(tr((B - A) . rho)) = Re(tr(B . rho)) - Re(tr(A . rho)). -/

  ⟨tc + 1 + k.val, by omega⟩

theorem countingQubit_injective : Function.Injective (countingQubit tc nc) := by
  intro a b h; simp [countingQubit, Fin.ext_iff] at h; exact Fin.ext h

theorem targetQubit_injective : Function.Injective (targetQubit tc nc) := by
  intro a b h; simp [targetQubit, Fin.ext_iff] at h; exact Fin.ext (by omega)

/-- Gates: H (1-qubit), CU_pow(2^(t-j)) (controlled modular exponentiation),
    QFT_inv (inverse QFT on t counting qubits).
    CU_pow j represents the gate CU_pow(2^(t-j)) applied to counting qubit c[j]
    where j : Fin (tc + 1) ranges over 1-indexed counting qubits.
    Concretely: CU_pow(2^(t-1))[c[1], q̄], CU_pow(2^(t-2))[c[2], q̄], ..., CU_pow(2^0)[c[t], q̄].
    Using 0-indexed j : Fin t, the power is 2^(t-1-j). -/
inductive ShorGate (tc nc : ℕ) : Type
  | H : ShorGate tc nc
  | CU_pow : Fin (tc + 1) → ShorGate tc nc   -- CU_pow(2^(t-j)) for the j-th counting qubit (1-indexed)
  | QFT_inv : ShorGate tc nc

  deriving DecidableEq

  | zero : ShorMeasOutcome
  | one : ShorMeasOutcome
  deriving DecidableEq

  elems := {.zero, .one}
  complete := fun | .zero => Finset.mem_insert_self _ _

    | .CU_pow _ => nc + 2     -- 1 control (counting) + (nc + 1) target qubits
    | .QFT_inv => tc + 1      -- all t counting qubits

theorem cuQvars_distinct (j : Fin (tc + 1)) :
    ∀ i₁ i₂ : Fin (nc + 2), i₁ ≠ i₂ → cuQvars tc nc j i₁ ≠ cuQvars tc nc j i₂ := by
  intro ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ hab

  cases a with

    | zero => exact absurd rfl hab
    | succ b' =>

  | succ a' =>

    | succ b' =>
      simp [targetQubit, Fin.ext_iff]
      intro h; exact absurd (Fin.ext (by simp [Fin.ext_iff] at hab ⊢; omega)) hab

theorem adjoint_comp_adjoint_le_one_of_comp_adjoint_le_one
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
    (K : E →ₗ[ℂ] E)
    (hK : @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE
      ((LinearMap.adjoint K).comp K) 1) :
    @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE
      (K.comp (LinearMap.adjoint K)) 1 := by
  haveI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  rw [loewnerOrder_iff]
  rw [loewnerOrder_iff] at hK
  -- hK : (1 - K†K).IsPositive, i.e. ∀v, ‖Kv‖² ≤ ‖v‖²
  -- Goal: (1 - KK†).IsPositive, i.e. ∀v, ‖K†v‖² ≤ ‖v‖²
  constructor
  · -- Symmetry of (1 - KK†): KK† is self-adjoint since (KK†)† = K†† K† = KK†
    intro x y
    simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.End.one_apply, inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right]
    congr 1
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
    -- ⟪K(K†x), y⟫ = ⟪K†x, K†y⟫ = ⟪x, K(K†y)⟫
    rw [← LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right K (LinearMap.adjoint K x) y]
    exact LinearMap.adjoint_inner_left K (LinearMap.adjoint K y) x
  · -- Non-negativity: ∀v, 0 ≤ re⟨v,v⟩ - re⟨K(K†v), v⟩ = ‖v‖² - ‖K†v‖²
    intro v
    simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.End.one_apply, inner_sub_left,
      LinearMap.comp_apply, map_sub]
    -- re⟨K(K†v), v⟩ = re⟨K†v, K†v⟩ by adjoint
    have hKadj_inner : RCLike.re ⟪K (LinearMap.adjoint K v), v⟫_ℂ =
        RCLike.re ⟪LinearMap.adjoint K v, LinearMap.adjoint K v⟫_ℂ := by
      congr 1
      exact (LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right K (LinearMap.adjoint K v) v).symm
    rw [hKadj_inner]
    -- Now goal: 0 ≤ re⟨v,v⟩ - re⟨K†v, K†v⟩ = ‖v‖² - ‖K†v‖²
    -- From hK: ‖Kw‖ ≤ ‖w‖ for all w, then Cauchy-Schwarz gives ‖K†v‖ ≤ ‖v‖

    -- Step 1: From hK, derive ‖Kw‖² ≤ ‖w‖² for all w
    have hKnorm : ∀ w : E, ‖K w‖ * ‖K w‖ ≤ ‖w‖ * ‖w‖ := by
      intro w
      have h1 := hK.2 w
      simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.End.one_apply, inner_sub_left,
        LinearMap.comp_apply, map_sub] at h1
      rw [LinearMap.adjoint_inner_left] at h1
      have h2 : RCLike.re ⟪K w, K w⟫_ℂ = ‖K w‖ * ‖K w‖ := by
        rw [inner_self_eq_norm_mul_norm]
      have h3 : RCLike.re ⟪w, w⟫_ℂ = ‖w‖ * ‖w‖ := by
        rw [inner_self_eq_norm_mul_norm]
      linarith [h2, h3]
    -- Step 2: ‖K(K†v)‖² ≤ ‖K†v‖² (apply hKnorm to w = K†v)
    have hKnorm_adj : ‖K (LinearMap.adjoint K v)‖ * ‖K (LinearMap.adjoint K v)‖ ≤
        ‖LinearMap.adjoint K v‖ * ‖LinearMap.adjoint K v‖ :=
      hKnorm (LinearMap.adjoint K v)

    -- Use Cauchy-Schwarz: |⟨K(K†v), v⟩| ≤ ‖K(K†v)‖ · ‖v‖
    have hCS := norm_inner_le_norm (𝕜 := ℂ) (K (LinearMap.adjoint K v)) v
    -- re⟨K(K†v), v⟩ ≤ |⟨K(K†v), v⟩|
    have hre_le_abs : RCLike.re ⟪K (LinearMap.adjoint K v), v⟫_ℂ ≤
        ‖⟪K (LinearMap.adjoint K v), v⟫_ℂ‖ := RCLike.re_le_norm _
    -- ‖K(K†v)‖ ≤ ‖K†v‖ from hKnorm_adj
    have hKKadj_le : ‖K (LinearMap.adjoint K v)‖ ≤ ‖LinearMap.adjoint K v‖ := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖K (LinearMap.adjoint K v)‖ - ‖LinearMap.adjoint K v‖),
                 norm_nonneg (K (LinearMap.adjoint K v)),
                 norm_nonneg (LinearMap.adjoint K v)]
    -- Combine: re⟨K†v, K†v⟩ ≤ ‖K(K†v)‖·‖v‖ ≤ ‖K†v‖·‖v‖
    have hbound :
        RCLike.re ⟪LinearMap.adjoint K v, LinearMap.adjoint K v⟫_ℂ ≤
        ‖LinearMap.adjoint K v‖ * ‖v‖ := by
      calc RCLike.re ⟪LinearMap.adjoint K v, LinearMap.adjoint K v⟫_ℂ
          = RCLike.re ⟪K (LinearMap.adjoint K v), v⟫_ℂ := hKadj_inner.symm
        _ ≤ ‖⟪K (LinearMap.adjoint K v), v⟫_ℂ‖ := hre_le_abs
        _ ≤ ‖K (LinearMap.adjoint K v)‖ * ‖v‖ := hCS
        _ ≤ ‖LinearMap.adjoint K v‖ * ‖v‖ := by
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hKKadj_le (norm_nonneg v)
    -- re⟨K†v, K†v⟩ = ‖K†v‖² and re⟨v,v⟩ = ‖v‖²
    have _h_Kadj_sq :
        RCLike.re ⟪LinearMap.adjoint K v, LinearMap.adjoint K v⟫_ℂ =
        ‖LinearMap.adjoint K v‖ * ‖LinearMap.adjoint K v‖ := by
      rw [inner_self_eq_norm_mul_norm]
    have hnorm_sq_v : RCLike.re ⟪v, v⟫_ℂ = ‖v‖ * ‖v‖ := by
      rw [inner_self_eq_norm_mul_norm]
    rw [hnorm_sq_v]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖K (LinearMap.adjoint K v)‖ - ‖v‖)]

/-- The trace of a product of positive semidefinite operators is non-negative:
    if A ≥ 0 and B ≥ 0, then re(tr(AB)) ≥ 0.

    Proof: convert to matrices via `stdOrthonormalBasis`, where `IsPositive` becomes
    `PosSemidef`, then apply the matrix-level `trace_mul_re_nonneg_of_posSemidef`
    (which uses CFC.sqrt to factor B = S*S and trace cyclicity). -/

lemma adjoint_comp_loewner_comp (T A B : E →ₗ[ℂ] E)
    (hle : (B - A).IsPositive) :
    @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE
      (LinearMap.adjoint T ∘ₗ A ∘ₗ T)
      (LinearMap.adjoint T ∘ₗ B ∘ₗ T) := by

  -- = T† ∘ (B - A) ∘ T
  have hsub : LinearMap.adjoint T ∘ₗ B ∘ₗ T - LinearMap.adjoint T ∘ₗ A ∘ₗ T =
      LinearMap.adjoint T ∘ₗ (B - A) ∘ₗ T := by
    ext v
    simp [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, map_sub]
  rw [hsub]

theorem forward_sandwich_mono
    (K : E →ₗ[ℂ] E) (A B : E →ₗ[ℂ] E)
    (hle : @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE A B) :
    @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE
      (K.comp (A.comp (LinearMap.adjoint K)))
      (K.comp (B.comp (LinearMap.adjoint K))) := by
  haveI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  rw [loewnerOrder_iff] at hle ⊢
  -- Goal: (K∘B∘K† - K∘A∘K†).IsPositive
  -- Rewrite as K∘(B-A)∘K†
  have heq : K.comp (B.comp (LinearMap.adjoint K)) -
      K.comp (A.comp (LinearMap.adjoint K)) =
      K.comp ((B - A).comp (LinearMap.adjoint K)) := by
    ext v
    simp [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, map_sub]
  rw [heq]
  exact forward_sandwich_isPositive K (B - A) hle

private theorem innerProductTensorProductBasis_tmul
    {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [Fintype ι₂]
    (b₁ : OrthonormalBasis ι₁ ℂ H₁) (b₂ : OrthonormalBasis ι₂ ℂ H₂)
    (x₁ : H₁) (y₁ : H₂) (x₂ : H₁) (y₂ : H₂) :
    innerProductTensorProductBasis H₁ H₂ b₁ b₂ (x₁ ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y₁) (x₂ ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y₂) =
    @inner ℂ H₁ _ x₁ x₂ * @inner ℂ H₂ _ y₁ y₂ := by
  unfold innerProductTensorProductBasis
  simp only
  rw [show (∑ ij : ι₁ × ι₂,
        (starRingEnd ℂ)
          ((b₁.toBasis.tensorProduct b₂.toBasis).repr (x₁ ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y₁) ij) *
        (b₁.toBasis.tensorProduct b₂.toBasis).repr (x₂ ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y₂) ij) =
      (∑ ij : ι₁ × ι₂,
        (starRingEnd ℂ (b₁.repr x₁ ij.1)) * (starRingEnd ℂ (b₂.repr y₁ ij.2)) *
        (b₁.repr x₂ ij.1) * (b₂.repr y₂ ij.2))
      from sum_tensorProduct_factor b₁ b₂ x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂]
  have h_rearrange : ∀ ij : ι₁ × ι₂,
    (starRingEnd ℂ (b₁.repr x₁ ij.1)) * (starRingEnd ℂ (b₂.repr y₁ ij.2)) *
    (b₁.repr x₂ ij.1) * (b₂.repr y₂ ij.2) =
    ((starRingEnd ℂ (b₁.repr x₁ ij.1)) * (b₁.repr x₂ ij.1)) *
    ((starRingEnd ℂ (b₂.repr y₁ ij.2)) * (b₂.repr y₂ ij.2)) := by
    intro ij; ring
  simp_rw [h_rearrange]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [← inner_eq_sum_orthonormalBasis b₁ x₁ x₂,
      ← inner_eq_sum_orthonormalBasis b₂ y₁ y₂]

where `ι_i(ψ) = ψ ⊗ e_i` and `φ_i(ψ ⊗ φ) = ⟨e_i, φ⟩ · ψ`. -/
def partialTraceBasis {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℂ H_B)
    (X : (TensorProduct ℂ H_A H_B) →ₗ[ℂ] (TensorProduct ℂ H_A H_B)) :
    H_A →ₗ[ℂ] H_A :=
  ∑ i : ι, (contractionMap (b i)).comp (X.comp (embeddingMap (b i)))

/-- Partial trace using the standard orthonormal basis (basis-independent definition). -/
def partialTrace :
    ((TensorProduct ℂ H_A H_B) →ₗ[ℂ] (TensorProduct ℂ H_A H_B)) →ₗ[ℂ] (H_A →ₗ[ℂ] H_A) := {
  toFun := fun X => partialTraceBasis (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H_B) X
  map_add' := by
    intro X Y
    unfold partialTraceBasis
    simp only [LinearMap.add_comp, LinearMap.comp_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' := by
    intro c X
    unfold partialTraceBasis
    simp only [LinearMap.smul_comp, LinearMap.comp_smul, Finset.smul_sum,
      RingHom.id_apply]
}

notation "Tr_B" => partialTrace

/-! ## Step 4: Orthonormality Helper Lemmas -/

/-- Diagonal orthonormality: `⟨e_i, e_i⟩ = 1`. -/
theorem stdBasis_inner_self (i : Fin (Module.finrank ℂ H_B)) :
    @inner ℂ H_B _ (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H_B i) (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H_B i) = (1 : ℂ) := by
  have hnorm := (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H_B).orthonormal.1 i
  rw [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, hnorm]
  norm_num

/-- Off-diagonal orthonormality: `⟨e_i, e_j⟩ = 0` when `i ≠ j`. -/
theorem stdBasis_inner_of_ne {i j : Fin (Module.finrank ℂ H_B)} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    @inner ℂ H_B _ (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H_B i) (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H_B j) = (0 : ℂ) := by
  exact (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H_B).orthonormal.2 hij

/-- Contraction and embedding with the same basis vector are inverse: `φ_i ∘ ι_i = id`. -/
theorem contractionMap_embeddingMap_same
    (i : Fin (Module.finrank ℂ H_B)) (a : H_A) :
    contractionMap (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H_B i)
                   (embeddingMap (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H_B i) a) = a := by
  rw [embeddingMap_apply, contractionMap_tmul]
  rw [stdBasis_inner_self]
  simp only [one_smul]

/-- Contraction and embedding with different basis vectors annihilate: `φ_i ∘ ι_j = 0` for `i ≠ j`. -/
theorem contractionMap_embeddingMap_diff
    {i j : Fin (Module.finrank ℂ H_B)} (hij : i ≠ j) (a : H_A) :
    contractionMap (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H_B i)
                   (embeddingMap (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H_B j) a) = 0 := by
  rw [embeddingMap_apply, contractionMap_tmul]
  rw [stdBasis_inner_of_ne hij]
  simp only [zero_smul]

/-- Applying `A ⊗ B` to an embedded vector. -/
theorem tensorMap_embeddingMap
    (A : H_A →ₗ[ℂ] H_A) (B : H_B →ₗ[ℂ] H_B)
    (i : Fin (Module.finrank ℂ H_B)) (a : H_A) :
    (TensorProduct.map A B) (embeddingMap (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H_B i) a) =
    embeddingMap (B (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H_B i)) (A a) := by
  rw [embeddingMap_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul, embeddingMap_apply]

/-! ## Step 5: Key Property — Pure Tensor Partial Trace -/

/-- Pure tensor partial trace: `Tr_B(A ⊗ B) = tr(B) · A`. -/
theorem partialTrace_tensorProduct (A : H_A →ₗ[ℂ] H_A) (B : H_B →ₗ[ℂ] H_B) :
    partialTrace (TensorProduct.map A B) = (LinearMap.trace ℂ H_B B) • A := by
  unfold partialTrace partialTraceBasis
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
  ext ψ
  simp only [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  -- Expand the embedding and contraction maps
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [2, i]
    rw [embeddingMap_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul, contractionMap_tmul]
  -- Simplify: ∑_i ⟨e_i, B e_i⟩ • A ψ = (∑_i ⟨e_i, B e_i⟩) • A ψ
  rw [← Finset.sum_smul]
  congr 1
  -- Trace as sum of diagonal inner products
  have h_trace : LinearMap.trace ℂ H_B B =
      ∑ i, @inner ℂ H_B _ (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H_B i)
                            (B (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H_B i)) := by
    exact B.trace_eq_sum_inner (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H_B)
  rw [← h_trace]

/-! ## Step 6: Application Helper -/

/-- Apply partial trace to an operator (explicit wrapper for clarity). -/
def applyPartialTrace
    (X_AB : (TensorProduct ℂ H_A H_B) →ₗ[ℂ] (TensorProduct ℂ H_A H_B)) :
    H_A →ₗ[ℂ] H_A :=
  partialTrace X_AB

end QHL.Quantum.PartialTraceInfra

theorem qeffect_loewner_antisymm (A B : QEffect n)
    (hab : @LE.le _ QEffect.instLE A B)
    (hba : @LE.le _ QEffect.instLE B A) :
    A = B := by
  have hmat : A.mat = B.mat := by
    have h1 : (B.mat - A.mat).PosSemidef := hab
    have h2 : (A.mat - B.mat).PosSemidef := hba
    -- Use the abstract Löwner antisymmetry via the matrix-to-linear-map bridge
    have hab' : @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder _).toPreorder.toLE
        A.mat.toEuclideanLin B.mat.toEuclideanLin := by
      rw [loewnerOrder_iff]
      rw [matrix_posSemidef_iff_isPositive] at h1
      convert h1 using 1
      ext v
      simp [LinearMap.sub_apply, Matrix.toEuclideanLin]
    have hba' : @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder _).toPreorder.toLE
        B.mat.toEuclideanLin A.mat.toEuclideanLin := by
      rw [loewnerOrder_iff]
      rw [matrix_posSemidef_iff_isPositive] at h2
      convert h2 using 1
      ext v
      simp [LinearMap.sub_apply, Matrix.toEuclideanLin]
    have := loewnerOrder_antisymm hab' hba'
    exact Matrix.toEuclideanLin.injective this
  cases A; cases B; simp_all

theorem single_comp_adjoint_subnormalized
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (ops : ι → (E →ₗ[ℂ] E))
    (hK : @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE
      (∑ i, (ops i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (ops i))) 1)
    (i : ι) :
    @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE
      ((ops i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (ops i))) 1 := by
  classical
  haveI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  -- KᵢKᵢ† ≤ ∑KK† ≤ I by transitivity
  suffices h : @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE
      ((ops i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (ops i)))
      (∑ j, (ops j).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (ops j))) by
    exact le_trans h hK
  -- Show: (∑KK† - KᵢKᵢ†).IsPositive
  rw [loewnerOrder_iff]
  have heq : (∑ j, (ops j).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (ops j))) -
      (ops i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (ops i)) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        (ops j).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (ops j)) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_erase_eq_sub (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  rw [heq]
  -- Sum of PSD operators is PSD. Each KⱼKⱼ† is PSD.
  apply Finset.sum_induction
  · exact fun a b ha hb => ha.add hb
  · exact ⟨fun x y => by simp, fun v => by simp⟩
  · intro j _
    -- KⱼKⱼ† = (Kⱼ†)†(Kⱼ†) is PSD (adjoint_comp_self with K = Kⱼ†)
    have : (ops j).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (ops j)) =
        (LinearMap.adjoint (LinearMap.adjoint (ops j))).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (ops j)) := by
      rw [LinearMap.adjoint_adjoint]
    rw [this]
    exact adjoint_comp_self_isPositive (LinearMap.adjoint (ops j))

/-- Adjoint sandwich preserves PDO using the `∑ KK† ≤ I` convention.
    From `∑ KᵢKᵢ† ≤ I`, we extract `KᵢKᵢ† ≤ I`, derive `Kᵢ†Kᵢ ≤ I`,
    then apply `adjoint_sandwich_isPDO`. -/

theorem sum_forward_sandwich_isPositive {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (K : ι → (E →ₗ[ℂ] E)) (A : ι → (E →ₗ[ℂ] E))
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsPositive) :
    (∑ i, (K i).comp ((A i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (K i)))).IsPositive := by
  haveI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  apply Finset.sum_induction
  · exact fun a b ha hb => ha.add hb
  · exact ⟨fun x y => by simp, fun v => by simp⟩
  · intro i _; exact forward_sandwich_isPositive (K i) (A i) (hA i)

/-- If ∑ Eᵢ Eᵢ† ≤ I (dual sub-normalization) and each Aᵢ ≤ I,
    then ∑ Eᵢ Aᵢ Eᵢ† ≤ I.
    Proof: ⟨(I-∑EAE†)v, v⟩ = ⟨v,v⟩ - ∑⟨A(E†v), E†v⟩
           ≥ ⟨v,v⟩ - ∑⟨E†v, E†v⟩ (since A ≤ I)
           = ⟨(I-∑EE†)v, v⟩ ≥ 0. -/

theorem sum_forward_sandwich_le_one {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (K : ι → (E →ₗ[ℂ] E))
    (hK : @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE
      (∑ i, (K i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (K i))) 1)
    (A : ι → (E →ₗ[ℂ] E))
    (hA : ∀ i, @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE (A i) 1) :
    @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE
      (∑ i, (K i).comp ((A i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (K i)))) 1 := by
  haveI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  -- Pointwise: EAE† ≤ EE† from A ≤ I
  have hpw : ∀ i, @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE
      ((K i).comp ((A i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (K i))))
      ((K i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (K i))) := by
    intro i
    rw [loewnerOrder_iff]
    -- (EE† - EAE†) = E(I-A)E†, which is PSD since (I-A) is PSD (from A ≤ I)
    have hsub_eq : (K i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (K i)) -
        (K i).comp ((A i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (K i))) =
        (K i).comp (((1 : E →ₗ[ℂ] E) - A i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (K i))) := by
      ext v; simp [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, Module.End.one_apply, map_sub]
    rw [hsub_eq]
    exact forward_sandwich_isPositive (K i) (1 - A i) ((loewnerOrder_iff (A i) 1).mp (hA i))
  rw [loewnerOrder_iff]
  -- Decompose: 1-∑EAE† = (1-∑EE†) + ∑(EE†-EAE†), use IsPositive.add
  have heq : (1 : E →ₗ[ℂ] E) - ∑ i, (K i).comp ((A i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (K i))) =
      ((1 : E →ₗ[ℂ] E) - ∑ i, (K i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (K i))) +
      (∑ i, ((K i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (K i)) -
        (K i).comp ((A i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (K i))))) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact (sub_add_sub_cancel 1 (∑ i, (K i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (K i)))
      (∑ i, (K i).comp ((A i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (K i))))).symm
  rw [heq]
  apply LinearMap.IsPositive.add
  · rw [← loewnerOrder_iff]; exact hK
  · apply Finset.sum_induction
    · exact fun a b ha hb => ha.add hb
    · exact ⟨fun x y => by simp, fun v => by simp⟩
    · intro i _
      rw [← loewnerOrder_iff]; exact hpw i

/-! ## Main Theorem: interpFormula is always a Quantum Effect -/

/-- The interpretation of any quantum predicate formula is a quantum effect.
    Proof by structural induction on the formula.

    This is Lemma 4 in Ying's paper: "σ(A) is a quantum effect for all A".

    The `htensor_comm` hypothesis asserts that interpretations of formulas on
    disjoint register sets commute. This is a fundamental property of the tensor
    product structure of quantum mechanics: operators on disjoint tensor factors
    always commute. -/

def interpFormula {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (psem : PredicateSemantics CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    (σ : ClassicalState ctx) :
    {S : Finset QVar} →
    QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S →
    (ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all)
  | _, .atomic K params qvars _ =>
      psem.atomInterp K σ params qvars
  | _, .complement A =>
      1 - interpFormula psem σ A
  | _, .tensor A₁ A₂ _ =>
      (interpFormula psem σ A₁).comp (interpFormula psem σ A₂)
  | _, .kraus F params qvars subFormulas _ _ =>
      ∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        (psem.krausInterp F σ params qvars i).comp
          ((interpFormula psem σ (subFormulas i)).comp
            (psem.krausInterp F σ params qvars i).adjoint)

/-! ## Unfolding Lemmas -/
preview.content_html:
What This Declaration Is Doing

This declaration defines the semantic interpretation of a quantum-predicate formula, relative to a fixed program context, a chosen semantics for primitive predicates and Kraus operators, and a classical state \(\sigma\). Its output is always an operator on the full Hilbert space of the context, so the definition turns syntactic formulas into their corresponding linear-operator semantics. Mathematically, it is a recursive interpretation map: atomic formulas are interpreted by the supplied primitive semantics, complement is sent to operator complement \(I-A\), the tensor-like connective is interpreted by operator composition, and a Kraus-formula is interpreted by the usual sum over Kraus branches \(\sum_i K_i \circ A_i \circ K_i^*\).

    (x : CVar) (e : Exp)
    (hqvInj : Function.Injective (qvarSubst x e))
    {S : Finset QVar}
    (A : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S) :
    QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym
      (S.image (qvarSubst x e)) :=
  match A with
  | .atomic K params qvars hdist =>
      -- q̄[e/x]: substitute in quantum variable subscripts
      -- Output sig = image (qvSub ∘ qvars) univ = (image qvars univ).image qvSub
      have hSig : Finset.image (fun i => qvarSubst x e (qvars i)) Finset.univ =
          (Finset.image qvars Finset.univ).image (qvarSubst x e) := by
        rw [Finset.image_image]; rfl
      hSig ▸ .atomic K (fun i => expSubst x e (params i))
        (fun i => qvarSubst x e (qvars i))
        (fun i j hij => hqvInj.ne (hdist i j hij))
  | .complement B =>
      .complement (substFormula expSubst qvarSubst x e hqvInj B)
  | .tensor A₁ A₂ hdisj =>
      have hDisj' : Disjoint (Finset.image (qvarSubst x e) _)
          (Finset.image (qvarSubst x e) _) :=
        disjoint_image_of_injective _ hqvInj hdisj
      have hUnion : Finset.image (qvarSubst x e) _ ∪
          Finset.image (qvarSubst x e) _ =
          ((_ ∪ _) : Finset QVar).image (qvarSubst x e) :=
        (Finset.image_union _ _).symm
      hUnion ▸ .tensor (substFormula expSubst qvarSubst x e hqvInj A₁)
        (substFormula expSubst qvarSubst x e hqvInj A₂) hDisj'
  | .kraus F params qvars subFormulas hdist hsub =>
      .kraus F (fun i => expSubst x e (params i)) (fun i => qvarSubst x e (qvars i))
        (fun i => substFormula expSubst qvarSubst x e hqvInj (subFormulas i))
        (fun i j hij => hqvInj.ne (hdist i j hij))
        (fun i => Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (hsub i))

What This Declaration Is Doing

This definition performs capture-free substitution of a classical variable x by an expression e throughout a quantum-predicate formula. It acts uniformly on the classical expression parameters of the formula via expSubst, and also on the quantum-variable indices/subscripts via qvarSubst, so the formula’s support set of quantum variables changes from S to its image under that renaming. The injectivity assumption on qvarSubst x e is the key mathematical side condition: it guarantees that distinct quantum variables remain distinct after substitution, so atomic predicates, tensor-factor disjointness, and Kraus-family side conditions are preserved. In short, the result is the same logical formula after substitution, but now regarded over the transformed set of quantum variables.

theorem expectationValue_re_nonneg {A ρ : E →ₗ[ℂ] E}
    (hA : IsQuantumEffect A) (hρ : IsPartialDensityOperator ρ) :
    0 ≤ (expectationValue A ρ).re := by
  classical
  -- Convert to matrices via the standard orthonormal basis
  let b := stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ E
  -- The matrices of A and ρ are PSD
  have hA_psd : (LinearMap.toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis A).PosSemidef :=
    (LinearMap.posSemidef_toMatrix_iff b).mpr hA.isPositive
  have hρ_psd : (LinearMap.toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis ρ).PosSemidef :=
    (LinearMap.posSemidef_toMatrix_iff b).mpr hρ.isPositive
  rw [expectationValue_eq_matrix_trace A ρ]
  exact trace_mul_re_nonneg_of_posSemidef hA_psd hρ_psd

def qftInvQvars : Fin (tc + 1) → Fin (tc + nc + 2) := countingQubit tc nc

theorem qftInvQvars_distinct :
    ∀ i₁ i₂ : Fin (tc + 1), i₁ ≠ i₂ → qftInvQvars tc nc i₁ ≠ qftInvQvars tc nc i₂ := by
  intro i₁ i₂ h
  exact fun heq => h (countingQubit_injective tc nc heq)

/-- Map PrepEigen gate qubits: all n target qubits q_1,...,q_n. -/
def prepEigenQvars : Fin (nc + 1) → Fin (tc + nc + 2) := targetQubit tc nc

theorem prepEigenQvars_distinct :
    ∀ i₁ i₂ : Fin (nc + 1), i₁ ≠ i₂ → prepEigenQvars tc nc i₁ ≠ prepEigenQvars tc nc i₂ := by
  intro i₁ i₂ h
  exact fun heq => h (targetQubit_injective tc nc heq)

/-! ## Signature: All Qubits -/

def sigAll : Finset (Fin (tc + nc + 2)) := Finset.univ

/-! ## Program Construction

  The phase estimation program:
    c_1 := |0⟩; ...; c_t := |0⟩; q_1 := |0⟩; ...; q_n := |0⟩;
    PREPARE_EIGENSTATE[q_1,...,q_n];
    H[c_1]; ...; H[c_t];
    CU_pow(2^{t-1})[c_1, q_1,...,q_n]; ...; CU_pow(2^0)[c_t, q_1,...,q_n];
    QFT_inv[c_1,...,c_t];
    m_1 := M[c_1]; ...; m_t := M[c_t]
-/

/-- Initialize counting qubit c_j (j ∈ Fin t): c_j := |0⟩. -/
def initCounting (j : Fin (tc + 1)) :
    QWhilePlus (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) :=
  .qInit (countingQubit tc nc j)

/-- Initialize target qubit q_k (k ∈ Fin n): q_k := |0⟩. -/
def initTarget (k : Fin (nc + 1)) :
    QWhilePlus (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) :=
  .qInit (targetQubit tc nc k)

/-- PREPARE_EIGENSTATE[q_1,...,q_n]: Prepare eigenstate on target register. -/
def prepEigen :
    QWhilePlus (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) :=
  .unitaryApp OFGate.PREPARE_EIGENSTATE Fin.elim0 (prepEigenQvars tc nc) (prepEigenQvars_distinct tc nc)

/-- H[c_j]: Apply Hadamard to counting qubit c_j. -/
def applyH (j : Fin (tc + 1)) :
    QWhilePlus (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) :=
  .unitaryApp OFGate.H Fin.elim0 (singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j))
    (fin1_distinct _)

/-- CU_pow(2^j)[c_j, q_1,...,q_n]: Apply controlled-U^{2^j} with control c_j. -/
def applyCU (j : Fin (tc + 1)) :
    QWhilePlus (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) :=
  .unitaryApp (OFGate.CU_pow j) Fin.elim0 (cuQvars tc nc j) (cuQvars_distinct tc nc j)

/-- QFT_inv[c_1,...,c_t]: Apply inverse QFT to counting register. -/
def applyQFTinv :
    QWhilePlus (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) :=
  .unitaryApp OFGate.QFT_inv Fin.elim0 (qftInvQvars tc nc) (qftInvQvars_distinct tc nc)

/-- m_j := M[c_j]: Measure counting qubit c_j, storing result in m_j. -/
def measureCounting (j : Fin (tc + 1)) :
    QWhilePlus (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) :=
  .measure (.m j) OFMeas.stdMeas (singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j)) (fin1_distinct _)

/-! ## Sequential Composition Helpers -/

/-- Chain a list of programs sequentially. -/
def seqList :
    List (QWhilePlus (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc)) →
    QWhilePlus (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc)
  | [] => .skip
  | [p] => p
  | p :: ps => .seq p (seqList ps)

/-! ## Quantum Predicate Formulas -/

private theorem allQvars_image_eq :
    Finset.image (id : Fin (tc + nc + 2) → Fin (tc + nc + 2)) Finset.univ = sigAll tc nc := by
  simp [sigAll, Finset.image_id]

def postPredicate :
    @QuantumPredicateFormula (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc) := by
  rw [← allQvars_image_eq tc nc]
  exact @QuantumPredicateFormula.atomic (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
    (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
    (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) OFAtomPred.postState Fin.elim0
    id (fun _ _ hij h => hij h)

def prePredicate :
    @QuantumPredicateFormula (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc) := by
  rw [← allQvars_image_eq tc nc]
  exact @QuantumPredicateFormula.atomic (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
    (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
    (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) OFAtomPred.preState Fin.elim0
    id (fun _ _ hij h => hij h)

/-! ## CQ-Assertions

A CQ-assertion is a pair (φ, A) where φ is a classical predicate on the classical
state σ and A is a quantum predicate formula on the quantum variables in S.

For phase estimation, the classical predicate φ is `fun _ => True` in both pre-
and postconditions.  This is a simplification: a more refined classical predicate
could track the relationship between measurement outcomes m_j and the phase φ
(e.g., that the binary string m_1...m_t approximates 2^t · φ).  The current
formulation focuses on the quantum state evolution.
-/

/-- Postcondition CQ-assertion: (True, postState).
    The quantum part `postState` represents the post-measurement density operator:
      Σ_{m=0}^{2^t-1} Pr(m) · |m⟩⟨m|[c_1,...,c_t] ⊗ |u⟩⟨u|[q_1,...,q_n]
    where Pr(m) is the probability of measuring outcome m on the counting register.
    The classical part φ = True means no constraint on classical variables. -/
def postCond (ctx : ProgramContext) :
    CQAssertion (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) ctx where
  S := sigAll tc nc
  φ := fun _ => True
  A := postPredicate tc nc

/-- Precondition CQ-assertion: (True, preState).
    The quantum part `preState` represents:
      |0⟩⟨0|^{⊗t}[c_1,...,c_t] ⊗ |u⟩⟨u|[q_1,...,q_n]
    i.e., counting qubits in |0⟩ and target register in eigenstate |u⟩ of U.
    The classical part φ = True means no constraint on classical variables. -/
def preCond (ctx : ProgramContext) :
    CQAssertion (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) ctx where
  S := sigAll tc nc
  φ := fun _ => True
  A := prePredicate tc nc

/-! ## Membership Lemmas -/

theorem singleQvar_mem_sigAll (q : Fin (tc + nc + 2)) :
    ∀ i : Fin 1, singleQvar tc nc q i ∈ sigAll tc nc :=
  fun _ => Finset.mem_univ _

theorem cuQvars_mem_sigAll (j : Fin (tc + 1)) :
    ∀ i : Fin (nc + 2), cuQvars tc nc j i ∈ sigAll tc nc :=
  fun _ => Finset.mem_univ _

theorem qftInvQvars_mem_sigAll :
    ∀ i : Fin (tc + 1), qftInvQvars tc nc i ∈ sigAll tc nc :=
  fun _ => Finset.mem_univ _

theorem prepEigenQvars_mem_sigAll :
    ∀ i : Fin (nc + 1), prepEigenQvars tc nc i ∈ sigAll tc nc :=
  fun _ => Finset.mem_univ _

/-! ## Backward-Chained Predicate Formulas (Kraus transforms) -/

def krausH (j : Fin (tc + 1))
    (A : @QuantumPredicateFormula (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc)) :
    @QuantumPredicateFormula (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc) :=
  .kraus OFKrausOpSym.unitH Fin.elim0 (singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j))
    (fun _ => A) (fin1_distinct _) (singleQvar_mem_sigAll tc nc _)

def krausCU (j : Fin (tc + 1))
    (A : @QuantumPredicateFormula (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc)) :
    @QuantumPredicateFormula (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc) :=
  .kraus (OFKrausOpSym.unitCU j) Fin.elim0 (cuQvars tc nc j)
    (fun _ => A) (cuQvars_distinct tc nc j) (cuQvars_mem_sigAll tc nc j)

def krausQFTinv
    (A : @QuantumPredicateFormula (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc)) :
    @QuantumPredicateFormula (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc) :=
  .kraus OFKrausOpSym.unitQFTinv Fin.elim0 (qftInvQvars tc nc)
    (fun _ => A) (qftInvQvars_distinct tc nc) (qftInvQvars_mem_sigAll tc nc)

def krausPrepEigen
    (A : @QuantumPredicateFormula (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc)) :
    @QuantumPredicateFormula (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc) :=
  .kraus OFKrausOpSym.unitPrepEigen Fin.elim0 (prepEigenQvars tc nc)
    (fun _ => A) (prepEigenQvars_distinct tc nc) (prepEigenQvars_mem_sigAll tc nc)

def krausInit (q : Fin (tc + nc + 2))
    (A : @QuantumPredicateFormula (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc)) :

def krausMeas (j : Fin (tc + 1))
    (A : @QuantumPredicateFormula (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _

      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _

/-- Make a CQ assertion from a quantum predicate formula with trivial classical part. -/
def mkCQAssertion
    (A : @QuantumPredicateFormula (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc))
    (ctx : ProgramContext) :
    CQAssertion (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) ctx where
  S := sigAll tc nc
  φ := fun _ => True
  A := A

/-! ## Trust Boundary and Bridge Instances

We use the gate bridge typeclasses from `QHL.Definitions.StandardGates`:
- `UnitaryKrausBridge sem psem U F_U`: rank-1 Kraus, K₀ = U†
- `InitKrausBridge sem psem F_B`: Kraus sum = qInit channel
- `MeasKrausBridge sem psem M F_M`: rank-1 Kraus for measurement

The `unitaryBridge_of`, `initBridge_of`, `measBridge_of` extraction functions
produce the exact form expected by `axiomUnitary`/`axiomInit`/`axiomMeasure`.
-/

variable {ctx : ProgramContext}
  (sem : ProgramSemantics (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
    (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) ctx)
  (psem : PredicateSemantics (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
    (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) ctx)
  (expSub : OFCVar tc → OFExp tc → OFExp tc → OFExp tc)
  (qvSub : OFCVar tc → OFExp tc → Fin (tc + nc + 2) → Fin (tc + nc + 2))

/-! ### Arity Equality Lemmas for `UnitaryKrausBridge`

The `UnitaryKrausBridge` typeclass requires `arity_eq : krausQuantumArity F_U = gateQuantumArity U`.
For our gates these are definitionally equal, so the cast `Fin.cast arity_eq` is the identity.
We provide qvars-agreement lemmas (`hQvars_*`) to satisfy the 5th argument of
`unitaryBridge_of`: `hQvars : fQvars = gateQvars ∘ Fin.cast arity_eq`.
Since fQvars = gateQvars for all our gates, these reduce to `ext i; simp`. -/

private theorem hQvars_H
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgramSemantics (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) ctx}
    {psem : PredicateSemantics (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) ctx}
    [h : UnitaryKrausBridge sem psem OFGate.H OFKrausOpSym.unitH]
    (j : Fin (tc + 1)) :
    singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j) =
    singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j) ∘ Fin.cast h.arity_eq := by
  ext i; simp [singleQvar]

private theorem hQvars_CU
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgramSemantics (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) ctx}
    {psem : PredicateSemantics (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) ctx}
    (j : Fin (tc + 1))
    [h : UnitaryKrausBridge sem psem (OFGate.CU_pow j) (OFKrausOpSym.unitCU j)] :
    cuQvars tc nc j = cuQvars tc nc j ∘ Fin.cast h.arity_eq := by
  ext i; simp

private theorem hQvars_QFTinv
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgramSemantics (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) ctx}
    {psem : PredicateSemantics (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) ctx}
    [h : UnitaryKrausBridge sem psem (OFGate.QFT_inv : OFGate tc nc) OFKrausOpSym.unitQFTinv] :
    qftInvQvars tc nc = qftInvQvars tc nc ∘ Fin.cast h.arity_eq := by
  ext i; simp

private theorem hQvars_PrepEigen
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgramSemantics (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) ctx}
    {psem : PredicateSemantics (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) ctx}
    [h : UnitaryKrausBridge sem psem (OFGate.PREPARE_EIGENSTATE : OFGate tc nc) OFKrausOpSym.unitPrepEigen] :
    prepEigenQvars tc nc = prepEigenQvars tc nc ∘ Fin.cast h.arity_eq := by
  ext i; simp

/-- Bridge hypothesis for m_j := M[c_j] (Layer 3).
    Unlike unitary gates, measurement bridges have additional classical-update
    conditions not captured by a single typeclass, so we bundle them explicitly:
    1. rank_one: the Kraus symbol has rank 1
    2. adjoint relation: K₀ = (measurement projector for outcome)†
    3. classical update coherence: measClassicalUpdate = classicalUpdate via y_j
    4. eqXY: the fresh-variable equality condition holds after measurement -/
def MeasBridge (j : Fin (tc + 1))
    (outcomeOf : ClassicalState ctx → OFMeasOutcome)
    (eqXY : ClassicalState ctx → Prop) : Prop :=
  ((ofPredCats tc nc).krausRank (OFKrausOpSym.measF j) = 1) ∧
  (∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
    (h1 : (ofPredCats tc nc).krausRank (OFKrausOpSym.measF j) = 1),
    psem.krausInterp (OFKrausOpSym.measF j) σ Fin.elim0
      (singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j))
      ⟨0, h1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ =
      (sem.measOp OFMeas.stdMeas σ (singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j))
        (outcomeOf σ)).adjoint) ∧
  (∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx,
    sem.measClassicalUpdate σ (.m j) OFMeas.stdMeas (outcomeOf σ) =
    sem.classicalUpdate σ (.m j) (.varRef (.y j))) ∧
  (∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx,
    eqXY (sem.measClassicalUpdate σ (.m j) OFMeas.stdMeas (outcomeOf σ)))

/-! ## Derivation Steps

Each derivation step proves a Hoare triple for a single gate application
using the corresponding QHL+ axiom (axiomUnitary, axiomInit, or axiomMeasure).
The precondition is always the backward-chained Kraus transform of the postcondition.

### Layer classification of external hypotheses

- **Layer 2** (semantic): `ProgramSemantics`, `PredicateSemantics` — the interpretation
  of programs and predicates in a concrete Hilbert space model.
- **Layer 3** (axiomatic bridge): `UnitaryKrausBridge`, `InitKrausBridge` instances —
  these assert that a Kraus symbol faithfully represents the gate's unitary/channel
  semantics.  They are assumed as typeclass instances and not derived from matrix
  definitions in this file.
-/

/-- Derivation step for H[c_j]: Hadamard gate on counting qubit c_j.
    Proves: {(True, K_H† · A · K_H)}  H[c_j]  {(True, A)}
    Uses: axiomUnitary with UnitaryKrausBridge for H (Layer 3 hypothesis). -/
theorem derivStep_H
    [UnitaryKrausBridge sem psem OFGate.H OFKrausOpSym.unitH]
    (j : Fin (tc + 1))
    (postA : @QuantumPredicateFormula (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc)) :
    QHLPlusTotDeriv sem psem expSub qvSub
      (mkCQAssertion tc nc (krausH tc nc j postA) ctx)
      (applyH tc nc j)
      (mkCQAssertion tc nc postA ctx) := by
  have hBridge := unitaryBridge_of (sem := sem) (psem := psem)
    (U := OFGate.H) (F_U := OFKrausOpSym.unitH)
    Fin.elim0 (singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j))
    Fin.elim0 (singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j))
    (hQvars_H (sem := sem) (psem := psem) tc nc j)
  exact @QHLPlusTotDeriv.axiomUnitary (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
    (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
    (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) ctx sem psem expSub qvSub
    OFGate.H Fin.elim0 (singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j)) (fin1_distinct _)
    (mkCQAssertion tc nc postA ctx)
    OFKrausOpSym.unitH Fin.elim0 (singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j))
    (fin1_distinct _) (singleQvar_mem_sigAll tc nc _) hBridge

/-- Derivation step for CU_pow(2^j): controlled-U^{2^j} with control qubit c_j
    and target qubits q_1,...,q_n.
    Proves: {(True, K_CU† · A · K_CU)}  CU_pow(2^j)[c_j, q̄]  {(True, A)}
    Uses: axiomUnitary with UnitaryKrausBridge for CU_pow j (Layer 3 hypothesis). -/
theorem derivStep_CU
    (j : Fin (tc + 1))
    [UnitaryKrausBridge sem psem (OFGate.CU_pow j) (OFKrausOpSym.unitCU j)]
    (postA : @QuantumPredicateFormula (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc)) :
    QHLPlusTotDeriv sem psem expSub qvSub
      (mkCQAssertion tc nc (krausCU tc nc j postA) ctx)
      (applyCU tc nc j)
      (mkCQAssertion tc nc postA ctx) := by
  have hBridge := unitaryBridge_of (sem := sem) (psem := psem)
    (U := OFGate.CU_pow j) (F_U := OFKrausOpSym.unitCU j)
    Fin.elim0 (cuQvars tc nc j)
    Fin.elim0 (cuQvars tc nc j)
    (hQvars_CU (sem := sem) (psem := psem) tc nc j)
  exact @QHLPlusTotDeriv.axiomUnitary (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
    (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
    (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) ctx sem psem expSub qvSub
    (OFGate.CU_pow j) Fin.elim0 (cuQvars tc nc j) (cuQvars_distinct tc nc j)
    (mkCQAssertion tc nc postA ctx)
    (OFKrausOpSym.unitCU j) Fin.elim0 (cuQvars tc nc j)
    (cuQvars_distinct tc nc j) (cuQvars_mem_sigAll tc nc j) hBridge

/-- Derivation step for QFT_inv: inverse QFT on all t counting qubits c_1,...,c_t.
    Proves: {(True, K_QFT⁻¹† · A · K_QFT⁻¹)}  QFT_inv[c̄]  {(True, A)}
    Uses: axiomUnitary with UnitaryKrausBridge for QFT_inv (Layer 3 hypothesis).
    The QFT_inv gate is treated as an opaque unitary; see QFT_subroutine.lean. -/
theorem derivStep_QFTinv
    [UnitaryKrausBridge sem psem (OFGate.QFT_inv : OFGate tc nc) OFKrausOpSym.unitQFTinv]
    (postA : @QuantumPredicateFormula (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc)) :
    QHLPlusTotDeriv sem psem expSub qvSub
      (mkCQAssertion tc nc (krausQFTinv tc nc postA) ctx)
      (applyQFTinv tc nc)
      (mkCQAssertion tc nc postA ctx) := by
  have hBridge := unitaryBridge_of (sem := sem) (psem := psem)
    (U := (OFGate.QFT_inv : OFGate tc nc)) (F_U := OFKrausOpSym.unitQFTinv)
    Fin.elim0 (qftInvQvars tc nc)
    Fin.elim0 (qftInvQvars tc nc)
    (hQvars_QFTinv (sem := sem) (psem := psem) tc nc)
  exact @QHLPlusTotDeriv.axiomUnitary (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
    (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
    (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) ctx sem psem expSub qvSub
    OFGate.QFT_inv Fin.elim0 (qftInvQvars tc nc) (qftInvQvars_distinct tc nc)
    (mkCQAssertion tc nc postA ctx)
    OFKrausOpSym.unitQFTinv Fin.elim0 (qftInvQvars tc nc)
    (qftInvQvars_distinct tc nc) (qftInvQvars_mem_sigAll tc nc) hBridge

/-- Derivation step for PREPARE_EIGENSTATE: prepare eigenstate |u⟩ on n target qubits.
    Proves: {(True, K_Prep† · A · K_Prep)}  PREPARE_EIGENSTATE[q̄]  {(True, A)}
    Uses: axiomUnitary with UnitaryKrausBridge for PREPARE_EIGENSTATE (Layer 3 hypothesis).
    This gate abstracts the preparation of an eigenstate |u⟩ of U on the target register. -/
theorem derivStep_PrepEigen
    [UnitaryKrausBridge sem psem (OFGate.PREPARE_EIGENSTATE : OFGate tc nc) OFKrausOpSym.unitPrepEigen]
    (postA : @QuantumPredicateFormula (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc)) :
    QHLPlusTotDeriv sem psem expSub qvSub
      (mkCQAssertion tc nc (krausPrepEigen tc nc postA) ctx)
      (prepEigen tc nc)
      (mkCQAssertion tc nc postA ctx) := by
  have hBridge := unitaryBridge_of (sem := sem) (psem := psem)
    (U := (OFGate.PREPARE_EIGENSTATE : OFGate tc nc)) (F_U := OFKrausOpSym.unitPrepEigen)
    Fin.elim0 (prepEigenQvars tc nc)
    Fin.elim0 (prepEigenQvars tc nc)
    (hQvars_PrepEigen (sem := sem) (psem := psem) tc nc)
  exact @QHLPlusTotDeriv.axiomUnitary (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
    (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
    (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) ctx sem psem expSub qvSub
    OFGate.PREPARE_EIGENSTATE Fin.elim0 (prepEigenQvars tc nc) (prepEigenQvars_distinct tc nc)
    (mkCQAssertion tc nc postA ctx)
    OFKrausOpSym.unitPrepEigen Fin.elim0 (prepEigenQvars tc nc)
    (prepEigenQvars_distinct tc nc) (prepEigenQvars_mem_sigAll tc nc) hBridge

/-- Derivation step for q := |0⟩: qubit initialization to |0⟩.
    Proves: {(True, K_init† · A · K_init)}  q := |0⟩  {(True, A)}
    Uses: axiomInit with InitKrausBridge for initB (Layer 3 hypothesis). -/
theorem derivStep_Init
    [InitKrausBridge sem psem OFKrausOpSym.initB]
    (q : Fin (tc + nc + 2))
    (postA : @QuantumPredicateFormula (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc)) :
    QHLPlusTotDeriv sem psem expSub qvSub
      (mkCQAssertion tc nc (krausInit tc nc q postA) ctx)
      (.qInit q)
      (mkCQAssertion tc nc postA ctx) := by
  have hBridge := initBridge_of (sem := sem) (psem := psem) (F_B := OFKrausOpSym.initB)
    q Fin.elim0
  exact @QHLPlusTotDeriv.axiomInit (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
    (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
    (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) ctx sem psem expSub qvSub
    q (mkCQAssertion tc nc postA ctx)
    OFKrausOpSym.initB Fin.elim0 (singleQvar tc nc q)
    (fin1_distinct _) (singleQvar_mem_sigAll tc nc _) hBridge

/-- Derivation step for m_j := M[c_j]: projective measurement of counting qubit c_j.
    Proves: {(φ[m_j/y_j], K_meas† · A[m_j/y_j] · K_meas)}
            m_j := M[c_j]
            {(φ ∧ eqXY, A)}
    Uses: axiomMeasure directly (no typeclass bridge — measurement bridges have
    additional classical-update conditions not captured by a single typeclass).
    The `MeasBridge` hypothesis (Layer 3) bundles the rank-1 Kraus condition,
    the adjoint relation, and classical update coherence. -/
theorem derivStep_Meas
    (j : Fin (tc + 1))
    (post_base : CQAssertion (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) ctx)
    (hInj : Function.Injective (qvSub (.m j) (.varRef (.y j))))
    (fHsub : ∀ i : Fin 1, singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j) i ∈
      post_base.S.image (qvSub (.m j) (.varRef (.y j))))
    (eqXY : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)
    (heqXY : ∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx,
      eqXY σ ↔ sem.classicalUpdate σ (.m j) (.varRef (.y j)) = σ)
    (hfresh_φ : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (e : OFExp tc),
      post_base.φ σ ↔ post_base.φ (sem.classicalUpdate σ (.y j) e))
    (hfresh_A : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (e : OFExp tc),
      interpFormula psem σ post_base.A =
      interpFormula psem (sem.classicalUpdate σ (.y j) e) post_base.A)
    (outcomeOf : ClassicalState ctx → OFMeasOutcome)
    (hMeasBridge : MeasBridge tc nc sem psem j outcomeOf eqXY) :
    QHLPlusTotDeriv sem psem expSub qvSub
      ⟨post_base.S.image (qvSub (.m j) (.varRef (.y j))),
       classSubstFormula sem (.m j) (.varRef (.y j)) post_base.φ,
       .kraus (OFKrausOpSym.measF j) Fin.elim0
         (singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j))
         (fun _ => substFormula expSub qvSub (.m j) (.varRef (.y j)) hInj post_base.A)
         (fin1_distinct _) fHsub⟩
      (measureCounting tc nc j)
      ⟨post_base.S, fun σ => post_base.φ σ ∧ eqXY σ, post_base.A⟩ := by
  have h := @QHLPlusTotDeriv.axiomMeasure (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
    (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
    (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) ctx sem psem expSub qvSub
    (.m j) OFMeas.stdMeas (singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j)) (fin1_distinct _)
    (.y j) (.varRef (.y j))
    post_base
    (OFKrausOpSym.measF j) Fin.elim0 (singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j))
    (fin1_distinct _) hInj fHsub
    eqXY heqXY hfresh_φ hfresh_A
    (by intro h; cases h)
    outcomeOf hMeasBridge
  exact h

theorem derivChain
    (preA midA postA : @QuantumPredicateFormula (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc)
      (Fin (tc + nc + 2)) (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc)
      (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _ (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc))
    (P₁ P₂ : QWhilePlus (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc))
    (h₁ : QHLPlusTotDeriv sem psem expSub qvSub
      (mkCQAssertion tc nc preA ctx) P₁ (mkCQAssertion tc nc midA ctx))
    (h₂ : QHLPlusTotDeriv sem psem expSub qvSub
      (mkCQAssertion tc nc midA ctx) P₂ (mkCQAssertion tc nc postA ctx)) :

      (mkCQAssertion tc nc preA ctx) (.seq P₁ P₂) (mkCQAssertion tc nc postA ctx) :=
  QHLPlusTotDeriv.ruleSeq h₁ h₂

private lemma kraus_heq_of_args_heq
    (F : KrausOpSym) {S₁ S₂ : Finset QVar} (hS : S₁ = S₂)
    (p₁ p₂ : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp) (hp : p₁ = p₂)
    (q₁ q₂ : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar) (hq : q₁ = q₂)
    (subs₁ : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) →
      QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S₁)
    (subs₂ : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) →
      QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S₂)
    (hsubs : ∀ i, HEq (subs₁ i) (subs₂ i))
    (hd₁ : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F), i ≠ j → q₁ i ≠ q₁ j)
    (hs₁ : ∀ i, q₁ i ∈ S₁)
    (hd₂ : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F), i ≠ j → q₂ i ≠ q₂ j)
    (hs₂ : ∀ i, q₂ i ∈ S₂) :
    HEq (QuantumPredicateFormula.kraus F p₁ q₁ subs₁ hd₁ hs₁)
         (QuantumPredicateFormula.kraus F p₂ q₂ subs₂ hd₂ hs₂) := by
  subst hS; subst hp; subst hq
  have : subs₁ = subs₂ := funext fun i => eq_of_heq (hsubs i)
  subst this; rfl

private lemma complement_heq_of_heq {S₁ S₂ : Finset QVar}

structure SubstIdentity
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgramSemantics (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) ctx)
    (expSub : ShorCVar tc → ShorExp tc → ShorExp tc → ShorExp tc)
    (qvSub : ShorCVar tc → ShorExp tc → Fin (tc + nc + 2) → Fin (tc + nc + 2)) : Prop where
  -- For each classical variable assignment, qvSub and expSub are identity
  found_false_qv : ∀ q, qvSub .found .falseVal q = q
  found_false_exp : ∀ t, expSub .found .falseVal t = t
  found_true_qv : ∀ q, qvSub .found .trueVal q = q
  found_true_exp : ∀ t, expSub .found .trueVal t = t
  result_zero_qv : ∀ q, qvSub .result .zero q = q
  result_zero_exp : ∀ t, expSub .result .zero t = t
  result_g_qv : ∀ q, qvSub .result (.var .g_var) q = q
  result_g_exp : ∀ t, expSub .result (.var .g_var) t = t
  result_f1_qv : ∀ q, qvSub .result (.var .f1_var) q = q
  result_f1_exp : ∀ t, expSub .result (.var .f1_var) t = t
  result_f2_qv : ∀ q, qvSub .result (.var .f2_var) q = q
  result_f2_exp : ∀ t, expSub .result (.var .f2_var) t = t
  a_random_qv : ∀ q, qvSub .a_var .randomA q = q
  a_random_exp : ∀ t, expSub .a_var .randomA t = t
  g_gcd_qv : ∀ q, qvSub .g_var .gcdAN q = q
  g_gcd_exp : ∀ t, expSub .g_var .gcdAN t = t
  r_cont_qv : ∀ q, qvSub .r_var .contFrac q = q
  r_cont_exp : ∀ t, expSub .r_var .contFrac t = t
  f1_gcd_qv : ∀ q, qvSub .f1_var .gcdF1 q = q
  f1_gcd_exp : ∀ t, expSub .f1_var .gcdF1 t = t
  f2_gcd_qv : ∀ q, qvSub .f2_var .gcdF2 q = q
  f2_gcd_exp : ∀ t, expSub .f2_var .gcdF2 t = t
  -- BExp freshness: notFound is not affected by a_var or g_var assignments
  notFound_fresh_a : ∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx,
    sem.boolEval σ ShorBExp.notFound →
    sem.boolEval (sem.classicalUpdate σ .a_var .randomA) ShorBExp.notFound
  notFound_fresh_g : ∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx,
    sem.boolEval σ ShorBExp.notFound →
    sem.boolEval (sem.classicalUpdate σ .g_var .gcdAN) ShorBExp.notFound

/-! ## Then Branch Derivation

Hoare triple: {(True /\ notFound /\ gGt1, I/2^(t+n))} result := g; found := true {(True, I/2^(t+n))}

This is Layer 2 (classical factor extraction): if gcd(a,N) > 1 then g is already a
non-trivial factor of N, so we just record it. The quantum state is untouched by
classical assignments, so the quantum predicate I/2^(t+n) is trivially preserved. -/

/-- Then branch: result := g; found := true.
    Uses axiomAssign (x2), ruleSeq, ruleConseq.
    Specialized to post = loopInvCQ (phi = True) so all entailments are trivially discharged.
    All entailments discharged inline via SubstIdentity + substCQAssertion_entails_of_id. -/

def krausCU (j : Fin (tc + 1))
    (A : @QuantumPredicateFormula (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (ofSyntaxCats tc nc) (ofPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc)) :
    @QuantumPredicateFormula (OFCVar tc) (OFExp tc) (OFBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (OFGate tc nc) (OFMeas tc nc) (OFAtomPred tc nc) (OFKrausOpSym tc nc) _

theorem basis_independence {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [Fintype ι₂]
    (b₁ : OrthonormalBasis ι₁ ℂ H₁) (b₂ : OrthonormalBasis ι₂ ℂ H₂)
    (v w : TensorProduct ℂ H₁ H₂) :
    innerProductTensorProductBasis H₁ H₂
      (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H₁) (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H₂) v w =
    innerProductTensorProductBasis H₁ H₂ b₁ b₂ v w := by
  -- Double induction on TensorProduct: first on v, then on w
  induction v using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    simp only [innerProductTensorProductBasis, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply,
               zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  | tmul x₁ y₁ =>
    induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero =>
      simp only [innerProductTensorProductBasis, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply,
                 mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    | tmul x₂ y₂ =>
      -- Both reduce to ⟨x₁,x₂⟩ * ⟨y₁,y₂⟩
      rw [innerProductTensorProductBasis_tmul (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H₁)
            (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H₂),
          innerProductTensorProductBasis_tmul b₁ b₂]
    | add w₁ w₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      rw [innerProductTensorProductBasis_add_right (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H₁)
            (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H₂),
          innerProductTensorProductBasis_add_right b₁ b₂,
          ih₁, ih₂]
  | add v₁ v₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    rw [innerProductTensorProductBasis_add_left (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H₁)
          (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H₂),
        innerProductTensorProductBasis_add_left b₁ b₂,
        ih₁, ih₂]

theorem comp_adjoint_le_one_of_adjoint_comp_le_one
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
    (K : E →ₗ[ℂ] E)
    (hK : @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE
      (K.comp (LinearMap.adjoint K)) 1) :
    @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE
      ((LinearMap.adjoint K).comp K) 1 := by
  haveI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  -- Apply adjoint_comp_adjoint_le_one_of_comp_adjoint_le_one to K†
  -- Hypothesis needs (K†)†(K†) ≤ I, i.e., K(K†) ≤ I — which is hK
  have h := adjoint_comp_adjoint_le_one_of_comp_adjoint_le_one
    (LinearMap.adjoint K) ?_
  -- h : (K†)(K†)† ≤ I, i.e., (K†)K ≤ I — but we need to unfold (K†)† = K
  · rwa [LinearMap.adjoint_adjoint] at h
  · -- Need (K†)†(K†) ≤ I, i.e., K(K†) ≤ I
    rwa [LinearMap.adjoint_adjoint]

class InvolutoryGate
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgramSemantics CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (U : Gate) where
  involutory : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
    (params : Fin (cats.gateClassicalArity U) → Exp)
    (qvars : Fin (cats.gateQuantumArity U) → QVar),
    (sem.unitaryOp U σ params qvars).comp (sem.unitaryOp U σ params qvars) = LinearMap.id

/-! ## Correction Preservation

The key physics fact for error correction gates: when a correction gate U
is applied to a postcondition A, and U preserves A (i.e., U†AU = A at the
interpFormula level), the correction entailment becomes trivially reflexive.

This is the core mechanism for discharging X-correction and Z-correction
bridges in teleportation, superdense coding, entanglement swapping, etc. -/

/-- A correction gate U with Kraus symbol F_U preserves a quantum predicate formula A:
    `interpFormula(F_U[qvars](A)) = interpFormula(A)` for all classical states σ.

    This encodes the physics that applying the correction gate to the postcondition
    yields the same operator. For example:
    - X correction in teleportation: X acts on q3, postcondition is |ψ⟩⟨ψ| on q3
    - Z correction in teleportation: Z acts on q3, postcondition is |ψ⟩⟨ψ| on q3

    When this holds, the CQAssertionEntails for the correction is trivially reflexive. -/

theorem partialTrace_tensorProduct (A : H_A →ₗ[ℂ] H_A) (B : H_B →ₗ[ℂ] H_B) :
    partialTrace (TensorProduct.map A B) = (LinearMap.trace ℂ H_B B) • A := by
  unfold partialTrace partialTraceBasis
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
  ext ψ
  simp only [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  -- Expand the embedding and contraction maps
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [2, i]
    rw [embeddingMap_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul, contractionMap_tmul]
  -- Simplify: ∑_i ⟨e_i, B e_i⟩ • A ψ = (∑_i ⟨e_i, B e_i⟩) • A ψ
  rw [← Finset.sum_smul]
  congr 1
  -- Trace as sum of diagonal inner products
  have h_trace : LinearMap.trace ℂ H_B B =
      ∑ i, @inner ℂ H_B _ (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H_B i)
                            (B (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H_B i)) := by
    exact B.trace_eq_sum_inner (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H_B)
  rw [← h_trace]

theorem single_kraus_subnormalized
    {k : ℕ} (ops : Fin k → (E →ₗ[ℂ] E))
    (hK : IsKrausFamily k ops) (i : Fin k) :
    @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE
      ((LinearMap.adjoint (ops i)).comp (ops i)) 1 := by
  haveI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  rw [isKrausFamily_iff] at hK
  -- K_i†K_i ≤ ∑K†K ≤ I by transitivity
  suffices h : @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE
      ((LinearMap.adjoint (ops i)).comp (ops i))
      (∑ j, (LinearMap.adjoint (ops j)).comp (ops j)) by
    exact le_trans h hK
  -- Show: (∑K†K - K_i†K_i).IsPositive
  rw [loewnerOrder_iff]
  -- Rewrite as sum over (univ \ {i})
  have heq : (∑ j, (LinearMap.adjoint (ops j)).comp (ops j)) -
      (LinearMap.adjoint (ops i)).comp (ops i) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        (LinearMap.adjoint (ops j)).comp (ops j) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_erase_eq_sub (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  rw [heq]
  -- Sum of PSD operators over erase set is PSD
  apply Finset.sum_induction
  · exact fun a b ha hb => ha.add hb
  · exact ⟨fun x y => by simp, fun v => by simp⟩
  · intro j _; exact adjoint_comp_self_isPositive (ops j)

theorem sum_adjoint_sandwich_le_one
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (K : ι → (E →ₗ[ℂ] E))
    (hK : @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE
      (∑ i, (LinearMap.adjoint (K i)).comp (K i)) 1)
    (A : ι → (E →ₗ[ℂ] E))
    (hA : ∀ i, @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE (A i) 1) :
    @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE
      (∑ i, (LinearMap.adjoint (K i)).comp ((A i).comp (K i))) 1 := by
  haveI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  -- Strategy: 1 - ∑K†AK = (1 - ∑K†K) + ∑(K†K - K†AK)
  -- Both summands are PSD, so their sum is PSD, hence (1 - ∑K†AK).IsPositive
  rw [loewnerOrder_iff]
  -- Step 1: Pointwise K†AK ≤ K†K (from A ≤ I via adjoint_sandwich_mono)
  have hpw : ∀ i, @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE
      ((LinearMap.adjoint (K i)).comp ((A i).comp (K i)))
      ((LinearMap.adjoint (K i)).comp (K i)) := by
    intro i
    have h := adjoint_sandwich_mono (K i) (A i) 1 (hA i)
    rwa [adjoint_sandwich_one] at h
  -- Step 2: Decompose 1 - ∑K†AK = (1 - ∑K†K) + ∑(K†K - K†AK)
  have heq : (1 : E →ₗ[ℂ] E) - ∑ i, (LinearMap.adjoint (K i)).comp ((A i).comp (K i)) =
      ((1 : E →ₗ[ℂ] E) - ∑ i, (LinearMap.adjoint (K i)).comp (K i)) +
      (∑ i, ((LinearMap.adjoint (K i)).comp (K i) -
        (LinearMap.adjoint (K i)).comp ((A i).comp (K i)))) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    -- Goal: 1 - ∑K†AK = (1 - ∑K†K) + (∑K†K - ∑K†AK)
    -- This is a - c = (a - b) + (b - c) in AddCommGroup
    exact (sub_add_sub_cancel 1 (∑ i, (LinearMap.adjoint (K i)).comp (K i))
      (∑ i, (LinearMap.adjoint (K i)).comp ((A i).comp (K i)))).symm
  rw [heq]
  -- Step 3: Both parts are PSD
  apply LinearMap.IsPositive.add
  · -- (1 - ∑K†K).IsPositive from hK
    rw [← loewnerOrder_iff]; exact hK
  · -- ∑(K†K - K†AK).IsPositive: sum of PSD is PSD
    -- Each (K†K - K†AK).IsPositive from hpw
    have hterm_pos : ∀ i, ((LinearMap.adjoint (K i)).comp (K i) -
        (LinearMap.adjoint (K i)).comp ((A i).comp (K i))).IsPositive := by
      intro i
      rw [← loewnerOrder_iff]; exact hpw i
    -- Sum of PSD operators is PSD
    apply Finset.sum_induction
    · -- Addition preserves positivity
      exact fun a b ha hb => ha.add hb
    · -- Zero is positive
      exact ⟨fun x y => by simp, fun v => by simp⟩
    · -- Each term is positive
      intro i _; exact hterm_pos i

theorem sum_forward_sandwich_mono
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (K : ι → (E →ₗ[ℂ] E)) (A B : ι → (E →ₗ[ℂ] E))
    (hle : ∀ i, @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE (A i) (B i)) :
    @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE
      (∑ i, (K i).comp ((A i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (K i))))
      (∑ i, (K i).comp ((B i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (K i)))) := by
  haveI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  rw [loewnerOrder_iff]
  -- Goal: (∑ KᵢBᵢKᵢ† - ∑ KᵢAᵢKᵢ†).IsPositive
  -- Rewrite as ∑ (KᵢBᵢKᵢ† - KᵢAᵢKᵢ†) = ∑ Kᵢ(Bᵢ-Aᵢ)Kᵢ†
  have heq : (∑ i, (K i).comp ((B i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (K i)))) -
      (∑ i, (K i).comp ((A i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (K i)))) =
      ∑ i, ((K i).comp ((B i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (K i))) -
        (K i).comp ((A i).comp (LinearMap.adjoint (K i)))) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [heq]
  apply Finset.sum_induction
  · exact fun a b ha hb => ha.add hb
  · exact ⟨fun x y => by simp, fun v => by simp⟩
  · intro i _
    rw [← loewnerOrder_iff]
    exact forward_sandwich_mono (K i) (A i) (B i) (hle i)

/-- Left-monotonicity of composition with a commuting positive operator:
    if `A ≤ B` and `C ≥ 0` with `(B - A) ∘ C = C ∘ (B - A)`, then `A ∘ C ≤ B ∘ C`.
    Proof: `B∘C - A∘C = (B-A)∘C`, product of commuting PSD is PSD. -/

  unfold toLinMap
  rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin_eq_toLin_orthonormal]
  rw [Matrix.toLin_mul
    (v₁ := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (2 ^ n)) ℂ).toBasis)
    (v₂ := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (2 ^ n)) ℂ).toBasis)
    (v₃ := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (2 ^ n)) ℂ).toBasis)]

    toLinMap n (1 : Matrix (Fin (2 ^ n)) (Fin (2 ^ n)) ℂ) = LinearMap.id := by
  unfold toLinMap
  rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin_eq_toLin_orthonormal, Matrix.toLin_one]

  rw [tele_toLinMap_id]
  rfl
