theorem trace_psd_product_nonneg
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
    (A B : E →ₗ[ℂ] E) (hA : A.IsPositive) (hB : B.IsPositive) :
    0 ≤ RCLike.re ((LinearMap.trace ℂ E) (A.comp B)) := by
  classical
  let b := stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ E
  have hA_psd : (LinearMap.toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis A).PosSemidef :=
    (LinearMap.posSemidef_toMatrix_iff b).mpr hA
  have hB_psd : (LinearMap.toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis B).PosSemidef :=
    (LinearMap.posSemidef_toMatrix_iff b).mpr hB
  have htrace_eq : (LinearMap.trace ℂ E) (A.comp B) =
      ((LinearMap.toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis A) *
       (LinearMap.toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis B)).trace := by
    rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace ℂ b.toBasis]
    congr 1
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_comp b.toBasis b.toBasis b.toBasis]
  rw [htrace_eq]
  exact trace_mul_re_nonneg_of_posSemidef hA_psd hB_psd

theorem unitaryBridge_of
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgSemantics ctx}
    {psem : PredSemantics ctx}
    {U : Gate} {F_U : KrausOpSym}
    [h : UnitaryKrausBridge sem psem U F_U]
    (fParams : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F_U) → Exp)
    (fQvars : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F_U) → QVar)
    (gateParams : Fin (cats.gateClassicalArity U) → Exp)
    (gateQvars : Fin (cats.gateQuantumArity U) → QVar)
    (hQvars : fQvars = gateQvars ∘ Fin.cast h.arity_eq) :
    (pcats.krausRank F_U = 1) ∧
    ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (h1 : pcats.krausRank F_U = 1),
      psem.krausInterp F_U σ fParams fQvars ⟨0, h1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ =
        (sem.unitaryOp U σ gateParams gateQvars).adjoint :=
  ⟨h.rank_one, fun σ h1 => by rw [hQvars]; exact h.bridge σ fParams gateParams gateQvars h1⟩

This connects the Kraus channel to the |0⟩ initialization.

def MeasBridge (j : Fin (tc + 1))
    (outcomeOf : ClassicalState ctx → ShorMeasOutcome)
    (eqXY : ClassicalState ctx → Prop) : Prop :=
  ((shorPredCats tc nc).krausRank (ShorKrausOpSym.measF j) = 1) ∧
  (∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
    (h1 : (shorPredCats tc nc).krausRank (ShorKrausOpSym.measF j) = 1),
    psem.krausInterp (ShorKrausOpSym.measF j) σ Fin.elim0
      (singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j))
      ⟨0, h1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ =
      (sem.measOp ShorMeas.stdMeas σ (singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j))
        (outcomeOf σ)).adjoint) ∧
  (∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx,
    sem.measClassicalUpdate σ (.m j) ShorMeas.stdMeas (outcomeOf σ) =
    sem.classicalUpdate σ (.m j) (.var (.y j))) ∧
  (∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx,
    eqXY (sem.measClassicalUpdate σ (.m j) ShorMeas.stdMeas (outcomeOf σ)))

(cnt : ℕ) → (Fin cnt → QWhilePlus (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc)) →
    QWhilePlus (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc)
  | 0, _ => .skip
  | 1, P => P ⟨0, by omega⟩
  | k + 2, P => .seq (P ⟨0, by omega⟩)
      (seqFold (k + 1) (fun i => P ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩))

/-- Initialize all counting qubits: c[1] := |0⟩; ...; c[t] := |0⟩. -/
def initAllCounting :
    QWhilePlus (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) :=
  seqFold tc nc (tc + 1) (fun j => .qInit (countingQubit tc nc j))

/-- Initialize all target qubits: q[1] := |0⟩; ...; q[n] := |0⟩. -/
def initAllTarget :
    QWhilePlus (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) :=
  seqFold tc nc (nc + 1) (fun k => .qInit (targetQubit tc nc k))

/-- Apply H to all counting qubits: H[c[1]]; ...; H[c[t]]. -/
def hadamardAllCounting :
    QWhilePlus (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) :=
  seqFold tc nc (tc + 1) (fun j => applyH tc nc j)

/-- Apply all CU_pow gates: CU_pow(2^(t-1))[c[1], q̄]; CU_pow(2^(t-2))[c[2], q̄]; ...; CU_pow(2^0)[c[t], q̄].
    The j-th gate (0-indexed) applies CU_pow(2^(t-j)) = CU_pow(2^(t-1-j)) to c[j+1]. -/
def cuAllCounting :
    QWhilePlus (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) :=
  seqFold tc nc (tc + 1) (fun j => applyCU tc nc j)

/-- Measure all counting qubits: m[1] := M[c[1]]; ...; m[t] := M[c[t]]. -/
def measureAllCounting :
    QWhilePlus (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) :=
  seqFold tc nc (tc + 1) (fun j => measureCounting tc nc j)

/-- Factor extraction: f1 := gcd(a^(r/2)-1, N); f2 := gcd(a^(r/2)+1, N);
    if 1 < f1 ∧ f1 < N then (result := f1; found := true)
    else if 1 < f2 ∧ f2 < N then (result := f2; found := true)
    else skip -/
def factorExtraction :
    QWhilePlus (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) :=
  .seq (.classAssign .f1_var .gcdF1)
    (.seq (.classAssign .f2_var .gcdF2)
      (.ifThenElse .f1Valid
        (.seq (.classAssign .result (.var .f1_var))
              (.classAssign .found .trueVal))
        (.ifThenElse .f2Valid
          (.seq (.classAssign .result (.var .f2_var))
                (.classAssign .found .trueVal))
          .skip)))

/-- The else branch: quantum phase estimation + classical post-processing.
    Initializes ALL t counting qubits + ALL n target qubits, applies gates, measures, post-processes. -/
def elseBranch :
    QWhilePlus (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) :=
  -- c[1] := |0⟩; ...; c[t] := |0⟩
  .seq (initAllCounting tc nc)
  -- q[1] := |0⟩; ...; q[n] := |0⟩
  (.seq (initAllTarget tc nc)
  -- H[c[1]]; ...; H[c[t]]
  (.seq (hadamardAllCounting tc nc)
  -- CU_pow(2^(t-1))[c[1], q̄]; CU_pow(2^(t-2))[c[2], q̄]; ...; CU_pow(2^0)[c[t], q̄]
  (.seq (cuAllCounting tc nc)
  -- QFT_inv[c[1],...,c[t]]
  (.seq (applyQFTinv tc nc)
  -- m[1] := M[c[1]]; ...; m[t] := M[c[t]]
  (.seq (measureAllCounting tc nc)
  -- r := continued_fraction(m, t)
  (.seq (.classAssign .r_var .contFrac)
  -- if evenRAndCheck then factorExtraction else skip
  (.ifThenElse .evenRAndCheck
    (factorExtraction tc nc)
    .skip)))))))

/-- The then branch: g > 1 so g is a factor. -/
def thenBranch :
    QWhilePlus (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) :=
  .seq (.classAssign .result (.var .g_var))
       (.classAssign .found .trueVal)

/-- Loop body: a := random; g := gcd(a,N); if g > 1 then ... else ... -/
def loopBody :
    QWhilePlus (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) :=
  .seq (.classAssign .a_var .randomA)
    (.seq (.classAssign .g_var .gcdAN)
      (.ifThenElse .gGt1
        (thenBranch tc nc)
        (elseBranch tc nc)))

/-- The complete Shor's factoring program. -/
def shorProgram :
    QWhilePlus (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) :=
  .seq (.classAssign .found .falseVal)
    (.seq (.classAssign .result .zero)
      (.whileDo .notFound (loopBody tc nc)))

/-! ## Quantum Predicate Formulas -/

def loopInvPred :
    @QuantumPredicateFormula (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc) (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (shorSyntaxCats tc nc) (shorPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc) := by
  rw [← allQvars_image_eq tc nc]
  exact @QuantumPredicateFormula.atomic (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc)
    (Fin (tc + nc + 2)) (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc)
    (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) _ (shorSyntaxCats tc nc) (shorPredCats tc nc)
    ShorAtomPred.loopInv Fin.elim0 id (fun _ _ hij h => hij h)

def postPred :
    @QuantumPredicateFormula (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc) (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (shorSyntaxCats tc nc) (shorPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc) := by
  rw [← allQvars_image_eq tc nc]
  exact @QuantumPredicateFormula.atomic (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc)
    (Fin (tc + nc + 2)) (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc)
    (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) _ (shorSyntaxCats tc nc) (shorPredCats tc nc)
    ShorAtomPred.postState Fin.elim0 id (fun _ _ hij h => hij h)

/-! ## CQ-Assertions -/

/-- Loop invariant CQ assertion: (True, I/2^(t+n)).

    The quantum predicate is the maximally mixed state I/2^(t+n). This captures
    that the quantum register is reset (all qubits re-initialized to |0>) at the
    start of each iteration. A stronger invariant could also encode classical
    progress: found=false \/ (found=true /\ result|N), but the classical
    correctness (factor extraction) lives in the program logic itself, not in
    the quantum predicate.

    The quantum predicate I/2^(t+n) is preserved because each iteration:
    1. Reinitializes all qubits to |0> (axiomInit)
    2. Runs QPE: H gates, CU_pow gates, QFT_inv (all unitary, preserve trace)
    3. Measures counting qubits (collapses state, but tr(rho) preserved)
    4. Classical post-processing (assignments don't touch quantum state) -/
def loopInvCQ (ctx : ProgramContext) :
    CQAssertion (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc) (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) ctx where
  S := sigAll tc nc
  φ := fun _ => True
  A := loopInvPred tc nc

/-- Postcondition: (True, I/2^(t+n)).
    Identical to the loop invariant — the postcondition is the maximally mixed
    state because ruleLoopPar guarantees the invariant holds on loop exit
    (when found=true). The classical guarantee (result | N) is not encoded
    in the quantum predicate; it follows from the program logic. -/
def postCond (ctx : ProgramContext) :
    CQAssertion (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc) (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) ctx where
  S := sigAll tc nc
  φ := fun _ => True
  A := loopInvPred tc nc  -- pre = post = (True, I/2^(t+n))

/-- Precondition: (True, I/2^(t+n)).
    The maximally mixed state — any initial quantum state satisfying this
    predicate is acceptable. Identical to loopInvCQ and postCond because
    the loop invariant is established by the initialization assignments
    (found := false; result := 0) which don't affect the quantum state. -/
def preCond (ctx : ProgramContext) :
    CQAssertion (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc) (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) ctx where
  S := sigAll tc nc
  φ := fun _ => True
  A := loopInvPred tc nc

def mkCQAssertion
    (A : @QuantumPredicateFormula (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc) (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (shorSyntaxCats tc nc) (shorPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc))
    (ctx : ProgramContext) :
    CQAssertion (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc) (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) ctx where
  S := sigAll tc nc
  φ := fun _ => True
  A := A

/-! ## Kraus Transform Helpers -/

def krausH (j : Fin (tc + 1))
    (A : @QuantumPredicateFormula (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc) (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (shorSyntaxCats tc nc) (shorPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc)) :
    @QuantumPredicateFormula (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc) (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (shorSyntaxCats tc nc) (shorPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc) :=
  .kraus ShorKrausOpSym.unitH Fin.elim0 (singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j))
    (fun _ => A) (fin1_distinct _) (singleQvar_mem_sigAll tc nc _)

def krausCU (j : Fin (tc + 1))
    (A : @QuantumPredicateFormula (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc) (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (shorSyntaxCats tc nc) (shorPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc)) :
    @QuantumPredicateFormula (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc) (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (shorSyntaxCats tc nc) (shorPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc) :=
  .kraus (ShorKrausOpSym.unitCU j) Fin.elim0 (cuQvars tc nc j)
    (fun _ => A) (cuQvars_distinct tc nc j) (cuQvars_mem_sigAll tc nc j)

def krausQFTinv
    (A : @QuantumPredicateFormula (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc) (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (shorSyntaxCats tc nc) (shorPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc)) :
    @QuantumPredicateFormula (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc) (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (shorSyntaxCats tc nc) (shorPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc) :=
  .kraus ShorKrausOpSym.unitQFTinv Fin.elim0 (qftInvQvars tc nc)
    (fun _ => A) (qftInvQvars_distinct tc nc) (qftInvQvars_mem_sigAll tc nc)

def krausInit (q : Fin (tc + nc + 2))
    (A : @QuantumPredicateFormula (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc) (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (shorSyntaxCats tc nc) (shorPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc)) :
    @QuantumPredicateFormula (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc) (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (shorSyntaxCats tc nc) (shorPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc) :=
  .kraus ShorKrausOpSym.initB Fin.elim0 (singleQvar tc nc q)
    (fun _ => A) (fin1_distinct _) (singleQvar_mem_sigAll tc nc _)

def krausMeas (j : Fin (tc + 1))
    (A : @QuantumPredicateFormula (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc) (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (shorSyntaxCats tc nc) (shorPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc)) :
    @QuantumPredicateFormula (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc) (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) _
      (shorSyntaxCats tc nc) (shorPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc) :=
  .kraus (ShorKrausOpSym.measF j) Fin.elim0 (singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j))
    (fun _ => A) (fin1_distinct _) (singleQvar_mem_sigAll tc nc _)

/-! ## Trust Boundary and Bridge Hypotheses

Gate typeclasses (`UnitaryKrausBridge`, `InitKrausBridge`) from StandardGates replace
manual bridge hypothesis types. Measurement bridges have additional classical update
conditions not captured by `MeasKrausBridge` alone, so we keep them explicit. -/

variable {ctx : ProgramContext}
  (sem : ProgramSemantics (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
    (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) ctx)
  (psem : PredicateSemantics (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
    (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc) (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) ctx)
  (expSub : ShorCVar tc → ShorExp tc → ShorExp tc → ShorExp tc)
  (qvSub : ShorCVar tc → ShorExp tc → Fin (tc + nc + 2) → Fin (tc + nc + 2))

/-! ### Arity Equality Lemmas for `UnitaryKrausBridge` -/

private theorem hQvars_H
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgramSemantics (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) ctx}
    {psem : PredicateSemantics (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc) (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) ctx}
    [h : UnitaryKrausBridge sem psem ShorGate.H ShorKrausOpSym.unitH]
    (j : Fin (tc + 1)) :
    singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j) =
    singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j) ∘ Fin.cast h.arity_eq := by
  ext i; simp [singleQvar]

private theorem hQvars_CU
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgramSemantics (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) ctx}
    {psem : PredicateSemantics (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc) (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) ctx}
    (j : Fin (tc + 1))
    [h : UnitaryKrausBridge sem psem (ShorGate.CU_pow j) (ShorKrausOpSym.unitCU j)] :
    cuQvars tc nc j = cuQvars tc nc j ∘ Fin.cast h.arity_eq := by
  ext i; simp

private theorem hQvars_QFTinv
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgramSemantics (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) ctx}
    {psem : PredicateSemantics (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc) (Fin (tc + nc + 2))
      (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc) (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) ctx}
    [h : UnitaryKrausBridge sem psem (ShorGate.QFT_inv : ShorGate tc nc) ShorKrausOpSym.unitQFTinv] :
    qftInvQvars tc nc = qftInvQvars tc nc ∘ Fin.cast h.arity_eq := by
  ext i; simp

/-- Bridge hypothesis for m_j := M[c_j].
    Unlike unitary/init bridges which are captured by typeclasses, measurement
    bridges have additional classical update conditions (the measured outcome
    must be stored in the correct classical variable via measClassicalUpdate)
    that are not captured by a simple typeclass, so we keep them explicit. -/
def MeasBridge (j : Fin (tc + 1))
    (outcomeOf : ClassicalState ctx → ShorMeasOutcome)
    (eqXY : ClassicalState ctx → Prop) : Prop :=
  ((shorPredCats tc nc).krausRank (ShorKrausOpSym.measF j) = 1) ∧
  (∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
    (h1 : (shorPredCats tc nc).krausRank (ShorKrausOpSym.measF j) = 1),
    psem.krausInterp (ShorKrausOpSym.measF j) σ Fin.elim0
      (singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j))
      ⟨0, h1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ =
      (sem.measOp ShorMeas.stdMeas σ (singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j))
        (outcomeOf σ)).adjoint) ∧
  (∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx,
    sem.measClassicalUpdate σ (.m j) ShorMeas.stdMeas (outcomeOf σ) =
    sem.classicalUpdate σ (.m j) (.var (.y j))) ∧
  (∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx,
    eqXY (sem.measClassicalUpdate σ (.m j) ShorMeas.stdMeas (outcomeOf σ)))

/-! ## Derivation Steps — Explicit QHL⁺ Constructor Instantiations

Using gate typeclasses with `unitaryBridge_of` / `initBridge_of` extraction.
Each step produces a `QHLPlusDeriv` for a single quantum operation. -/

/-- axiomInit: {(True, K_init[q](A))} q := |0> {(True, A)}
    Qubit initialization via InitKrausBridge typeclass. -/
theorem derivStep_Init
    [InitKrausBridge sem psem ShorKrausOpSym.initB]
    (q : Fin (tc + nc + 2))
    (postA : @QuantumPredicateFormula (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc)
      (Fin (tc + nc + 2)) (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc)
      (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) _ (shorSyntaxCats tc nc) (shorPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc)) :
    QHLPlusDeriv sem psem expSub qvSub
      (mkCQAssertion tc nc (krausInit tc nc q postA) ctx)
      (.qInit q)
      (mkCQAssertion tc nc postA ctx) := by
  have hBridge := initBridge_of (sem := sem) (psem := psem) (F_B := ShorKrausOpSym.initB)
    q Fin.elim0
  exact @QHLPlusDeriv.axiomInit (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc)
    (Fin (tc + nc + 2)) (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc)
    (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) _ (shorSyntaxCats tc nc) (shorPredCats tc nc)
    ctx sem psem expSub qvSub
    q (mkCQAssertion tc nc postA ctx)
    ShorKrausOpSym.initB Fin.elim0 (singleQvar tc nc q)
    (fin1_distinct _) (singleQvar_mem_sigAll tc nc _) hBridge

/-- axiomUnitary: {(True, K_H[c_j](A))} H[c_j] {(True, A)}
    Hadamard gate on counting qubit j via UnitaryKrausBridge typeclass. -/
theorem derivStep_H
    [UnitaryKrausBridge sem psem ShorGate.H ShorKrausOpSym.unitH]
    (j : Fin (tc + 1))
    (postA : @QuantumPredicateFormula (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc)
      (Fin (tc + nc + 2)) (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc)
      (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) _ (shorSyntaxCats tc nc) (shorPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc)) :
    QHLPlusDeriv sem psem expSub qvSub
      (mkCQAssertion tc nc (krausH tc nc j postA) ctx)
      (applyH tc nc j)
      (mkCQAssertion tc nc postA ctx) := by
  have hBridge := unitaryBridge_of (sem := sem) (psem := psem)
    (U := ShorGate.H) (F_U := ShorKrausOpSym.unitH)
    Fin.elim0 (singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j))
    Fin.elim0 (singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j))
    (hQvars_H (sem := sem) (psem := psem) tc nc j)
  exact @QHLPlusDeriv.axiomUnitary (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc)
    (Fin (tc + nc + 2)) (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc)
    (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) _ (shorSyntaxCats tc nc) (shorPredCats tc nc)
    ctx sem psem expSub qvSub
    ShorGate.H Fin.elim0 (singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j)) (fin1_distinct _)
    (mkCQAssertion tc nc postA ctx)
    ShorKrausOpSym.unitH Fin.elim0 (singleQvar tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j))
    (fin1_distinct _) (singleQvar_mem_sigAll tc nc _) hBridge

/-- axiomUnitary: {(True, K_CU_j[c_j,q_bar](A))} CU_pow(2^(t-1-j))[c_j, q_bar] {(True, A)}
    Controlled modular exponentiation gate on counting qubit j and all target qubits.
    For 0-indexed j, the power is 2^(t-1-j). Via UnitaryKrausBridge typeclass. -/
theorem derivStep_CU
    (j : Fin (tc + 1))
    [UnitaryKrausBridge sem psem (ShorGate.CU_pow j) (ShorKrausOpSym.unitCU j)]
    (postA : @QuantumPredicateFormula (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc)
      (Fin (tc + nc + 2)) (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc)
      (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) _ (shorSyntaxCats tc nc) (shorPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc)) :
    QHLPlusDeriv sem psem expSub qvSub
      (mkCQAssertion tc nc (krausCU tc nc j postA) ctx)
      (applyCU tc nc j)
      (mkCQAssertion tc nc postA ctx) := by
  have hBridge := unitaryBridge_of (sem := sem) (psem := psem)
    (U := ShorGate.CU_pow j) (F_U := ShorKrausOpSym.unitCU j)
    Fin.elim0 (cuQvars tc nc j)
    Fin.elim0 (cuQvars tc nc j)
    (hQvars_CU (sem := sem) (psem := psem) tc nc j)
  exact @QHLPlusDeriv.axiomUnitary (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc)
    (Fin (tc + nc + 2)) (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc)
    (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) _ (shorSyntaxCats tc nc) (shorPredCats tc nc)
    ctx sem psem expSub qvSub
    (ShorGate.CU_pow j) Fin.elim0 (cuQvars tc nc j) (cuQvars_distinct tc nc j)
    (mkCQAssertion tc nc postA ctx)
    (ShorKrausOpSym.unitCU j) Fin.elim0 (cuQvars tc nc j)

theorem interpFormula_eqRec {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
    {S₁ S₂ : Finset QVar} (hS : S₁ = S₂)
    (A : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S₁) :
    interpFormula psem σ (hS ▸ A) = interpFormula psem σ A := by
  subst hS; rfl

/-! ## Part (2): Interpretation commutes with substitution -/

/-- **Lemma 5, Part (2): Substitution Semantics [Ying, Lemma 4.2(2)]**

    The interpretation of quantum predicate formulas commutes with substitution:
    if sigma' = sigma[x := sigma(e)], then

      sigma(A[e/x]) = sigma'(A)

    That is, evaluating the substituted formula A[e/x] in the original classical
    state sigma gives the same operator as evaluating the original formula A in
    the updated state sigma[x := sigma(e)].

    This semantic property is essential for the soundness of the Assignment Axiom
    in QHL+: {phi[e/x], A[e/x]} x := e {phi, A}. It ensures that the precondition
    evaluated before the assignment equals the postcondition evaluated after.

    The proof proceeds by structural induction on the quantum predicate formula A,
    using the hypotheses that atomic predicate and Kraus operator interpretations
    commute with substitution. -/

lemma unitaryTransform_trace_re_eq {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (U : Gate) (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
    (params : Fin (cats.gateClassicalArity U) → Exp)
    (qvars : Fin (cats.gateQuantumArity U) → QVar)
    (ρ : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all)
    (_hρ : IsPartialDensityOperator ρ) :
    ((LinearMap.trace ℂ ctx.H_all)
      ((sem.unitaryOp U σ params qvars).comp
        (ρ.comp (sem.unitaryOp U σ params qvars).adjoint))).re =
    ((LinearMap.trace ℂ ctx.H_all) ρ).re := by
  haveI : CompleteSpace ctx.H_all := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ ctx.H_all
  -- Rewrite comp to ∘ₗ for trace cyclicity
  have hcyc : (sem.unitaryOp U σ params qvars).comp
      (ρ.comp (sem.unitaryOp U σ params qvars).adjoint) =
    (sem.unitaryOp U σ params qvars) ∘ₗ ρ ∘ₗ (sem.unitaryOp U σ params qvars).adjoint := rfl
  rw [hcyc]
  -- By trace cyclicity: tr(U ρ U†) = tr(U† U ρ)
  rw [trace_comp_comp_cycle]
  -- Reassociate: U† ∘ₗ (U ∘ₗ ρ) = (U† ∘ₗ U) ∘ₗ ρ
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_assoc]
  -- Now: tr((U† ∘ₗ U) ∘ₗ ρ) = tr(id ∘ₗ ρ) = tr(ρ)
  rw [sem.unitaryOp_isUnitary U σ params qvars, LinearMap.id_comp]

/-- Helper: each summand `tr(M_m ρ M_m†) = tr(M_m† M_m ρ)` by trace cyclicity. -/
private lemma trace_meas_summand {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx}
    (M : Meas) (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
    (qvars : Fin (cats.measQuantumArity M) → QVar)
    (m : cats.measOutcomeType M)
    (ρ : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all) :
    (LinearMap.trace ℂ ctx.H_all)
      ((sem.measOp M σ qvars m).comp
        (ρ.comp (sem.measOp M σ qvars m).adjoint)) =
    (LinearMap.trace ℂ ctx.H_all)
      ((LinearMap.adjoint (sem.measOp M σ qvars m) ∘ₗ (sem.measOp M σ qvars m)) ∘ₗ ρ) := by
  haveI : CompleteSpace ctx.H_all := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ ctx.H_all
  have : (sem.measOp M σ qvars m).comp (ρ.comp (sem.measOp M σ qvars m).adjoint) =
    (sem.measOp M σ qvars m) ∘ₗ ρ ∘ₗ LinearMap.adjoint (sem.measOp M σ qvars m) := rfl
  rw [this, trace_comp_comp_cycle, LinearMap.comp_assoc]

/-- **Case 5 derivation**: Measurement sum of traces is bounded by trace.
Derived from `measOp_sum_isQuantumEffect` using Proposition 4
(expectation bounded by trace). The proof follows the paper:
1. By trace cyclicity: `tr(M_m ρ M_m†) = tr(M_m† M_m ρ)` for each m.
2. By linearity: `∑_m tr(M_m† M_m ρ) = tr((∑_m M_m† M_m) ρ)`.
3. Since `S = ∑_m M_m† M_m` is a quantum effect, by Prop 4: `tr(S ρ) ≤ tr(ρ)`. -/

/-- Embed a 2×2 gate on qubit 1 of a 3-qubit system: `I₂ ⊗ U ⊗ I₂`. -/
def embed_q1 (U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : ThreeQubitMatrix :=
  let leftRight : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℂ :=
    (kronFlat U I₂).submatrix (Fin.cast (by norm_num)) (Fin.cast (by norm_num))
  (kronFlat I₂ leftRight).submatrix (Fin.cast (by norm_num)) (Fin.cast (by norm_num))

/-- CNOT on qubits `(0,1)` in 3-qubit space: `CNOT ⊗ I₂`. -/
def cnot01 : ThreeQubitMatrix :=
  (kronFlat ConcreteGates.cnotM I₂).submatrix
    (Fin.cast (by norm_num)) (Fin.cast (by norm_num))

/-- CNOT on qubits `(1,2)` in 3-qubit space: `I₂ ⊗ CNOT`. -/
def cnot12 : ThreeQubitMatrix :=
  (kronFlat I₂ ConcreteGates.cnotM).submatrix
    (Fin.cast (by norm_num)) (Fin.cast (by norm_num))

/-- Embed a one-qubit gate on the first wire of a three-qubit system. -/
abbrev embedFirstQubit (U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : ThreeQubitMatrix :=
  embed_q0 U

/-- Embed a one-qubit gate on the last wire of a three-qubit system. -/
abbrev embedLastQubit (U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : ThreeQubitMatrix :=
  embed_q2 U

/-- Embed a one-qubit gate on the middle wire of a three-qubit system. -/
abbrev embedMiddleQubit (U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : ThreeQubitMatrix :=
  embed_q1 U

/-- Embed a two-qubit gate on wires `(0, 1)` of a three-qubit system. -/
abbrev embedLeftPair (U : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℂ) : ThreeQubitMatrix :=
  castSquare (by norm_num) (kronFlat U I₂)

/-- Embed a two-qubit gate on wires `(1, 2)` of a three-qubit system. -/
abbrev embedRightPair (U : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℂ) : ThreeQubitMatrix :=
  castSquare (by norm_num) (kronFlat I₂ U)

/-! ## Teleportation Compatibility Shims -/

/-- Hadamard on qubit 0 in 3-qubit space. -/
def H_q0 : ThreeQubitMatrix := embed_q0 ConcreteGates.hadamardH

/-- Pauli-X on qubit 2 in 3-qubit space. -/
def X_q2 : ThreeQubitMatrix := embed_q2 ConcreteGates.pauliX

/-- Pauli-Z on qubit 2 in 3-qubit space. -/
def Z_q2 : ThreeQubitMatrix := embed_q2 ConcreteGates.pauliZ

/-- Bell pair preparation: `CNOT₀₁ · H₀`. -/
def bellPrep : ThreeQubitMatrix := cnot01 * H_q0

/-- Bell measurement: `H₀ · CNOT₀₁`. -/
def bellMeasure : ThreeQubitMatrix := H_q0 * cnot01

end QHL.Quantum.ConcreteModel

class CorrectionPreserves
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (psem : PredicateSemantics CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)

    (A : QuantumPredicateFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S)

    (hdist : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F_U), i ≠ j → qvars i ≠ qvars j)

    interpFormula psem σ (.kraus F_U cparams qvars (fun _ => A) hdist hmem) =

private theorem if_expectation_kraus_cycle
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    {S : Finset QVar}
    (B : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S)
    (σ' : ClassicalState ctx)
    (ρ' : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all)
    (K : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all)
    (ψ : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)
    (heff : IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem σ' B)) :
    (if ψ σ' ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem σ' B)
     then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem σ' B)
             (K.adjoint.comp (ρ'.comp K))).re
     else 0) =
    (if ψ σ'
     then (expectationValue
             (K.comp ((interpFormula psem σ' B).comp K.adjoint)) ρ').re
     else 0) := by
  simp only [heff, and_true]
  split_ifs with h
  · exact (expectationValue_kraus_cycle K (interpFormula psem σ' B) ρ').symm
  · rfl

/-! ## Main theorem -/

/-- **Disjoint Kraus Postcondition Commutativity [Ying, Accumulation Rules]**

    When the quantum variables of a Kraus operator family F are disjoint from the
    quantum variables of program P (i.e., qv(F) ∩ qv(P) = empty), the Kraus
    operators commute with program execution for the purpose of postcondition
    expectation computation:

      sum_i postcondExpect(B_i, P, K_i^dagger . rho . K_i)
        <= postcondExpect(sum_j K_j . B_j . K_j^dagger, P, rho)

    This is the key technical lemma underlying the Accumulation Rules (Accum1, Accum2)
    of QHL+, which allow reasoning about quantum programs that apply Kraus operators
    on registers disjoint from the program's quantum variables.

    The proof uses:
    (1) Replay reindexing: derivations from K-sandwiched states biject with
        derivations from the original state.
    (2) Trace cyclicity: E(B, K^dagger . rho' . K) = E(K . B . K^dagger, rho').
    (3) Fubini interchange: finite Kraus sums commute with derivation tsums.
    (4) Kraus decomposition: sum_i E(K_i . B_i . K_i^dagger, rho') =
        E(sum_j K_j . B_j . K_j^dagger, rho'). -/

  -- S.image (qvSub x e) |>.image qvarBaseName = S.image qvarBaseName
  simp only [QuantumPredicateFormula.sig]
  rw [Finset.image_image]
  congr 1
  ext q
  exact hPresName q

private lemma kraus_heq_of_args_heq
    (F : KrausOpSym) {S₁ S₂ : Finset QVar} (hS : S₁ = S₂)
    (p₁ p₂ : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp) (hp : p₁ = p₂)
    (q₁ q₂ : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar) (hq : q₁ = q₂)
    (subs₁ : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) →
      QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S₁)
    (subs₂ : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) →
      QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S₂)
    (hsubs : ∀ i, HEq (subs₁ i) (subs₂ i))
    (hd₁ : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F), i ≠ j → q₁ i ≠ q₁ j)
    (hs₁ : ∀ i, q₁ i ∈ S₁)
    (hd₂ : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F), i ≠ j → q₂ i ≠ q₂ j)
    (hs₂ : ∀ i, q₂ i ∈ S₂) :
    HEq (QuantumPredicateFormula.kraus F p₁ q₁ subs₁ hd₁ hs₁)
         (QuantumPredicateFormula.kraus F p₂ q₂ subs₂ hd₂ hs₂) := by
  subst hS; subst hp; subst hq
  have : subs₁ = subs₂ := funext fun i => eq_of_heq (hsubs i)
  subst this; rfl

/-! ## Compositionality Properties -/

private lemma complement_heq_of_heq {S₁ S₂ : Finset QVar}
    (hS : S₁ = S₂)
    {A : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S₁}
    {B : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S₂}
    (h : HEq A B) : HEq A.complement B.complement := by
  subst hS; exact congrArg QuantumPredicateFormula.complement (eq_of_heq h) ▸ HEq.rfl

lemma substFormula_wellFormed_witness
    [Inhabited CVar] [Inhabited Exp] [Infinite QVar]
    [Inhabited AtomPred]
    (expSubst : CVar → Exp → Exp → Exp)
    (qvarSubst : CVar → Exp → QVar → QVar)
    (x : CVar) (e : Exp)
    (hqvInj : Function.Injective (qvarSubst x e)) :
    ∃ (S : Finset QVar)
      (A : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S)
      (B : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym
        (S.image (qvarSubst x e))),
      B.sig = S.image (qvarSubst x e) := by
  let qv : Fin (pcats.predQuantumArity (default : AtomPred)) → QVar :=
    (Infinite.natEmbedding QVar) ∘ Fin.val
  have hqv_inj : Function.Injective qv := by
    intro i j h
    have h1 := (Infinite.natEmbedding QVar).injective h
    exact Fin.val_injective h1
  have hdist : ∀ i j : Fin _, i ≠ j → qv i ≠ qv j := fun i j hij => hqv_inj.ne hij
  refine ⟨Finset.image qv Finset.univ, .atomic default (fun _ => default) qv hdist, ?_, rfl⟩
  exact substFormula expSubst qvarSubst x e hqvInj
    (.atomic default (fun _ => default) qv hdist)

/-! ## Helper: interpFormula is invariant under signature reindexing

Since `interpFormula` maps to `ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all` and does not depend on
the signature index `S`, it is invariant under `eqRec` on the signature. -/

/-- `interpFormula` applied to a signature-reindexed atomic formula gives the same result. -/
private theorem eq_rec_interpFormula_atomic {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
    (K : AtomPred)
    (params : Fin (pcats.predClassicalArity K) → Exp)
    (qvars : Fin (pcats.predQuantumArity K) → QVar)
    (hdist : ∀ i j : Fin _, i ≠ j → qvars i ≠ qvars j)
    {S : Finset QVar} (hS : Finset.image qvars Finset.univ = S) :
    interpFormula psem σ (hS ▸ QuantumPredicateFormula.atomic K params qvars hdist) =
      interpFormula psem σ (QuantumPredicateFormula.atomic K params qvars hdist) := by
  subst hS; rfl

/-- `interpFormula` applied to a signature-reindexed tensor formula gives the same result. -/
private theorem eq_rec_interpFormula_tensor {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
    {S₁ S₂ : Finset QVar} (hS : S₁ ∪ S₂ = (S₁ ∪ S₂))
    (A₁ : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S₁)
    (A₂ : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S₂)
    (hdisj : Disjoint S₁ S₂) :
    interpFormula psem σ (hS ▸ QuantumPredicateFormula.tensor A₁ A₂ hdisj) =
      interpFormula psem σ (QuantumPredicateFormula.tensor A₁ A₂ hdisj) := by
  rfl

/-- `interpFormula` is invariant under `eqRec` on the signature: if `hS : S₁ = S₂`,
    then interpreting a formula transported along `hS` gives the same result. -/

structure SubstitutionSemantics
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    (expSub : CVar → Exp → Exp → Exp)
    (qvSub : CVar → Exp → QVar → QVar) where
  /-- Quantum variable substitution is injective.
      Ensures distinctness of quantum variables is preserved under substitution. -/
  qvSub_injective : ∀ (x : CVar) (e : Exp), Function.Injective (qvSub x e)
  /-- Substitution lemma for atomic predicates (Lemma 5, Part 2 — atoms):
      `atomInterp(K, σ, expSub(params), qvSub(qvars)) = atomInterp(K, σ[x:=e], params, qvars)`.
      In the paper this follows from the definition of interpretation; here it is
      part of what it means to have a valid substitution semantics. -/
  substInterp_atom : ∀ (x : CVar) (e : Exp)
    (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
    (K : AtomPred)
    (params : Fin (pcats.predClassicalArity K) → Exp)
    (qvars : Fin (pcats.predQuantumArity K) → QVar),
    psem.atomInterp K σ (fun i => expSub x e (params i))
      (fun i => qvSub x e (qvars i)) =
    psem.atomInterp K (sem.classicalUpdate σ x e) params qvars
  /-- Substitution lemma for Kraus operators (Lemma 5, Part 2 — Kraus):
      `krausInterp(F, σ, expSub(params), qvSub(qvars), i) = krausInterp(F, σ[x:=e], params, qvars, i)`.
      Same coherence as `substInterp_atom` but for Kraus operator families. -/
  substInterp_kraus : ∀ (x : CVar) (e : Exp)
    (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
    (F : KrausOpSym)
    (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
    (qvars : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)
    (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F)),
    psem.krausInterp F σ (fun j => expSub x e (params j))
      (fun j => qvSub x e (qvars j)) i =
    psem.krausInterp F (sem.classicalUpdate σ x e) params qvars i

/-! ## Soundness Axioms

These bundle the semantic compatibility assumptions needed for the soundness proof.
They reflect the paper's implicit assumptions about the semantic interpretation. -/

/-- The foundational semantic compatibility axioms needed for the soundness proof of QHL⁺.
    This structure contains only the foundational axioms (semantic identities, substitution,
    Kraus properties). The 5 provable soundness rules (loop_tot, accum1/2_par, accum1/2_tot)
    are proved as standalone theorems in separate files.

    ## Fundamental axioms (genuine assumptions, cannot be derived internally):
    - `traceAxioms` — (now trivial: all fields moved into `ProgramSemantics`)
    - `summableTrace` — trace summability for tsum-based semantics (cannot be derived
      without Fintype — see field docstring for full explanation and instantiation recipe)
    - `substSem` — substitution semantics (bundles `qvSub_injective`, `substInterp_atom`,
      `substInterp_kraus` — these are DEFINITIONAL, part of `SubstitutionSemantics`)
    - `soundness_measure` — measurement rule soundness (uses measurement bridge)

    ## Bridge axioms (MOVED to QHLPlusDeriv constructors):
    The former `krausInit_bridge` and `krausUnitary_bridge` (and derived
    `krausInit_expectation` / `krausUnitary_expectation`) have been moved into the
    `axiomInit` and `axiomUnitary` constructors of `QHLPlusDeriv` / `QHLPlusTotDeriv`
    as explicit bridge hypotheses (`hInitBridge`, `hUnitaryBridge`).
    Reason: universally quantifying over all KrausOpSym was unsatisfiable for concrete
    multi-constructor types. The bridge now applies only to the specific F_B / F_U

    - `traceNonIncreaseDeriv`: derivable from `ProgramSemantics` fields + `summableTrace`

    - `interpFormula_effect`: derivable via `interpFormula_isQuantumEffect` in

    - `disjointKrausAccum1CommPar`: derivable via

/-! ## The Concrete ProgramContext -/

/-- The 3-qubit teleportation program context. -/
abbrev teleCtx : ProgramContext := nQubitContext 3 TeleCVar teleCVarType

/-- Abbreviation for classical states in the teleportation context. -/
abbrev TeleClassicalState := ClassicalState teleCtx

/-! ## Teleportation-Specific Helper Lemmas -/

/-- The adjoint of `toLinMap n M` equals `toLinMap n Mᴴ`. -/
private theorem tele_toLinMap_adjoint (n : ℕ) (M : Matrix (Fin (2 ^ n)) (Fin (2 ^ n)) ℂ) :
    (toLinMap n M).adjoint = toLinMap n Mᴴ := by
  unfold toLinMap
  rw [← Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint]

/-- Composition of `toLinMap` corresponds to matrix multiplication. -/
private theorem tele_toLinMap_comp (n : ℕ) (A B : Matrix (Fin (2 ^ n)) (Fin (2 ^ n)) ℂ) :
    (toLinMap n A).comp (toLinMap n B) = toLinMap n (A * B) := by
  unfold toLinMap
  rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin_eq_toLin_orthonormal]
  rw [Matrix.toLin_mul
    (v₁ := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (2 ^ n)) ℂ).toBasis)
    (v₂ := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (2 ^ n)) ℂ).toBasis)
    (v₃ := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (2 ^ n)) ℂ).toBasis)]

/-- `toLinMap n 1` is the identity linear map. -/
private theorem tele_toLinMap_id (n : ℕ) :
    toLinMap n (1 : Matrix (Fin (2 ^ n)) (Fin (2 ^ n)) ℂ) = LinearMap.id := by
  unfold toLinMap
  rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin_eq_toLin_orthonormal, Matrix.toLin_one]

/-- `toLinMap` maps the identity matrix to the algebraic `1`. -/
private theorem tele_toLinMap_one (n : ℕ) :
    toLinMap n (1 : Matrix (Fin (2 ^ n)) (Fin (2 ^ n)) ℂ) = 1 := by
  rw [tele_toLinMap_id]
  rfl

/-- Forward sandwich preserves PDO when `U U† ≤ I`. -/
private theorem tele_forward_sandwich_isPDO
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (U : E →ₗ[ℂ] E) (ρ : E →ₗ[ℂ] E)
    (hρ : IsPartialDensityOperator ρ)
    (hU : @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE (U.comp U.adjoint) 1) :
    IsPartialDensityOperator (U.comp (ρ.comp U.adjoint)) := by
  convert adjoint_sandwich_isPDO U.adjoint ρ hρ (by rwa [LinearMap.adjoint_adjoint]) using 2
  exact (LinearMap.adjoint_adjoint U).symm

theorem trace_sandwich_le
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
    (K ρ : E →ₗ[ℂ] E)
    (hρ : ρ.IsPositive)
    (hK : @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE
      ((LinearMap.adjoint K).comp K) 1) :
    RCLike.re ((LinearMap.trace ℂ E) ((LinearMap.adjoint K).comp (ρ.comp K))) ≤
    RCLike.re ((LinearMap.trace ℂ E) ρ) := by
  haveI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  -- Step 1: tr(K†∘ρ∘K) = tr(ρ∘K∘K†) by trace cyclicity
  -- Use mul notation (comp = mul for Module.End) so that trace_mul_comm applies
  have hcyclic : (LinearMap.trace ℂ E) (LinearMap.adjoint K * (ρ * K)) =
      (LinearMap.trace ℂ E) (ρ * (K * LinearMap.adjoint K)) := by
    rw [LinearMap.trace_mul_comm, mul_assoc]
  -- comp = mul definitionally for Module.End, so use `show` to switch notation
  show RCLike.re ((LinearMap.trace ℂ E) (LinearMap.adjoint K * (ρ * K))) ≤ _
  rw [hcyclic]
  -- Now goal is re(tr(ρ * (K * K†))) ≤ re(tr(ρ))
  -- Step 2: I - KK† ≥ 0
  have hKK : (1 - K * LinearMap.adjoint K).IsPositive := by
    rw [show (1 : E →ₗ[ℂ] E) - K * LinearMap.adjoint K =
        (1 : E →ₗ[ℂ] E) - K.comp (LinearMap.adjoint K) from rfl]
    rw [← loewnerOrder_iff]
    exact adjoint_comp_adjoint_le_one_of_comp_adjoint_le_one K hK
  -- Step 3: tr(ρ(I-KK†)) ≥ 0
  have hnn : 0 ≤ RCLike.re ((LinearMap.trace ℂ E) (ρ * (1 - K * LinearMap.adjoint K))) :=
    trace_psd_product_nonneg ρ (1 - K * LinearMap.adjoint K) hρ hKK
  -- Step 4: tr(ρ(I-KK†)) = tr(ρ) - tr(ρ(KK†))
  have hexpand : (LinearMap.trace ℂ E) (ρ * (1 - K * LinearMap.adjoint K)) =
      (LinearMap.trace ℂ E) ρ - (LinearMap.trace ℂ E) (ρ * (K * LinearMap.adjoint K)) := by
    rw [mul_sub, map_sub, mul_one]
  rw [hexpand] at hnn
  simp only [map_sub] at hnn
  linarith

/-! ## Adjoint Sandwich Preserves PDO -/

/-- If `ρ` is a partial density operator and `K†K ≤ I` (from sub-normalization),
    then `K†ρK` is a partial density operator.

    Step 1 (PSD): `K†ρK ≥ 0` by `adjoint_sandwich_isPositive` since `ρ ≥ 0`.
    Step 2 (trace): `tr(K†ρK) ≤ tr(ρ) ≤ 1` by `trace_sandwich_le`. -/

def CQAssertionEntails
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    (a₁ a₂ : CQAssert CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx) : Prop :=
  (∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx, a₁.φ σ → a₂.φ σ) ∧
  (∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx, a₁.φ σ →
    interpFormula psem σ a₁.A ≤ interpFormula psem σ a₂.A)

/-- Unfolding lemma for `CQAssertionEntails`. -/
preview.content_html:
What This Declaration Is Doing

This definition introduces the entailment relation between two classical-quantum assertions. Mathematically, it says that `a₁` entails `a₂` when, in every classical state, the classical condition of `a₁` is strong enough to force the classical condition of `a₂`, and whenever that classical condition of `a₁` holds, the quantum predicate carried by `a₁` is below the one carried by `a₂` in the semantic order. Its role is to formalize when one assertion is logically/semantically stronger than another, taking both the classical side and the quantum side into account.

Declaration Header

def CQAssertionEntails
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    (a_1 a_2 : CQAssert CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx) : Prop :=
  (forall σ : ClassicalState ctx, a_1.φ σ -> a_2.φ σ) /\
  (forall σ : ClassicalState ctx, a_1.φ σ ->
    interpFormula psem σ a_1.A <= interpFormula psem σ a_2.A)

  • psem (explicit input): the semantic map assigning mathematical meaning to the objects under study; more concretely, it is a gate symbol or gate-level operation.
  • a₁ a₂ (explicit input): the ambient context fixing the variables and registers under discussion; more concretely, it is a gate symbol or gate-level operation.
  • ∀ σ (explicit input): the ambient context fixing the variables and registers under discussion; more concretely, it is a rule that takes a classical state, usually written as a valuation of classical variables and returns an auxiliary object of type `a_2.φ σ`.
  • ∀ σ (explicit input): an interpretation map turning syntax into mathematical meaning; more concretely, it is a rule that takes a classical state, usually written as a valuation of classical variables and returns an auxiliary object of type `interpFormula psem σ a_1.A <= interpFormula psem σ a_2.A`.

Routine lines are intentionally omitted. This section only calls out places where Lean notation or proof scripting hides the underlying mathematical move.

  1. line 53 (forall σ : ClassicalState ctx, a_1.φ σ -> a_2.φ σ) /\
    This states the first requirement for entailment: for every classical state σ, whenever the classical condition φ of a₁ holds at σ, the classical condition φ of a₂ also holds. The final ∧ says that this classical implication must be combined with a second, quantum-order condition.
  2. line 54 (forall σ : ClassicalState ctx, a_1.φ σ ->
    This begins the second requirement, again ranging over every classical state σ, but only under the assumption that a₁’s classical side condition φ holds there. In other words, the quantum comparison is only demanded on states where a₁ is classically applicable.
  3. line 55 interpFormula psem σ a_1.A <= interpFormula psem σ a_2.A)
    Here the quantum parts of the two assertions are compared at the same classical state σ: the interpretation of a₁.A must be less than or equal to the interpretation of a₂.A. Mathematically, this says a₂’s quantum claim is at least as strong as, or contains, the one from a₁ at every relevant σ.

structure TerminatingDerivation
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx) where
  /-- The terminal state reached. -/
  result : CQState ctx
  /-- The derivation path. -/
  path : DerivationPath sem
  /-- Well-formedness: path starts from ⟨P, ω⟩. -/
  path_start : path.startConfig = Configuration.ofProgram P ω
  /-- Well-formedness: path ends at ⟨↓, result⟩. -/
  path_end : path.endConfig = Configuration.terminal result
  /-- Well-formedness: consecutive steps in path are connected. -/
  path_wf : path.wf
  /-- Deep well-formedness: all substeps have correct c₁/c₂. -/
  path_deep_wf : path.all_substep_wf := by trivial

/-- The number of operational steps in a terminating derivation. -/
preview.content_html:
What This Declaration Is Doing

`QHL.TerminatingDerivation` packages the data witnessing that a program `P`, started in an initial classical-quantum state `ω`, actually terminates under the operational semantics `sem`. Mathematically, it is a certificate of one complete execution: it records the final state reached, the sequence of reduction steps taken, and proofs that this sequence really starts from the intended initial configuration, ends in a terminal configuration, and is locally consistent at each step. The parameters `ctx`, `sem`, `P`, and `ω` fix the ambient programming language/state space, the transition system, the program being run, and the initial state. The output is therefore not just the endpoint `result`, but a fully validated terminating run from `⟨P, ω⟩` to a halted configuration.

def joinSeqPath {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (P₂ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (path₁ path₂ : DerivationPath sem) : DerivationPath sem :=
  match path₁ with
  | .refl _ => path₂
  | .step s rest =>
    match s.c₁.prog, s.c₂.prog with
    | some P₁_cur, none =>
      .step (.seqDone P₁_cur P₂ s.startState s.c₂.state s) (joinSeqPath sem P₂ rest path₂)
    | some P₁_cur, some P₁' =>
      .step (.seqStep P₁_cur P₂ P₁' s.startState s.c₂.state s) (joinSeqPath sem P₂ rest path₂)
    | none, _ => path₂ -- impossible: steps from terminal configs don't arise in valid paths

/-- `joinSeqPath` preserves or increases path length relative to `path₂`. -/

theorem krausInit_expectation_from_bridge
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx}
    {psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx}
    (q : QVar) (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
    (F_B : KrausOpSym)
    (fParams : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F_B) → Exp)
    (fQvars : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F_B) → QVar)
    (fHdist : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F_B), i ≠ j → fQvars i ≠ fQvars j)
    {S : Finset QVar}
    (fHsub : ∀ i, fQvars i ∈ S)
    (A : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S)
    (ρ : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all)
    -- Bridge hypothesis (from QHLPlusDeriv.axiomInit.hInitBridge)
    (hBridge : ∀ (σ' : ClassicalState ctx) (ρ' : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all),
      ∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F_B),
        (psem.krausInterp F_B σ' fParams fQvars i).adjoint.comp
          (ρ'.comp (psem.krausInterp F_B σ' fParams fQvars i)) =
      sem.qInitTransform σ' q ρ') :
    (expectationValue
      (interpFormula psem σ (.kraus F_B fParams fQvars (fun _ => A) fHdist fHsub)) ρ).re =
    (expectationValue (interpFormula psem σ A) (sem.qInitTransform σ q ρ)).re := by
  rw [interpFormula_kraus]
  rw [expectationValue_sum_left_re]
  simp_rw [expectationValue_kraus_cycle']
  rw [← expectationValue_sum_right_re]
  rw [hBridge σ ρ]

theorem krausUnitary_expectation_from_bridge
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx}
    {psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx}
    (U : Gate)
    (gateParams : Fin (cats.gateClassicalArity U) → Exp)
    (gateQvars : Fin (cats.gateQuantumArity U) → QVar)
    (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
    (F_U : KrausOpSym)
    (fParams : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F_U) → Exp)
    (fQvars : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F_U) → QVar)
    (fHdist : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F_U), i ≠ j → fQvars i ≠ fQvars j)
    {S : Finset QVar}
    (fHsub : ∀ i, fQvars i ∈ S)
    (A : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S)
    (ρ : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all)
    -- Bridge hypothesis (from QHLPlusDeriv.axiomUnitary.hUnitaryBridge)
    (hBridge :
      (pcats.krausRank F_U = 1) ∧
      ∀ (σ' : ClassicalState ctx) (h1 : pcats.krausRank F_U = 1),
        psem.krausInterp F_U σ' fParams fQvars ⟨0, h1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ =
          (sem.unitaryOp U σ' gateParams gateQvars).adjoint) :
    (expectationValue
      (interpFormula psem σ (.kraus F_U fParams fQvars (fun _ => A) fHdist fHsub)) ρ).re =
    (expectationValue (interpFormula psem σ A)
      ((sem.unitaryOp U σ gateParams gateQvars).comp
        (ρ.comp (sem.unitaryOp U σ gateParams gateQvars).adjoint))).re := by
  obtain ⟨hrank1, hK0⟩ := hBridge
  rw [interpFormula_kraus]
  rw [expectationValue_sum_left_re]
  simp_rw [expectationValue_kraus_cycle']
  have hsum_single : ∀ (f : Fin (pcats.krausRank F_U) → ℝ),
      ∑ i, f i = f ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ := by
    intro f
    have : Subsingleton (Fin (pcats.krausRank F_U)) := by
      rw [hrank1]; exact Unique.instSubsingleton
    exact Fintype.sum_subsingleton _ _
  rw [hsum_single]
  specialize hK0 σ hrank1
  congr 1
  rw [hK0]
  simp [LinearMap.adjoint_adjoint]

private lemma ofProgram_terminal_conflict {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (P : Prog) (ω ω' : CQState ctx)
    {c : Configuration CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx}
    (hstart : c = Configuration.ofProgram P ω)
    (hend : c = Configuration.terminal ω') : False := by
  have hprog_start := congr_arg Configuration.prog hstart
  have hprog_end := congr_arg Configuration.prog hend
  simp [Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.prog] at hprog_start hprog_end
  rw [hprog_start] at hprog_end
  exact absurd hprog_end nofun

private lemma terminatingDerivation_simple_result {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : Semantics ctx)
    (P : Prog) (ω ω' : CQState ctx)
    (hstep_target : ∀ s : OpStep sem,
      s.c₁ = Configuration.ofProgram P ω → s.c₂ = Configuration.terminal ω')
    (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω) :
    d.result = ω' := by
  obtain ⟨result, path, hstart, hend, hwf⟩ := d
  cases path with
  | refl c =>
    exact False.elim (ofProgram_terminal_conflict P ω result hstart hend)
  | step s rest =>
    simp [DerivationPath.startConfig] at hstart
    have hs₂ := hstep_target s hstart
    obtain ⟨hconn, _⟩ := hwf
    have hrest_start : rest.startConfig = Configuration.terminal ω' := hconn ▸ hs₂
    have hrest_end := derivationPath_from_terminal_eq sem ω' rest hrest_start
    simp [DerivationPath.endConfig] at hend
    rw [hrest_end] at hend
    simp [Configuration.terminal, Configuration.mk.injEq] at hend
    exact hend.symm

    PLift (p₂.endConfig = Configuration.terminal result) ×
    PLift p₂.wf ×

noncomputable def joinSeqPath_splitSeqPath_certified_path_eq {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    {P₁ P₂ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas}
    {ω : CQState ctx}

    (hstart : path.startConfig = Configuration.ofProgram (.seq P₁ P₂) ω)
    {result : CQState ctx}

    let sp := splitSeqPath_certified sem path hstart hend hwf hall
    joinSeqPath sem P₂ sp.2.1 sp.2.2.1 = path := by
  -- Match on (path, hstart, hend, hwf, hall) mirroring splitSeqPath_certified exactly
  match path, hstart, hend, hwf, hall with
  | .refl c, hstart, hend, _, _ =>

    have h1 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hstart
    have h2 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hend
    simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, DerivationPath.endConfig,
      Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.prog] at h1 h2
    rw [h1] at h2; exact absurd h2 nofun
  | .step (.seqStep P₁' P₂' P₁'' ω_s ω_e sub) rest, hstart, hend, hwf, hall =>
    -- splitSeqPath_certified reduces in this branch to:
    --   let sp_rest := splitSeqPath_certified sem rest ...
    --   ⟨sp_rest.1, .step sub sp_rest.2.1, sp_rest.2.2.1, ...⟩
    -- So sp.2.1 = .step sub sp_rest.2.1, sp.2.2.1 = sp_rest.2.2.1
    have hsc₁ : (OpStep.seqStep P₁' P₂' P₁'' ω_s ω_e sub).c₁ =
      Configuration.ofProgram (.seq P₁ P₂) ω := by
      simpa [DerivationPath.startConfig] using hstart
    have hprogs := congr_arg Configuration.prog hsc₁
    simp only [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.prog,
      ProgDown.running, Option.some.injEq, QWhilePlus.seq.injEq] at hprogs
    obtain ⟨hc₁_sub, hc₂_sub, _⟩ := hall.1
    have hsub_c₁_prog : sub.c₁.prog = some P₁ := by rw [hc₁_sub, hprogs.1]; rfl
    have hsub_c₂_prog : sub.c₂.prog = some P₁'' := by rw [hc₂_sub]; rfl
    -- Unfold splitSeqPath_certified: in this branch it matches and produces the tuple in term mode
    unfold splitSeqPath_certified
    -- The term-mode match should reduce since we matched on the same pattern
    -- The result is: ⟨ω_mid, .step sub p₁_rest, p₂, ...⟩
    -- where (ω_mid, p₁_rest, p₂, ...) = splitSeqPath_certified sem rest ...
    -- Use change to assert the definitionally equal simplified form
    change joinSeqPath sem P₂
      (.step sub (splitSeqPath_certified sem rest _ _ hwf.2 hall.2).2.1)
      (splitSeqPath_certified sem rest _ _ hwf.2 hall.2).2.2.1 =
      .step (.seqStep P₁' P₂' P₁'' ω_s ω_e sub) rest
    unfold joinSeqPath; rw [hsub_c₁_prog, hsub_c₂_prog]; simp only [joinSeqPath]
    have hss : sub.startState = ω_s := by
      cases sub <;> simp_all [OpStep.startState, OpStep.c₁,
        Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.state]
    rw [hss, show sub.c₂.state = ω_e from by rw [hc₂_sub]; rfl]
    -- Goal: .step (.seqStep P₁ P₂ ...) (joinSeqPath ...) = .step (.seqStep P₁' P₂' ...) rest
    -- Rewrite P₁' → P₁ and P₂' → P₂ only on the RHS using conv
    conv_rhs => rw [show P₁' = P₁ from hprogs.1, show P₂' = P₂ from hprogs.2]
    congr 1
    exact joinSeqPath_splitSeqPath_certified_path_eq sem rest _ _ hwf.2 hall.2
  | .step (.seqDone P₁' P₂' ω_s ω_e sub) rest, hstart, hend, hwf, hall =>
    have hsc₁ : (OpStep.seqDone P₁' P₂' ω_s ω_e sub).c₁ =
      Configuration.ofProgram (.seq P₁ P₂) ω := by
      simpa [DerivationPath.startConfig] using hstart
    have hprogs := congr_arg Configuration.prog hsc₁
    simp only [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.prog,
      ProgDown.running, Option.some.injEq, QWhilePlus.seq.injEq] at hprogs
    obtain ⟨hc₁_sub, hc₂_sub, _⟩ := hall.1
    have hsub_c₁_prog : sub.c₁.prog = some P₁ := by rw [hc₁_sub, hprogs.1]; rfl
    have hsub_c₂_prog : sub.c₂.prog = none := by rw [hc₂_sub]; rfl
    unfold splitSeqPath_certified
    change joinSeqPath sem P₂ (.step sub (.refl (Configuration.terminal ω_e))) rest =
      .step (.seqDone P₁' P₂' ω_s ω_e sub) rest
    unfold joinSeqPath
    rw [hsub_c₁_prog, hsub_c₂_prog]
    simp only [joinSeqPath]
    have hss : sub.startState = ω_s := by
      cases sub <;> simp_all [OpStep.startState, OpStep.c₁,
        Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.state]
    have hcs : sub.c₂.state = ω_e := by rw [hc₂_sub]; rfl
    rw [hss, hcs]
    conv_rhs => rw [show P₁' = P₁ from hprogs.1, show P₂' = P₂ from hprogs.2]
  | .step (.skip _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.classAssign _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.qInit _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.unitaryApp _ _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.measure _ _ _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.ifTrue _ _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.ifFalse _ _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.whileTrue _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.whileFalse _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart

/-- Split a TerminatingDerivation for P₁;P₂ into P₁ and P₂ sub-derivations.
    Constructs full TerminatingDerivation objects with all well-formedness certificates,
    including `path_deep_wf` (all_substep_wf) propagated from the input derivation. -/
noncomputable def splitSeqDeriv {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (P₁ P₂ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx)
    (d : TerminatingDerivation sem (.seq P₁ P₂) ω) :
    (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P₁ ω) × TerminatingDerivation sem P₂ d₁.result := by
  let ⟨ω_mid, p₁, p₂, ⟨h₁s⟩, ⟨h₁e⟩, ⟨h₁w⟩, ⟨h₁a⟩, ⟨h₂s⟩, ⟨h₂e⟩, ⟨h₂w⟩, ⟨h₂a⟩⟩ :=
    splitSeqPath_certified sem d.path d.path_start d.path_end d.path_wf d.path_deep_wf
  exact ⟨⟨ω_mid, p₁, h₁s, h₁e, h₁w, h₁a⟩,
         ⟨d.result, p₂, h₂s, h₂e, h₂w, h₂a⟩⟩

/-- The P₂ sub-path from `splitSeqPath_certified` has strictly smaller length than the input path.
    Uses the roundtrip lemma `joinSeqPath_splitSeqPath_certified_path_eq` and
    `joinSeqPath_length_ge_snd` to establish the bound without unfolding the opaque definition. -/

theorem substFormula_interp {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    (expSubst : CVar → Exp → Exp → Exp)
    (qvarSubst : CVar → Exp → QVar → QVar)
    (x : CVar) (e : Exp)
    (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
    (σ' : ClassicalState ctx)
    (hqvInj : Function.Injective (qvarSubst x e))
    (hAtom : ∀ (K : AtomPred)
      (params : Fin (pcats.predClassicalArity K) → Exp)
      (qvars : Fin (pcats.predQuantumArity K) → QVar),
      psem.atomInterp K σ (fun i => expSubst x e (params i))
        (fun i => qvarSubst x e (qvars i)) =
      psem.atomInterp K σ' params qvars)
    (hKraus : ∀ (F : KrausOpSym)
      (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
      (qvars : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar),
      psem.krausInterp F σ (fun i => expSubst x e (params i))
        (fun i => qvarSubst x e (qvars i)) =
      psem.krausInterp F σ' params qvars)
    {S : Finset QVar}
    (A : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S) :
    interpFormula psem σ (substFormula expSubst qvarSubst x e hqvInj A) =
      interpFormula psem σ' A := by
  induction A with
  | atomic K params qvars hdist =>
    simp only [substFormula]
    rw [interpFormula_eqRec]
    simp only [interpFormula_atomic]
    exact hAtom K params qvars
  | complement B ih =>
    simp only [substFormula_complement, interpFormula_complement, ih]
  | tensor A₁ A₂ hdisj ih₁ ih₂ =>
    simp only [substFormula]
    rw [interpFormula_eqRec]
    simp only [interpFormula_tensor]
    rw [ih₁, ih₂]
  | kraus F params qvars subFormulas hdist hsub ih =>
    simp only [substFormula, interpFormula_kraus]
    congr 1
    ext i
    have hK := hKraus F params qvars
    rw [ih i, hK]

theorem substFormula_id (expSub : CVar → Exp → Exp → Exp)
    (qvSub : CVar → Exp → QVar → QVar) (x : CVar) (e : Exp)
    (hqvInj : Function.Injective (qvSub x e))
    (hExpId : ∀ t : Exp, expSub x e t = t)
    (hQvId : ∀ q : QVar, qvSub x e q = q)
    {S : Finset QVar}
    (A : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S) :
    HEq (substFormula expSub qvSub x e hqvInj A) A := by
  have hQvSubEq : qvSub x e = id := funext hQvId
  have hImgEq : ∀ (T : Finset QVar), T.image (qvSub x e) = T := by
    intro T; rw [hQvSubEq, Finset.image_id]
  induction A with
  | atomic K params qvars hdist =>
    have h1 : (fun i => expSub x e (params i)) = params := funext fun i => hExpId _
    have h2 : (fun i => qvSub x e (qvars i)) = qvars := funext fun i => hQvId _
    simp only [substFormula]
    refine (eqRec_heq _ _).trans ?_
    suffices ∀ p q (hp : p = params) (hq : q = qvars)
        (hd : ∀ i j : Fin _, i ≠ j → q i ≠ q j),
        HEq (QuantumPredicateFormula.atomic K p q hd)
             (QuantumPredicateFormula.atomic K params qvars hdist) by
      exact this _ _ h1 h2 _
    intro p q hp hq hd; subst hp; subst hq; rfl
  | complement B ih =>
    simp only [substFormula_complement]
    exact complement_heq_of_heq (hImgEq _) ih
  | tensor A₁ A₂ hdisj ih₁ ih₂ =>
    rename_i S₁ S₂
    have hS₁ : S₁.image (qvSub x e) = S₁ := hImgEq S₁
    have hS₂ : S₂.image (qvSub x e) = S₂ := hImgEq S₂
    have hSig : (S₁ ∪ S₂).image (qvSub x e) = S₁ ∪ S₂ := hImgEq _
    -- Build the result as an explicit transport
    have inner : HEq ((substFormula expSub qvSub x e hqvInj A₁).tensor
        (substFormula expSub qvSub x e hqvInj A₂)
        (disjoint_image_of_injective _ hqvInj hdisj))
        (A₁.tensor A₂ hdisj) := by
      suffices ∀ (T₁ : Finset QVar) (hT₁ : T₁ = S₁)
          (T₂ : Finset QVar) (hT₂ : T₂ = S₂)
          (B₁ : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym T₁)
          (_ : HEq B₁ A₁)
          (B₂ : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym T₂)
          (_ : HEq B₂ A₂)
          (hd : Disjoint T₁ T₂) (hd' : Disjoint S₁ S₂),
          HEq (QuantumPredicateFormula.tensor B₁ B₂ hd) (A₁.tensor A₂ hd') by
        exact this _ hS₁ _ hS₂ _ ih₁ _ ih₂ _ hdisj
      intro T₁ hT₁ T₂ hT₂ B₁ hB₁ B₂ hB₂ hd hd'
      subst hT₁; subst hT₂
      have := eq_of_heq hB₁; have := eq_of_heq hB₂
      subst ‹B₁ = A₁›; subst ‹B₂ = A₂›; rfl
    -- Now connect substFormula (which uses hUnion ▸) to the tensor we just proved about
    show substFormula expSub qvSub x e hqvInj (A₁.tensor A₂ hdisj) ≍ A₁.tensor A₂ hdisj
    simp only [substFormula]
    exact (eqRec_heq _ _).trans inner
  | kraus F params qvars subFormulas hdist hsub ih =>
    simp only [substFormula]
    exact kraus_heq_of_args_heq _ (hImgEq _)
      _ _ (funext fun i => hExpId _) _ _ (funext fun i => hQvId _)
      _ _ (fun i => ih i) _ _ _ _

    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    (σ : ClassicalState ctx)

  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := witness.hloc₂ A₂

theorem dualKrausAction_isQuantumEffect {k : ℕ} {ops : Fin k → (E →ₗ[ℂ] E)}
    (hK : IsKrausFamily k ops)
    {effects : Fin k → (E →ₗ[ℂ] E)}
    (heff : ∀ i, IsQuantumEffect (effects i)) :
    IsQuantumEffect (dualKrausAction k ops effects) := by
  constructor
  · -- Positive semidefinite
    exact dualKrausAction_isPositive ops effects (fun i => (heff i).isPositive)
  · -- (1 - F*).IsPositive, i.e., F* ≤ 1
    -- F* ≤ ∑ Eᵢ† Eᵢ ≤ 1
    have h1 : @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE
        (dualKrausAction k ops effects)
        (∑ i, LinearMap.adjoint (ops i) ∘ₗ ops i) :=

    have h2 : @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder E).toPreorder.toLE
        (∑ i, LinearMap.adjoint (ops i) ∘ₗ ops i) 1 := hK
    -- Transitivity
    have h3 := loewnerOrder_trans h1 h2
    rw [loewnerOrder_iff] at h3
    exact h3

    (hle : A ≤ B) :
    expectation A ρ ≤ expectation B ρ := by
  -- Translate the matrix-level Löwner order to the abstract level

    show (B.mat.toEuclideanLin - A.mat.toEuclideanLin).IsPositive
    have hle_mat : (B.mat - A.mat).PosSemidef := hle

    convert hle_mat using 1

  have h := @expectationValue_re_monotone (EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) _ _ _
    A.mat.toEuclideanLin B.mat.toEuclideanLin ρ.mat.toEuclideanLin
    (qeffect_isQuantumEffect A) (qeffect_isQuantumEffect B)

theorem innerProduct_self_eq_zero (v : TensorProduct ℂ H₁ H₂) :
    ⟪v, v⟫ₜ = 0 ↔ v = 0 := by
  classical
  let b₁ := stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H₁
  let b₂ := stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ H₂
  let basis := b₁.toBasis.tensorProduct b₂.toBasis
  rw [innerProductTensorProduct_eq_basis b₁ b₂]
  unfold innerProductTensorProductBasis
  simp only
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h_coords_zero : ∀ ij, basis.repr v ij = 0 := by
      intro ij
      have h_eq : ∑ ij, (starRingEnd ℂ (basis.repr v ij)) * (basis.repr v ij) =
                  ∑ ij, (Complex.normSq (basis.repr v ij) : ℂ) := by
        congr 1; funext ij'
        simp [Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self]
      rw [h_eq] at h
      have h_sum_real : (∑ ij, (Complex.normSq (basis.repr v ij) : ℂ)) =
                        (↑(∑ ij, Complex.normSq (basis.repr v ij)) : ℂ) := by
        rw [← Complex.ofReal_sum]
      rw [h_sum_real] at h
      have h_zero_real : (∑ ij, Complex.normSq (basis.repr v ij)) = 0 :=
        Complex.ofReal_inj.mp h
      have h_term_zero : ∀ ij ∈ Finset.univ, Complex.normSq (basis.repr v ij) = 0 := by
        exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
                  (fun ij _ => Complex.normSq_nonneg (basis.repr v ij))).mp h_zero_real
      exact Complex.normSq_eq_zero.mp (h_term_zero ij (Finset.mem_univ ij))
    have : basis.repr v = 0 := by ext ij; exact h_coords_zero ij
    exact basis.repr.injective (by simp [this])
  · intro h; rw [h]; simp [map_zero]

/-! ## Section 5: Pure Tensor Formula -/

/-- Pure tensor formula: `⟪x₁ ⊗ y₁, x₂ ⊗ y₂⟫ₜ = ⟨x₁, x₂⟩ · ⟨y₁, y₂⟩`.
    Uses Parseval identity + coordinate factorization + Fubini for finite sums. -/

theorem interpFormula_complement_anti_mono
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
    {S : Finset QVar}
    (A B : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S)
    (h : @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder ctx.H_all).toPreorder.toLE
      (interpFormula psem σ A) (interpFormula psem σ B)) :
    @LE.le _ (LoewnerOrder ctx.H_all).toPreorder.toLE
      (interpFormula psem σ (.complement B))
      (interpFormula psem σ (.complement A)) := by
  haveI : CompleteSpace ctx.H_all := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ ctx.H_all
  simp only [interpFormula_complement]
  -- Goal: 1 - σ(B) ≤ 1 - σ(A)
  -- From h: σ(A) ≤ σ(B), i.e. (σ(B) - σ(A)).IsPositive
  rw [loewnerOrder_iff] at h ⊢
  -- Goal: ((1 - σ(A)) - (1 - σ(B))).IsPositive = (σ(B) - σ(A)).IsPositive
  have heq : (1 : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all) - interpFormula psem σ A -
      ((1 : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all) - interpFormula psem σ B) =
      interpFormula psem σ B - interpFormula psem σ A := by
    ext v
    simp [LinearMap.sub_apply]
  rw [heq]
  exact h

/-- **Kraus monotone**: if `σ(Aᵢ) ≤ σ(Bᵢ)` for all i, then
    `σ(F[q̄]({Aᵢ})) ≤ σ(F[q̄]({Bᵢ}))`.

    Proof: unfold to `∑ Kᵢ ∘ Aᵢ ∘ Kᵢ†`, apply `sum_forward_sandwich_mono`. -/

theorem interpFormula_isQuantumEffect_simple
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
    (htensor_comm : ∀ {S₁ S₂ : Finset QVar}
      (A₁ : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S₁)
      (A₂ : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S₂)
      (_ : Disjoint S₁ S₂),
      (interpFormula psem σ A₁).comp (interpFormula psem σ A₂) =
      (interpFormula psem σ A₂).comp (interpFormula psem σ A₁))
    {S : Finset QVar}
    (A : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S) :
    IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem σ A) := by
  haveI : CompleteSpace ctx.H_all := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ ctx.H_all
  induction A with
  | atomic K params qvars hdist =>
    -- Case 1: atomic — directly from psem
    exact psem.atomInterp_isQuantumEffect K σ params qvars
  | complement A ihA =>
    -- Case 2: complement — swap the two positivity conditions
    simp only [interpFormula_complement]
    exact ⟨ihA.complement_isPositive, by simpa [sub_sub_cancel] using ihA.isPositive⟩
  | tensor A₁ A₂ hdisj ihA₁ ihA₂ =>
    -- Case 3: tensor — by commutativity of disjoint operators + effect composition
    simp only [interpFormula_tensor]
    exact tensorComp_isQuantumEffect psem σ A₁ A₂ hdisj ihA₁ ihA₂
      (htensor_comm A₁ A₂ hdisj)
  | kraus F params qvars subFormulas hdist hsub ihSub =>
    -- Case 4: kraus — ∑ Eᵢ ∘ σ(Bᵢ) ∘ Eᵢ†
    simp only [interpFormula_kraus]
    -- interpFormula = ∑ Eᵢ ∘ σ(Bᵢ) ∘ Eᵢ†
    -- By IH, each σ(Bᵢ) is a QE: 0 ≤ σ(Bᵢ) ≤ I
    -- Lower bound: ∑ E A E† ≥ 0 (each E A E† ≥ 0 since A ≥ 0)
    -- Upper bound: ∑ E A E† ≤ I (using dual sub-normalization ∑EE† ≤ I and A ≤ I)
    constructor
    · -- Lower bound: positivity
      apply sum_forward_sandwich_isPositive
      intro i; exact (ihSub i).isPositive
    · -- Upper bound: ≤ I
      -- Need: (1 - ∑EAE†).IsPositive
      have hle := sum_forward_sandwich_le_one
        (fun i => psem.krausInterp F σ params qvars i)
        (psem.krausInterp_isKrausFamily F σ params qvars)
        (fun i => interpFormula psem σ (subFormulas i))
        (fun i => by
          rw [loewnerOrder_iff]
          exact (ihSub i).complement_isPositive)
      rw [loewnerOrder_iff] at hle
      exact hle

    (Finset.univ.sum (fun m =>
      ((LinearMap.trace ℂ ctx.H_all)
        ((sem.measOp M σ qvars m).comp
          (ρ.comp (sem.measOp M σ qvars m).adjoint))).re)) ≤
    ((LinearMap.trace ℂ ctx.H_all) ρ).re := by
  -- Step 1: Rewrite each summand using trace cyclicity
  have hsum_eq : ∀ m, ((LinearMap.trace ℂ ctx.H_all)
      ((sem.measOp M σ qvars m).comp
        (ρ.comp (sem.measOp M σ qvars m).adjoint))).re =
    ((LinearMap.trace ℂ ctx.H_all)
      ((LinearMap.adjoint (sem.measOp M σ qvars m) ∘ₗ
        (sem.measOp M σ qvars m)) ∘ₗ ρ)).re := by
    intro m; congr 1; exact trace_meas_summand M σ qvars m ρ
  simp_rw [hsum_eq]
  -- Step 2: ∑ tr(A_m ∘ₗ ρ).re = (∑ tr(A_m ∘ₗ ρ)).re  [re distributes over finite sum]
  rw [← Complex.re_sum]
  -- Step 3: ∑ tr(A_m ∘ₗ ρ) = tr(∑ A_m ∘ₗ ρ) = tr((∑ A_m) ∘ₗ ρ)
  -- = expectationValue(S, ρ)
  have hexpect : (∑ m : cats.measOutcomeType M,
      (LinearMap.trace ℂ ctx.H_all)
        ((LinearMap.adjoint (sem.measOp M σ qvars m) ∘ₗ
          (sem.measOp M σ qvars m)) ∘ₗ ρ)) =
    expectationValue (∑ m : cats.measOutcomeType M,
      LinearMap.adjoint (sem.measOp M σ qvars m) ∘ₗ (sem.measOp M σ qvars m)) ρ := by
    unfold expectationValue
    rw [← map_sum]
    congr 1
    ext v
    simp [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [hexpect]
  -- Step 4: Apply Prop 4 (expectation bounded by trace)

structure MeasurementConfig
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSemantics ctx)
    (psem : PredSemantics ctx)
    (expSub : CVar → Exp → Exp → Exp)
    (qvSub : CVar → Exp → QVar → QVar) where
  /-- The classical variable `x` that stores the measurement outcome. -/
  x : CVar
  /-- The measurement symbol `M` being applied. -/
  M : Meas
  /-- The qubit map for the measurement. -/
  measQvars : Fin (cats.measQuantumArity M) → QVar
  /-- Distinctness of measurement qubits. -/
  measHdist : ∀ i j : Fin (cats.measQuantumArity M), i ≠ j → measQvars i ≠ measQvars j
  /-- The fresh classical variable `y` (standing for a possible outcome). -/
  y : CVar
  /-- The expression form of `y`. -/
  y_exp : Exp
  /-- The base postcondition `(φ, A)` (before adding `x = y`). -/
  post_base : CQAssert CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx
  /-- The Kraus operator symbol `F_M(y)` for the measurement. -/
  F_My : KrausOpSym
  /-- Classical parameters for the Kraus symbol. -/
  fParams : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F_My) → Exp
  /-- Quantum variable map for the Kraus symbol. -/
  fQvars : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F_My) → QVar
  /-- Distinctness of Kraus quantum variables. -/
  fHdist : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F_My), i ≠ j → fQvars i ≠ fQvars j
  /-- Injectivity of quantum variable substitution `qvSub x y_exp`. -/
  hInj : Function.Injective (qvSub x y_exp)
  /-- Kraus qvars lie in the substituted support. -/
  fHsub : ∀ i, fQvars i ∈ post_base.S.image (qvSub x y_exp)
  /-- The classical formula `x = y` in the postcondition. -/
  eqXY : ClassicalState ctx → Prop
  /-- `eqXY` models `x = y`: holds iff updating `x` to `y`'s value is identity. -/
  heqXY : ∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx, eqXY σ ↔ sem.classicalUpdate σ x y_exp = σ
  /-- Freshness: `y ∉ free(φ)` — updating `y` does not change `φ`. -/
  hfresh_φ : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (e : Exp),
    post_base.φ σ ↔ post_base.φ (sem.classicalUpdate σ y e)
  /-- Freshness: `y ∉ cv(A)` — updating `y` does not change interpretation of `A`. -/
  hfresh_A : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (e : Exp),
    interpFormula psem σ post_base.A =
    interpFormula psem (sem.classicalUpdate σ y e) post_base.A
  /-- Freshness: `y ≠ x`. -/
  hy_ne_x : y ≠ x
  /-- Maps each classical state to the measurement outcome that `y_exp` selects. -/
  outcomeOf : ClassicalState ctx → cats.measOutcomeType M
  /-- Bridge hypothesis: F_My has rank 1, its single operator is (measOp)†,
      outcome selection is consistent with classical update,
      and eqXY holds at the measured state. -/
  hMeasBridge :
    (pcats.krausRank F_My = 1) ∧
    (∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (h1 : pcats.krausRank F_My = 1),
      psem.krausInterp F_My σ fParams fQvars ⟨0, h1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ =
        (sem.measOp M σ measQvars (outcomeOf σ)).adjoint) ∧
    (∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx),
      sem.measClassicalUpdate σ x M (outcomeOf σ) = sem.classicalUpdate σ x y_exp) ∧
    (∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx),
      eqXY (sem.measClassicalUpdate σ x M (outcomeOf σ)))
