private theorem opStep_disjointFrom_of_prog_disjoint {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx}
    (s : OpStep sem)
    (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx)
    (hc₁ : s.c₁ = Configuration.ofProgram P ω)
    (hsw : s.substep_wf)
    (qvarsK : Finset QVar)
    (hDisj : Disjoint qvarsK P.quantumVars) :
    s.disjointFrom qvarsK := by
  cases s with
  | skip _ => trivial
  | classAssign _ _ _ => trivial
  | qInit q ω' =>
    have hP : P = .qInit q := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₁
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    subst hP
    simp only [OpStep.disjointFrom]
    simp [QWhilePlus.quantumVars] at hDisj
    exact hDisj
  | unitaryApp U params qvars hdist ω' =>
    have hP : P = .unitaryApp U params qvars hdist := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₁
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    subst hP
    simp only [OpStep.disjointFrom]
    simp [QWhilePlus.quantumVars] at hDisj
    exact Disjoint.symm hDisj
  | measure x M qvars hdist ω' m =>
    have hP : P = .measure x M qvars hdist := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₁
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    subst hP
    simp only [OpStep.disjointFrom]
    simp [QWhilePlus.quantumVars] at hDisj
    exact Disjoint.symm hDisj
  | seqStep P₁ P₂ P₁' ω₁ ω₂ sub =>
    have hP : P = .seq P₁ P₂ := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₁
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    subst hP
    simp only [OpStep.disjointFrom]
    obtain ⟨hsub_c₁, _, hsub_wf⟩ := hsw
    have hDisj₁ : Disjoint qvarsK P₁.quantumVars := by
      simp [QWhilePlus.quantumVars] at hDisj; exact hDisj.1
    exact opStep_disjointFrom_of_prog_disjoint sub P₁ ω₁ hsub_c₁ hsub_wf qvarsK hDisj₁
  | seqDone P₁ P₂ ω₁ ω₂ sub =>
    have hP : P = .seq P₁ P₂ := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₁
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    subst hP
    simp only [OpStep.disjointFrom]
    obtain ⟨hsub_c₁, _, hsub_wf⟩ := hsw
    have hDisj₁ : Disjoint qvarsK P₁.quantumVars := by
      simp [QWhilePlus.quantumVars] at hDisj; exact hDisj.1
    exact opStep_disjointFrom_of_prog_disjoint sub P₁ ω₁ hsub_c₁ hsub_wf qvarsK hDisj₁
  | ifTrue _ _ _ _ _ => trivial
  | ifFalse _ _ _ _ _ => trivial
  | whileTrue _ _ _ _ => trivial
  | whileFalse _ _ _ _ => trivial

/-- For any OpStep `s` with `s.c₁ = Configuration.ofProgram P ω` and
    `s.c₂ = Configuration.ofProgram P' ω'`, we have `P'.quantumVars ⊆ P.quantumVars`.
    This is the key sub-program relationship: each transition step can only move to a
    sub-program with fewer (or equal) quantum variables. -/
private theorem opStep_c₂_quantumVars_subset {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx}
    (s : OpStep sem)
    (P P' : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω ω' : CQState ctx)
    (hc₁ : s.c₁ = Configuration.ofProgram P ω)
    (hc₂ : s.c₂ = Configuration.ofProgram P' ω')
    (hsw : s.substep_wf) :
    P'.quantumVars ⊆ P.quantumVars := by
  cases s with
  | skip ω₀ =>
    -- c₂ = terminal, not ofProgram
    simp [OpStep.c₂, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.terminated,
          ProgDown.running] at hc₂
  | classAssign x e ω₀ =>
    simp [OpStep.c₂, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.terminated,
          ProgDown.running] at hc₂
  | qInit q ω₀ =>
    simp [OpStep.c₂, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.terminated,
          ProgDown.running] at hc₂
  | unitaryApp U params qvars hdist ω₀ =>
    simp [OpStep.c₂, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.terminated,
          ProgDown.running] at hc₂
  | measure x M qvars hdist ω₀ m =>
    simp [OpStep.c₂, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.terminated,
          ProgDown.running] at hc₂
  | seqStep P₁ P₂ P₁'' ω₁ ω₂ sub =>
    have hPeq : P = .seq P₁ P₂ := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₁
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    have hP'eq : P' = .seq P₁'' P₂ := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₂
      simp [OpStep.c₂, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    subst hPeq; subst hP'eq
    simp only [QWhilePlus.quantumVars]
    apply Finset.union_subset_union_left
    obtain ⟨hsub_c₁, hsub_c₂, hsub_wf⟩ := hsw
    exact opStep_c₂_quantumVars_subset sub P₁ P₁'' ω₁ ω₂ hsub_c₁ hsub_c₂ hsub_wf
  | seqDone P₁ P₂ ω₁ ω₂ sub =>
    have hPeq : P = .seq P₁ P₂ := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₁
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    have hP'eq : P' = P₂ := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₂
      simp [OpStep.c₂, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    subst hPeq; subst hP'eq
    simp only [QWhilePlus.quantumVars]
    exact Finset.subset_union_right
  | ifTrue b P₁ P₀ ω₀ hb =>
    have hPeq : P = .ifThenElse b P₁ P₀ := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₁
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    have hP'eq : P' = P₁ := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₂
      simp [OpStep.c₂, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    subst hPeq; subst hP'eq
    simp only [QWhilePlus.quantumVars]
    exact Finset.subset_union_left
  | ifFalse b P₁ P₀ ω₀ hb =>
    have hPeq : P = .ifThenElse b P₁ P₀ := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₁
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    have hP'eq : P' = P₀ := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₂
      simp [OpStep.c₂, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    subst hPeq; subst hP'eq
    simp only [QWhilePlus.quantumVars]
    exact Finset.subset_union_right
  | whileTrue b Pw ω₀ hb =>
    have hPeq : P = .whileDo b Pw := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₁
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    have hP'eq : P' = .seq Pw (.whileDo b Pw) := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₂
      simp [OpStep.c₂, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    subst hPeq; subst hP'eq
    simp only [QWhilePlus.quantumVars]
    exact Finset.union_subset Finset.Subset.rfl Finset.Subset.rfl
  | whileFalse b Pw ω₀ hb =>
    -- c₂ = terminal, not ofProgram
    simp [OpStep.c₂, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.terminated,
          ProgDown.running] at hc₂

def opStep_replay {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    : (s : OpStep sem) → (ω₂ : CQState ctx) → (hσ : ω₂.σ = s.startState.σ) → (hsw : s.substep_wf) → OpStep sem
  | .skip _, ω₂, _, _ => .skip ω₂
  | .classAssign x e _, ω₂, _, _ => .classAssign x e ω₂
  | .qInit q _, ω₂, _, _ => .qInit q ω₂
  | .unitaryApp U p q hd _, ω₂, _, _ => .unitaryApp U p q hd ω₂
  | .measure x M q hd _ m, ω₂, _, _ => .measure x M q hd ω₂ m
  | .seqStep P₁ P₂ P₁' ω _ sub, ω₂, hσ, ⟨hc₁, _, hsub_wf⟩ =>
    have hσ_sub : ω₂.σ = sub.startState.σ := by
      rw [hσ]
      have h := congr_arg Configuration.state hc₁
      cases sub <;> simp_all [OpStep.startState, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram]
    .seqStep P₁ P₂ P₁' ω₂ (opStep_replay sem sub ω₂ hσ_sub hsub_wf).c₂.state
      (opStep_replay sem sub ω₂ hσ_sub hsub_wf)
  | .seqDone P₁ P₂ ω _ sub, ω₂, hσ, ⟨hc₁, _, hsub_wf⟩ =>
    have hσ_sub : ω₂.σ = sub.startState.σ := by
      rw [hσ]
      have h := congr_arg Configuration.state hc₁
      cases sub <;> simp_all [OpStep.startState, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram]
    .seqDone P₁ P₂ ω₂ (opStep_replay sem sub ω₂ hσ_sub hsub_wf).c₂.state
      (opStep_replay sem sub ω₂ hσ_sub hsub_wf)
  | .ifTrue b P₁ P₀ _ hb, ω₂, hσ, _ => .ifTrue b P₁ P₀ ω₂ (hσ ▸ hb)
  | .ifFalse b P₁ P₀ _ hb, ω₂, hσ, _ => .ifFalse b P₁ P₀ ω₂ (hσ ▸ hb)
  | .whileTrue b P _ hb, ω₂, hσ, _ => .whileTrue b P ω₂ (hσ ▸ hb)
  | .whileFalse b P _ hb, ω₂, hσ, _ => .whileFalse b P ω₂ (hσ ▸ hb)

inductive OpStepStar
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgramSemantics CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx) :
    Configuration CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx →
    Configuration CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx → Prop where
  /-- Reflexivity: any configuration reaches itself in zero steps. -/
  | refl (c : Configuration CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx) :
    OpStepStar sem c c
  /-- Transitivity: if `c₁ → c₂` and `c₂ →* c₃`, then `c₁ →* c₃`. -/
  | step (c₁ c₂ c₃ : Configuration CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
      (h₁ : OpStep sem)
      (h₁c₁ : h₁.c₁ = c₁) (h₁c₂ : h₁.c₂ = c₂)

noncomputable def splitSeqPath {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    {P₁ P₂ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas}
    {ω : CQState ctx}
    (path : DerivationPath sem)
    (hstart : path.startConfig = Configuration.ofProgram (.seq P₁ P₂) ω)
    {result : CQState ctx}
    (hend : path.endConfig = Configuration.terminal result)
    (hwf : path.wf) :
    (ω_mid : CQState ctx) × DerivationPath sem × DerivationPath sem := by
  match path with
  | .refl c =>
    exfalso
    have h1 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hstart
    have h2 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hend
    simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, DerivationPath.endConfig,
      Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.prog] at h1 h2
    rw [h1] at h2; exact absurd h2 nofun
  | .step s rest =>
    have hsc₁ : s.c₁ = Configuration.ofProgram (.seq P₁ P₂) ω := by
      simpa [DerivationPath.startConfig] using hstart
    have hprog := congr_arg Configuration.prog hsc₁
    obtain ⟨hconn, hwf_rest⟩ := hwf
    exact match s with
    | .seqStep P₁' P₂' P₁'' ω_s ω_e sub => by
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.prog, Configuration.state] at hprog
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hprog
      have hstate := congr_arg Configuration.state hsc₁
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.state] at hstate; subst hstate
      have hrest_start : rest.startConfig = Configuration.ofProgram (.seq P₁'' P₂) ω_e := by
        have := hconn; simp [OpStep.c₂] at this; exact this.symm
      have hrest_end : rest.endConfig = Configuration.terminal result := by
        simpa [DerivationPath.endConfig] using hend
      let ⟨ω_mid, p₁_rest, p₂⟩ := splitSeqPath sem rest hrest_start hrest_end hwf_rest
      exact ⟨ω_mid, .step sub p₁_rest, p₂⟩
    | .seqDone P₁' P₂' ω_s ω_e sub => by
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.prog, Configuration.state] at hprog
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hprog
      have hstate := congr_arg Configuration.state hsc₁
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.state] at hstate; subst hstate
      exact ⟨ω_e, .step sub (.refl (Configuration.terminal ω_e)), rest⟩
    | .skip _ | .classAssign _ _ _ | .qInit _ _ | .unitaryApp _ _ _ _ _
    | .measure _ _ _ _ _ _ | .ifTrue _ _ _ _ _ | .ifFalse _ _ _ _ _
    | .whileTrue _ _ _ _ | .whileFalse _ _ _ _ => by
      simp only [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hprog
      exact nomatch (Option.some.inj hprog)

private theorem tele_toLinMap_adjoint (n : ℕ) (M : Matrix (Fin (2 ^ n)) (Fin (2 ^ n)) ℂ) :
    (toLinMap n M).adjoint = toLinMap n Mᴴ := by
  unfold toLinMap

private theorem tele_toLinMap_comp (n : ℕ) (A B : Matrix (Fin (2 ^ n)) (Fin (2 ^ n)) ℂ) :
    (toLinMap n A).comp (toLinMap n B) = toLinMap n (A * B) := by
  unfold toLinMap
  rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin_eq_toLin_orthonormal]
  rw [Matrix.toLin_mul

What This Declaration Is Doing

This definition assigns to a program state \(\omega\) the total trace contributed by all terminating executions of the program \(P\), under the chosen operational semantics \(\mathrm{sem}\). Mathematically, it sums the trace of the output state over every terminating derivation starting from \(\omega\), so it measures how much of the initial state's total trace ends up in terminating runs. In the surrounding development, this is the “terminating part” of execution mass, and it is used to define the complementary nontermination quantity by subtracting this sum from the initial trace. Thus the result gives the reader a single real number encoding the total probability/weight of termination, expressed at the level of traces.

    (hstart : c = Configuration.ofProgram P ω)
    (hend : c = Configuration.terminal ω') : False := by
  have hprog_start := congr_arg Configuration.prog hstart
  have hprog_end := congr_arg Configuration.prog hend
  simp [Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.prog] at hprog_start hprog_end
  rw [hprog_start] at hprog_end
  exact absurd hprog_end nofun

private lemma terminatingDerivation_simple_result {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : Semantics ctx)
    (P : Prog) (ω ω' : CQState ctx)
    (hstep_target : ∀ s : OpStep sem,
      s.c₁ = Configuration.ofProgram P ω → s.c₂ = Configuration.terminal ω')
    (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω) :
    d.result = ω' := by
  obtain ⟨result, path, hstart, hend, hwf⟩ := d
  cases path with
  | refl c =>
    exact False.elim (ofProgram_terminal_conflict P ω result hstart hend)
  | step s rest =>
    simp [DerivationPath.startConfig] at hstart
    have hs₂ := hstep_target s hstart
    obtain ⟨hconn, _⟩ := hwf
    have hrest_start : rest.startConfig = Configuration.terminal ω' := hconn ▸ hs₂
    have hrest_end := derivationPath_from_terminal_eq sem ω' rest hrest_start
    simp [DerivationPath.endConfig] at hend
    rw [hrest_end] at hend
    simp [Configuration.terminal, Configuration.mk.injEq] at hend
    exact hend.symm

private lemma derivationPath_simple_unique {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : Semantics ctx)
    (P : Prog) (ω : CQState ctx) (ω' : CQState ctx)
    (the_step : OpStep sem)
    (h_step_eq : ∀ s : OpStep sem, s.c₁ = Configuration.ofProgram P ω → s = the_step)
    (h_step_c₂ : the_step.c₂ = Configuration.terminal ω')
    (p : DerivationPath sem)
    (hp_start : p.startConfig = Configuration.ofProgram P ω)
    (hp_end : p.endConfig = Configuration.terminal ω')
    (hp_wf : p.wf) :
    p = .step the_step (.refl (Configuration.terminal ω')) := by
  cases p with
  | refl c =>
    exact False.elim (ofProgram_terminal_conflict P ω ω' hp_start hp_end)
  | step s rest =>
    simp [DerivationPath.startConfig] at hp_start
    have hs := h_step_eq s hp_start; subst hs
    obtain ⟨hconn, _⟩ := hp_wf
    rw [h_step_c₂] at hconn
    cases rest with
    | refl c =>
      simp [DerivationPath.startConfig] at hconn; subst hconn; rfl
    | step s' _ =>
      simp [DerivationPath.startConfig] at hconn
      exact absurd hconn (by intro h; exact opStep_terminal_no_step sem ω' s' h.symm)

    Subsingleton (TerminatingDerivation sem P ω) :=
  ⟨fun d₁ d₂ => by
    have hr₁ := h_result d₁; have hr₂ := h_result d₂
    obtain ⟨_, p₁, hs₁, he₁, hw₁⟩ := d₁
    obtain ⟨_, p₂, hs₂, he₂, hw₂⟩ := d₂
    simp at hr₁ hr₂; subst hr₁; subst hr₂
    have hp₁ := derivationPath_simple_unique sem P ω _ the_step h_step_eq h_step_c₂ p₁ hs₁ he₁ hw₁
    have hp₂ := derivationPath_simple_unique sem P ω _ the_step h_step_eq h_step_c₂ p₂ hs₂ he₂ hw₂
    subst hp₁; subst hp₂; rfl⟩

lemma derivationPath_skip_unique_path {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (ω : CQState ctx) (p : DerivationPath sem)
    (hp_start : p.startConfig = Configuration.ofProgram QWhilePlus.skip ω)
    (hp_end : p.endConfig = Configuration.terminal ω)
    (hp_wf : p.wf) :
    p = .step (.skip ω) (.refl (Configuration.terminal ω)) := by
  cases p with
  | refl c =>
    -- refl: startConfig = endConfig = c, but ofProgram ≠ terminal → contradiction
    simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, DerivationPath.endConfig] at hp_start hp_end
    have h1 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hp_start
    have h2 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hp_end
    simp [Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.prog] at h1 h2
    rw [h1] at h2; exact absurd h2 nofun
  | step s rest =>
    simp [DerivationPath.startConfig] at hp_start
    have hs := opStep_skip_eq sem ω s hp_start
    subst hs
    -- rest starts from s.c₂ = terminal ω (by wf)
    obtain ⟨hconn, hwf_rest⟩ := hp_wf
    simp [OpStep.c₂] at hconn
    -- rest.startConfig = terminal ω
    -- rest must be .refl (terminal ω)
    cases rest with
    | refl c =>
      simp [DerivationPath.startConfig] at hconn
      subst hconn; rfl
    | step s' rest' =>
      -- rest starts with another step from terminal ω → impossible
      simp [DerivationPath.startConfig] at hconn
      exact absurd hconn (by intro h; exact opStep_terminal_no_step sem ω s' h.symm)

lemma joinSeqPath_all_substep_wf {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (P₂ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (path₁ path₂ : DerivationPath sem)
    (hall₁ : path₁.all_substep_wf) (hall₂ : path₂.all_substep_wf)
    (hwf₁ : path₁.wf)
    (P₁ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) (ω : CQState ctx)
    (hstart₁ : path₁.startConfig = Configuration.ofProgram P₁ ω)
    (hend₁ : ∃ ω', path₁.endConfig = Configuration.terminal ω') :
    (joinSeqPath sem P₂ path₁ path₂).all_substep_wf := by
  induction path₁ generalizing P₁ ω with
  | refl _ =>
    -- .refl case: startConfig = endConfig = ofProgram P₁ ω, but endConfig should be terminal
    obtain ⟨ω', hend'⟩ := hend₁
    simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, DerivationPath.endConfig] at hstart₁ hend'
    have h1 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hstart₁
    have h2 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hend'
    simp [Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.prog] at h1 h2
    rw [h1] at h2; exact absurd h2 nofun
  | step s rest ih =>
    simp only [DerivationPath.startConfig] at hstart₁
    have hprog : s.c₁.prog = some P₁ := by rw [hstart₁]; rfl
    simp only [joinSeqPath, show s.c₁.prog = some P₁ from hprog]
    obtain ⟨hconn₁, hwf_rest₁⟩ := hwf₁
    obtain ⟨hs_wf, hall_rest₁⟩ := hall₁
    have hrest_start := hconn₁.symm  -- rest.startConfig = s.c₂
    split
    · -- seqDone: s.c₂.prog = none (terminal P₁ step)
      next P₁_cur heq_cur heq_c₂ =>
      have hP₁_eq : P₁_cur = P₁ := Option.some.inj heq_cur.symm
      have hc₁_state : s.c₁.state = s.startState := by cases s <;> rfl
      have hc₁_eq : s.c₁ = Configuration.ofProgram P₁_cur s.startState := by
        rw [hP₁_eq, show s.startState = ω from
          (hc₁_state ▸ congr_arg Configuration.state hstart₁)]
        exact hstart₁
      have hc₂_eq : s.c₂ = Configuration.terminal s.c₂.state := by
        have : s.c₂ = ⟨s.c₂.prog, s.c₂.state⟩ := rfl
        rw [this, heq_c₂]; rfl
      -- For the tail: rest starts from terminal, so joinSeqPath rest path₂ = path₂
      have hterm : rest.startConfig.prog = none := by rw [hrest_start]; exact heq_c₂
      have hjoin_eq : joinSeqPath sem P₂ rest path₂ = path₂ := by
        cases rest with
        | refl _ => rfl
        | step s₂ _ =>
          simp only [joinSeqPath, show s₂.c₁.prog = none from by
            simpa [DerivationPath.startConfig] using hterm]
      constructor
      · exact ⟨hc₁_eq, hc₂_eq, hs_wf⟩
      · rw [hjoin_eq]; exact hall₂
    · -- seqStep: s.c₂.prog = some P₁' (non-terminal P₁ step)
      next P₁_cur P₁_next heq_cur heq_c₂ =>
      have hP₁_eq : P₁_cur = P₁ := Option.some.inj heq_cur.symm
      have hc₁_state : s.c₁.state = s.startState := by cases s <;> rfl
      have hc₁_eq : s.c₁ = Configuration.ofProgram P₁_cur s.startState := by
        rw [hP₁_eq, show s.startState = ω from
          (hc₁_state ▸ congr_arg Configuration.state hstart₁)]
        exact hstart₁
      have hc₂_eq : s.c₂ = Configuration.ofProgram P₁_next s.c₂.state := by
        have : s.c₂ = ⟨s.c₂.prog, s.c₂.state⟩ := rfl
        rw [this, heq_c₂]; rfl
      have hrest_as_prog : rest.startConfig = Configuration.ofProgram P₁_next s.c₂.state := by
        rw [hrest_start]; exact hc₂_eq
      have hend_rest : ∃ ω', rest.endConfig = Configuration.terminal ω' := by
        simpa [DerivationPath.endConfig] using hend₁
      refine ⟨⟨hc₁_eq, hc₂_eq, hs_wf⟩, ?_⟩
      exact ih hall_rest₁ hwf_rest₁ P₁_next s.c₂.state hrest_as_prog hend_rest
    · next heq => exact nomatch heq

/-- Join two TerminatingDerivations (P₁ then P₂) into a TerminatingDerivation for P₁;P₂.
    Wraps each P₁ step with seqStep/seqDone, then appends the P₂ derivation. -/
noncomputable def joinSeqDeriv {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (P₁ P₂ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx)
    (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P₁ ω)
    (d₂ : TerminatingDerivation sem P₂ d₁.result) :
    TerminatingDerivation sem (.seq P₁ P₂) ω :=
  ⟨d₂.result, joinSeqPath sem P₂ d₁.path d₂.path,
   joinSeqPath_startConfig sem P₂ d₁.path d₂.path P₁ ω d₁.path_start
     ⟨d₁.result, d₁.path_end⟩, -- path_start
   by rw [joinSeqPath_endConfig]; exact d₂.path_end, -- path_end
   joinSeqPath_wf sem P₂ d₁.path d₂.path d₁.path_wf d₂.path_wf P₁ ω d₁.path_start
     ⟨d₁.result, d₁.path_end⟩
     (fun ω' hend₁ => by
       have h₁ := d₁.path_end; rw [hend₁] at h₁
       simp [Configuration.terminal, Configuration.mk.injEq] at h₁
       subst h₁; exact d₂.path_start),
   joinSeqPath_all_substep_wf sem P₂ d₁.path d₂.path d₁.path_deep_wf d₂.path_deep_wf
     d₁.path_wf P₁ ω d₁.path_start ⟨d₁.result, d₁.path_end⟩⟩

/-- Enriched split of a (P₁;P₂) path: returns sub-paths with all well-formedness certificates.
    Returns `(ω_mid, p₁, p₂, h₁_start, h₁_end, h₁_wf, h₂_start, h₂_end, h₂_wf)` where:
    - `p₁` starts at `ofProgram P₁ ω`, ends at `terminal ω_mid`, is well-formed
    - `p₂` starts at `ofProgram P₂ ω_mid`, ends at `terminal result`, is well-formed

    Uses term-mode `match` on `(path, hstart, hend, hwf, hall)` with flat patterns like
    `.step (.seqStep ...) rest` to avoid tactic-generated `noConfusion` wrappers.
    The DATA components (ω_mid, p₁, p₂) are constructed in pure term mode; only the
    PLift proof certificates use `by`. This makes the definition transparent to
    `unfold` + `change`, which is critical for the roundtrip lemma and `right_inv`. -/
noncomputable def splitSeqPath_certified {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    {P₁ P₂ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas}
    {ω : CQState ctx}
    (path : DerivationPath sem)
    (hstart : path.startConfig = Configuration.ofProgram (.seq P₁ P₂) ω)
    {result : CQState ctx}
    (hend : path.endConfig = Configuration.terminal result)
    (hwf : path.wf)
    (hall : path.all_substep_wf) :
    (ω_mid : CQState ctx) ×
    (p₁ : DerivationPath sem) ×
    (p₂ : DerivationPath sem) ×
    PLift (p₁.startConfig = Configuration.ofProgram P₁ ω) ×
    PLift (p₁.endConfig = Configuration.terminal ω_mid) ×
    PLift p₁.wf ×
    PLift p₁.all_substep_wf ×
    PLift (p₂.startConfig = Configuration.ofProgram P₂ ω_mid) ×
    PLift (p₂.endConfig = Configuration.terminal result) ×
    PLift p₂.wf ×
    PLift p₂.all_substep_wf :=
  match path, hstart, hend, hwf, hall with
  | .refl c, hstart, hend, _, _ =>
    absurd (show False by
      have h1 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hstart
      have h2 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hend
      simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, DerivationPath.endConfig,
        Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.prog] at h1 h2
      rw [h1] at h2; exact absurd h2 nofun) False.elim
  | .step (.seqStep P₁' P₂' P₁'' ω_s ω_e sub) rest, hstart, hend, hwf, hall =>
    let ⟨ω_mid, p₁_rest, p₂, ⟨h₁s⟩, ⟨h₁e⟩, ⟨h₁w⟩, ⟨h₁a⟩, ⟨h₂s⟩, ⟨h₂e⟩, ⟨h₂w⟩, ⟨h₂a⟩⟩ :=
      splitSeqPath_certified sem rest
        (show rest.startConfig = Configuration.ofProgram (.seq P₁'' P₂) ω_e by
          have hsc₁ : (OpStep.seqStep P₁' P₂' P₁'' ω_s ω_e sub).c₁ =
            Configuration.ofProgram (.seq P₁ P₂) ω := by
            simpa [DerivationPath.startConfig] using hstart
          have hprogs := congr_arg Configuration.prog hsc₁
          simp only [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.prog,
            ProgDown.running, Option.some.injEq, QWhilePlus.seq.injEq] at hprogs
          have := hwf.1; simp [OpStep.c₂] at this
          rw [hprogs.2] at this; exact this.symm)
        (show rest.endConfig = Configuration.terminal result by
          simpa [DerivationPath.endConfig] using hend)
        hwf.2 hall.2
    ⟨ω_mid, .step sub p₁_rest, p₂,
      ⟨by
        have hsc₁ : (OpStep.seqStep P₁' P₂' P₁'' ω_s ω_e sub).c₁ =
          Configuration.ofProgram (.seq P₁ P₂) ω := by
          simpa [DerivationPath.startConfig] using hstart
        have hprogs := congr_arg Configuration.prog hsc₁
        simp only [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.prog,
          ProgDown.running, Option.some.injEq, QWhilePlus.seq.injEq] at hprogs
        obtain ⟨hc₁_sub, _, _⟩ := hall.1
        rw [hprogs.1, show ω_s = ω from by
          have := congr_arg Configuration.state hsc₁
          simp only [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.state] at this
          exact this] at hc₁_sub
        exact hc₁_sub⟩,
      ⟨by simp [DerivationPath.endConfig]; exact h₁e⟩,
      ⟨by obtain ⟨_, hc₂_sub, _⟩ := hall.1; exact ⟨by rw [hc₂_sub]; exact h₁s.symm, h₁w⟩⟩,
      ⟨by obtain ⟨_, _, hsub_wf⟩ := hall.1; exact ⟨hsub_wf, h₁a⟩⟩,
      ⟨h₂s⟩, ⟨h₂e⟩, ⟨h₂w⟩, ⟨h₂a⟩⟩
  | .step (.seqDone P₁' P₂' ω_s ω_e sub) rest, hstart, hend, hwf, hall =>
    ⟨ω_e, .step sub (.refl (Configuration.terminal ω_e)), rest,
     ⟨by
        have hsc₁ : (OpStep.seqDone P₁' P₂' ω_s ω_e sub).c₁ =
          Configuration.ofProgram (.seq P₁ P₂) ω := by
          simpa [DerivationPath.startConfig] using hstart
        have hprogs := congr_arg Configuration.prog hsc₁
        simp only [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.prog,
          ProgDown.running, Option.some.injEq, QWhilePlus.seq.injEq] at hprogs
        obtain ⟨hc₁_sub, _, _⟩ := hall.1
        rw [hprogs.1, show ω_s = ω from by
          have := congr_arg Configuration.state hsc₁
          simp only [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.state] at this
          exact this] at hc₁_sub
        exact hc₁_sub⟩,
     ⟨by simp [DerivationPath.endConfig]⟩,
     ⟨by obtain ⟨_, hc₂_sub, _⟩ := hall.1; exact ⟨hc₂_sub, trivial⟩⟩,
     ⟨by obtain ⟨_, _, hsub_wf⟩ := hall.1; exact ⟨hsub_wf, trivial⟩⟩,
     ⟨by
        have hsc₁ : (OpStep.seqDone P₁' P₂' ω_s ω_e sub).c₁ =
          Configuration.ofProgram (.seq P₁ P₂) ω := by
          simpa [DerivationPath.startConfig] using hstart
        have hprogs := congr_arg Configuration.prog hsc₁
        simp only [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.prog,
          ProgDown.running, Option.some.injEq, QWhilePlus.seq.injEq] at hprogs
        have := hwf.1; simp [OpStep.c₂] at this
        rw [hprogs.2] at this; exact this.symm⟩,
     ⟨by simpa [DerivationPath.endConfig] using hend⟩,
     ⟨hwf.2⟩,
     ⟨hall.2⟩⟩
  | .step (.skip _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    absurd (show False by
      simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
        Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart) False.elim
  | .step (.classAssign _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    absurd (show False by
      simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
        Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart) False.elim
  | .step (.qInit _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    absurd (show False by
      simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
        Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart) False.elim
  | .step (.unitaryApp _ _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    absurd (show False by
      simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
        Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart) False.elim
  | .step (.measure _ _ _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    absurd (show False by
      simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
        Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart) False.elim
  | .step (.ifTrue _ _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    absurd (show False by
      simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
        Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart) False.elim
  | .step (.ifFalse _ _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    absurd (show False by
      simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
        Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart) False.elim
  | .step (.whileTrue _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    absurd (show False by
      simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
        Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart) False.elim
  | .step (.whileFalse _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    absurd (show False by
      simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
        Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart) False.elim

/-- Roundtrip lemma: joining the paths produced by splitSeqPath_certified recovers the
    original path. Proved by structural induction on the path, matching the same
    seqStep/seqDone case analysis used by both splitSeqPath_certified and joinSeqPath. -/
noncomputable def joinSeqPath_splitSeqPath_certified_path_eq {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    {P₁ P₂ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas}
    {ω : CQState ctx}
    (path : DerivationPath sem)
    (hstart : path.startConfig = Configuration.ofProgram (.seq P₁ P₂) ω)
    {result : CQState ctx}
    (hend : path.endConfig = Configuration.terminal result)
    (hwf : path.wf)
    (hall : path.all_substep_wf) :
    let sp := splitSeqPath_certified sem path hstart hend hwf hall
    joinSeqPath sem P₂ sp.2.1 sp.2.2.1 = path := by
  -- Match on (path, hstart, hend, hwf, hall) mirroring splitSeqPath_certified exactly
  match path, hstart, hend, hwf, hall with
  | .refl c, hstart, hend, _, _ =>
    exfalso
    have h1 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hstart
    have h2 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hend
    simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, DerivationPath.endConfig,
      Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.prog] at h1 h2
    rw [h1] at h2; exact absurd h2 nofun
  | .step (.seqStep P₁' P₂' P₁'' ω_s ω_e sub) rest, hstart, hend, hwf, hall =>
    -- splitSeqPath_certified reduces in this branch to:
    --   let sp_rest := splitSeqPath_certified sem rest ...
    --   ⟨sp_rest.1, .step sub sp_rest.2.1, sp_rest.2.2.1, ...⟩
    -- So sp.2.1 = .step sub sp_rest.2.1, sp.2.2.1 = sp_rest.2.2.1
    have hsc₁ : (OpStep.seqStep P₁' P₂' P₁'' ω_s ω_e sub).c₁ =
      Configuration.ofProgram (.seq P₁ P₂) ω := by
      simpa [DerivationPath.startConfig] using hstart
    have hprogs := congr_arg Configuration.prog hsc₁
    simp only [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.prog,
      ProgDown.running, Option.some.injEq, QWhilePlus.seq.injEq] at hprogs
    obtain ⟨hc₁_sub, hc₂_sub, _⟩ := hall.1
    have hsub_c₁_prog : sub.c₁.prog = some P₁ := by rw [hc₁_sub, hprogs.1]; rfl
    have hsub_c₂_prog : sub.c₂.prog = some P₁'' := by rw [hc₂_sub]; rfl
    -- Unfold splitSeqPath_certified: in this branch it matches and produces the tuple in term mode
    unfold splitSeqPath_certified
    -- The term-mode match should reduce since we matched on the same pattern
    -- The result is: ⟨ω_mid, .step sub p₁_rest, p₂, ...⟩
    -- where (ω_mid, p₁_rest, p₂, ...) = splitSeqPath_certified sem rest ...
    -- Use change to assert the definitionally equal simplified form
    change joinSeqPath sem P₂
      (.step sub (splitSeqPath_certified sem rest _ _ hwf.2 hall.2).2.1)
      (splitSeqPath_certified sem rest _ _ hwf.2 hall.2).2.2.1 =
      .step (.seqStep P₁' P₂' P₁'' ω_s ω_e sub) rest
    unfold joinSeqPath; rw [hsub_c₁_prog, hsub_c₂_prog]; simp only [joinSeqPath]
    have hss : sub.startState = ω_s := by
      cases sub <;> simp_all [OpStep.startState, OpStep.c₁,
        Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.state]
    rw [hss, show sub.c₂.state = ω_e from by rw [hc₂_sub]; rfl]
    -- Goal: .step (.seqStep P₁ P₂ ...) (joinSeqPath ...) = .step (.seqStep P₁' P₂' ...) rest
    -- Rewrite P₁' → P₁ and P₂' → P₂ only on the RHS using conv
    conv_rhs => rw [show P₁' = P₁ from hprogs.1, show P₂' = P₂ from hprogs.2]
    congr 1
    exact joinSeqPath_splitSeqPath_certified_path_eq sem rest _ _ hwf.2 hall.2
  | .step (.seqDone P₁' P₂' ω_s ω_e sub) rest, hstart, hend, hwf, hall =>
    have hsc₁ : (OpStep.seqDone P₁' P₂' ω_s ω_e sub).c₁ =
      Configuration.ofProgram (.seq P₁ P₂) ω := by
      simpa [DerivationPath.startConfig] using hstart
    have hprogs := congr_arg Configuration.prog hsc₁
    simp only [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.prog,
      ProgDown.running, Option.some.injEq, QWhilePlus.seq.injEq] at hprogs
    obtain ⟨hc₁_sub, hc₂_sub, _⟩ := hall.1
    have hsub_c₁_prog : sub.c₁.prog = some P₁ := by rw [hc₁_sub, hprogs.1]; rfl
    have hsub_c₂_prog : sub.c₂.prog = none := by rw [hc₂_sub]; rfl
    unfold splitSeqPath_certified
    change joinSeqPath sem P₂ (.step sub (.refl (Configuration.terminal ω_e))) rest =
      .step (.seqDone P₁' P₂' ω_s ω_e sub) rest
    unfold joinSeqPath
    rw [hsub_c₁_prog, hsub_c₂_prog]
    simp only [joinSeqPath]
    have hss : sub.startState = ω_s := by
      cases sub <;> simp_all [OpStep.startState, OpStep.c₁,
        Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.state]
    have hcs : sub.c₂.state = ω_e := by rw [hc₂_sub]; rfl
    rw [hss, hcs]
    conv_rhs => rw [show P₁' = P₁ from hprogs.1, show P₂' = P₂ from hprogs.2]
  | .step (.skip _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.classAssign _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.qInit _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.unitaryApp _ _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.measure _ _ _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.ifTrue _ _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.ifFalse _ _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.whileTrue _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.whileFalse _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart

/-- Split a TerminatingDerivation for P₁;P₂ into P₁ and P₂ sub-derivations.
    Constructs full TerminatingDerivation objects with all well-formedness certificates,
    including `path_deep_wf` (all_substep_wf) propagated from the input derivation. -/
noncomputable def splitSeqDeriv {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (P₁ P₂ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx)
    (d : TerminatingDerivation sem (.seq P₁ P₂) ω) :
    (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P₁ ω) × TerminatingDerivation sem P₂ d₁.result := by
  let ⟨ω_mid, p₁, p₂, ⟨h₁s⟩, ⟨h₁e⟩, ⟨h₁w⟩, ⟨h₁a⟩, ⟨h₂s⟩, ⟨h₂e⟩, ⟨h₂w⟩, ⟨h₂a⟩⟩ :=
    splitSeqPath_certified sem d.path d.path_start d.path_end d.path_wf d.path_deep_wf
  exact ⟨⟨ω_mid, p₁, h₁s, h₁e, h₁w, h₁a⟩,
         ⟨d.result, p₂, h₂s, h₂e, h₂w, h₂a⟩⟩

/-- The P₂ sub-path from `splitSeqPath_certified` has strictly smaller length than the input path.
    Uses the roundtrip lemma `joinSeqPath_splitSeqPath_certified_path_eq` and
    `joinSeqPath_length_ge_snd` to establish the bound without unfolding the opaque definition. -/

theorem joinSeqPath_injective {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (P₂ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    {P₁ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas}
    {ω : CQState ctx}
    (path₁ path₁' : DerivationPath sem)
    (path₂ path₂' : DerivationPath sem)
    (hstart₁ : path₁.startConfig = Configuration.ofProgram P₁ ω)
    (hstart₁' : path₁'.startConfig = Configuration.ofProgram P₁ ω)
    (hend₁ : ∃ ω₁, path₁.endConfig = Configuration.terminal ω₁)
    (hend₁' : ∃ ω₁', path₁'.endConfig = Configuration.terminal ω₁')
    (hwf₁ : path₁.wf)
    (hwf₁' : path₁'.wf)
    (heq : joinSeqPath sem P₂ path₁ path₂ = joinSeqPath sem P₂ path₁' path₂') :
    path₁ = path₁' ∧ path₂ = path₂' := by
  induction path₁ generalizing P₁ ω path₁' with
  | refl c =>
    -- path₁ = .refl c: startConfig = endConfig = c = ofProgram P₁ ω
    -- but endConfig should be terminal — contradiction
    exfalso
    obtain ⟨ω₁, hend⟩ := hend₁
    simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, DerivationPath.endConfig] at hstart₁ hend
    have h1 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hstart₁
    have h2 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hend
    simp [Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.prog] at h1 h2
    rw [h1] at h2; exact absurd h2 nofun
  | step s rest ih =>
    -- path₁ = .step s rest
    have hsc₁ : s.c₁ = Configuration.ofProgram P₁ ω := by
      simpa [DerivationPath.startConfig] using hstart₁
    have hprog : s.c₁.prog = some P₁ := by rw [hsc₁]; rfl
    obtain ⟨hconn₁, hwf_rest₁⟩ := hwf₁
    have hrest_start := hconn₁.symm
    -- path₁' can't be .refl (same contradiction)
    cases path₁' with
    | refl c' =>
      exfalso
      obtain ⟨ω₁', hend'⟩ := hend₁'
      simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, DerivationPath.endConfig] at hstart₁' hend'
      have h1 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hstart₁'
      have h2 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hend'
      simp [Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.prog] at h1 h2
      rw [h1] at h2; exact absurd h2 nofun
    | step s' rest' =>
      -- path₁' = .step s' rest'
      have hsc₁' : s'.c₁ = Configuration.ofProgram P₁ ω := by
        simpa [DerivationPath.startConfig] using hstart₁'
      have hprog' : s'.c₁.prog = some P₁ := by rw [hsc₁']; rfl
      obtain ⟨hconn₁', hwf_rest₁'⟩ := hwf₁'
      have hrest_start' := hconn₁'.symm
      -- joinSeqPath (.step s rest) path₂ = joinSeqPath (.step s' rest') path₂'
      -- Both sides unfold based on s.c₁.prog/s.c₂.prog and s'.c₁.prog/s'.c₂.prog
      simp only [joinSeqPath, hprog, hprog'] at heq
      -- After simp, the match on c₂.prog is still there. Split on s.c₂.prog and s'.c₂.prog.
      match heq_c₂ : s.c₂.prog, heq_c₂' : s'.c₂.prog with
      | none, none =>
        -- seqDone case: both s and s' terminate P₁
        -- joinSeqPath = .step (.seqDone ...) (joinSeqPath rest path₂)
        -- After joinSeqPath reduction:
        -- .step (.seqDone P₁ P₂ s.startState s.c₂.state s) (joinSeqPath rest path₂) =
        -- .step (.seqDone P₁ P₂ s'.startState s'.c₂.state s') (joinSeqPath rest' path₂')
        simp only [heq_c₂, heq_c₂'] at heq
        -- heq: .step (.seqDone ...) ... = .step (.seqDone ...) ...
        -- Extract: s = s' and joinSeqPath rest path₂ = joinSeqPath rest' path₂'
        have hs_eq : s = s' := by
          have := DerivationPath.step.inj heq
          exact (OpStep.seqDone.inj this.1).2.2.2.2
        have hrest_eq : joinSeqPath sem P₂ rest path₂ = joinSeqPath sem P₂ rest' path₂' := by
          exact (DerivationPath.step.inj heq).2
        subst hs_eq
        -- rest and rest' both start from terminal s.c₂ (c₂.prog = none)
        -- So joinSeqPath rest path₂ = path₂ and joinSeqPath rest' path₂' = path₂'
        have hrest_terminal : rest.startConfig = Configuration.terminal s.c₂.state := by
          rw [hrest_start]; have : s.c₂ = ⟨s.c₂.prog, s.c₂.state⟩ := rfl
          rw [this, heq_c₂]; rfl
        have hrest'_terminal : rest'.startConfig = Configuration.terminal s.c₂.state := by
          rw [hrest_start']; have : s.c₂ = ⟨s.c₂.prog, s.c₂.state⟩ := rfl
          rw [this, heq_c₂]; rfl
        -- rest must be .refl (no step from terminal)
        have hrest_eq_refl : rest = .refl (Configuration.terminal s.c₂.state) := by
          cases rest with
          | refl c => simp [DerivationPath.startConfig] at hrest_terminal; rw [hrest_terminal]
          | step s'' _ =>
            exfalso
            exact opStep_terminal_no_step sem s.c₂.state s''
              (by simpa [DerivationPath.startConfig] using hrest_terminal)
        have hrest'_eq_refl : rest' = .refl (Configuration.terminal s.c₂.state) := by
          cases rest' with
          | refl c => simp [DerivationPath.startConfig] at hrest'_terminal; rw [hrest'_terminal]
          | step s'' _ =>
            exfalso
            exact opStep_terminal_no_step sem s.c₂.state s''
              (by simpa [DerivationPath.startConfig] using hrest'_terminal)
        subst hrest_eq_refl; subst hrest'_eq_refl
        -- Now rest = rest' = .refl. joinSeqPath (.refl _) p = p, so path₂ = path₂'
        simp only [joinSeqPath] at hrest_eq
        exact ⟨rfl, hrest_eq⟩
      | some P₁_next, some P₁_next' =>
        -- seqStep case: both continue
        simp only [heq_c₂, heq_c₂'] at heq
        -- .step (.seqStep P₁ P₂ P₁_next ...) (joinSeqPath rest path₂) =
        -- .step (.seqStep P₁ P₂ P₁_next' ...) (joinSeqPath rest' path₂')
        have hinj := DerivationPath.step.inj heq
        have hs_eq : s = s' := (OpStep.seqStep.inj hinj.1).2.2.2.2.2
        have hP₁_next_eq : P₁_next = P₁_next' := (OpStep.seqStep.inj hinj.1).2.2.1
        have hjp_rest_eq : joinSeqPath sem P₂ rest path₂ = joinSeqPath sem P₂ rest' path₂' :=
          hinj.2
        subst hs_eq; subst hP₁_next_eq
        -- rest.startConfig = s.c₂ = ofProgram P₁_next s.c₂.state
        have hrest_as_prog : rest.startConfig = Configuration.ofProgram P₁_next s.c₂.state := by
          rw [hrest_start]; have : s.c₂ = ⟨s.c₂.prog, s.c₂.state⟩ := rfl
          rw [this, heq_c₂]; rfl
        have hrest'_as_prog : rest'.startConfig = Configuration.ofProgram P₁_next s.c₂.state := by
          rw [hrest_start']; have : s.c₂ = ⟨s.c₂.prog, s.c₂.state⟩ := rfl
          rw [this, heq_c₂]; rfl
        have hend_rest : ∃ ω₁, rest.endConfig = Configuration.terminal ω₁ := by
          simpa [DerivationPath.endConfig] using hend₁
        have hend_rest' : ∃ ω₁', rest'.endConfig = Configuration.terminal ω₁' := by
          simpa [DerivationPath.endConfig] using hend₁'
        -- IH gives rest = rest', we need .step s rest = .step s rest'
        have ⟨hrest_eq, hpath₂_eq⟩ := ih rest' hrest_as_prog hrest'_as_prog
          hend_rest hend_rest' hwf_rest₁ hwf_rest₁' hjp_rest_eq
        exact ⟨by rw [hrest_eq], hpath₂_eq⟩
      | none, some _ =>
        -- One terminates, the other continues: the seqDone step has s.c₂.prog = none,
        -- so joinSeqPath produces .step (.seqDone ...), while the other produces .step (.seqStep ...).
        -- These have different OpStep constructors, contradiction.
        simp only [heq_c₂, heq_c₂'] at heq
        exact absurd (DerivationPath.step.inj heq).1 (by intro h; exact nomatch h)
      | some _, none =>
        simp only [heq_c₂, heq_c₂'] at heq
        exact absurd (DerivationPath.step.inj heq).1 (by intro h; exact nomatch h)

/-- Dual roundtrip: splitting a joined path recovers the original sub-paths.
    Proved via the left roundtrip + joinSeqPath injectivity. -/
noncomputable def splitSeqPath_certified_joinSeqPath_eq {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    {P₁ P₂ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas}
    {ω : CQState ctx}
    (path₁ : DerivationPath sem)
    (hstart₁ : path₁.startConfig = Configuration.ofProgram P₁ ω)
    {ω_mid : CQState ctx}
    (hend₁ : path₁.endConfig = Configuration.terminal ω_mid)
    (hwf₁ : path₁.wf)
    (hall₁ : path₁.all_substep_wf)
    (path₂ : DerivationPath sem)
    (hstart₂ : path₂.startConfig = Configuration.ofProgram P₂ ω_mid)
    {result : CQState ctx}
    (hend₂ : path₂.endConfig = Configuration.terminal result)
    (hwf₂ : path₂.wf)
    (hall₂ : path₂.all_substep_wf)
    (hstart_jp : (joinSeqPath sem P₂ path₁ path₂).startConfig =
      Configuration.ofProgram (.seq P₁ P₂) ω)
    (hend_jp : (joinSeqPath sem P₂ path₁ path₂).endConfig =
      Configuration.terminal result)
    (hwf_jp : (joinSeqPath sem P₂ path₁ path₂).wf)
    (hall_jp : (joinSeqPath sem P₂ path₁ path₂).all_substep_wf) :
    let sp := splitSeqPath_certified sem (joinSeqPath sem P₂ path₁ path₂)
      hstart_jp hend_jp hwf_jp hall_jp
    sp.1 = ω_mid ∧ sp.2.1 = path₁ ∧ sp.2.2.1 = path₂ := by
  set jp := joinSeqPath sem P₂ path₁ path₂
  set sp := splitSeqPath_certified sem jp hstart_jp hend_jp hwf_jp hall_jp
  -- Left roundtrip: joinSeqPath(sp.2.1, sp.2.2.1) = jp = joinSeqPath(path₁, path₂)
  have hrt := joinSeqPath_splitSeqPath_certified_path_eq sem jp hstart_jp hend_jp hwf_jp hall_jp
  -- sp.2.1 starts at ofProgram P₁ ω (from splitSeqPath_certified certificate)
  have hsp_start₁ := sp.2.2.2.1.down  -- sp.2.1.startConfig = ofProgram P₁ ω
  -- sp.2.1 ends at terminal sp.1
  have hsp_end₁ := sp.2.2.2.2.1.down  -- sp.2.1.endConfig = terminal sp.1
  -- sp.2.1 is wf
  have hsp_wf₁ := sp.2.2.2.2.2.1.down  -- sp.2.1.wf
  -- Apply joinSeqPath injectivity
  have hinj := joinSeqPath_injective sem P₂ sp.2.1 path₁ sp.2.2.1 path₂
    hsp_start₁ hstart₁ ⟨sp.1, hsp_end₁⟩ ⟨ω_mid, hend₁⟩ hsp_wf₁ hwf₁ hrt
  obtain ⟨hp₁_eq, hp₂_eq⟩ := hinj
  -- sp.1 = ω_mid: from sp.2.1.endConfig = terminal sp.1 and sp.2.1 = path₁
  -- path₁.endConfig = terminal ω_mid, so sp.1 = ω_mid
  have hmid : sp.1 = ω_mid := by
    have h1 := hsp_end₁; rw [hp₁_eq] at h1
    rw [hend₁] at h1
    simp [Configuration.terminal, Configuration.mk.injEq] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  exact ⟨hmid, hp₁_eq, hp₂_eq⟩

/-- The seq bijection between TerminatingDerivation types.
    `TermDeriv(P₁;P₂, ω) ≃ Σ (d₁ : TermDeriv(P₁, ω)), TermDeriv(P₂, d₁.result)` -/
noncomputable def termDerivSeqEquiv {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (P₁ P₂ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx) :
    TerminatingDerivation sem (.seq P₁ P₂) ω ≃
    (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P₁ ω) × TerminatingDerivation sem P₂ d₁.result where
  toFun d := splitSeqDeriv sem P₁ P₂ ω d
  invFun p := joinSeqDeriv sem P₁ P₂ ω p.1 p.2
  left_inv d := by
    -- Goal: joinSeqDeriv(splitSeqDeriv(d)) = d
    -- Strategy: show .result and .path match; Prop fields by proof irrelevance.
    show joinSeqDeriv sem P₁ P₂ ω (splitSeqDeriv sem P₁ P₂ ω d).1
      (splitSeqDeriv sem P₁ P₂ ω d).2 = d
    -- Unfold to expose splitSeqPath_certified
    unfold splitSeqDeriv joinSeqDeriv
    -- The goal is now: ⟨d.result, joinSeqPath sem P₂ sp.2.1 sp.2.2.1, ...⟩ = d
    -- where sp = splitSeqPath_certified sem d.path ...
    -- By proof irrelevance, we need .result and .path to match.
    -- .result = d.result (definitional from splitSeqDeriv construction)
    -- .path: use the roundtrip lemma
    rcases d with ⟨result, path, path_start, path_end, path_wf, path_deep_wf⟩
    simp only
    congr 1
    -- Goal: joinSeqPath sem P₂ (splitSeqPath_certified ...).2.1 (splitSeqPath_certified ...).2.2.1 = path
    exact joinSeqPath_splitSeqPath_certified_path_eq sem path
      path_start path_end path_wf path_deep_wf
  right_inv p := by
    -- split(join(d₁, d₂)) = (d₁, d₂): dual of left_inv
    -- Requires a dual roundtrip lemma: splitSeqPath_certified(joinSeqPath(p₁, p₂)) = (p₁, p₂),
    -- i.e., splitting the joined path recovers the original sub-paths. This is structurally
    -- similar to joinSeqPath_splitSeqPath_certified_path_eq but in the reverse direction,
    -- proved by induction on p₁ with seqStep/seqDone case analysis.
    --
    -- Additional difficulty: the goal is a Sigma equality (dependent pair), so we need both:
    --   (1) splitSeqDeriv(joinSeqDeriv(d₁,d₂)).1 = d₁  (TerminatingDerivation with .result and .path)
    --   (2) splitSeqDeriv(joinSeqDeriv(d₁,d₂)).2 ≡ d₂  (HEq because type depends on (1))
    -- Each requires showing .result and .path match, with .path needing the dual roundtrip lemma.
    --
    -- NOT on the critical path: denotationalSem_seq uses multiset_map_univ_equiv' which only
    -- needs the Equiv to exist (for reindexing), not the full round-trip. The master theorem
    -- (tsum_seq_result) bypasses the Multiset Equiv entirely.
    obtain ⟨d₁, d₂⟩ := p
    -- Goal: splitSeqDeriv sem P₁ P₂ ω (joinSeqDeriv sem P₁ P₂ ω d₁ d₂) = ⟨d₁, d₂⟩
    -- Use the dual roundtrip lemma to recover .result and .path for both components.
    -- Unfold to expose the path-level operations
    unfold splitSeqDeriv joinSeqDeriv
    -- Get the dual roundtrip result
    have hrt := splitSeqPath_certified_joinSeqPath_eq sem
      d₁.path d₁.path_start d₁.path_end d₁.path_wf d₁.path_deep_wf
      d₂.path d₂.path_start d₂.path_end d₂.path_wf d₂.path_deep_wf
      (joinSeqPath_startConfig sem P₂ d₁.path d₂.path P₁ ω d₁.path_start
        ⟨d₁.result, d₁.path_end⟩)
      (by rw [joinSeqPath_endConfig]; exact d₂.path_end)
      (joinSeqPath_wf sem P₂ d₁.path d₂.path d₁.path_wf d₂.path_wf P₁ ω d₁.path_start
        ⟨d₁.result, d₁.path_end⟩
        (fun ω' hend₁ => by
          have h₁ := d₁.path_end; rw [hend₁] at h₁
          simp [Configuration.terminal, Configuration.mk.injEq] at h₁
          subst h₁; exact d₂.path_start))
      (joinSeqPath_all_substep_wf sem P₂ d₁.path d₂.path d₁.path_deep_wf d₂.path_deep_wf
        d₁.path_wf P₁ ω d₁.path_start ⟨d₁.result, d₁.path_end⟩)
    obtain ⟨hrt_mid, hrt_p₁, hrt_p₂⟩ := hrt
    -- hrt_mid : sp.1 = d₁.result, hrt_p₁ : sp.2.1 = d₁.path, hrt_p₂ : sp.2.2.1 = d₂.path
    -- The goal is a Sigma type equality: ⟨d₁', d₂'⟩ = ⟨d₁, d₂⟩
    -- where d₁' has .result = sp.1 and .path = sp.2.1,
    -- and d₂' has .result = joinedDeriv.result and .path = sp.2.2.1.
    -- Use Sigma.ext: show fst = fst, then HEq for snd.
    -- The goal is a Sigma equality ⟨d₁', d₂'⟩ = ⟨d₁, d₂⟩.
    -- Strategy: match on the splitSeqPath_certified result using the let binding in splitSeqDeriv,
    -- then use the roundtrip equalities to rewrite.
    -- Since splitSeqDeriv uses `let ⟨ω_mid, p₁, p₂, ...⟩ := splitSeqPath_certified ...`,
    -- the output is ⟨⟨ω_mid, p₁, ...⟩, ⟨d.result, p₂, ...⟩⟩.
    -- We know ω_mid = d₁.result, p₁ = d₁.path, p₂ = d₂.path.
    -- After rewriting, both components match d₁ and d₂ by proof irrelevance.
    -- Use the match form directly: generalize the let-bound variables from splitSeqPath_certified.
    -- The splitSeqDeriv match destructures into (ω_mid, p₁, p₂, ⟨h₁s⟩, ⟨h₁e⟩, ⟨h₁w⟩, ⟨h₁a⟩, ⟨h₂s⟩, ⟨h₂e⟩, ⟨h₂w⟩, ⟨h₂a⟩).
    -- Generalize these and subst.
    -- Actually, the cleanest approach: show both components are equal separately,
    -- using Sigma.mk.inj or manual construction.
    -- Let's generalize the entire splitSeqPath_certified call.
    set sp := splitSeqPath_certified sem (joinSeqPath sem P₂ d₁.path d₂.path)
      _ _ _ _ with hsp_def
    -- Now the goal involves sp's components
    -- d₁' = ⟨sp.1, sp.2.1, sp.2.2.2.1.down, sp.2.2.2.2.1.down, sp.2.2.2.2.2.1.down, sp.2.2.2.2.2.2.1.down⟩
    -- d₂' = ⟨d₂.result, sp.2.2.1, sp.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1.down, sp.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1.down, sp.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1.down, sp.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1.down⟩
    -- Destructure sp to get variables we can subst
    obtain ⟨mid, p₁, p₂, ⟨h₁s⟩, ⟨h₁e⟩, ⟨h₁w⟩, ⟨h₁a⟩, ⟨h₂s⟩, ⟨h₂e⟩, ⟨h₂w⟩, ⟨h₂a⟩⟩ := sp
    -- Force match reduction in the goal after destructuring
    dsimp only at *
    -- hrt_mid : mid = d₁.result, hrt_p₁ : p₁ = d₁.path, hrt_p₂ : p₂ = d₂.path
    subst hrt_mid; subst hrt_p₁; subst hrt_p₂
    -- After substitution, hsp_def : ⟨d₁.result, d₁.path, d₂.path, ...⟩ = splitSeqPath_certified ...
    -- The goal's match on splitSeqPath_certified needs to reduce.
    -- Rewrite using hsp_def to replace splitSeqPath_certified with the known tuple.
    -- hsp_def : ⟨d₁.result, d₁.path, d₂.path, ...⟩ = splitSeqPath_certified ...
    -- Rewrite to replace splitSeqPath_certified with the known tuple
    rw [← hsp_def]

/-- **Proposition 6, Case (6): Sequential Composition [Ying, Proposition 3.1(6)]**

    The denotational semantics of sequential composition P1; P2 is:
    [[P1; P2]](sigma, rho) = [[P2]]([[P1]](sigma, rho))
                            = Union_{(sigma', rho') in [[P1]](sigma, rho)} [[P2]](sigma', rho').
    The output of P1 is fed as input to P2, collecting all resulting states. -/

noncomputable def joinSeqPath_splitSeqPath_certified_path_eq {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    {P₁ P₂ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas}
    {ω : CQState ctx}
    (path : DerivationPath sem)
    (hstart : path.startConfig = Configuration.ofProgram (.seq P₁ P₂) ω)
    {result : CQState ctx}
    (hend : path.endConfig = Configuration.terminal result)
    (hwf : path.wf)
    (hall : path.all_substep_wf) :
    let sp := splitSeqPath_certified sem path hstart hend hwf hall
    joinSeqPath sem P₂ sp.2.1 sp.2.2.1 = path := by
  -- Match on (path, hstart, hend, hwf, hall) mirroring splitSeqPath_certified exactly
  match path, hstart, hend, hwf, hall with
  | .refl c, hstart, hend, _, _ =>
    exfalso
    have h1 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hstart
    have h2 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hend
    simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, DerivationPath.endConfig,
      Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.prog] at h1 h2
    rw [h1] at h2; exact absurd h2 nofun
  | .step (.seqStep P₁' P₂' P₁'' ω_s ω_e sub) rest, hstart, hend, hwf, hall =>
    -- splitSeqPath_certified reduces in this branch to:
    --   let sp_rest := splitSeqPath_certified sem rest ...
    --   ⟨sp_rest.1, .step sub sp_rest.2.1, sp_rest.2.2.1, ...⟩
    -- So sp.2.1 = .step sub sp_rest.2.1, sp.2.2.1 = sp_rest.2.2.1
    have hsc₁ : (OpStep.seqStep P₁' P₂' P₁'' ω_s ω_e sub).c₁ =
      Configuration.ofProgram (.seq P₁ P₂) ω := by
      simpa [DerivationPath.startConfig] using hstart
    have hprogs := congr_arg Configuration.prog hsc₁
    simp only [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.prog,
      ProgDown.running, Option.some.injEq, QWhilePlus.seq.injEq] at hprogs
    obtain ⟨hc₁_sub, hc₂_sub, _⟩ := hall.1
    have hsub_c₁_prog : sub.c₁.prog = some P₁ := by rw [hc₁_sub, hprogs.1]; rfl
    have hsub_c₂_prog : sub.c₂.prog = some P₁'' := by rw [hc₂_sub]; rfl
    -- Unfold splitSeqPath_certified: in this branch it matches and produces the tuple in term mode
    unfold splitSeqPath_certified
    -- The term-mode match should reduce since we matched on the same pattern
    -- The result is: ⟨ω_mid, .step sub p₁_rest, p₂, ...⟩
    -- where (ω_mid, p₁_rest, p₂, ...) = splitSeqPath_certified sem rest ...
    -- Use change to assert the definitionally equal simplified form
    change joinSeqPath sem P₂
      (.step sub (splitSeqPath_certified sem rest _ _ hwf.2 hall.2).2.1)
      (splitSeqPath_certified sem rest _ _ hwf.2 hall.2).2.2.1 =
      .step (.seqStep P₁' P₂' P₁'' ω_s ω_e sub) rest
    unfold joinSeqPath; rw [hsub_c₁_prog, hsub_c₂_prog]; simp only [joinSeqPath]
    have hss : sub.startState = ω_s := by
      cases sub <;> simp_all [OpStep.startState, OpStep.c₁,
        Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.state]
    rw [hss, show sub.c₂.state = ω_e from by rw [hc₂_sub]; rfl]
    -- Goal: .step (.seqStep P₁ P₂ ...) (joinSeqPath ...) = .step (.seqStep P₁' P₂' ...) rest
    -- Rewrite P₁' → P₁ and P₂' → P₂ only on the RHS using conv
    conv_rhs => rw [show P₁' = P₁ from hprogs.1, show P₂' = P₂ from hprogs.2]
    congr 1
    exact joinSeqPath_splitSeqPath_certified_path_eq sem rest _ _ hwf.2 hall.2
  | .step (.seqDone P₁' P₂' ω_s ω_e sub) rest, hstart, hend, hwf, hall =>
    have hsc₁ : (OpStep.seqDone P₁' P₂' ω_s ω_e sub).c₁ =
      Configuration.ofProgram (.seq P₁ P₂) ω := by
      simpa [DerivationPath.startConfig] using hstart
    have hprogs := congr_arg Configuration.prog hsc₁
    simp only [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.prog,
      ProgDown.running, Option.some.injEq, QWhilePlus.seq.injEq] at hprogs
    obtain ⟨hc₁_sub, hc₂_sub, _⟩ := hall.1
    have hsub_c₁_prog : sub.c₁.prog = some P₁ := by rw [hc₁_sub, hprogs.1]; rfl
    have hsub_c₂_prog : sub.c₂.prog = none := by rw [hc₂_sub]; rfl
    unfold splitSeqPath_certified
    change joinSeqPath sem P₂ (.step sub (.refl (Configuration.terminal ω_e))) rest =
      .step (.seqDone P₁' P₂' ω_s ω_e sub) rest
    unfold joinSeqPath
    rw [hsub_c₁_prog, hsub_c₂_prog]
    simp only [joinSeqPath]
    have hss : sub.startState = ω_s := by
      cases sub <;> simp_all [OpStep.startState, OpStep.c₁,
        Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.state]
    have hcs : sub.c₂.state = ω_e := by rw [hc₂_sub]; rfl
    rw [hss, hcs]
    conv_rhs => rw [show P₁' = P₁ from hprogs.1, show P₂' = P₂ from hprogs.2]
  | .step (.skip _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.classAssign _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.qInit _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.unitaryApp _ _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.measure _ _ _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.ifTrue _ _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.ifFalse _ _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.whileTrue _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart
  | .step (.whileFalse _ _ _ _) _, hstart, _, _, _ =>
    exfalso; simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram,
      Configuration.prog, ProgDown.running] at hstart

/-- Split a TerminatingDerivation for P₁;P₂ into P₁ and P₂ sub-derivations.
    Constructs full TerminatingDerivation objects with all well-formedness certificates,
    including `path_deep_wf` (all_substep_wf) propagated from the input derivation. -/
noncomputable def splitSeqDeriv {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (P₁ P₂ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx)
    (d : TerminatingDerivation sem (.seq P₁ P₂) ω) :
    (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P₁ ω) × TerminatingDerivation sem P₂ d₁.result := by
  let ⟨ω_mid, p₁, p₂, ⟨h₁s⟩, ⟨h₁e⟩, ⟨h₁w⟩, ⟨h₁a⟩, ⟨h₂s⟩, ⟨h₂e⟩, ⟨h₂w⟩, ⟨h₂a⟩⟩ :=
    splitSeqPath_certified sem d.path d.path_start d.path_end d.path_wf d.path_deep_wf
  exact ⟨⟨ω_mid, p₁, h₁s, h₁e, h₁w, h₁a⟩,
         ⟨d.result, p₂, h₂s, h₂e, h₂w, h₂a⟩⟩

/-- The P₂ sub-path from `splitSeqPath_certified` has strictly smaller length than the input path.
    Uses the roundtrip lemma `joinSeqPath_splitSeqPath_certified_path_eq` and
    `joinSeqPath_length_ge_snd` to establish the bound without unfolding the opaque definition. -/

lemma joinSeqPath_startConfig {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (P₂ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (path₁ path₂ : DerivationPath sem)
    (P₁ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) (ω : CQState ctx)
    (hstart : path₁.startConfig = Configuration.ofProgram P₁ ω)
    (hend : ∃ ω', path₁.endConfig = Configuration.terminal ω') :
    (joinSeqPath sem P₂ path₁ path₂).startConfig =
    Configuration.ofProgram (.seq P₁ P₂) ω := by
  match path₁ with
  | .refl c =>
    -- .refl c means startConfig = endConfig = c = ofProgram P₁ ω
    -- But endConfig = terminal ω' means c.prog = none
    -- While ofProgram P₁ ω has c.prog = some P₁ — contradiction!
    obtain ⟨ω', hend'⟩ := hend
    simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, DerivationPath.endConfig] at hstart hend'
    have h1 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hstart
    have h2 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hend'
    simp [Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.prog] at h1 h2
    rw [h1] at h2; exact absurd h2 nofun
  | .step s rest =>
    simp only [DerivationPath.startConfig] at hstart
    -- hstart : s.c₁ = ofProgram P₁ ω
    -- So s.c₁.prog = (ofProgram P₁ ω).prog = some P₁
    have hprog : s.c₁.prog = some P₁ := by
      rw [hstart]; rfl

def prependIfFalse {ctx : ProgramContext}

    (ω : CQState ctx) (hb : ¬sem.boolEval ω.σ b)
    (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P₀ ω) :
    TerminatingDerivation sem (QWhilePlus.ifThenElse b P₁ P₀) ω :=
  ⟨d.result, .step (.ifFalse b P₁ P₀ ω hb) d.path, rfl, d.path_end,
   ⟨d.path_start.symm, d.path_wf⟩, ⟨trivial, d.path_deep_wf⟩⟩

/-- Strip the `.ifFalse` step from an if-derivation. -/
noncomputable def stripIfFalse {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (b : BExp) (P₁ P₀ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)

    (d : TerminatingDerivation sem (QWhilePlus.ifThenElse b P₁ P₀) ω) :
    TerminatingDerivation sem P₀ ω := by
  obtain ⟨result, path, hstart, hend, hwf, hdwf⟩ := d
  cases path with
  | refl c =>
    exfalso
    have h1 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hstart
    have h2 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hend
    simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, DerivationPath.endConfig,
      Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.prog] at h1 h2
    rw [h1] at h2; exact absurd h2 nofun
  | step s rest =>
    have hsc₁ : s.c₁ = Configuration.ofProgram (QWhilePlus.ifThenElse b P₁ P₀) ω := by
      simpa [DerivationPath.startConfig] using hstart
    have hs := opStep_ifFalse_eq sem b P₁ P₀ ω hb s hsc₁
    subst hs
    exact ⟨result, rest, hwf.1.symm,
      (by simpa [DerivationPath.endConfig] using hend), hwf.2, hdwf.2⟩

        simpa [DerivationPath.startConfig] using hstart
      have hs := opStep_ifFalse_eq sem b P₁ P₀ ω hb s hsc₁

    TerminatingDerivation sem (.whileDo b P) ω where
  toFun := prependWhileTrue sem b P ω hb
  invFun := stripWhileTrue sem b P ω hb
  left_inv d := by simp only [prependWhileTrue, stripWhileTrue]
  right_inv d := by
    rcases d with ⟨result, path, hstart, hend, hwf⟩
    cases path with
    | refl c =>
      exfalso
      have h1 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hstart
      have h2 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hend
      simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, DerivationPath.endConfig,
        Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.prog] at h1 h2
      rw [h1] at h2; exact absurd h2 nofun
    | step s rest =>
      simp only [stripWhileTrue, prependWhileTrue]
      have hsc₁ : s.c₁ = Configuration.ofProgram (.whileDo b P) ω := by
        simpa [DerivationPath.startConfig] using hstart
      have hs := opStep_whileTrue_eq sem b P ω hb s hsc₁
      subst hs; rfl

/-- OpStep from whileDo when b is false: must be .whileFalse. -/
