theorem soundness_measure_satisfiable
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (hne : ∀ M : Meas, Nonempty (cats.measOutcomeType M))
    (σ₀ : ClassicalState ctx) (q₀ : QVar)
    (expSub : CVar → Exp → Exp → Exp)
    (qvSub : CVar → Exp → QVar → QVar)
    -- Tensor commutativity: needed for interpFormula_isQuantumEffect
    (htensor_comm :
      letI pcats := StandardKrausOpSym.mkQuantumPredicateCats (cats := cats) hne
      letI psem := mkStandardPredicateSemantics sem hne σ₀ q₀
      ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
        {S₁ S₂ : Finset QVar}
        (A₁ : QuantumPredicateFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas
          TrivialAtomPred (StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) S₁)
        (A₂ : QuantumPredicateFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas
          TrivialAtomPred (StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) S₂),
        Disjoint S₁ S₂ →
        (interpFormula psem σ A₁).comp (interpFormula psem σ A₂) =
        (interpFormula psem σ A₂).comp (interpFormula psem σ A₁))
    -- Substitution coherence for atoms (needed for substFormula_interp)
    (hSubstAtom :
      letI pcats := StandardKrausOpSym.mkQuantumPredicateCats (cats := cats) hne
      letI psem := mkStandardPredicateSemantics sem hne σ₀ q₀
      ∀ (x : CVar) (e : Exp) (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
        (K : TrivialAtomPred)
        (params : Fin (pcats.predClassicalArity K) → Exp)
        (qvars : Fin (pcats.predQuantumArity K) → QVar),
        psem.atomInterp K σ (fun i => expSub x e (params i))
          (fun i => qvSub x e (qvars i)) =
        psem.atomInterp K (sem.classicalUpdate σ x e) params qvars)
    -- Substitution coherence for Kraus operators (needed for substFormula_interp)
    (hSubstKraus :
      letI pcats := StandardKrausOpSym.mkQuantumPredicateCats (cats := cats) hne
      letI psem := mkStandardPredicateSemantics sem hne σ₀ q₀
      ∀ (x : CVar) (e : Exp) (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
        (F : StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
        (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
        (qvars : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)
        (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F)),
        psem.krausInterp F σ (fun j => expSub x e (params j))
          (fun j => qvSub x e (qvars j)) i =
        psem.krausInterp F (sem.classicalUpdate σ x e) params qvars i) :
    letI pcats := StandardKrausOpSym.mkQuantumPredicateCats (cats := cats) hne
    letI psem := mkStandardPredicateSemantics sem hne σ₀ q₀
    ∀ (x : CVar) (M : Meas)
      (measQvars : Fin (cats.measQuantumArity M) → QVar)
      (measHdist : ∀ i j : Fin (cats.measQuantumArity M), i ≠ j → measQvars i ≠ measQvars j)
      (y : CVar) (y_exp : Exp)
      (post_base : CQAssertion CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas
        TrivialAtomPred (StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) ctx)
      (F_My : StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
      (fParams : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F_My) → Exp)
      (fQvars : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F_My) → QVar)
      (fHdist : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F_My), i ≠ j → fQvars i ≠ fQvars j)
      (hInj : Function.Injective (qvSub x y_exp))
      (fHsub : ∀ i, fQvars i ∈ post_base.S.image (qvSub x y_exp))
      (eqXY : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)
      (heqXY : ∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx, eqXY σ ↔ sem.classicalUpdate σ x y_exp = σ)
      (hfresh_φ : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (e : Exp),
        post_base.φ σ ↔ post_base.φ (sem.classicalUpdate σ y e))
      (hfresh_A : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (e : Exp),
        interpFormula psem σ post_base.A =
        interpFormula psem (sem.classicalUpdate σ y e) post_base.A)
      (hy_ne_x : y ≠ x)
      (outcomeOf : ClassicalState ctx → cats.measOutcomeType M)
      (hMeasBridge :
        (pcats.krausRank F_My = 1) ∧
        (∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (h1 : pcats.krausRank F_My = 1),
          psem.krausInterp F_My σ fParams fQvars ⟨0, h1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ =
            (sem.measOp M σ measQvars (outcomeOf σ)).adjoint) ∧
        (∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx),
          sem.measClassicalUpdate σ x M (outcomeOf σ) = sem.classicalUpdate σ x y_exp) ∧
        (∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx),
          eqXY (sem.measClassicalUpdate σ x M (outcomeOf σ)))),
      HoareTripleTotDeriv sem psem
        ⟨post_base.S.image (qvSub x y_exp),
         classSubstFormula sem x y_exp post_base.φ,
         .kraus F_My fParams fQvars
           (fun _ => substFormula expSub qvSub x y_exp hInj post_base.A) fHdist fHsub⟩
        (.measure x M measQvars measHdist)
        ⟨post_base.S, fun σ => post_base.φ σ ∧ eqXY σ, post_base.A⟩ := by
  intro x M measQvars measHdist y y_exp post_base F_My fParams fQvars fHdist
    hInj fHsub eqXY heqXY hfresh_φ hfresh_A hy_ne_x outcomeOf hMeasBridge ω hφ_subst hqe_pre
  letI pcats := StandardKrausOpSym.mkQuantumPredicateCats (cats := cats) hne
  let psem := mkStandardPredicateSemantics sem hne σ₀ q₀
  obtain ⟨hrank1, hK0, hOutcome, hEqXY_at_meas⟩ := hMeasBridge
  -- Step 1: Reindex postcondExpectDeriv tsum → finite sum over measurement outcomes.
  unfold postcondExpectDeriv
  conv_rhs =>
    rw [← Equiv.tsum_eq (termDerivMeasureEquiv sem x M measQvars measHdist ω)]
  simp only [termDerivMeasureEquiv, CQState.measTransform, CQState.σ, CQState.ρ]
  haveI : Fintype (cats.measOutcomeType M) := cats.measOutcomeFinite M
  rw [tsum_fintype]
  -- Step 2: Expand LHS using interpFormula_kraus → rank-1 sum → single term.
  rw [interpFormula_kraus]
  -- The Kraus expansion gives ∑_i K_i · A[y/x] · K_i†. Since rank = 1, single term.
  have hsum_single : ∀ (f : Fin (pcats.krausRank F_My) → (ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all)),
      ∑ i, f i = f ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ := by
    intro f
    have : Subsingleton (Fin (pcats.krausRank F_My)) := by
      rw [hrank1]; exact Unique.instSubsingleton
    exact Fintype.sum_subsingleton _ _
  rw [hsum_single]
  -- Step 3: Apply trace cyclicity.
  -- LHS = E(K · A[y/x] · K†, ρ) = E(A[y/x], K† · ρ · K) via expectationValue_kraus_cycle
  rw [expectationValue_kraus_cycle]
  -- Step 4: Use bridge to replace K with (M_{m*})†.
  specialize hK0 ω.σ hrank1
  set m_star := outcomeOf ω.σ
  -- hK0 : krausInterp F_My ω.σ ... = (measOp M ω.σ measQvars m_star)†
  -- LHS = E(A[y/x], K†·ρ·K) where K = M_m*†
  -- K† = (M_m*†)† = M_m*, K = M_m*†
  -- So K†·ρ·K = M_m*·ρ·M_m*† = ρ'_{m*} (the measurement transform)
  -- Step 5: Show LHS ≤ RHS by bounding LHS ≤ the m*-th term of the sum.
  -- Establish the if-conditions at m*:
  have hσ_eq : sem.measClassicalUpdate ω.σ x M m_star = sem.classicalUpdate ω.σ x y_exp :=
    hOutcome ω.σ
  have heqXY_holds : eqXY (sem.measClassicalUpdate ω.σ x M m_star) :=
    hEqXY_at_meas ω.σ
  have hφ_holds : post_base.φ (sem.measClassicalUpdate ω.σ x M m_star) := by
    rw [hσ_eq]; exact hφ_subst
  have hqe_post : IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem (sem.measClassicalUpdate ω.σ x M m_star)
      post_base.A) := by
    rw [hσ_eq]
    exact interpFormula_isQuantumEffect psem _ (htensor_comm _)
      (fun A' B' hA' hB' hcomm => by
        haveI : CompleteSpace ctx.H_all := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ ctx.H_all
        exact ⟨(TensorEffects.comp_isQuantumEffect_of_commuting_effects
          A' B' hA'.isPositive hB'.isPositive hA'.complement_isPositive
          hB'.complement_isPositive hcomm).1,
          (TensorEffects.comp_isQuantumEffect_of_commuting_effects
          A' B' hA'.isPositive hB'.isPositive hA'.complement_isPositive
          hB'.complement_isPositive hcomm).2⟩)
      (fun F params qvars => psem.krausInterp_isKrausFamily F _ params qvars) _
  -- Substitution lemma: A[y/x]@ω.σ = A@(classicalUpdate ω.σ x y_exp) = A@σ'_{m*}
  have hInterp_eq : interpFormula psem ω.σ
      (substFormula expSub qvSub x y_exp hInj post_base.A) =
      interpFormula psem (sem.classicalUpdate ω.σ x y_exp) post_base.A :=
    substFormula_interp psem expSub qvSub x y_exp ω.σ
      (sem.classicalUpdate ω.σ x y_exp) hInj
      (fun K params qvars => hSubstAtom x y_exp ω.σ K params qvars)
      (fun F params qvars => funext (fun i => hSubstKraus x y_exp ω.σ F params qvars i))
      post_base.A
  -- LHS = E(A[y/x]@ω.σ, K†·ρ·K). By bridge K = M_m*†, so K† = M_m* and
  -- K†·ρ·K = M_m*·ρ·M_m*† = the measurement transform ρ'_{m*}.
  -- Also A[y/x]@ω.σ = A@σ'_{m*} by substitution + bridge.
  -- So LHS = E(A@σ'_{m*}, M_m*·ρ·M_m*†) = the m*-th RHS term.
  -- Therefore LHS ≤ full RHS sum (non-negative terms).
  -- First, show LHS equals the value of the m*-th RHS term:
  have hLHS_eq : (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω.σ
        (substFormula expSub qvSub x y_exp hInj post_base.A))
      ((psem.krausInterp F_My ω.σ fParams fQvars ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).adjoint.comp
        (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F_My ω.σ fParams fQvars ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩)))).re =
    (expectationValue (interpFormula psem (sem.measClassicalUpdate ω.σ x M m_star) post_base.A)
      ((sem.measOp M ω.σ measQvars m_star).comp
        (ω.ρ.comp (sem.measOp M ω.σ measQvars m_star).adjoint))).re := by
    rw [hInterp_eq, ← hσ_eq]
    congr 1
    rw [hK0]
    simp [LinearMap.adjoint_adjoint]
  rw [hLHS_eq]
  -- Now: E(A@σ'_{m*}, ρ'_{m*}).re ≤ ∑ m, [if cond then E(A@σ'_m, ρ'_m) else 0]
  -- LHS = m*-th term (condition true), rest ≥ 0, so LHS ≤ sum.
  classical
  -- Use calc: LHS = if ... then LHS else 0 ≤ ∑ m, if ... then ... else 0
  calc (expectationValue (interpFormula psem (sem.measClassicalUpdate ω.σ x M m_star) post_base.A)
        ((sem.measOp M ω.σ measQvars m_star).comp
          (ω.ρ.comp (sem.measOp M ω.σ measQvars m_star).adjoint))).re
      = (if (post_base.φ (sem.measClassicalUpdate ω.σ x M m_star) ∧
             eqXY (sem.measClassicalUpdate ω.σ x M m_star)) ∧
            IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem (sem.measClassicalUpdate ω.σ x M m_star) post_base.A)
          then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem (sem.measClassicalUpdate ω.σ x M m_star) post_base.A)
                 ((sem.measOp M ω.σ measQvars m_star).comp
                   (ω.ρ.comp (sem.measOp M ω.σ measQvars m_star).adjoint))).re
          else 0) := by
        rw [if_pos ⟨⟨hφ_holds, heqXY_holds⟩, hqe_post⟩]
    _ ≤ _ := by
        -- The RHS sum is ∑ b, g(b) for some function g that was produced by
        -- simp [termDerivMeasureEquiv, ...]. The LHS is g(m_star) with the if resolved.
        -- All terms g(b) ≥ 0, so g(m_star) ≤ ∑ g(b).
        -- Use linarith with the non-negativity of the other terms:
        have hnn : ∀ b : cats.measOutcomeType M, b ≠ m_star → 0 ≤
          (if (post_base.φ (sem.measClassicalUpdate ω.σ x M b) ∧
               eqXY (sem.measClassicalUpdate ω.σ x M b)) ∧
              IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem (sem.measClassicalUpdate ω.σ x M b) post_base.A)
           then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem (sem.measClassicalUpdate ω.σ x M b) post_base.A)
                  ((sem.measOp M ω.σ measQvars b).comp
                    (ω.ρ.comp (sem.measOp M ω.σ measQvars b).adjoint))).re
           else 0) := by
          intro b _
          split_ifs with h
          · exact expectationValue_re_nonneg h.2
              (sem.measTransform_pdo M ω.σ measQvars b ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp)
          · exact le_refl _
        -- The sum in the goal was expanded by simp[termDerivMeasureEquiv, ...].
        -- We need: if_pos_value ≤ expanded_sum.
        -- The expanded sum is definitionally ∑ m, f(m) for the right f.
        -- Finset.single_le_sum won't unify due to the syntactic expansion.
        -- Instead, fold the sum back:
        have : ∀ m : cats.measOutcomeType M, 0 ≤
          (if (post_base.φ (sem.measClassicalUpdate ω.σ x M m) ∧
               eqXY (sem.measClassicalUpdate ω.σ x M m)) ∧
              IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem (sem.measClassicalUpdate ω.σ x M m) post_base.A)
           then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem (sem.measClassicalUpdate ω.σ x M m) post_base.A)
                  ((sem.measOp M ω.σ measQvars m).comp
                    (ω.ρ.comp (sem.measOp M ω.σ measQvars m).adjoint))).re
           else 0) := by
          intro m
          split_ifs with h
          · exact expectationValue_re_nonneg h.2
              (sem.measTransform_pdo M ω.σ measQvars m ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp)
          · exact le_refl _
        -- Now use Finset.single_le_sum on the correct function
        -- Use convert to handle the syntactic mismatch from simp expansion
        have hsls := Finset.single_le_sum (fun m (_ : m ∈ Finset.univ) => this m) (Finset.mem_univ m_star)
        exact_mod_cast hsls

/-! ## Substitution Coherence: Satisfiability

The `SubstitutionSemantics` / `SoundnessBase` substitution fields
(`qvSub_injective`, `substInterp_atom`, `substInterp_kraus`) are satisfiable.
We give two concrete witnesses:

1. **Identity substitution is injective** — `fun _ _ q => q` is `Function.id`,
   which is injective. This shows `qvSub_injective` is satisfiable independently
   of the semantic model.

2. **`substInterp_atom` is trivially true for `TrivialAtomPred`** — because
   `mkStandardPredicateSemantics` defines `atomInterp _ _ _ _ = 0` for all inputs,
   both sides of the equation are `0` and the equality holds by `rfl`.

3. **`substInterp_kraus` requires a semantic coherence hypothesis** — for a
   concrete `ProgramSemantics`, `krausInterp (.forGate U) σ (expSub∘params) (qvSub∘qvars)`
   involves `unitaryOp U σ (expSub∘params) (qvSub∘qvars)`, and the RHS involves
   `unitaryOp U (classicalUpdate σ x e) params qvars`. These coincide when:
   ```
   unitaryOp U σ (expSub x e ∘ params) qvars =
     unitaryOp U (classicalUpdate σ x e) params qvars
   ```
   i.e., whenever the gate operator evaluates its classical parameters by looking
   them up in `σ` (exactly as the paper's concrete model does). This is not
   derivable from `ProgramSemantics` axioms alone; it is the paper's Lemma 5
   coherence condition, which must be supplied as a hypothesis for any concrete
   semantic model. The theorem `substInterp_kraus_satisfiable` below packages
   this correctly. -/

/-- Identity quantum-variable substitution is injective.
    For any `x : CVar` and `e : Exp`, the function `(fun _ _ q => q) x e = id` is injective.
    This witnesses that `qvSub_injective` is satisfiable: supply `fun _ _ q => q` for `qvSub`. -/

      (loopInvCQ tc nc ctx)
      (factorExtraction tc nc)

    intro a b h; rw [hSubstId.f1_gcd_qv a, hSubstId.f1_gcd_qv b] at h; exact h
  have hF2Inj : Function.Injective (qvSub .f2_var .gcdF2) := by
    intro a b h; rw [hSubstId.f2_gcd_qv a, hSubstId.f2_gcd_qv b] at h; exact h
  -- Since post.φ = fun _ => True, all classical entailments are trivial (via transitivity)
  have hResultF1Inj : Function.Injective (qvSub .result (.var .f1_var)) := by
    intro a b h; rw [hSubstId.result_f1_qv a, hSubstId.result_f1_qv b] at h; exact h
  have hFoundInj : Function.Injective (qvSub .found .trueVal) := by
    intro a b h; rw [hSubstId.found_true_qv a, hSubstId.found_true_qv b] at h; exact h

      (substCQAssertion sem expSub qvSub .f2_var .gcdF2 hF2Inj post) :=
    entails_substCQAssertion_of_id sem psem expSub qvSub .f2_var .gcdF2 hF2Inj
      hSubstId.f2_gcd_qv hSubstId.f2_gcd_exp post (fun _ _ => trivial)
  -- substF2(post) ⊨ substF1(substF2(post))

/-! ## Main Correctness Theorem -/

/-- Shor's factoring algorithm: partial correctness in QHL⁺.

    **What IS proved (Layer 1 — proof-rule structure):**
    The derivation tree is fully constructed using QHL⁺ proof rules:
    - `axiomInit` for qubit initialization (all t counting + all n target qubits)
    - `axiomUnitary` for H (all t counting), CU_pow(2^(t-1-j)) (all t counting), QFT_inv
    - `axiomMeasure` for counting qubit measurements (all t counting)
    - `ruleSeq` for sequential composition
    - `ruleCond` for conditionals (g > 1, evenRAndCheck, f1Valid, f2Valid)
    - `ruleLoopPar` for the while (not found) loop (partial correctness — may not terminate)
    - `ruleConseq` for bridging pre/postconditions
    - `axiomAssign` for classical assignments (found, result, a, g, r, f1, f2)
    - `axiomSkip` for skip in else branches

    Gate typeclasses (`UnitaryKrausBridge`, `InitKrausBridge`) replace manual bridge hypotheses.
    Trivial entailments (reflexivity, classical weakening) discharged inline.
    Assignment entailments discharged via `SubstIdentity` + `substCQAssertion_entails_of_id`.

    **What is ASSUMED (external hypotheses):**
    - `hElseDeriv` (Layer 3): QPE subroutine correctness — the else branch
      (quantum phase estimation + classical post-processing) preserves the
      loop invariant. This should ultimately come from `Order_finding` but
      is taken as an axiom here.
    - `hThenDeriv` (Layer 2): Factor extraction when gcd(a,N) > 1 — the then
      branch preserves the loop invariant. This is provable from number theory
      (if g = gcd(a,N) > 1 then g|N) and the fact that classical assignments
      don't change the quantum state.
    - `SubstIdentity` (Layer 2): Classical variable assignments (found, result,
      a, g, r, f1, f2) do not affect quantum variable indexing, i.e., `qvSub`
      and `expSub` act as identity for these assignments. Provable from concrete
      semantics where classical and quantum variables are independent.
    - Gate typeclasses (Layer 2): `InitKrausBridge`, `UnitaryKrausBridge` for
      H, CU_pow, QFT_inv — standard gate semantics.

    **Note on partial correctness:**
    Uses `QHLPlusDeriv` (not `QHLPlusTotDeriv`), so the result is:
    IF the program terminates THEN the postcondition holds.
    Termination holds with probability >= 1 - 1/2^k after k iterations
    (by the order-finding success probability), but this is not proved here. -/

    (j : Fin (tc + 1))

    (postA : @QuantumPredicateFormula (ShorCVar tc) (ShorExp tc) (ShorBExp tc)
      (Fin (tc + nc + 2)) (ShorGate tc nc) (ShorMeas tc nc) (ShorAtomPred tc nc)
      (ShorKrausOpSym tc nc) _ (shorSyntaxCats tc nc) (shorPredCats tc nc) (sigAll tc nc)) :
    QHLPlusDeriv sem psem expSub qvSub
      (mkCQAssertion tc nc
        (krausInit tc nc (countingQubit tc nc j)
          (krausH tc nc j (krausCU tc nc j postA))) ctx)
      (.seq (.qInit (countingQubit tc nc j))
       (.seq (applyH tc nc j) (applyCU tc nc j)))
      (mkCQAssertion tc nc postA ctx) := by
  apply QHLPlusDeriv.ruleSeq (derivStep_Init tc nc sem psem expSub qvSub _ _)
  apply QHLPlusDeriv.ruleSeq (derivStep_H tc nc sem psem expSub qvSub _ _)

/-! ## Substitution Identity Hypotheses

Classical variables (found, result, a_var, g_var, r_var, f1_var, f2_var) do NOT
index quantum variables, so qvSub and expSub act as identity for these assignments.
We bundle these as a structure to avoid repeating them. -/

/-- Substitution acts as identity for non-quantum classical variables,
    and boolean expressions are fresh (not affected by unrelated assignments).

    **Why each field is needed (Layer 2 — provable from concrete semantics):**

    The `*_qv` fields assert that `qvSub x e q = q` for each classical
    assignment `x := e`. This holds because classical variables (found,
    result, a_var, g_var, r_var, f1_var, f2_var) do not index into the
    quantum variable space — substituting them cannot rename quantum registers.

    The `*_exp` fields assert that `expSub x e t = t` for each classical
    assignment. This holds because quantum predicate formulas in this
    algorithm do not contain classical expressions that depend on these
    variables (the predicates are all `(True, I/2^(t+n))`).

    The `notFound_fresh_*` fields assert that the boolean expression
    `not found` is not affected by assignments to `a_var` or `g_var`.
    This holds because `found` is a distinct variable from `a_var`/`g_var`,
    and assigning to `a_var`/`g_var` does not change the value of `found`.

    In a concrete instantiation, all these fields are provable by `rfl`
    or simple evaluation. They are hypotheses here because the theorem
    is parametric over `sem`, `expSub`, and `qvSub`. -/

noncomputable def termDerivSeqEquiv {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (P₁ P₂ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx) :
    TerminatingDerivation sem (.seq P₁ P₂) ω ≃
    (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P₁ ω) × TerminatingDerivation sem P₂ d₁.result where
  toFun d := splitSeqDeriv sem P₁ P₂ ω d
  invFun p := joinSeqDeriv sem P₁ P₂ ω p.1 p.2
  left_inv d := by
    -- Goal: joinSeqDeriv(splitSeqDeriv(d)) = d
    -- Strategy: show .result and .path match; Prop fields by proof irrelevance.
    show joinSeqDeriv sem P₁ P₂ ω (splitSeqDeriv sem P₁ P₂ ω d).1
      (splitSeqDeriv sem P₁ P₂ ω d).2 = d
    -- Unfold to expose splitSeqPath_certified
    unfold splitSeqDeriv joinSeqDeriv
    -- The goal is now: ⟨d.result, joinSeqPath sem P₂ sp.2.1 sp.2.2.1, ...⟩ = d
    -- where sp = splitSeqPath_certified sem d.path ...
    -- By proof irrelevance, we need .result and .path to match.
    -- .result = d.result (definitional from splitSeqDeriv construction)
    -- .path: use the roundtrip lemma
    rcases d with ⟨result, path, path_start, path_end, path_wf, path_deep_wf⟩
    simp only
    congr 1
    -- Goal: joinSeqPath sem P₂ (splitSeqPath_certified ...).2.1 (splitSeqPath_certified ...).2.2.1 = path
    exact joinSeqPath_splitSeqPath_certified_path_eq sem path
      path_start path_end path_wf path_deep_wf
  right_inv p := by
    -- split(join(d₁, d₂)) = (d₁, d₂): dual of left_inv
    -- Requires a dual roundtrip lemma: splitSeqPath_certified(joinSeqPath(p₁, p₂)) = (p₁, p₂),
    -- i.e., splitting the joined path recovers the original sub-paths. This is structurally
    -- similar to joinSeqPath_splitSeqPath_certified_path_eq but in the reverse direction,
    -- proved by induction on p₁ with seqStep/seqDone case analysis.
    --
    -- Additional difficulty: the goal is a Sigma equality (dependent pair), so we need both:
    --   (1) splitSeqDeriv(joinSeqDeriv(d₁,d₂)).1 = d₁  (TerminatingDerivation with .result and .path)
    --   (2) splitSeqDeriv(joinSeqDeriv(d₁,d₂)).2 ≡ d₂  (HEq because type depends on (1))
    -- Each requires showing .result and .path match, with .path needing the dual roundtrip lemma.
    --
    -- NOT on the critical path: denotationalSem_seq uses multiset_map_univ_equiv' which only
    -- needs the Equiv to exist (for reindexing), not the full round-trip. The master theorem
    -- (tsum_seq_result) bypasses the Multiset Equiv entirely.
    obtain ⟨d₁, d₂⟩ := p
    -- Goal: splitSeqDeriv sem P₁ P₂ ω (joinSeqDeriv sem P₁ P₂ ω d₁ d₂) = ⟨d₁, d₂⟩
    -- Use the dual roundtrip lemma to recover .result and .path for both components.
    -- Unfold to expose the path-level operations
    unfold splitSeqDeriv joinSeqDeriv
    -- Get the dual roundtrip result
    have hrt := splitSeqPath_certified_joinSeqPath_eq sem
      d₁.path d₁.path_start d₁.path_end d₁.path_wf d₁.path_deep_wf
      d₂.path d₂.path_start d₂.path_end d₂.path_wf d₂.path_deep_wf
      (joinSeqPath_startConfig sem P₂ d₁.path d₂.path P₁ ω d₁.path_start
        ⟨d₁.result, d₁.path_end⟩)
      (by rw [joinSeqPath_endConfig]; exact d₂.path_end)
      (joinSeqPath_wf sem P₂ d₁.path d₂.path d₁.path_wf d₂.path_wf P₁ ω d₁.path_start
        ⟨d₁.result, d₁.path_end⟩
        (fun ω' hend₁ => by
          have h₁ := d₁.path_end; rw [hend₁] at h₁
          simp [Configuration.terminal, Configuration.mk.injEq] at h₁
          subst h₁; exact d₂.path_start))
      (joinSeqPath_all_substep_wf sem P₂ d₁.path d₂.path d₁.path_deep_wf d₂.path_deep_wf
        d₁.path_wf P₁ ω d₁.path_start ⟨d₁.result, d₁.path_end⟩)
    obtain ⟨hrt_mid, hrt_p₁, hrt_p₂⟩ := hrt
    -- hrt_mid : sp.1 = d₁.result, hrt_p₁ : sp.2.1 = d₁.path, hrt_p₂ : sp.2.2.1 = d₂.path
    -- The goal is a Sigma type equality: ⟨d₁', d₂'⟩ = ⟨d₁, d₂⟩
    -- where d₁' has .result = sp.1 and .path = sp.2.1,
    -- and d₂' has .result = joinedDeriv.result and .path = sp.2.2.1.
    -- Use Sigma.ext: show fst = fst, then HEq for snd.
    -- The goal is a Sigma equality ⟨d₁', d₂'⟩ = ⟨d₁, d₂⟩.
    -- Strategy: match on the splitSeqPath_certified result using the let binding in splitSeqDeriv,
    -- then use the roundtrip equalities to rewrite.
    -- Since splitSeqDeriv uses `let ⟨ω_mid, p₁, p₂, ...⟩ := splitSeqPath_certified ...`,
    -- the output is ⟨⟨ω_mid, p₁, ...⟩, ⟨d.result, p₂, ...⟩⟩.
    -- We know ω_mid = d₁.result, p₁ = d₁.path, p₂ = d₂.path.
    -- After rewriting, both components match d₁ and d₂ by proof irrelevance.
    -- Use the match form directly: generalize the let-bound variables from splitSeqPath_certified.
    -- The splitSeqDeriv match destructures into (ω_mid, p₁, p₂, ⟨h₁s⟩, ⟨h₁e⟩, ⟨h₁w⟩, ⟨h₁a⟩, ⟨h₂s⟩, ⟨h₂e⟩, ⟨h₂w⟩, ⟨h₂a⟩).
    -- Generalize these and subst.
    -- Actually, the cleanest approach: show both components are equal separately,
    -- using Sigma.mk.inj or manual construction.
    -- Let's generalize the entire splitSeqPath_certified call.
    set sp := splitSeqPath_certified sem (joinSeqPath sem P₂ d₁.path d₂.path)
      _ _ _ _ with hsp_def
    -- Now the goal involves sp's components
    -- d₁' = ⟨sp.1, sp.2.1, sp.2.2.2.1.down, sp.2.2.2.2.1.down, sp.2.2.2.2.2.1.down, sp.2.2.2.2.2.2.1.down⟩
    -- d₂' = ⟨d₂.result, sp.2.2.1, sp.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1.down, sp.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1.down, sp.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1.down, sp.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1.down⟩
    -- Destructure sp to get variables we can subst
    obtain ⟨mid, p₁, p₂, ⟨h₁s⟩, ⟨h₁e⟩, ⟨h₁w⟩, ⟨h₁a⟩, ⟨h₂s⟩, ⟨h₂e⟩, ⟨h₂w⟩, ⟨h₂a⟩⟩ := sp
    -- Force match reduction in the goal after destructuring
    dsimp only at *
    -- hrt_mid : mid = d₁.result, hrt_p₁ : p₁ = d₁.path, hrt_p₂ : p₂ = d₂.path
    subst hrt_mid; subst hrt_p₁; subst hrt_p₂
    -- After substitution, hsp_def : ⟨d₁.result, d₁.path, d₂.path, ...⟩ = splitSeqPath_certified ...
    -- The goal's match on splitSeqPath_certified needs to reduce.
    -- Rewrite using hsp_def to replace splitSeqPath_certified with the known tuple.
    -- hsp_def : ⟨d₁.result, d₁.path, d₂.path, ...⟩ = splitSeqPath_certified ...
    -- Rewrite to replace splitSeqPath_certified with the known tuple
    rw [← hsp_def]

/-- **Proposition 6, Case (6): Sequential Composition [Ying, Proposition 3.1(6)]**

    The denotational semantics of sequential composition P1; P2 is:
    [[P1; P2]](sigma, rho) = [[P2]]([[P1]](sigma, rho))
                            = Union_{(sigma', rho') in [[P1]](sigma, rho)} [[P2]](sigma', rho').
    The output of P1 is fed as input to P2, collecting all resulting states. -/

instance terminatingDerivation_skip_subsingleton {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (ω : CQState ctx) :
    Subsingleton (TerminatingDerivation sem QWhilePlus.skip ω) :=
  ⟨fun d₁ d₂ => by
    -- Both results = ω
    have hr₁ := terminatingDerivation_skip_result sem ω d₁
    have hr₂ := terminatingDerivation_skip_result sem ω d₂
    -- For TerminatingDerivation equality: .result, .path must match
    -- (.path_start, .path_end, .path_wf are Prop — proof irrelevant)
    -- Both paths must be .step (.skip ω) (.refl (terminal ω))
    -- Use ext-like reasoning: result equal + path equal → d₁ = d₂
    -- Both paths are uniquely determined: .step (.skip ω) (.refl (terminal ω))
    obtain ⟨_, path₁, hs₁, he₁, hw₁⟩ := d₁
    obtain ⟨_, path₂, hs₂, he₂, hw₂⟩ := d₂
    simp at hr₁ hr₂; subst hr₁; subst hr₂
    have hp₁ := derivationPath_skip_unique_path sem _ path₁ hs₁ he₁ hw₁
    have hp₂ := derivationPath_skip_unique_path sem _ path₂ hs₂ he₂ hw₂
    subst hp₁; subst hp₂; rfl⟩

/-- Generic helper: for simple programs (unique step to terminal), the derivation path is unique.
    Takes the unique step and its proof as arguments. -/
private lemma derivationPath_simple_unique {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : Semantics ctx)
    (P : Prog) (ω : CQState ctx) (ω' : CQState ctx)
    (the_step : OpStep sem)
    (h_step_eq : ∀ s : OpStep sem, s.c₁ = Configuration.ofProgram P ω → s = the_step)
    (h_step_c₂ : the_step.c₂ = Configuration.terminal ω')
    (p : DerivationPath sem)
    (hp_start : p.startConfig = Configuration.ofProgram P ω)
    (hp_end : p.endConfig = Configuration.terminal ω')
    (hp_wf : p.wf) :
    p = .step the_step (.refl (Configuration.terminal ω')) := by
  cases p with
  | refl c =>
    exact False.elim (ofProgram_terminal_conflict P ω ω' hp_start hp_end)
  | step s rest =>
    simp [DerivationPath.startConfig] at hp_start
    have hs := h_step_eq s hp_start; subst hs
    obtain ⟨hconn, _⟩ := hp_wf
    rw [h_step_c₂] at hconn
    cases rest with
    | refl c =>
      simp [DerivationPath.startConfig] at hconn; subst hconn; rfl
    | step s' _ =>
      simp [DerivationPath.startConfig] at hconn
      exact absurd hconn (by intro h; exact opStep_terminal_no_step sem ω' s' h.symm)

/-- Generic Subsingleton for simple programs (unique step to terminal). -/
private lemma terminatingDerivation_simple_subsingleton {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : Semantics ctx)
    (P : Prog) (ω : CQState ctx) (ω' : CQState ctx)
    (the_step : OpStep sem)
    (h_step_eq : ∀ s : OpStep sem, s.c₁ = Configuration.ofProgram P ω → s = the_step)
    (h_step_c₂ : the_step.c₂ = Configuration.terminal ω')
    (h_result : ∀ d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω, d.result = ω') :
    Subsingleton (TerminatingDerivation sem P ω) :=
  ⟨fun d₁ d₂ => by
    have hr₁ := h_result d₁; have hr₂ := h_result d₂
    obtain ⟨_, p₁, hs₁, he₁, hw₁⟩ := d₁
    obtain ⟨_, p₂, hs₂, he₂, hw₂⟩ := d₂
    simp at hr₁ hr₂; subst hr₁; subst hr₂
    have hp₁ := derivationPath_simple_unique sem P ω _ the_step h_step_eq h_step_c₂ p₁ hs₁ he₁ hw₁
    have hp₂ := derivationPath_simple_unique sem P ω _ the_step h_step_eq h_step_c₂ p₂ hs₂ he₂ hw₂
    subst hp₁; subst hp₂; rfl⟩

theorem soundness_accum2_tot_deriv_proof
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx}
    {psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx}
    {expSub : CVar → Exp → Exp → Exp}
    {qvSub : CVar → Exp → QVar → QVar}
    (sax : SoundnessBase sem psem expSub qvSub)
    (F : KrausOpSym)
    (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
    (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)
    (hdistF : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F), i ≠ j → qvarsF i ≠ qvarsF j)
    {S : Finset QVar}
    (preAs postBs : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) →
      QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S)
    (hsubF : ∀ i, qvarsF i ∈ S)
    (preφ postψ : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)
    (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (hpremises : ∀ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
      HoareTripleTotDeriv sem psem ⟨S, preφ, preAs i⟩ P ⟨S, postψ, postBs i⟩)
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint (Finset.image qvarsF Finset.univ) P.quantumVars) :
    HoareTripleTotDeriv sem psem
      ⟨S, preφ, .kraus F params qvarsF preAs hdistF hsubF⟩
      P
      ⟨S, postψ, .kraus F params qvarsF postBs hdistF hsubF⟩ := by
  -- === STEP 0: Unfold HoareTripleTotDeriv ===
  intro ω hpreφ hQE_kraus
  simp only [interpFormula_kraus] at hQE_kraus ⊢
  -- === STEPS 1-3: Kraus Decomposition ===
  rw [expectationValue_kraus_decompose]
  -- === STEP 4: Per-branch hypothesis application ===
  have hbranch : ∀ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
      (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω.σ (preAs i))
        ((psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
          (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)))).re ≤
      postcondExpectDeriv psem ⟨S, postψ, postBs i⟩ sem P
        ⟨ω.σ,
         (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
           (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
         sax.krausInterp_sandwich_pdo F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ := by
    intro i
    exact hpremises i
      ⟨ω.σ,
       (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
         (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
       sax.krausInterp_sandwich_pdo F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩
      hpreφ (sax.interpFormula_effect ω.σ (preAs i))
  -- === STEPS 5-7: Fubini + reassembly via disjointKrausPostcondComm ===
  calc ∑ i, (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω.σ (preAs i))
          ((psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
            (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)))).re
      ≤ ∑ i, postcondExpectDeriv psem ⟨S, postψ, postBs i⟩ sem P
            ⟨ω.σ,
             (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
               (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
             sax.krausInterp_sandwich_pdo F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ := by
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hbranch i)
    _ ≤ postcondExpectDeriv psem
            ⟨S, postψ, .kraus F params qvarsF postBs hdistF hsubF⟩ sem P ω := by
        exact sax.disjointKrausPostcondComm F params qvarsF hdistF postBs hsubF
          postψ P ω hdisjoint

theorem hoareTriplePar_of_programEquiv
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    (pre : CQAssert CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    {P₁ P₂ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas}
    (post : CQAssert CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    [∀ ω, Fintype (TerminatingDerivation sem P₁ ω)]
    [∀ ω, Fintype (TerminatingDerivation sem P₂ ω)]
    (hequiv : ProgramEquiv sem P₁ P₂)
    (hpar : HoareTriplePar sem psem pre P₁ post) :
    HoareTriplePar sem psem pre P₂ post := by
  intro ω hφ hQE
  have h₁ := hpar ω hφ hQE
  -- Rewrite using the multiset equality from program equivalence
  have hm : denotationalSem sem P₁ ω = denotationalSem sem P₂ ω := hequiv ω
  rw [postcondExpectSum_congr psem post hm] at h₁
  rw [nonTerminationTrace_congr sem hequiv ω] at h₁
  exact h₁

/-! ## Main theorem: program equivalence preserves partial correctness (iff) -/

/-- **Lemma 6: Program Equivalence Preserves Correctness**

    If two quantum programs P1 and P2 are equivalent (P1 ~ P2, Definition 14),
    meaning they produce the same output multiset for every input state, then
    they satisfy exactly the same Hoare triples for partial correctness:

      |=_par {phi, A} P1 {psi, B}  iff  |=_par {phi, A} P2 {psi, B}

    The total correctness analogue (Equation (5.2) / `lem-eq2` in the paper)
    also holds by the same argument but is not separately formalized here.

    The proof follows directly from the definitions: since P1 ~ P2 implies
    [[P1]](sigma, rho) = [[P2]](sigma, rho) as multisets, the postcondition
    expectation sums and non-termination traces are identical.

    Paper reference: Lemma 5.1 (program equivalence preserves correctness) of
    [Ying, "A Practical Quantum Hoare Logic with Classical Variables, I", 2025]. -/

    (fun d => expectationValue_re_le_trace_re (sax.interpFormula_effect d.result.σ post.A)
      d.result.is_partialDensityOp)

/-! ## While-True Decomposition Equiv and Trace Remainder Bound

These build the Equiv `W(ω) ≃ Σ d₁:P(ω), W(d₁.result)` by composing
`termDerivWhileTrueEquiv.symm` (W → P;W) with `termDerivSeqEquiv` (P;W → Σ d₁, W(d₁.result)).
The key properties are:
- **result preservation**: `(e d).2.result = d.result`
- **pathLength decrease**: `(e d).2.pathLength < d.pathLength`
The Equivs (`termDerivSeqEquiv`, `termDerivWhileTrueEquiv`) are used for
the round-trip equivalence with opaque tactic-defined path operations. -/

/-- The forward map of while-true decomposition: given a while-derivation where b holds,
    strip the whileTrue step to get a P;W derivation, then split it into (d₁, d₂). -/
noncomputable def whileTrueDecompose_fwd
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (b : BExp) (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx) (hb : sem.boolEval ω.σ b)
    (d : TerminatingDerivation sem (.whileDo b P) ω) :
    (Σ (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω),
       TerminatingDerivation sem (.whileDo b P) d₁.result) :=
  let d_seq := stripWhileTrue sem b P ω hb d
  let ⟨d₁, d₂⟩ := splitSeqDeriv sem P (.whileDo b P) ω d_seq
  ⟨d₁, d₂⟩

noncomputable def whileTrueDecomposeEquiv
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (b : BExp) (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx) (hb : sem.boolEval ω.σ b) :
    TerminatingDerivation sem (.whileDo b P) ω ≃
    (Σ (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω),
       TerminatingDerivation sem (.whileDo b P) d₁.result) where
  toFun := whileTrueDecompose_fwd sem b P ω hb
  invFun p :=
    prependWhileTrue sem b P ω hb (joinSeqDeriv sem P (.whileDo b P) ω p.1 p.2)
  left_inv d := by
    -- prependWhileTrue(joinSeqDeriv(splitSeqDeriv(stripWhileTrue(d)))) = d
    -- Factor: joinSeqDeriv ∘ splitSeqDeriv = id (termDerivSeqEquiv.left_inv),
    --         then prependWhileTrue ∘ stripWhileTrue = id (termDerivWhileTrueEquiv.right_inv).
    show prependWhileTrue sem b P ω hb
      (joinSeqDeriv sem P (.whileDo b P) ω
        (splitSeqDeriv sem P (.whileDo b P) ω (stripWhileTrue sem b P ω hb d)).1
        (splitSeqDeriv sem P (.whileDo b P) ω (stripWhileTrue sem b P ω hb d)).2) = d
    have hseq := (termDerivSeqEquiv sem P (.whileDo b P) ω).left_inv
      (stripWhileTrue sem b P ω hb d)
    -- hseq : joinSeqDeriv(splitSeqDeriv(stripWhileTrue(d))) = stripWhileTrue(d)
    conv at hseq => lhs; simp only [termDerivSeqEquiv]
    rw [hseq]
    exact (termDerivWhileTrueEquiv sem b P ω hb).right_inv d
  right_inv p := by
    -- splitSeqDeriv(stripWhileTrue(prependWhileTrue(joinSeqDeriv(d₁,d₂)))) = (d₁,d₂)
    -- Factor: stripWhileTrue ∘ prependWhileTrue = id (termDerivWhileTrueEquiv.left_inv),
    --         then splitSeqDeriv ∘ joinSeqDeriv = id (termDerivSeqEquiv.right_inv).
    obtain ⟨d₁, d₂⟩ := p
    show whileTrueDecompose_fwd sem b P ω hb
      (prependWhileTrue sem b P ω hb (joinSeqDeriv sem P (.whileDo b P) ω d₁ d₂)) = ⟨d₁, d₂⟩
    unfold whileTrueDecompose_fwd
    have hwhile := (termDerivWhileTrueEquiv sem b P ω hb).left_inv
      (joinSeqDeriv sem P (.whileDo b P) ω d₁ d₂)
    conv at hwhile => lhs; simp only [termDerivWhileTrueEquiv]
    simp only [hwhile]
    exact (termDerivSeqEquiv sem P (.whileDo b P) ω).right_inv ⟨d₁, d₂⟩

/-- The sub-while-derivation from `whileTrueDecomposeEquiv` preserves `.result`. -/

theorem termDeriv_replay_id {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    {ω : CQState ctx} (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω) :
    termDeriv_replay sem P d ω rfl = d := by
  have hstart_state : d.path.startConfig.state = ω :=
    congr_arg Configuration.state d.path_start
  have hend_state : d.path.endConfig.state = d.result :=
    congr_arg Configuration.state d.path_end
  have hpath_id := derivPath_replay_id d.path d.path_wf d.path_deep_wf
  -- hpath_id : derivPath_replay sem d.path d.path.startConfig.state rfl ... = d.path
  -- We need: the derivPath_replay with ω equals the one with d.path.startConfig.state
  -- Since hstart_state : d.path.startConfig.state = ω,
  -- by proof irrelevance (in CQState and σ), the two are equal after substitution
  -- Build the path equality explicitly
  have hpath_eq : derivPath_replay sem d.path ω
      (by exact (congr_arg (fun c => c.state.σ) d.path_start).symm)
      d.path_wf d.path_deep_wf = d.path := by
    -- simp can handle the dependent rewrite that rw/conv cannot
    simp only [show ω = d.path.startConfig.state from hstart_state.symm, hpath_id]
  -- Now use hpath_eq and hend_state
  show termDeriv_replay sem P d ω rfl = d
  simp only [termDeriv_replay]
  simp only [hpath_eq, hend_state]

theorem termDeriv_replay_result_rho {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (hyp : DisjointCommHypotheses sem)
    (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    {ω : CQState ctx} (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω)
    (ω_K : CQState ctx)
    (hσ : ω_K.σ = ω.σ)
    (K : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all)
    (qvarsK : Finset QVar)
    (hρ : ω_K.ρ = K.adjoint.comp (ω.ρ.comp K))
    (hDisj : d.path.allDisjointFrom qvarsK) :
    (termDeriv_replay sem P d ω_K hσ).result.ρ =
    K.adjoint.comp (d.result.ρ.comp K) := by
  -- result.ρ = (derivPath_replay ...).endConfig.state.ρ
  change (derivPath_replay sem d.path ω_K _ d.path_wf d.path_deep_wf).endConfig.state.ρ =
    K.adjoint.comp (d.result.ρ.comp K)
  have hend : d.path.endConfig.state = d.result :=
    congr_arg Configuration.state d.path_end
  have hσ_path : ω_K.σ = d.path.startConfig.state.σ := by
    rw [hσ]; exact (congr_arg (fun c => c.state.σ) d.path_start).symm
  have hρ_path : ω_K.ρ = K.adjoint.comp (d.path.startConfig.state.ρ.comp K) := by
    rw [hρ]; congr 1; congr 1
    exact (congr_arg (fun c => c.state.ρ) d.path_start).symm
  rw [derivPath_replay_ρ sem hyp d.path ω_K K qvarsK hσ_path hρ_path d.path_wf
      d.path_deep_wf hDisj, hend]

/-- For any OpStep `s` with `s.c₁ = Configuration.ofProgram P ω` and well-formed substeps,
    if `qvarsK` is disjoint from `P.quantumVars`, then `s.disjointFrom qvarsK`.
    Proved by cases on `s`, extracting the program from the c₁ equation. -/
private theorem opStep_disjointFrom_of_prog_disjoint {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx}
    (s : OpStep sem)
    (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx)
    (hc₁ : s.c₁ = Configuration.ofProgram P ω)
    (hsw : s.substep_wf)
    (qvarsK : Finset QVar)
    (hDisj : Disjoint qvarsK P.quantumVars) :
    s.disjointFrom qvarsK := by
  cases s with
  | skip _ => trivial
  | classAssign _ _ _ => trivial
  | qInit q ω' =>
    have hP : P = .qInit q := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₁
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    subst hP
    simp only [OpStep.disjointFrom]
    simp [QWhilePlus.quantumVars] at hDisj
    exact hDisj
  | unitaryApp U params qvars hdist ω' =>
    have hP : P = .unitaryApp U params qvars hdist := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₁
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    subst hP
    simp only [OpStep.disjointFrom]
    simp [QWhilePlus.quantumVars] at hDisj
    exact Disjoint.symm hDisj
  | measure x M qvars hdist ω' m =>
    have hP : P = .measure x M qvars hdist := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₁
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    subst hP
    simp only [OpStep.disjointFrom]
    simp [QWhilePlus.quantumVars] at hDisj
    exact Disjoint.symm hDisj
  | seqStep P₁ P₂ P₁' ω₁ ω₂ sub =>
    have hP : P = .seq P₁ P₂ := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₁
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    subst hP
    simp only [OpStep.disjointFrom]
    obtain ⟨hsub_c₁, _, hsub_wf⟩ := hsw
    have hDisj₁ : Disjoint qvarsK P₁.quantumVars := by
      simp [QWhilePlus.quantumVars] at hDisj; exact hDisj.1
    exact opStep_disjointFrom_of_prog_disjoint sub P₁ ω₁ hsub_c₁ hsub_wf qvarsK hDisj₁
  | seqDone P₁ P₂ ω₁ ω₂ sub =>
    have hP : P = .seq P₁ P₂ := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₁
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    subst hP
    simp only [OpStep.disjointFrom]
    obtain ⟨hsub_c₁, _, hsub_wf⟩ := hsw
    have hDisj₁ : Disjoint qvarsK P₁.quantumVars := by
      simp [QWhilePlus.quantumVars] at hDisj; exact hDisj.1
    exact opStep_disjointFrom_of_prog_disjoint sub P₁ ω₁ hsub_c₁ hsub_wf qvarsK hDisj₁
  | ifTrue _ _ _ _ _ => trivial
  | ifFalse _ _ _ _ _ => trivial
  | whileTrue _ _ _ _ => trivial
  | whileFalse _ _ _ _ => trivial

/-- For any OpStep `s` with `s.c₁ = Configuration.ofProgram P ω` and
    `s.c₂ = Configuration.ofProgram P' ω'`, we have `P'.quantumVars ⊆ P.quantumVars`.
    This is the key sub-program relationship: each transition step can only move to a
    sub-program with fewer (or equal) quantum variables. -/
private theorem opStep_c₂_quantumVars_subset {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx}
    (s : OpStep sem)
    (P P' : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω ω' : CQState ctx)
    (hc₁ : s.c₁ = Configuration.ofProgram P ω)
    (hc₂ : s.c₂ = Configuration.ofProgram P' ω')
    (hsw : s.substep_wf) :
    P'.quantumVars ⊆ P.quantumVars := by
  cases s with
  | skip ω₀ =>
    -- c₂ = terminal, not ofProgram
    simp [OpStep.c₂, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.terminated,
          ProgDown.running] at hc₂
  | classAssign x e ω₀ =>
    simp [OpStep.c₂, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.terminated,
          ProgDown.running] at hc₂
  | qInit q ω₀ =>
    simp [OpStep.c₂, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.terminated,
          ProgDown.running] at hc₂
  | unitaryApp U params qvars hdist ω₀ =>
    simp [OpStep.c₂, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.terminated,
          ProgDown.running] at hc₂
  | measure x M qvars hdist ω₀ m =>
    simp [OpStep.c₂, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.terminated,
          ProgDown.running] at hc₂
  | seqStep P₁ P₂ P₁'' ω₁ ω₂ sub =>
    have hPeq : P = .seq P₁ P₂ := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₁
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    have hP'eq : P' = .seq P₁'' P₂ := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₂
      simp [OpStep.c₂, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    subst hPeq; subst hP'eq
    simp only [QWhilePlus.quantumVars]
    apply Finset.union_subset_union_left
    obtain ⟨hsub_c₁, hsub_c₂, hsub_wf⟩ := hsw
    exact opStep_c₂_quantumVars_subset sub P₁ P₁'' ω₁ ω₂ hsub_c₁ hsub_c₂ hsub_wf
  | seqDone P₁ P₂ ω₁ ω₂ sub =>
    have hPeq : P = .seq P₁ P₂ := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₁
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    have hP'eq : P' = P₂ := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₂
      simp [OpStep.c₂, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    subst hPeq; subst hP'eq
    simp only [QWhilePlus.quantumVars]
    exact Finset.subset_union_right
  | ifTrue b P₁ P₀ ω₀ hb =>
    have hPeq : P = .ifThenElse b P₁ P₀ := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₁
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    have hP'eq : P' = P₁ := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₂
      simp [OpStep.c₂, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    subst hPeq; subst hP'eq
    simp only [QWhilePlus.quantumVars]
    exact Finset.subset_union_left
  | ifFalse b P₁ P₀ ω₀ hb =>
    have hPeq : P = .ifThenElse b P₁ P₀ := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₁
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    have hP'eq : P' = P₀ := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₂
      simp [OpStep.c₂, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    subst hPeq; subst hP'eq
    simp only [QWhilePlus.quantumVars]
    exact Finset.subset_union_right
  | whileTrue b Pw ω₀ hb =>
    have hPeq : P = .whileDo b Pw := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₁
      simp [OpStep.c₁, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    have hP'eq : P' = .seq Pw (.whileDo b Pw) := by
      have := congr_arg Configuration.prog hc₂
      simp [OpStep.c₂, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.running] at this; exact this.symm
    subst hPeq; subst hP'eq
    simp only [QWhilePlus.quantumVars]
    exact Finset.union_subset Finset.Subset.rfl Finset.Subset.rfl
  | whileFalse b Pw ω₀ hb =>
    -- c₂ = terminal, not ofProgram
    simp [OpStep.c₂, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.ofProgram, ProgDown.terminated,
          ProgDown.running] at hc₂

theorem postcondExpectDeriv_mono
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx}
    {psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx}
    {expSub : CVar → Exp → Exp → Exp} {qvSub : CVar → Exp → QVar → QVar}
    (sax : SoundnessBase sem psem expSub qvSub)
    (post₁ post₂ : CQAssert CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx)
    (h : ∀ σ, post₁.φ σ → post₂.φ σ)
    (hA : ∀ σ, post₁.φ σ → interpFormula psem σ post₁.A ≤ interpFormula psem σ post₂.A) :
    postcondExpectDeriv psem post₁ sem P ω ≤
    postcondExpectDeriv psem post₂ sem P ω := by
  unfold postcondExpectDeriv
  apply Summable.tsum_le_tsum
  · intro d
    split_ifs with h₁ h₂ h₂
    · -- Both conditions hold: use Löwner order monotonicity
      exact expectationValue_re_monotone h₁.2 h₂.2 (hA d.result.σ h₁.1) d.result.is_partialDensityOp
    · -- post₁.φ holds but ¬(post₂.φ ∧ QEffect): contradiction
      -- h₁.1 : post₁.φ → h gives post₂.φ, and interpFormula_effect gives QEffect
      exact absurd ⟨h d.result.σ h₁.1, sax.interpFormula_effect d.result.σ post₂.A⟩ h₂
    · -- post₁ doesn't hold, post₂ does: 0 ≤ value
      exact expectationValue_re_nonneg h₂.2 d.result.is_partialDensityOp
    · -- Neither holds: 0 ≤ 0
      exact le_refl _
  · -- summability of post₁ terms (bounded by trace)
    exact postcondExpectDeriv_term_summable sem psem sax post₁ P ω
  · -- summability of post₂ terms (bounded by trace)
    exact postcondExpectDeriv_term_summable sem psem sax post₂ P ω

/-- Postcondition non-negativity. -/

theorem tsum_classAssign_result {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (x : CVar) (e : Exp) (ω : CQState ctx) (f : CQState ctx → ℝ) :
    ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem (QWhilePlus.classAssign x e) ω), f d.result =
    f (ω.classAssign sem x e) := by
  have hsub := terminatingDerivation_classAssign_subsingleton sem x e ω
  let d₀ : TerminatingDerivation sem (QWhilePlus.classAssign x e) ω :=
    ⟨_, .step (.classAssign x e ω) (.refl _), rfl, rfl, ⟨rfl, trivial⟩, ⟨trivial, trivial⟩⟩
  simpa [d₀, terminatingDerivation_classAssign_result sem x e ω d₀] using
    tsum_eq_of_unique d₀ (fun d => hsub.elim d d₀) (fun d => f d.result)

theorem tsum_seq_result {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (P₁ P₂ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx) (f : CQState ctx → ℝ)
    (hf : Summable (fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem (QWhilePlus.seq P₁ P₂) ω => f d.result)) :
    ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem (QWhilePlus.seq P₁ P₂) ω), f d.result =
    ∑' (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P₁ ω),
      ∑' (d₂ : TerminatingDerivation sem P₂ d₁.result), f d₂.result := by
  -- Step 1: Reindex via seq Equiv
  let e := termDerivSeqEquiv sem P₁ P₂ ω
  let g := fun (p : (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P₁ ω) ×
      TerminatingDerivation sem P₂ d₁.result) => f p.2.result
  -- Step 2: hf : Summable (fun d => f d.result) = Summable (g ∘ e), so Summable g
  have hge : (fun d => f d.result) = g ∘ e := rfl
  have hg : Summable g := e.summable_iff.mp (hge ▸ hf)
  -- Step 3: Reindex tsum via Equiv + decompose Sigma
  calc ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem (.seq P₁ P₂) ω), f d.result
      = ∑' p, g p := by rw [show (fun (d : TerminatingDerivation sem (.seq P₁ P₂) ω) =>
          f d.result) = g ∘ e from rfl]; exact e.tsum_eq g
    _ = ∑' (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P₁ ω),
          ∑' (d₂ : TerminatingDerivation sem P₂ d₁.result), f d₂.result :=
        hg.tsum_sigma

    {psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx}

    {qvSub : CVar → Exp → QVar → QVar}

    (F F' : KrausOpSym)
    (hrank1 : pcats.krausRank F' = 1)

    (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)
    (qvarsF' : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F') → QVar)
    (hdistF : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F), i ≠ j → qvarsF i ≠ qvarsF j)
    (hdistF' : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F'), i ≠ j → qvarsF' i ≠ qvarsF' j)
    {S : Finset QVar}
    (preAs : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) → Formula S)
    (hsubF : ∀ i, qvarsF i ∈ S)
    (hsubF' : ∀ i, qvarsF' i ∈ S)
    (preφ : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)
    (postψs : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) → (ClassicalState ctx → Prop))
    (postB : Formula S)
    (P : Prog)
    (hpremises : ∀ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
      ParTriple sem psem ⟨S, preφ, preAs i⟩ P ⟨S, postψs i, postB⟩)
    (hmutex : ∀ (i₁ i₂ : Fin (pcats.krausRank F)),
      i₁ ≠ i₂ → ∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx, ¬(postψs i₁ σ ∧ postψs i₂ σ))

    (hprop : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F))
      (ρ : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all),
      IsPartialDensityOperator ρ →

        (ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F σ params qvarsF i)) ≤
      (psem.krausInterp F' σ params' qvarsF'
        ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).adjoint.comp
        (ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F' σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩))) :
    ParTriple sem psem
      ⟨S, preφ, .kraus F params qvarsF preAs hdistF hsubF⟩
      P
      ⟨S, fun σ => ∃ i, postψs i σ,
       .kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF'⟩ := by
  -- === STEP A: Unfold HoareTripleParDeriv ===
  intro ω hpreφ hQE_kraus
  simp only [interpFormula_kraus] at hQE_kraus ⊢
  -- === STEPS A-C: Kraus Decomposition ===
  rw [expectationValue_kraus_decompose]
  -- === STEP D: Per-branch hypothesis application ===

      (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω.σ (preAs i))
        ((psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
          (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)))).re ≤
      postcondExpectDeriv psem ⟨S, postψs i, postB⟩ sem P
        ⟨ω.σ,
         (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
           (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
         sax.krausInterp_sandwich_pdo F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ +
      nonTermTraceDeriv sem P
        ⟨ω.σ,
         (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
           (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
         sax.krausInterp_sandwich_pdo F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ := by
    intro i
    have hqe_i : IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem ω.σ (preAs i)) :=
      sax.interpFormula_effect ω.σ (preAs i)
    exact (hpremises i)
      ⟨ω.σ,
       (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
         (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
       sax.krausInterp_sandwich_pdo F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩
      hpreφ hqe_i
  -- === STEPS D→E-G: Sum branches and apply Fubini+mutex+prop ===
  calc ∑ i, (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω.σ (preAs i))
          ((psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
            (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)))).re
      ≤ ∑ i, (postcondExpectDeriv psem ⟨S, postψs i, postB⟩ sem P
            ⟨ω.σ,
             (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
               (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
             sax.krausInterp_sandwich_pdo F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ +
           nonTermTraceDeriv sem P
            ⟨ω.σ,
             (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
               (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
             sax.krausInterp_sandwich_pdo F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩) := by
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hbranch i)
    _ ≤ postcondExpectDeriv psem
            ⟨S, fun σ => ∃ i, postψs i σ,
             .kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF'⟩ sem P ω +
          nonTermTraceDeriv sem P ω := by
        exact accum1_fubini_mutex_prop_bound sax F F' hrank1 params params' qvarsF qvarsF'
          hdistF hdistF' postB hsubF hsubF' postψs P ω hmutex hdisjoint hprop

theorem soundness_accum2_par_deriv_proof
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx}
    {psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx}
    {expSub : CVar → Exp → Exp → Exp}
    {qvSub : CVar → Exp → QVar → QVar}
    (sax : SoundnessBase sem psem expSub qvSub)
    (F : KrausOpSym)
    (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
    (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)
    (hdistF : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F), i ≠ j → qvarsF i ≠ qvarsF j)
    {S : Finset QVar}
    (preAs postBs : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) →
      QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S)
    (hsubF : ∀ i, qvarsF i ∈ S)
    (preφ postψ : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)
    (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (hpremises : ∀ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
      HoareTripleParDeriv sem psem ⟨S, preφ, preAs i⟩ P ⟨S, postψ, postBs i⟩)
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint (Finset.image qvarsF Finset.univ) P.quantumVars) :
    HoareTripleParDeriv sem psem
      ⟨S, preφ, .kraus F params qvarsF preAs hdistF hsubF⟩
      P
      ⟨S, postψ, .kraus F params qvarsF postBs hdistF hsubF⟩ := by
  -- === STEP 0: Unfold HoareTripleParDeriv ===
  intro ω hpreφ hQE_kraus
  simp only [interpFormula_kraus] at hQE_kraus ⊢
  -- === STEPS 1-3: Kraus Decomposition ===
  -- E(∑ᵢ Kᵢ Aᵢ Kᵢ†, ρ).re = ∑ᵢ E(Aᵢ, Kᵢ†ρKᵢ).re
  rw [expectationValue_kraus_decompose]
  -- === STEP 4: Per-branch hypothesis application ===
  -- ∀ i: E(Aᵢ, Kᵢ†ρKᵢ) ≤ postcondExpect(Bᵢ, sandwiched) + NT(sandwiched)
  have hbranch : ∀ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
      (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω.σ (preAs i))
        ((psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
          (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)))).re ≤
      postcondExpectDeriv psem ⟨S, postψ, postBs i⟩ sem P
        ⟨ω.σ,
         (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
           (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
         sax.krausInterp_sandwich_pdo F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ +
      nonTermTraceDeriv sem P
        ⟨ω.σ,
         (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
           (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
         sax.krausInterp_sandwich_pdo F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ := by
    intro i
    -- hpremises i gives HoareTripleParDeriv for branch i
    -- We apply it to the sandwiched CQState
    have hqe_i : IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem ω.σ (preAs i)) :=
      sax.interpFormula_effect ω.σ (preAs i)
    exact apply_hpremise_sandwiched sax F params qvarsF (preAs i) (postBs i)
      preφ postψ P i (hpremises i) ω hpreφ hqe_i
  -- === STEP 4→6-8: Sum branches and apply Fubini+reassembly ===
  -- ∑ᵢ E(Aᵢ, Kᵢ†ρKᵢ) ≤ ∑ᵢ (postcondExpect_i + NT_i)
  --                    ≤ postcondExpect(kraus post) + NT(ω)
  calc ∑ i, (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω.σ (preAs i))
          ((psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
            (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)))).re
      ≤ ∑ i, (postcondExpectDeriv psem ⟨S, postψ, postBs i⟩ sem P
            ⟨ω.σ,
             (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
               (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
             sax.krausInterp_sandwich_pdo F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ +
           nonTermTraceDeriv sem P
            ⟨ω.σ,
             (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
               (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
             sax.krausInterp_sandwich_pdo F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩) := by
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hbranch i)
    _ ≤ postcondExpectDeriv psem
            ⟨S, postψ, .kraus F params qvarsF postBs hdistF hsubF⟩ sem P ω +
          nonTermTraceDeriv sem P ω := by
        exact accum2_fubini_reassembly_bound sax F params qvarsF hdistF postBs hsubF
          postψ P ω hdisjoint

/-! ## Master Soundness Inductions

These state soundness using `HoareTripleParDeriv` / `HoareTripleTotDeriv`, which
use `tsum` over derivations and do NOT require `Fintype (TerminatingDerivation ...)`.

**Proof strategy**: For singleton programs (skip, assign, init, unitary) and conditional,
the proofs use tsum structural equations directly — no `finDeriv` needed. These cases
derive `Fintype` structurally from `Subsingleton` or transport along `Equiv`.
For complex rules (seq, measure, loop, consequence, accumulation), the proofs delegate
to the `_deriv` wrapper theorems above, which handle the tsum↔Multiset conversion. -/

/-- **Theorem 1, Part (1): Soundness of QHL+ for Partial Correctness [Ying, Theorem 6.1]**

    If a Hoare triple {phi, A} P {psi, B} is derivable in the proof system QHL+_par
    (using the 12 proof rules: Skip, Assign, Init, Unitary, Measure, Seq, If,
    While, Consequence, Accum1, Accum2, and the structural rules), then the
    triple is valid in the sense of partial correctness:

      |-_par {phi, A} P {psi, B}  implies  |=_par {phi, A} P {psi, B}

    Validity means: for every classical-quantum state (sigma, rho) satisfying
    the precondition (sigma |= phi and sigma(A) is well-defined),

      tr(sigma(A) . rho) <= Sum{|tr(sigma'(B) . rho') | ...  |} + NT(P)(sigma, rho)

    where the sum ranges over output states satisfying the postcondition, and
    NT(P)(sigma, rho) is the non-termination probability.

    The proof proceeds by induction on the derivation, verifying that each axiom
    is valid and each rule preserves validity. Key ingredients include:
    Proposition 6 (structural semantics), Proposition 7 (trace non-increase),
    Lemma 5 (substitution), and Proposition 5 (expectation monotonicity). -/

noncomputable def whileTrueDecomposeEquiv
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (b : BExp) (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx) (hb : sem.boolEval ω.σ b) :
    TerminatingDerivation sem (.whileDo b P) ω ≃
    (Σ (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω),
       TerminatingDerivation sem (.whileDo b P) d₁.result) where
  toFun := whileTrueDecompose_fwd sem b P ω hb
  invFun p :=
    prependWhileTrue sem b P ω hb (joinSeqDeriv sem P (.whileDo b P) ω p.1 p.2)
  left_inv d := by
    -- prependWhileTrue(joinSeqDeriv(splitSeqDeriv(stripWhileTrue(d)))) = d
    -- Factor: joinSeqDeriv ∘ splitSeqDeriv = id (termDerivSeqEquiv.left_inv),
    --         then prependWhileTrue ∘ stripWhileTrue = id (termDerivWhileTrueEquiv.right_inv).
    show prependWhileTrue sem b P ω hb
      (joinSeqDeriv sem P (.whileDo b P) ω
        (splitSeqDeriv sem P (.whileDo b P) ω (stripWhileTrue sem b P ω hb d)).1
        (splitSeqDeriv sem P (.whileDo b P) ω (stripWhileTrue sem b P ω hb d)).2) = d
    have hseq := (termDerivSeqEquiv sem P (.whileDo b P) ω).left_inv
      (stripWhileTrue sem b P ω hb d)
    -- hseq : joinSeqDeriv(splitSeqDeriv(stripWhileTrue(d))) = stripWhileTrue(d)
    conv at hseq => lhs; simp only [termDerivSeqEquiv]
    rw [hseq]
    exact (termDerivWhileTrueEquiv sem b P ω hb).right_inv d
  right_inv p := by
    -- splitSeqDeriv(stripWhileTrue(prependWhileTrue(joinSeqDeriv(d₁,d₂)))) = (d₁,d₂)
    -- Factor: stripWhileTrue ∘ prependWhileTrue = id (termDerivWhileTrueEquiv.left_inv),
    --         then splitSeqDeriv ∘ joinSeqDeriv = id (termDerivSeqEquiv.right_inv).
    obtain ⟨d₁, d₂⟩ := p
    show whileTrueDecompose_fwd sem b P ω hb
      (prependWhileTrue sem b P ω hb (joinSeqDeriv sem P (.whileDo b P) ω d₁ d₂)) = ⟨d₁, d₂⟩
    unfold whileTrueDecompose_fwd
    have hwhile := (termDerivWhileTrueEquiv sem b P ω hb).left_inv
      (joinSeqDeriv sem P (.whileDo b P) ω d₁ d₂)
    conv at hwhile => lhs; simp only [termDerivWhileTrueEquiv]
    simp only [hwhile]
    exact (termDerivSeqEquiv sem P (.whileDo b P) ω).right_inv ⟨d₁, d₂⟩

theorem denotationalSem_seq {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (P₁ P₂ : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx)
    [Fintype (TerminatingDerivation sem (QWhilePlus.seq P₁ P₂) ω)]
    [Fintype (TerminatingDerivation sem P₁ ω)]
    [∀ ω', Fintype (TerminatingDerivation sem P₂ ω')] :
    denotationalSem sem (QWhilePlus.seq P₁ P₂) ω =
    (denotationalSem sem P₁ ω).bind (fun ω' => denotationalSem sem P₂ ω') := by
  -- Paper: Proposition 3.1 Case 6 — ⟦P₁;P₂⟧(ω) = ⟦P₂⟧(⟦P₁⟧(ω))
  -- Step 1: Reindex LHS via termDerivSeqEquiv using multiset_map_univ_equiv.
  -- Step 2: Show the Sigma-indexed multiset equals the bind decomposition.
  let e := termDerivSeqEquiv sem P₁ P₂ ω
  simp only [denotationalSem]
  -- Step 1: Reindex LHS from TermDeriv(P₁;P₂, ω) to PSigma type via termDerivSeqEquiv
  have hreindex := multiset_map_univ_equiv' e
    TerminatingDerivation.result
    (fun (p : (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P₁ ω) × TerminatingDerivation sem P₂ d₁.result) =>
      p.2.result)
    (fun _ => rfl)
  rw [hreindex]
  -- Step 2: Move outer map on RHS inside the bind
  rw [Multiset.bind_map]
  -- Goal: map (fun p => p.snd.result) Finset.univ.val (Sigma type)
  --     = Finset.univ.val.bind (fun d₁ => map result Finset.univ.val)
  -- (d₁ : α) × β d₁ is Sigma in Lean 4. Sigma.instFintype gives
  -- Finset.univ = Finset.univ.sigma (fun _ => Finset.univ) by rfl.
  -- Finset.sigma.val = Multiset.sigma = s.bind (fun a => (t a).map (Sigma.mk a)).
  -- Push map through bind, compose with Sigma.mk, get result.
  show ((Finset.univ.sigma fun (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P₁ ω) => (Finset.univ :
    Finset (TerminatingDerivation sem P₂ d₁.result))).val.map
    (fun (p : (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P₁ ω) × TerminatingDerivation sem P₂ d₁.result) =>
      p.2.result)) =
    (Finset.univ : Finset (TerminatingDerivation sem P₁ ω)).val.bind
      (fun (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P₁ ω) =>
        (Finset.univ : Finset (TerminatingDerivation sem P₂ d₁.result)).val.map
          TerminatingDerivation.result)
  simp only [Finset.sigma, Multiset.sigma, Multiset.map_bind, Multiset.map_map, Function.comp]

theorem tsum_while_true_decompose
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    {expSub : CVar → Exp → Exp → Exp} {qvSub : CVar → Exp → QVar → QVar}
    (sax : SoundnessBase sem psem expSub qvSub)
    (b : BExp) (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx) (hb : sem.boolEval ω.σ b) (f : CQState ctx → ℝ)
    (hf_summ : Summable (fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem (.whileDo b P) ω => f d.result)) :
    ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem (QWhilePlus.whileDo b P) ω), f d.result =
    ∑' (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω),
      ∑' (d₂ : TerminatingDerivation sem (QWhilePlus.whileDo b P) d₁.result),
        f d₂.result := by
  let e₁ := termDerivWhileTrueEquiv sem b P ω hb
  have step1 : ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem (.whileDo b P) ω), f d.result =
      ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem (.seq P (.whileDo b P)) ω), f d.result :=
    (e₁.tsum_eq (fun d => f d.result)).symm
  rw [step1]
  have hf_seq : Summable (fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem (.seq P (.whileDo b P)) ω =>
      f d.result) :=
    e₁.summable_iff.mpr hf_summ
  exact tsum_seq_result sem P (.whileDo b P) ω f hf_seq

/-- Postcondition summability. -/

    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (b : BExp) (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)

    (whileTrueDecomposeEquiv sem b P ω hb d).2.pathLength < d.pathLength := by
  -- The forward map is splitSeqDeriv(stripWhileTrue(d)).
  -- We chain: .2.pathLength < (stripWhileTrue d).pathLength < d.pathLength

  unfold whileTrueDecompose_fwd
  -- Chain the two strict inequalities
  have h1 := splitSeqDeriv_snd_pathLength_lt sem P (.whileDo b P) ω (stripWhileTrue sem b P ω hb d)
  have h2 : (stripWhileTrue sem b P ω hb d).pathLength < d.pathLength := by
    obtain ⟨result, path, hstart, hend, hwf, hdwf⟩ := d
    cases path with
    | refl c =>

      subst hs

      omega
  exact lt_trans h1 h2

theorem whileTrueDecomposeEquiv_result
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (b : BExp) (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx) (hb : sem.boolEval ω.σ b)
    (d : TerminatingDerivation sem (.whileDo b P) ω) :
    (whileTrueDecomposeEquiv sem b P ω hb d).2.result = d.result := by
  -- The Equiv's toFun = whileTrueDecompose_fwd = splitSeqDeriv(stripWhileTrue(d))
  -- We prove: (1) stripWhileTrue preserves .result, (2) splitSeqDeriv stores input's .result as .2.result
  show (whileTrueDecompose_fwd sem b P ω hb d).2.result = d.result
  unfold whileTrueDecompose_fwd
  -- Now goal is about splitSeqDeriv(stripWhileTrue d)
  -- splitSeqDeriv always stores its input's .result as .2.result (by construction: ⟨d.result, p₂, ...⟩)
  -- So it suffices to show (stripWhileTrue d).result = d.result
  -- We prove both by replaying stripWhileTrue's case analysis
  have hstrip_result : (stripWhileTrue sem b P ω hb d).result = d.result := by
    obtain ⟨result, path, hstart, hend, hwf, hdwf⟩ := d
    cases path with
    | refl c =>
      exfalso
      have h1 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hstart
      have h2 := congr_arg Configuration.prog hend
      simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, DerivationPath.endConfig,
        Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.terminal, Configuration.prog] at h1 h2
      rw [h1] at h2; exact absurd h2 nofun
    | step s rest =>
      -- The result is `result` after stripping, but hidden behind Eq.rec from subst.
      -- We replay the subst to eliminate the Eq.rec.
      have hsc₁ : s.c₁ = Configuration.ofProgram (.whileDo b P) ω := by
        simpa [DerivationPath.startConfig] using hstart
      have hs := opStep_whileTrue_eq sem b P ω hb s hsc₁
      subst hs
      simp only [stripWhileTrue, TerminatingDerivation.result]
  -- splitSeqDeriv stores d_seq.result as .2.result
  have hsplit_result : ∀ (d_seq : TerminatingDerivation sem (.seq P (.whileDo b P)) ω),
      (splitSeqDeriv sem P (.whileDo b P) ω d_seq).2.result = d_seq.result := by
    intro d_seq; simp only [splitSeqDeriv, TerminatingDerivation.result]
  rw [hsplit_result, hstrip_result]

theorem disjointCommDeriv_tsum_reindex {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (hyp : DisjointCommHypotheses sem)
    (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω ω_K : CQState ctx)
    (hσ : ω_K.σ = ω.σ)
    (K : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all)
    (qvarsK : Finset QVar)
    (hρ : ω_K.ρ = K.adjoint.comp (ω.ρ.comp K))
    (hDisj : Disjoint qvarsK P.quantumVars)
    (f : ClassicalState ctx → (ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all) → ℝ) :
    ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω_K), f d.result.σ d.result.ρ =
    ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω),
      f d.result.σ (K.adjoint.comp (d.result.ρ.comp K)) := by
  -- Step 1: Reindex via replay equivalence
  rw [show (∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω_K), f d.result.σ d.result.ρ) =
    ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω),
      f ((replay_equiv sem P ω ω_K hσ d).result.σ)
        ((replay_equiv sem P ω ω_K hσ d).result.ρ)
    from ((replay_equiv sem P ω ω_K hσ).tsum_eq
      (fun d => f d.result.σ d.result.ρ)).symm]
  -- Step 2: Show summands are equal pointwise
  congr 1; ext d
  -- replay_equiv maps d ↦ termDeriv_replay sem P d ω_K hσ
  show f (termDeriv_replay sem P d ω_K hσ).result.σ
         (termDeriv_replay sem P d ω_K hσ).result.ρ =
       f d.result.σ (K.adjoint.comp (d.result.ρ.comp K))
  -- σ preservation
  have hσ_eq : (termDeriv_replay sem P d ω_K hσ).result.σ = d.result.σ :=
    termDeriv_replay_σ sem P d ω_K hσ
  -- K-sandwich for ρ (requires path-level disjointness)
  have hDisj_path : d.path.allDisjointFrom qvarsK :=
    allDisjointFrom_of_wf_quantumVars d.path P ω d.path_start d.path_wf
      d.path_deep_wf qvarsK hDisj
  have hρ_eq : (termDeriv_replay sem P d ω_K hσ).result.ρ =
      K.adjoint.comp (d.result.ρ.comp K) :=
    termDeriv_replay_result_rho sem hyp P d ω_K hσ K qvarsK hρ hDisj_path
  rw [hσ_eq, hρ_eq]

private theorem traceNonIncrease_while_bounded {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (b : BExp) (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    [hfin : ∀ (Q : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) (ω' : CQState ctx),
      Fintype (TerminatingDerivation sem Q ω')]
    (ih_body : ∀ ω' : CQState ctx, traceSumRe (denotationalSem sem P ω') ≤ ω'.traceRe)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ ω : CQState ctx,
    (∀ d : TerminatingDerivation sem (.whileDo b P) ω, d.pathLength ≤ n) →
    traceSumRe (denotationalSem sem (.whileDo b P) ω) ≤ ω.traceRe := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih_n =>
    intro ω hbound
    by_cases hb : sem.boolEval ω.σ b
    · -- b = true: decompose while -> P; while
      rw [denotationalSem_while_true_eq_seq sem b P ω hb,
          denotationalSem_seq sem P (.whileDo b P) ω,
          traceSumRe_bind]
      calc ((denotationalSem sem P ω).map
              (fun ω' => traceSumRe (denotationalSem sem (.whileDo b P) ω'))).sum
          ≤ ((denotationalSem sem P ω).map (fun ω' => ω'.traceRe)).sum := by
            apply Multiset.sum_map_le_sum_map _ _ _
            intro ω' _hω'
            have ⟨d₁_w, hd₁_res⟩ : ∃ d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω,
                d₁.result = ω' := (mem_denotationalSem sem P ω ω').mp _hω'
            have hbound' : ∀ d₂ : TerminatingDerivation sem (.whileDo b P) ω',
                d₂.pathLength ≤ n - 1 := by

theorem tsum_while_unfold_result {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (b : BExp) (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx) (f : CQState ctx → ℝ) :
    ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem (QWhilePlus.whileDo b P) ω), f d.result =
    ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem
      (QWhilePlus.ifThenElse b (QWhilePlus.seq P (QWhilePlus.whileDo b P)) QWhilePlus.skip) ω),
      f d.result := by
  by_cases hb : sem.boolEval ω.σ b
  · -- b=true: while ≃ P;while ≃ if(b, P;while, skip)
    -- Both while and if derivations pass through P;while, so the tsums match.
    -- Both Equivs go P;while ≃ while and P;while ≃ if, preserving .result
    -- e₁ : P;while ≃ while, e₂ : P;while ≃ if
    -- e₁.tsum_eq: ∑'(P;while) f(e₁ d).result = ∑'(while) f d.result
    -- e₂.tsum_eq: ∑'(P;while) f(e₂ d).result = ∑'(if) f d.result
    -- Since (eᵢ d).result = d.result (prepend preserves result), both LHS = ∑'(P;while) f d.result
    -- So ∑'(while) = ∑'(P;while) = ∑'(if)
    let e₁ := termDerivWhileTrueEquiv sem b P ω hb
    let e₂ := termDerivIfTrueEquiv sem b (.seq P (.whileDo b P)) .skip ω hb
    exact (e₁.tsum_eq (fun d => f d.result)).symm.trans
      (e₂.tsum_eq (fun d => f d.result))
  · -- b=false: both while and if have single derivations with result ω
    -- While tsum = f(ω) by tsum_whileFalse_result
    -- If tsum: ifFalse → skip → f(ω) by tsum_ifFalse + tsum_skip
    rw [tsum_whileFalse_result sem b P ω hb f]
    -- RHS: ∑' (d : TermDeriv(if b then P;while else skip, ω)), f d.result
    -- termDerivIfFalseEquiv: TermDeriv(skip, ω) ≃ TermDeriv(if, ω)
    -- .tsum_eq: ∑'(skip), f(e d).result = ∑'(if), f d.result
    -- Since (e d).result = d.result (prepend preserves result):
    -- ∑'(skip), f d.result = ∑'(if), f d.result
    -- And ∑'(skip), f d.result = f ω (tsum_skip_result)
    -- So ∑'(if), f d.result = f ω
    symm
    exact (termDerivIfFalseEquiv sem b (.seq P (.whileDo b P)) .skip ω hb).tsum_eq
      (fun d => f d.result) |>.symm |>.trans (tsum_skip_result sem ω f)
