theorem soundness_loop_tot_deriv
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    {expSub : CVar → Exp → Exp → Exp} {qvSub : CVar → Exp → QVar → QVar}
    (sax : SoundnessBase sem psem expSub qvSub)
    (b : BExp) (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (inv : CQAssert CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    (hbody : HoareTripleTotDeriv sem psem
      ⟨inv.S, fun σ => inv.φ σ ∧ sem.boolEval σ b, inv.A⟩ P inv)
    -- Variant conditions
    (z : CVar) (t : Exp)
    (tEqZ tLtZ tGeZero : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)
    (hvariant : HoareTripleTotDeriv sem psem
      ⟨inv.S, fun σ => inv.φ σ ∧ sem.boolEval σ b ∧ tEqZ σ, inv.A⟩ P
      ⟨inv.S, fun σ => tLtZ σ, inv.A⟩)
    (hbound : ∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx, inv.φ σ → tGeZero σ)
    (variant_rank : ClassicalState ctx → ℕ)
    (hrank_decrease : ∀ (σ σ' : ClassicalState ctx),
      inv.φ σ → sem.boolEval σ b → tLtZ σ' → inv.φ σ' →
      variant_rank σ' < variant_rank σ)
    -- Variant decrease: each body execution from an invariant-satisfying state
    -- strictly decreases the variant rank. Mathematically follows from z-freshness
    -- + hvariant + hrank_decrease, but the extraction of pointwise tLtZ from the
    -- tsum-based Hoare triple requires QIT infrastructure not yet formalized.
    (variant_decrease : ∀ (ω' : CQState ctx),
      inv.φ ω'.σ → sem.boolEval ω'.σ b →
      IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem ω'.σ inv.A) →
      ∀ d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω',
      inv.φ d₁.result.σ → variant_rank d₁.result.σ < variant_rank ω'.σ) :
    HoareTripleTotDeriv sem psem
      inv (.whileDo b P) (conjNegBExpCQAssertion sem inv b) := by
  -- Paper: Appendix A.2, Rule-Loop-tot.
  -- Total correctness = partial correctness + termination.
  -- Strategy: well-founded induction on variant_rank(ω.σ).
  -- Prove E ≤ postcondExpect directly (not via NT = 0).
  set W := QWhilePlus.whileDo b P with hW_def
  set post := conjNegBExpCQAssertion sem inv b with hpost_def
  -- Main proof by well-founded induction on variant_rank(ω.σ)
  suffices hind : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : CQState ctx),
      variant_rank ω.σ = n → inv.φ ω.σ →
      IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem ω.σ inv.A) →
      (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω.σ inv.A) ω.ρ).re ≤
        postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W ω by
    intro ω hφ hQE
    exact hind (variant_rank ω.σ) ω rfl hφ hQE
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | ind n ih =>
  intro ω hn hφ hQE
  by_cases hb : sem.boolEval ω.σ b
  · -- Inductive step: b holds at ω
    -- Decompose postcondExpect via tsum_while_true_decompose
    have hpc_decomp : postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W ω =
        ∑' (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω),
          postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W d₁.result := by
      unfold postcondExpectDeriv
      let f : CQState ctx → ℝ := fun ω' =>
        if post.φ ω'.σ ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem ω'.σ post.A)
        then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω'.σ post.A) ω'.ρ).re else 0
      show ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem W ω), f d.result =
        ∑' (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω),
          ∑' (d₂ : TerminatingDerivation sem W d₁.result), f d₂.result
      exact tsum_while_true_decompose sem psem sax b P ω hb f
        (postcondExpectDeriv_ite_summable sem psem sax post W ω)
    -- From hbody: E(A, ω.ρ) ≤ postcondExpectDeriv(inv, P, ω)
    have hbody_app := hbody ω ⟨hφ, hb⟩ hQE
    -- Suffices: postcondExpect(inv, P, ω) ≤ postcondExpect(post, W, ω)
    suffices hsuff : postcondExpectDeriv psem inv sem P ω ≤
        postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W ω by linarith
    rw [hpc_decomp]
    -- Pointwise bound: each d₁'s contribution ≤ postcondExpect(post, W, d₁.result)
    unfold postcondExpectDeriv
    apply Summable.tsum_le_tsum
    · intro d₁
      by_cases hcond : inv.φ d₁.result.σ ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem d₁.result.σ inv.A)
      · rw [if_pos hcond]
        -- Apply IH: variant_rank(d₁.result.σ) < n
        have hrank_lt : variant_rank d₁.result.σ < n := by
          rw [← hn]
          exact variant_decrease ω hφ hb hQE d₁ hcond.1
        exact ih (variant_rank d₁.result.σ) hrank_lt d₁.result rfl hcond.1 hcond.2
      · rw [if_neg hcond]
        exact postcondExpectDeriv_nonneg sem psem sax post W d₁.result
    · exact postcondExpectDeriv_ite_summable sem psem sax inv P ω
    · exact postcondExpectDeriv_comp_summable sax post P W ω
  · -- Base case: ¬b, loop terminates immediately
    have hpc : postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W ω =
        (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω.σ inv.A) ω.ρ).re := by
      unfold postcondExpectDeriv
      simp only [hpost_def]
      rw [tsum_whileFalse_result sem b P ω hb (fun ω' =>
        if (conjNegBExpCQAssertion sem inv b).φ ω'.σ ∧
          IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem ω'.σ (conjNegBExpCQAssertion sem inv b).A)
        then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω'.σ (conjNegBExpCQAssertion sem inv b).A) ω'.ρ).re
        else 0)]
      simp only [conjNegBExpCQAssertion, conjNegBExpFormula]
      rw [if_pos ⟨⟨hφ, hb⟩, hQE⟩]
    rw [hpc]

theorem trRem_reindex_bound
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx}
    (b : BExp) (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx) (hb : sem.boolEval ω.σ b)
    (n : ℕ)
    (hsumm_W : ∀ ω₀ : CQState ctx,
      Summable (fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem (.whileDo b P) ω₀ => d.result.traceRe))
    (hsumm_P : Summable (fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω => d.result.traceRe))
    (hsum_trRem : Summable (fun d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω =>
        ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem (.whileDo b P) d₁.result),
          if (n - 1) < d.pathLength then d.result.traceRe else 0)) :
    (∑' d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω,
      ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem (.whileDo b P) d₁.result),
        if (n - 1) < d.pathLength then d.result.traceRe else 0) ≤
    ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem (.whileDo b P) ω),
      if n < d.pathLength then d.result.traceRe else 0 := by
  set W := QWhilePlus.whileDo b P
  -- The Equiv: WhileDeriv(ω) ≃ Σ d₁:BodyDeriv(ω), WhileDeriv(d₁.result)
  let e := whileTrueDecomposeEquiv sem b P ω hb
  -- Key properties
  have hplen_all : ∀ (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω)
      (d₂ : TerminatingDerivation sem W d₁.result),
      d₂.pathLength < (e.symm ⟨d₁, d₂⟩).pathLength := by
    intro d₁ d₂
    have h1 := while_decompose_pathLen_lt sem b P ω hb (e.symm ⟨d₁, d₂⟩)
    change (e (e.symm ⟨d₁, d₂⟩)).snd.pathLength < (e.symm ⟨d₁, d₂⟩).pathLength at h1
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at h1; exact h1
  have hres_all : ∀ (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω)
      (d₂ : TerminatingDerivation sem W d₁.result),
      (e.symm ⟨d₁, d₂⟩).result = d₂.result := by
    intro d₁ d₂
    have h1 := whileTrueDecomposeEquiv_result sem b P ω hb (e.symm ⟨d₁, d₂⟩)
    change (e (e.symm ⟨d₁, d₂⟩)).snd.result = (e.symm ⟨d₁, d₂⟩).result at h1
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at h1; exact h1.symm
  -- Summability via Equiv
  have hhe_tr_summ : Summable ((fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem W ω =>
      d.result.traceRe) ∘ e.symm) :=
    (Equiv.summable_iff e.symm).mpr (hsumm_W ω)
  have hhe_summ : Summable (fun dd : (Σ d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω,
      TerminatingDerivation sem W d₁.result) =>
      if n < (e.symm dd).pathLength then (e.symm dd).result.traceRe else (0 : ℝ)) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
      (fun dd => by split <;> [exact (e.symm dd).result.traceRe_nonneg; exact le_refl 0])
      (fun dd => by split <;> [exact le_refl _; exact (e.symm dd).result.traceRe_nonneg])
      hhe_tr_summ
  -- Chain: ∑' d, g(d) = ∑' d₁ d₂, g(e.symm ⟨d₁, d₂⟩)
  have hchain : (∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem W ω),
      if n < d.pathLength then d.result.traceRe else 0) =
      ∑' (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω)
        (d₂ : TerminatingDerivation sem W d₁.result),
        if n < (e.symm ⟨d₁, d₂⟩).pathLength then (e.symm ⟨d₁, d₂⟩).result.traceRe else 0 :=
    (Equiv.tsum_eq e.symm
      (f := fun d => if n < d.pathLength then d.result.traceRe else 0)).symm.trans
      (Summable.tsum_sigma hhe_summ)
  rw [hchain]
  -- Pointwise bound
  apply Summable.tsum_le_tsum
  · intro d₁
    apply Summable.tsum_le_tsum
    · intro d₂
      by_cases hd : n - 1 < d₂.pathLength
      · have hn_lt : n < (e.symm ⟨d₁, d₂⟩).pathLength := by
          have := hplen_all d₁ d₂; omega
        rw [if_pos hd, if_pos hn_lt, hres_all d₁ d₂]
      · rw [if_neg hd]

        · exact le_refl 0
    · exact Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
        (fun d₂ => by split <;> [exact d₂.result.traceRe_nonneg; exact le_refl 0])

    · exact Summable.sigma_factor hhe_summ d₁
  · exact hsum_trRem
  · exact Summable.sigma hhe_summ

      ⟨ω.σ, K.adjoint.comp (ω.ρ.comp K), hpdo⟩ =
    ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω),
      if ψ d.result.σ ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem d.result.σ B)
      then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem d.result.σ B)
              (K.adjoint.comp (d.result.ρ.comp K))).re
      else 0 := by
  unfold postcondExpectDeriv
  exact disjointCommDeriv_tsum_reindex sem hyp P ω
    ⟨ω.σ, K.adjoint.comp (ω.ρ.comp K), hpdo⟩ rfl K qvarsK rfl hDisj
    (fun σ' ρ' =>
      if ψ σ' ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem σ' B)
      then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem σ' B) ρ').re
      else 0)

/-! ## Step 2: Trace cyclicity for conditional expectation value -/

/-- Trace cyclicity for a conditional expectation value summand:
    when IsQE holds, E(B, K†ρ'K).re = E(K∘B∘K†, ρ').re.
    The IsQuantumEffect condition is simplified when it is always true. -/
private theorem if_expectation_kraus_cycle
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    {S : Finset QVar}
    (B : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S)
    (σ' : ClassicalState ctx)
    (ρ' : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all)
    (K : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all)
    (ψ : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)
    (heff : IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem σ' B)) :
    (if ψ σ' ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem σ' B)
     then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem σ' B)
             (K.adjoint.comp (ρ'.comp K))).re
     else 0) =
    (if ψ σ'
     then (expectationValue
             (K.comp ((interpFormula psem σ' B).comp K.adjoint)) ρ').re
     else 0) := by
  simp only [heff, and_true]
  split_ifs with h
  · exact (expectationValue_kraus_cycle K (interpFormula psem σ' B) ρ').symm
  · rfl

/-! ## Main theorem -/

/-- **Disjoint Kraus Postcondition Commutativity [Ying, Accumulation Rules]**

    When the quantum variables of a Kraus operator family F are disjoint from the
    quantum variables of program P (i.e., qv(F) ∩ qv(P) = empty), the Kraus
    operators commute with program execution for the purpose of postcondition
    expectation computation:

      sum_i postcondExpect(B_i, P, K_i^dagger . rho . K_i)
        <= postcondExpect(sum_j K_j . B_j . K_j^dagger, P, rho)

    This is the key technical lemma underlying the Accumulation Rules (Accum1, Accum2)
    of QHL+, which allow reasoning about quantum programs that apply Kraus operators
    on registers disjoint from the program's quantum variables.

    The proof uses:
    (1) Replay reindexing: derivations from K-sandwiched states biject with
        derivations from the original state.
    (2) Trace cyclicity: E(B, K^dagger . rho' . K) = E(K . B . K^dagger, rho').
    (3) Fubini interchange: finite Kraus sums commute with derivation tsums.
    (4) Kraus decomposition: sum_i E(K_i . B_i . K_i^dagger, rho') =
        E(sum_j K_j . B_j . K_j^dagger, rho'). -/

theorem soundness_loop_tot_deriv_of_positive_witness_boundary
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    {expSub : CVar → Exp → Exp → Exp} {qvSub : CVar → Exp → QVar → QVar}
    (sax : SoundnessBase sem psem expSub qvSub)
    (b : BExp) (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (inv : CQAssert CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    (hbody : HoareTripleTotDeriv sem psem
      ⟨inv.S, fun σ => inv.φ σ ∧ sem.boolEval σ b, inv.A⟩ P inv)
    (z : CVar) (t : Exp)
    (tEqZ tLtZ tGeZero : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)
    (hvariant : HoareTripleTotDeriv sem psem
      ⟨inv.S, fun σ => inv.φ σ ∧ sem.boolEval σ b ∧ tEqZ σ, inv.A⟩ P
      ⟨inv.S, fun σ => tLtZ σ, inv.A⟩)
    (hbound : ∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx, inv.φ σ → tGeZero σ)
    (variant_rank : ClassicalState ctx → ℕ)
    (hrank_decrease : ∀ (σ σ' : ClassicalState ctx),
      inv.φ σ → sem.boolEval σ b → tLtZ σ' → inv.φ σ' →
      variant_rank σ' < variant_rank σ)
    (variant_decrease_pos : LoopTotPositiveWitnessRankBoundary sem psem b P inv variant_rank) :
    HoareTripleTotDeriv sem psem
      inv (.whileDo b P) (conjNegBExpCQAssertion sem inv b) := by
  set W := QWhilePlus.whileDo b P with hW_def
  set post := conjNegBExpCQAssertion sem inv b with hpost_def
  suffices hind : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : CQState ctx),
      variant_rank ω.σ = n → inv.φ ω.σ →
      IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem ω.σ inv.A) →
      (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω.σ inv.A) ω.ρ).re ≤
        postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W ω by
    intro ω hφ hQE
    exact hind (variant_rank ω.σ) ω rfl hφ hQE
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | ind n ih =>
    intro ω hn hφ hQE
    by_cases hb : sem.boolEval ω.σ b
    · have hpc_decomp : postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W ω =
          ∑' (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω),
            postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W d₁.result := by
        unfold postcondExpectDeriv
        let f : CQState ctx → ℝ := fun ω' =>
          if post.φ ω'.σ ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem ω'.σ post.A)
          then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω'.σ post.A) ω'.ρ).re else 0
        show ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem W ω), f d.result =
          ∑' (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω),
            ∑' (d₂ : TerminatingDerivation sem W d₁.result), f d₂.result
        exact tsum_while_true_decompose sem psem sax b P ω hb f
          (postcondExpectDeriv_ite_summable sem psem sax post W ω)
      have hbody_app := hbody ω ⟨hφ, hb⟩ hQE
      suffices hsuff : postcondExpectDeriv psem inv sem P ω ≤
          postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W ω by
        linarith
      rw [hpc_decomp]
      unfold postcondExpectDeriv
      apply Summable.tsum_le_tsum
      · intro d₁
        by_cases hcond : inv.φ d₁.result.σ ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem d₁.result.σ inv.A)
        · rw [if_pos hcond]
          by_cases hmass :
              0 <
                (expectationValue (interpFormula psem d₁.result.σ inv.A) d₁.result.ρ).re
          · have hrank_lt : variant_rank d₁.result.σ < n := by
              rw [← hn]
              exact variant_decrease_pos ω hφ hb hQE d₁ hcond.1 hmass
            exact ih (variant_rank d₁.result.σ) hrank_lt d₁.result rfl hcond.1 hcond.2
          · have hnonneg :
                0 ≤
                  (expectationValue (interpFormula psem d₁.result.σ inv.A) d₁.result.ρ).re :=
              expectationValue_re_nonneg hcond.2 d₁.result.is_partialDensityOp
            have hzero :
                (expectationValue (interpFormula psem d₁.result.σ inv.A) d₁.result.ρ).re = 0 := by
              exact le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hmass) hnonneg
            rw [hzero]
            exact postcondExpectDeriv_nonneg sem psem sax post W d₁.result
        · rw [if_neg hcond]
          exact postcondExpectDeriv_nonneg sem psem sax post W d₁.result
      · exact postcondExpectDeriv_ite_summable sem psem sax inv P ω
      · exact postcondExpectDeriv_comp_summable sax post P W ω
    · have hpc : postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W ω =
          (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω.σ inv.A) ω.ρ).re := by
        unfold postcondExpectDeriv
        simp only [hpost_def]
        rw [tsum_whileFalse_result sem b P ω hb (fun ω' =>
          if (conjNegBExpCQAssertion sem inv b).φ ω'.σ ∧
            IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem ω'.σ (conjNegBExpCQAssertion sem inv b).A)
          then (expectationValue
              (interpFormula psem ω'.σ (conjNegBExpCQAssertion sem inv b).A) ω'.ρ).re
          else 0)]
        simp only [conjNegBExpCQAssertion, conjNegBExpFormula]
        rw [if_pos ⟨⟨hφ, hb⟩, hQE⟩]
      rw [hpc]

/--
`tLtZ`-flavored wrapper around the weaker positive-witness boundary.
-/

theorem traceNonIncrease_while {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (b : BExp) (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    [hfin : ∀ (Q : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) (ω' : CQState ctx),
      Fintype (TerminatingDerivation sem Q ω')]
    (ih_body : ∀ ω' : CQState ctx, traceSumRe (denotationalSem sem P ω') ≤ ω'.traceRe)
    (ω : CQState ctx) :
    traceSumRe (denotationalSem sem (.whileDo b P) ω) ≤ ω.traceRe := by
  let bound := Finset.sup (Finset.univ : Finset (TerminatingDerivation sem (.whileDo b P) ω))
    (fun d => d.pathLength)
  exact traceNonIncrease_while_bounded sem b P ih_body bound ω
    (fun d => Finset.le_sup (f := fun d => d.pathLength) (Finset.mem_univ d))

/-! ## Main Theorem -/

/-- **Proposition 7 (Trace Non-Increase) [Ying, Proposition 3.2]**

    For any quantum program P and any input state (sigma, rho), the sum of
    traces over all output states is bounded by the input trace:

      Sum{|tr(rho') | (sigma', rho') in [[P]](sigma, rho)|} <= tr(rho)

    This inequality captures the physical principle that quantum operations
    (including measurement and initialization) cannot increase the total
    probability. In the special case where equality holds, the program P
    terminates almost surely from input (sigma, rho).

    The non-termination probability is defined as:
      NT(P)(sigma, rho) = tr(rho) - Sum{|tr(rho') | ...|}  >= 0

    This result is proved by structural induction on P, using Proposition 6
    to decompose the denotational semantics of each program construct. -/

theorem soundness_loop_par_deriv_theorem
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    {expSub : CVar → Exp → Exp → Exp} {qvSub : CVar → Exp → QVar → QVar}
    (sax : SoundnessBase sem psem expSub qvSub)
    (b : BExp)
    (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (inv : CQAssert CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
    (hbody : HoareTripleParDeriv sem psem
      ⟨inv.S, fun σ => inv.φ σ ∧ sem.boolEval σ b, inv.A⟩
      P inv) :
    HoareTripleParDeriv sem psem inv (QWhilePlus.whileDo b P)
      ⟨inv.S, fun σ => inv.φ σ ∧ ¬sem.boolEval σ b, inv.A⟩ := by
  -- Paper: Appendix A.2, Rule-Loop-par
  intro ω hφ hEffect
  by_cases hb : sem.boolEval ω.σ b
  · -- Case b = true: strong induction on pathLength with trace remainder bound.
    set W := QWhilePlus.whileDo b P with hW_def
    set post := (⟨inv.S, fun σ => inv.φ σ ∧ ¬sem.boolEval σ b, inv.A⟩ :
      CQAssert CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx) with hpost_def
    -- Part A: Inductive bound
    -- ∀ n ω', E(inv.A, ω'.ρ) ≤ pcW(ω') + NT_W(ω') + trRem(n, ω')
    have hbound : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ω' : CQState ctx), inv.φ ω'.σ →
        IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem ω'.σ inv.A) →
        (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω'.σ inv.A) ω'.ρ).re ≤
          postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W ω' +
          nonTermTraceDeriv sem W ω' +
          ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem W ω'),
            if n < d.pathLength then d.result.traceRe else 0 := by
      intro n
      induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | _ n ih =>
        intro ω' hφ' hQE'
        -- Base bound: E ≤ ω'.traceRe
        have hE_le_tr : (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω'.σ inv.A) ω'.ρ).re ≤
            ω'.traceRe :=
          expectationValue_re_le_trace_re hQE' ω'.is_partialDensityOp
        -- pcW ≥ 0
        have hpcW_nonneg : 0 ≤ postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W ω' :=
          postcondExpectDeriv_nonneg sem psem sax post W ω'
        -- NT_W ≥ 0
        have hntW_nonneg : 0 ≤ nonTermTraceDeriv sem W ω' := by
          unfold nonTermTraceDeriv; linarith [sax.traceNonIncreaseDeriv W ω']
        by_cases hb' : sem.boolEval ω'.σ b
        · -- b=true at ω': the main inductive case
          have hbody_app := hbody ω' ⟨hφ', hb'⟩ hQE'
          -- Decompose pcW(ω') and traceSumDeriv(W, ω') when b holds
          -- Decompose postcondExpect and traceSum via while-true decomposition
          let pcfun : CQState ctx → ℝ := fun ω'' =>
            if post.φ ω''.σ ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem ω''.σ post.A)
            then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω''.σ post.A) ω''.ρ).re else 0
          have hpc_decomp : postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W ω' =
              ∑' (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω'),
                postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W d₁.result := by
            simp only [postcondExpectDeriv, W]
            have hpcfun_summ : Summable (fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem W ω' =>
                pcfun d.result) := by
              have := postcondExpectDeriv_ite_summable sem psem sax post W ω'
              exact this.congr (fun d => by simp only [pcfun]; congr 1)
            exact tsum_while_true_decompose sem psem sax b P ω' hb' pcfun hpcfun_summ
          have hts_decomp : traceSumDeriv sem W ω' =
              ∑' (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω'),
                traceSumDeriv sem W d₁.result := by
            simp only [traceSumDeriv, W]
            exact tsum_while_true_decompose sem psem sax b P ω' hb' CQState.traceRe
              (sax.summableTrace W ω')
          by_cases hn : n = 0
          · -- n = 0: trRem(0) = traceSumDeriv, so pcW + NT_W + trRem(0) ≥ ω'.trRe ≥ E
            subst hn
            have hrem_eq_ts : (∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem W ω'),
                if 0 < d.pathLength then d.result.traceRe else 0) =
                traceSumDeriv sem W ω' := by
              unfold traceSumDeriv
              congr 1; ext d
              have hpl : 0 < d.pathLength := by
                obtain ⟨r, path, hstart, hend, hwf, hdwf⟩ := d
                cases path with
                | refl _ =>
                  -- A while-derivation can't be a refl path (start ≠ terminal)
                  exfalso
                  simp [DerivationPath.startConfig, DerivationPath.endConfig,
                    Configuration.ofProgram, Configuration.terminal] at hstart hend
                  rw [hstart] at hend; exact absurd hend nofun
                | step s rest =>
                  simp only [TerminatingDerivation.pathLength, DerivationPath.length]
                  omega
              simp [hpl]
            rw [hrem_eq_ts]
            unfold nonTermTraceDeriv
            linarith
          · -- n ≥ 1: full inductive argument
            have hn_pos : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
            have hTNI_W := sax.traceNonIncreaseDeriv W
            have hsumm_W := sax.summableTrace W
            have hsumm_P := sax.summableTrace P ω'
            let trRemFun := fun (m : ℕ) (ω₀ : CQState ctx) =>
              ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem W ω₀),
                if m < d.pathLength then d.result.traceRe else 0
            have htrRem_nonneg : ∀ m ω₀, 0 ≤ trRemFun m ω₀ :=
              fun m ω₀ => tsum_nonneg fun d => by
                by_cases h : m < d.pathLength
                · rw [if_pos h]; exact d.result.traceRe_nonneg
                · rw [if_neg h]
            have htrRem_le_ts : ∀ m ω₀, trRemFun m ω₀ ≤ traceSumDeriv sem W ω₀ := by
              intro m ω₀; unfold traceSumDeriv
              apply Summable.tsum_le_tsum
              · intro d
                by_cases h : m < d.pathLength
                · rw [if_pos h]
                · rw [if_neg h]; exact d.result.traceRe_nonneg
              · exact Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
                  (fun d => by
                    by_cases h : m < d.pathLength
                    · rw [if_pos h]; exact d.result.traceRe_nonneg
                    · rw [if_neg h])
                  (fun d => by
                    by_cases h : m < d.pathLength
                    · rw [if_pos h]
                    · rw [if_neg h]; exact d.result.traceRe_nonneg)
                  (hsumm_W ω₀)
              · exact hsumm_W ω₀
            have hsum_pcW_comp : Summable (fun d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω' =>
                postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W d₁.result) :=
              postcondExpectDeriv_comp_summable sax post P W ω'
            have hsum_tsW_comp : Summable (fun d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω' =>
                traceSumDeriv sem W d₁.result) :=
              traceSumDeriv_comp_summable sax P W ω'
            have hsum_trRem : Summable (fun d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω' =>
                trRemFun (n - 1) d₁.result) :=
              Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
                (fun d₁ => htrRem_nonneg (n - 1) d₁.result)
                (fun d₁ => le_trans (htrRem_le_ts (n - 1) d₁.result) (hTNI_W d₁.result))
                hsumm_P
            have hpc_nonneg_d : ∀ ω₀ : CQState ctx,
                0 ≤ postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W ω₀ :=
              fun ω₀ => postcondExpectDeriv_nonneg sem psem sax post W ω₀
            have hpc_le_ts_d : ∀ ω₀ : CQState ctx,
                postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W ω₀ ≤ traceSumDeriv sem W ω₀ :=
              fun ω₀ => postcondExpectDeriv_le_traceSumDeriv sem psem sax post W ω₀
            -- Summability of the combined RHS per d₁
            have hsum_rhs : Summable (fun d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω' =>
                postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W d₁.result +
                d₁.result.traceRe - traceSumDeriv sem W d₁.result +
                trRemFun (n - 1) d₁.result) := by
              have hrw : (fun d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω' =>
                  postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W d₁.result +
                  d₁.result.traceRe - traceSumDeriv sem W d₁.result +
                  trRemFun (n - 1) d₁.result) =
                (fun d₁ => (postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W d₁.result +
                  trRemFun (n - 1) d₁.result) +
                  (d₁.result.traceRe - traceSumDeriv sem W d₁.result)) := by
                ext; ring
              rw [hrw]
              exact (Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
                (fun d₁ => by linarith [hpc_nonneg_d d₁.result, htrRem_nonneg (n - 1) d₁.result])
                (fun d₁ => by
                  linarith [le_trans (hpc_le_ts_d d₁.result) (hTNI_W d₁.result),
                            le_trans (htrRem_le_ts (n - 1) d₁.result) (hTNI_W d₁.result)])
                (hsumm_P.add hsumm_P)).add (hsumm_P.sub hsum_tsW_comp)
            -- Pointwise bound from IH
            have hpw : ∀ d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω',
                (if inv.φ d₁.result.σ ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem d₁.result.σ inv.A)
                 then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem d₁.result.σ inv.A) d₁.result.ρ).re
                 else 0) ≤
                postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W d₁.result +
                d₁.result.traceRe - traceSumDeriv sem W d₁.result +
                trRemFun (n - 1) d₁.result := by
              intro d₁
              by_cases hcond : inv.φ d₁.result.σ ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem d₁.result.σ inv.A)
              · rw [if_pos hcond]
                have hih := ih (n - 1) (Nat.sub_lt hn_pos Nat.one_pos) d₁.result hcond.1 hcond.2
                unfold nonTermTraceDeriv at hih; linarith
              · rw [if_neg hcond]
                linarith [hpc_nonneg_d d₁.result, hTNI_W d₁.result, htrRem_nonneg (n - 1) d₁.result]
            -- Sum the pointwise bounds
            have hpw_sum : postcondExpectDeriv psem inv sem P ω' ≤
                ∑' d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω',
                  (postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W d₁.result +
                   d₁.result.traceRe - traceSumDeriv sem W d₁.result +
                   trRemFun (n - 1) d₁.result) := by
              unfold postcondExpectDeriv
              exact Summable.tsum_le_tsum (fun d₁ => hpw d₁)
                (postcondExpectDeriv_ite_summable sem psem sax inv P ω')
                hsum_rhs
            -- Decompose the tsum into four terms
            have hsum_decomp :
              (∑' d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω',
                (postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W d₁.result +
                 d₁.result.traceRe - traceSumDeriv sem W d₁.result +
                 trRemFun (n - 1) d₁.result)) =
              (∑' d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω',
                postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W d₁.result) +
              (∑' d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω', d₁.result.traceRe) -
              (∑' d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω', traceSumDeriv sem W d₁.result) +
              (∑' d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω', trRemFun (n - 1) d₁.result) := by
              have hrw : (fun d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω' =>
                  postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W d₁.result +
                  d₁.result.traceRe - traceSumDeriv sem W d₁.result +
                  trRemFun (n - 1) d₁.result) =
                (fun d₁ =>
                  (postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W d₁.result +
                  (d₁.result.traceRe - traceSumDeriv sem W d₁.result)) +
                  trRemFun (n - 1) d₁.result) := by
                ext; ring
              rw [hrw, (hsum_pcW_comp.add (hsumm_P.sub hsum_tsW_comp)).tsum_add hsum_trRem,
                  hsum_pcW_comp.tsum_add (hsumm_P.sub hsum_tsW_comp),
                  hsumm_P.tsum_sub hsum_tsW_comp]; ring
            -- Key bound: ∑ trRem(n-1, d₁.result) ≤ trRem(n, ω')
            -- Requires whileTrueDecomposeEquiv (while ≃ Σ d₁, while(d₁.result))
            -- and the pathLength strict decrease property.
            -- See old backup Thm_1_SoundnessOfQHLPlus.lean lines 908-985.
            have htrRem_reindex :
              (∑' d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω', trRemFun (n - 1) d₁.result) ≤
              trRemFun n ω' := by
              exact trRem_reindex_bound b P ω' hb' n hsumm_W hsumm_P hsum_trRem
            -- Final assembly: E ≤ pcW + NT_W + trRem(n)
            unfold nonTermTraceDeriv at hbody_app ⊢
            have htsP_eq : traceSumDeriv sem P ω' =
              ∑' (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω'), d₁.result.traceRe := rfl
            rw [htsP_eq] at hbody_app
            rw [hsum_decomp, hpc_decomp.symm, hts_decomp.symm] at hpw_sum
            show (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω'.σ inv.A) ω'.ρ).re ≤
              postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W ω' +
              (ω'.traceRe - traceSumDeriv sem W ω') +
              trRemFun n ω'
            linarith
        · -- b=false at ω': loop terminates immediately
          have htsum_chain : ∀ g : CQState ctx → ℝ,
              ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem W ω'), g d.result = g ω' :=
            fun g => tsum_whileFalse_result sem b P ω' hb' g
          let pcf : CQState ctx → ℝ := fun ω'' =>
            if post.φ ω''.σ ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem ω''.σ post.A)
            then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω''.σ post.A) ω''.ρ).re else 0
          have hpc : postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W ω' =
              (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω'.σ inv.A) ω'.ρ).re := by
            have : postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem W ω' = pcf ω' := by
              simp only [postcondExpectDeriv, W]
              exact htsum_chain pcf
            rw [this]
            simp only [pcf, post]
            exact if_pos ⟨⟨hφ', hb'⟩, sax.interpFormula_effect ω'.σ inv.A⟩
          have hts : traceSumDeriv sem W ω' = ω'.traceRe := by
            unfold traceSumDeriv; exact htsum_chain CQState.traceRe
          have hnt : nonTermTraceDeriv sem W ω' = 0 := by
            simp [nonTermTraceDeriv, hts]
          have hrem_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem W ω'),
              if n < d.pathLength then d.result.traceRe else 0 :=
            tsum_nonneg fun d => by split <;> [exact d.result.traceRe_nonneg; exact le_refl 0]
          rw [hpc, hnt]; linarith
    -- Part B: Convergence — trRem(n) → 0 as n → ∞, so E ≤ pcW + NT_W
    apply le_of_forall_pos_lt_add
    intro ε hε
    have hsumm := sax.summableTrace W ω
    have hhas := hsumm.hasSum
    set f := (fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem W ω => d.result.traceRe) with hf_def
    have h_sub_lt : ∑' d, f d - ε < ∑' d, f d := sub_lt_self _ hε
    have h_evt := (tendsto_order.1 hhas).1 _ h_sub_lt
    rw [SummationFilter.unconditional_filter, Filter.eventually_atTop] at h_evt
    obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀⟩ := h_evt
    have hs₀_self := hs₀ s₀ le_rfl
    set N := s₀.sup TerminatingDerivation.pathLength with hN_def
    have hb_N := hbound N ω hφ hEffect
    suffices h_trRem : ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem W ω),
        (if N < d.pathLength then d.result.traceRe else 0) < ε by linarith
    set g_N := (fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem W ω =>
      if N < d.pathLength then d.result.traceRe else 0) with hgN_def
    set h_N := (fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem W ω =>
      if d.pathLength ≤ N then d.result.traceRe else 0) with hhN_def
    have hgh : ∀ d, g_N d + h_N d = f d := by
      intro d; simp only [g_N, h_N, f]
      by_cases hd : N < d.pathLength
      · rw [if_pos hd, if_neg (by omega)]; ring
      · rw [if_neg hd, if_pos (by omega)]; ring
    have hg_summ : Summable g_N :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
        (fun d => by simp only [g_N]; split <;> [exact d.result.traceRe_nonneg; exact le_refl 0])
        (fun d => by simp only [g_N]; split <;> [exact le_refl _; exact d.result.traceRe_nonneg])
        hsumm
    have hh_summ : Summable h_N :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
        (fun d => by simp only [h_N]; split <;> [exact d.result.traceRe_nonneg; exact le_refl 0])
        (fun d => by simp only [h_N]; split <;> [exact le_refl _; exact d.result.traceRe_nonneg])
        hsumm
    have htsum_gh : ∑' d, g_N d + ∑' d, h_N d = ∑' d, f d := by
      rw [← hg_summ.tsum_add hh_summ]
      congr 1; ext d; exact hgh d
    have hsum_le : ∑ d ∈ s₀, f d ≤ ∑' d, h_N d := by
      have hconv : ∑ d ∈ s₀, f d = ∑ d ∈ s₀, h_N d := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro d hd
        simp only [h_N, f]
        rw [if_pos (Finset.le_sup hd)]
      rw [hconv]
      exact hh_summ.sum_le_tsum s₀
        (fun d _ => by simp only [h_N]; split <;> [exact d.result.traceRe_nonneg; exact le_refl 0])
    have hg_bound : ∑' d, g_N d ≤ ∑' d, f d - ∑ d ∈ s₀, f d := by linarith
    linarith
  · -- Case b = false: while terminates immediately with result ω
    apply le_add_of_le_of_nonneg
    · let post := (⟨inv.S, fun σ => inv.φ σ ∧ ¬sem.boolEval σ b, inv.A⟩ :
        CQAssert CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx)
      show (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω.σ inv.A) ω.ρ).re ≤
        postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem (.whileDo b P) ω
      have hpc : postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem (.whileDo b P) ω =
          (if post.φ ω.σ ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem ω.σ post.A)
           then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω.σ post.A) ω.ρ).re else 0) := by
        unfold postcondExpectDeriv
        simp only [post]
        exact tsum_whileFalse_result sem b P ω hb (fun ω' =>
          if (inv.φ ω'.σ ∧ ¬sem.boolEval ω'.σ b) ∧
            IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem ω'.σ inv.A)
          then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω'.σ inv.A) ω'.ρ).re else 0)
      rw [hpc, if_pos ⟨⟨hφ, hb⟩, hEffect⟩]
    · -- nonTermTrace ≥ 0
      unfold nonTermTraceDeriv
      linarith [sax.traceNonIncreaseDeriv (.whileDo b P) ω]

theorem soundness_tot_deriv
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx}
    {psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx}
    {expSub : CVar → Exp → Exp → Exp}
    {qvSub : CVar → Exp → QVar → QVar}
    (sax : SoundnessBase sem psem expSub qvSub)
    {pre post : Assertion ctx}
    {P : Prog}
    (h : QHLPlusTotDeriv sem psem expSub qvSub pre P post) :
    TotTriple sem psem pre P post := by
  -- Paper: Theorem 4.1 (total correctness). Induction on QHLPlusTotDeriv.
  -- Total correctness: E(pre.A, ω.ρ) ≤ postcondExpect(post, P, ω)
  -- (no nonTermTrace term — program must terminate)
  induction h with
  | axiomSkip a =>
    -- {a} skip {a} (total): E(a.A, ω.ρ) ≤ postcondExpectDeriv(a, skip, ω)
    intro ω hφ hEffect
    unfold postcondExpectDeriv
    have key : ∀ d : TerminatingDerivation sem .skip ω,
      (if a.φ d.result.σ ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem d.result.σ a.A)
       then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem d.result.σ a.A) d.result.ρ).re else 0) =
      (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω.σ a.A) ω.ρ).re := by
      intro d; rw [terminatingDerivation_skip_result sem ω d]; simp [hφ, hEffect]
    rw [tsum_congr key]
    have ⟨d₀⟩ : Nonempty (TerminatingDerivation sem .skip ω) :=
      ⟨⟨ω, .step (.skip ω) (.refl _), rfl, rfl, ⟨rfl, trivial⟩, ⟨trivial, trivial⟩⟩⟩
    haveI := terminatingDerivation_skip_subsingleton sem ω
    let e : Unit ≃ TerminatingDerivation sem .skip ω :=
      ⟨fun _ => d₀, fun _ => (), fun _ => rfl, fun d => Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
    rw [← e.tsum_eq]; simp
  | axiomAssign x e post hInj =>
    -- {φ[e/x], A[e/x]} (x := e) {φ, A} (total): substitution lemma
    intro ω hφ hEffect
    have hpc : postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem (.classAssign x e) ω =
        if post.φ (ω.classAssign sem x e).σ ∧
          IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem (ω.classAssign sem x e).σ post.A)
        then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem (ω.classAssign sem x e).σ post.A)
          (ω.classAssign sem x e).ρ).re else 0 := by
      unfold postcondExpectDeriv
      exact tsum_classAssign_result sem x e ω fun ω' =>
        if post.φ ω'.σ ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem ω'.σ post.A)
        then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω'.σ post.A) ω'.ρ).re else 0
    rw [hpc]
    have hφ' : post.φ (ω.classAssign sem x e).σ := by
      simp only [CQState.classAssign, CQState.σ]; exact hφ
    have hQE' : IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem (ω.classAssign sem x e).σ post.A) :=
      sax.interpFormula_effect _ _
    rw [if_pos ⟨hφ', hQE'⟩]
    have hρ_eq : (ω.classAssign sem x e).ρ = ω.ρ := by
      simp [CQState.classAssign, CQState.ρ]
    have hsub := substFormula_interp psem expSub qvSub x e ω.σ
      (sem.classicalUpdate ω.σ x e) hInj
      (fun K params qvars => sax.substInterp_atom x e ω.σ K params qvars)
      (fun F params qvars => funext fun i => sax.substInterp_kraus x e ω.σ F params qvars i)
      post.A
    rw [show (ω.classAssign sem x e).σ = sem.classicalUpdate ω.σ x e from rfl, ← hsub, hρ_eq]
    exact le_of_eq rfl
  | axiomInit q post F_B fParams fQvars fHdist fHsub hInitBridge =>
    -- {φ, F_B[q](A)} (q := |0⟩) {φ, A} (total): Kraus duality for init
    intro ω hφ hQE
    have hpc : postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem (.qInit q) ω =
        if post.φ (ω.initTransform sem q).σ ∧
          IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem (ω.initTransform sem q).σ post.A)
        then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem (ω.initTransform sem q).σ post.A)
          (ω.initTransform sem q).ρ).re else 0 := by
      unfold postcondExpectDeriv
      exact tsum_qInit_result sem q ω fun ω' =>
        if post.φ ω'.σ ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem ω'.σ post.A)
        then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω'.σ post.A) ω'.ρ).re else 0
    rw [hpc]
    have hσ_eq : (ω.initTransform sem q).σ = ω.σ := by
      simp [CQState.initTransform, CQState.σ]
    have hφ' : post.φ (ω.initTransform sem q).σ := by rw [hσ_eq]; exact hφ
    have hQE' : IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem (ω.initTransform sem q).σ post.A) :=
      sax.interpFormula_effect _ _
    rw [if_pos ⟨hφ', hQE'⟩, hσ_eq]
    have hρ_eq : (ω.initTransform sem q).ρ = sem.qInitTransform ω.σ q ω.ρ := by
      simp [CQState.initTransform, CQState.ρ]
    rw [hρ_eq]
    have hkraus := krausInit_expectation_from_bridge q ω.σ F_B fParams fQvars fHdist fHsub
      post.A ω.ρ hInitBridge
    linarith
  | axiomUnitary U gateParams gateQvars gateHdist post F_U fParams fQvars fHdist fHsub
      hUnitaryBridge =>
    -- {φ, F_U[q̄](A)} U(t̄)[q̄] {φ, A} (total): cyclic trace property
    intro ω hφ hQE
    have hpc : postcondExpectDeriv psem post sem
        (.unitaryApp U gateParams gateQvars gateHdist) ω =
        if post.φ (ω.unitaryTransform sem U gateParams gateQvars).σ ∧
          IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem
            (ω.unitaryTransform sem U gateParams gateQvars).σ post.A)
        then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem
            (ω.unitaryTransform sem U gateParams gateQvars).σ post.A)
          (ω.unitaryTransform sem U gateParams gateQvars).ρ).re else 0 := by
      unfold postcondExpectDeriv
      exact tsum_unitaryApp_result sem U gateParams gateQvars gateHdist ω fun ω' =>
        if post.φ ω'.σ ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem ω'.σ post.A)
        then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω'.σ post.A) ω'.ρ).re else 0
    rw [hpc]
    have hσ_eq : (ω.unitaryTransform sem U gateParams gateQvars).σ = ω.σ := by
      simp [CQState.unitaryTransform, CQState.σ]
    have hφ' : post.φ (ω.unitaryTransform sem U gateParams gateQvars).σ := by
      rw [hσ_eq]; exact hφ
    have hQE' : IsQuantumEffect
        (interpFormula psem (ω.unitaryTransform sem U gateParams gateQvars).σ post.A) :=
      sax.interpFormula_effect _ _
    rw [if_pos ⟨hφ', hQE'⟩, hσ_eq]
    have hρ_eq : (ω.unitaryTransform sem U gateParams gateQvars).ρ =
      (sem.unitaryOp U ω.σ gateParams gateQvars).comp
        (ω.ρ.comp (sem.unitaryOp U ω.σ gateParams gateQvars).adjoint) := by
      simp [CQState.unitaryTransform, CQState.ρ]
    rw [hρ_eq]
    have hkraus := krausUnitary_expectation_from_bridge U gateParams gateQvars ω.σ
      F_U fParams fQvars fHdist fHsub post.A ω.ρ hUnitaryBridge
    linarith
  | axiomMeasure x M measQvars measHdist y y_exp post_base F_My fParams fQvars fHdist
      hInj fHsub eqXY heqXY hfresh_φ hfresh_A hy_ne_x outcomeOf hMeasBridge =>
    exact sax.soundness_measure x M measQvars measHdist y y_exp post_base F_My fParams
      fQvars fHdist hInj fHsub eqXY heqXY hfresh_φ hfresh_A hy_ne_x outcomeOf hMeasBridge
  | ruleSeq _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    -- {pre} P₁;P₂ {post} (total): seq decomposition + IH telescoping
    rename_i _ mid post_seq P₁ P₂ _ _
    intro ω hφ hQE
    -- Decompose postcondExpectDeriv for seq
    have hpc : postcondExpectDeriv psem post_seq sem (P₁ ;; P₂) ω =
        ∑' (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P₁ ω),
          postcondExpectDeriv psem post_seq sem P₂ d₁.result := by
      unfold postcondExpectDeriv
      exact tsum_seq_result sem P₁ P₂ ω (fun ω' =>
        if post_seq.φ ω'.σ ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem ω'.σ post_seq.A)
        then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω'.σ post_seq.A) ω'.ρ).re else 0)
        (postcondExpectDeriv_ite_summable sem psem sax post_seq (.seq P₁ P₂) ω)
    rw [hpc]
    have hle₁ := ih₁ ω hφ hQE
    -- Pointwise bound from ih₂ (total: no NT term)
    have hpw : ∀ (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P₁ ω),
        (if mid.φ d₁.result.σ ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem d₁.result.σ mid.A)
         then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem d₁.result.σ mid.A) d₁.result.ρ).re
         else 0) ≤
        postcondExpectDeriv psem post_seq sem P₂ d₁.result := by
      intro d₁
      split
      case isTrue h => exact ih₂ d₁.result h.1 h.2
      case isFalse _ =>
        exact postcondExpectDeriv_nonneg sem psem sax post_seq P₂ d₁.result
    -- Sum the pointwise bounds
    have hpw_sum : postcondExpectDeriv psem mid sem P₁ ω ≤
        ∑' (d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P₁ ω),
          postcondExpectDeriv psem post_seq sem P₂ d₁.result := by
      unfold postcondExpectDeriv
      exact Summable.tsum_le_tsum hpw
        (postcondExpectDeriv_ite_summable sem psem sax mid P₁ ω)
        (postcondExpectDeriv_comp_summable sax post_seq P₁ P₂ ω)
    linarith
  | ruleCond _ _ ih₁ ih₀ =>
    -- {φ, A} if b then P₁ else P₀ {ψ, B} (total): case split on boolean guard
    rename_i _ post' b P₁ P₀ _ _
    intro ω hφ hQE
    by_cases hb : sem.boolEval ω.σ b
    · have hpc : postcondExpectDeriv psem post' sem (.ifThenElse b P₁ P₀) ω =
          postcondExpectDeriv psem post' sem P₁ ω := by
        unfold postcondExpectDeriv
        exact tsum_ifTrue_result sem b P₁ P₀ ω hb fun ω' =>
          if post'.φ ω'.σ ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem ω'.σ post'.A)
          then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω'.σ post'.A) ω'.ρ).re else 0
      rw [hpc]
      exact ih₁ ω ⟨hφ, hb⟩ hQE
    · have hpc : postcondExpectDeriv psem post' sem (.ifThenElse b P₁ P₀) ω =
          postcondExpectDeriv psem post' sem P₀ ω := by
        unfold postcondExpectDeriv
        exact tsum_ifFalse_result sem b P₁ P₀ ω hb fun ω' =>
          if post'.φ ω'.σ ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem ω'.σ post'.A)
          then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem ω'.σ post'.A) ω'.ρ).re else 0
      rw [hpc]
      exact ih₀ ω ⟨hφ, hb⟩ hQE
  | ruleLoopTot t z tEqZ tLtZ tGeZero hbody hvariant hbound hfresh_z_φ hfresh_z_b
      hfresh_z_t hfresh_z_P htEqZ_achievable hfresh_z_A hderiv_stable variant_rank
      hrank_decrease hvariant_pointwise ih_body ih_variant =>
    exact soundness_loop_tot_deriv sem psem sax _ _ _ ih_body z t tEqZ tLtZ tGeZero
      (by convert ih_variant using 2; ext σ; simp [conjBExpFormula, and_assoc])
      hbound variant_rank hrank_decrease
      -- variant_decrease: derived from hrank_decrease + hvariant_pointwise
      (fun ω' hφ' hb' hQE' d₁ hφ_out => by
        apply hrank_decrease ω'.σ d₁.result.σ hφ' hb' _ hφ_out
        exact hvariant_pointwise ω' hφ' hb' hQE' d₁ hφ_out)
  | ruleConseq hpre hderiv hpost ih =>
    intro ω hφ' hQE'
    have hφ := hpre.1 ω.σ hφ'
    apply le_trans (expectationValue_re_monotone hQE' (sax.interpFormula_effect ω.σ _)
      (hpre.2 ω.σ hφ') ω.is_partialDensityOp)
    apply le_trans (ih ω hφ (sax.interpFormula_effect ω.σ _))
    clear pre post P
    exact postcondExpectDeriv_mono sax _ _ ‹_› ω
      (fun σ hφ => hpost.1 σ hφ) (fun σ hφ => hpost.2 σ hφ)
  | ruleAccum1 F F' hrank1 params params' qvarsF qvarsF' hdistF hdistF' preAs hsubF hsubF'
      preφ postψs postB P hpremises hmutex hdisjoint hprop ih_premises =>
    exact soundness_accum1_tot_deriv sax F F' hrank1 params params' qvarsF qvarsF'
      hdistF hdistF' preAs hsubF hsubF' preφ postψs postB P
      (fun i => ih_premises i) hmutex hdisjoint hprop
  | ruleAccum2 F params qvarsF hdistF preAs postBs hsubF preφ postψ P
      hpremises hdisjoint ih_premises =>
    exact soundness_accum2_tot_deriv sax F params qvarsF hdistF preAs postBs hsubF
      preφ postψ P (fun i => ih_premises i) hdisjoint
preview.content_html:
What This Declaration Is Doing

This theorem is the main soundness statement for the total-correctness proof system: if a Hoare-style judgment `QHLPlusTotDeriv ... pre P post` is derivable syntactically, then it is semantically valid as a `TotTriple`. Mathematically, it says that every proof rule of the logic preserves the intended total-correctness meaning: starting from any state satisfying the precondition, the expected value encoded by the precondition is bounded by the postcondition expectation after executing `P`, with only terminating runs contributing. The parameters `sem`, `psem`, `expSub`, `qvSub`, and especially `sax : SoundnessBase ...` supply the semantic interpretation of programs/assertions and the basic soundness facts for substitution, initialization, unitary evolution, and measurement. The proof proceeds by induction over the derivation `h`, so each constructor of the proof system is matched with its corresponding semantic soundness argument.

Declaration Header

theorem soundness_tot_deriv
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx}
    {psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx}
    {expSub : CVar -> Exp -> Exp -> Exp}
    {qvSub : CVar -> Exp -> QVar -> QVar}
    (sax : SoundnessBase sem psem expSub qvSub)
    {pre post : Assertion ctx}

Inputs and Outputs in Natural Language

  • ctx (implicit input): the ambient context fixing the variables and registers under discussion; more concretely, it is a program context fixing the classical and quantum registers under discussion.
  • sem (implicit input): the semantic map assigning mathematical meaning to the objects under study; more concretely, it is a program in the quantum while language.
  • psem (implicit input): the semantic map assigning mathematical meaning to the objects under study; more concretely, it is a gate symbol or gate-level operation.
  • expSub (implicit input): a substitution rule that replaces variables by expressions; more concretely, it is a rule that takes a classical variable symbol, an arithmetic expression in the classical fragment, and an arithmetic expression in the classical fragment and returns an arithmetic expression in the classical fragment.
  • qvSub (implicit input): a rule that takes a classical variable symbol, an arithmetic expression in the classical fragment, and a quantum register variable and returns a quantum register variable.
  • sax (explicit input): a substitution rule that replaces variables by expressions; more concretely, it is an auxiliary object of type `SoundnessBase sem psem expSub qvSub`.
  • pre post (implicit input): the hypothesis or precondition assumed before the program runs; more concretely, it is a classical-quantum assertion used as a precondition or postcondition.
  • Output. The declaration returns a proposition whose proof establishes the stated claim.

Selected Lean Lines to Unpack

Routine lines are intentionally omitted. This section only calls out places where Lean notation or proof scripting hides the underlying mathematical move.

  1. line 797 induction h with
    The proof proceeds by induction on the derivation of the Hoare-style judgment \(h\). Mathematically, this means proving soundness separately for each axiom and inference rule that could have produced the derivation.
  2. line 811 let e : Unit ≃ TerminatingDerivation sem .skip ω :=
    This defines an explicit bijection between `Unit` and the set of terminating executions of `skip` from the state \(\omega\). The point is that `skip` has exactly one terminating derivation, so the infinite sum over derivations can be treated as a one-term sum.
  3. line 834 have hsub := substFormula_interp psem expSub qvSub x e ω.σ
    This invokes the substitution lemma for formulas: evaluating the postcondition after updating \(x := e\) is the same as evaluating the syntactically substituted assertion before the update. It is the key step that connects the assignment rule's substituted precondition to the semantic state transformation.
  4. line 934 exact Summable.tsum_le_tsum hpw
    This applies the general fact that if two summable series satisfy a term-by-term inequality, then their total sums satisfy the same inequality. Here it lifts the pointwise bound for each terminating derivation of \(P_1\) to a bound for the whole sequential composition.
  5. line 962 exact soundness_loop_tot_deriv sem psem sax _ _ _ ih_body z t tEqZ tLtZ tGeZero
    This discharges the loop case by appealing to a previously established total-soundness theorem for loops. The induction hypotheses for the body and the variant argument are supplied as inputs, along with the ranking and freshness assumptions.
  6. line 972 apply le_trans (expectationValue_re_monotone hQE' (sax.interpFormula_effect ω.σ _)
    This starts a transitive inequality chain by using monotonicity of expectation: if one effect is pointwise below another, then its expected value is also below the other's. In the consequence rule, this is the step that replaces the original precondition by the stronger one justified by the premise.

theorem disjointKrausAccum1Comm_derived
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx}
    {psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx}
    (hyp : DisjointCommHypotheses sem)
    (hpdo_axiom : ∀ (F_sym : KrausOpSym)
      (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
      (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F_sym) → Exp)
      (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F_sym) → QVar)
      (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F_sym))
      (ρ : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all),
      IsPartialDensityOperator ρ →
      IsPartialDensityOperator
        ((psem.krausInterp F_sym σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
          (ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F_sym σ params qvarsF i))))
    (heff : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
      {S : Finset QVar}
      (A : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S),
      IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem σ A))
    -- Expectation monotonicity: A ≤ B and C is effect ⟹ E(C,A) ≤ E(C,B)
    (hExpectMono : ∀ (C A B : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all),
      IsQuantumEffect C → A ≤ B → (expectationValue C A).re ≤ (expectationValue C B).re)
    (F F' : KrausOpSym)
    (hrank1 : pcats.krausRank F' = 1)
    (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
    (params' : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F') → Exp)
    (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)
    (qvarsF' : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F') → QVar)
    (hdistF : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F), i ≠ j → qvarsF i ≠ qvarsF j)
    (hdistF' : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F'), i ≠ j → qvarsF' i ≠ qvarsF' j)
    {S : Finset QVar}
    (postB : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S)
    (hsubF : ∀ i, qvarsF i ∈ S)
    (hsubF' : ∀ i, qvarsF' i ∈ S)
    (postψs : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) → (ClassicalState ctx → Prop))
    (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx)
    (hmutex : ∀ (i₁ i₂ : Fin (pcats.krausRank F)),
      i₁ ≠ i₂ → ∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx, ¬(postψs i₁ σ ∧ postψs i₂ σ))
    (hDisj : Disjoint (Finset.image qvarsF Finset.univ) P.quantumVars)
    (hprop : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F))
      (ρ : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all),
      IsPartialDensityOperator ρ →
      (psem.krausInterp F σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
        (ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F σ params qvarsF i)) ≤
      (psem.krausInterp F' σ params' qvarsF'
        ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).adjoint.comp
        (ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F' σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩)))
    -- Classical parameter stability
    (hσ_stable : ∀ (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω) (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F)),
      psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i =
      psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)
    (hσ_stable' : ∀ (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω),
      psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ =
      psem.krausInterp F' ω.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩)
    -- Per-branch summability (derivable from comparison test, taken as hypothesis)
    (hPerBranchSummable : ∀ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
      Summable (fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω =>
        if postψs i d.result.σ
        then (expectationValue
                ((psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).comp
                  ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
                    (psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint))
                d.result.ρ).re
        else 0))
    -- RHS summability (after interpFormula_kraus unfolding)
    (hRHSSummable : Summable (fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω =>
      if (∃ i, postψs i d.result.σ) ∧
         IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem d.result.σ
           (.kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF'))
      then (expectationValue
              (interpFormula psem d.result.σ
                (.kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF'))
              d.result.ρ).re
      else 0)) :
    ∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
      postcondExpectDeriv psem ⟨S, postψs i, postB⟩ sem P
        ⟨ω.σ,
         (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
           (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
         hpdo_axiom F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ ≤
    postcondExpectDeriv psem
      ⟨S, fun σ => ∃ i, postψs i σ,
       .kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF'⟩ sem P ω := by
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  -- STEP 1: Reindex each LHS summand via replay bijection
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  have hreindex : ∀ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
      postcondExpectDeriv psem ⟨S, postψs i, postB⟩ sem P
        ⟨ω.σ,
         (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
           (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
         hpdo_axiom F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ =
      ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω),
        if postψs i d.result.σ ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB)
        then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB)
                ((psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
                  (d.result.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)))).re
        else 0 := fun i =>
    postcondExpectDeriv_reindex_sandwich sem hyp psem postB (postψs i) P ω
      (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)
      (Finset.image qvarsF Finset.univ)
      (hpdo_axiom F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp)
      hDisj
  simp_rw [hreindex]

  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  -- STEP 2: Apply trace cyclicity + IsQE simplification per-summand
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  have hcycle : ∀ (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F)) (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω),
      (if postψs i d.result.σ ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB)
       then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB)
               ((psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
                 (d.result.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)))).re
       else 0) =
      (if postψs i d.result.σ
       then (expectationValue
               ((psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).comp
                 ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
                   (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint))
               d.result.ρ).re
       else 0) := fun i d =>
    if_expectation_kraus_cycle psem postB d.result.σ d.result.ρ
      (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i) (postψs i) (heff d.result.σ postB)
  simp_rw [hcycle]
  -- Now LHS = ∑ᵢ ∑'_d (if postψs_i(σ') then E(Kᵢ(ω.σ)∘postB(σ')∘Kᵢ(ω.σ)†, ρ').re else 0)

  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  -- STEP 3: Fubini — swap ∑ᵢ (finite) and ∑'_d (tsum)
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  -- Abbreviate the per-branch function
  set g : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) → TerminatingDerivation sem P ω → ℝ :=
    fun i d =>
      if postψs i d.result.σ
      then (expectationValue
              ((psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).comp
                ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
                  (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint))
              d.result.ρ).re
      else 0 with hg_def
  -- Convert hPerBranchSummable to use ω.σ for Fubini
  have hSummable_g : ∀ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F), Summable (g i) := by
    intro i
    have hsub := hPerBranchSummable i
    apply Summable.congr hsub
    intro d
    simp only [hg_def]
    rw [hσ_stable d i]
  have hfubini : ∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F), ∑' d, g i d =
      ∑' d, ∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F), g i d := by
    rw [← Summable.tsum_finsetSum (fun i _ => hSummable_g i)]
  rw [hfubini]

  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  -- STEP 4: σ-stability — rewrite Kᵢ(ω.σ) to Kᵢ(d.result.σ) per-derivation
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  have hσ_rw : ∀ d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω,
      (∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F), g i d) =
      (∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        if postψs i d.result.σ
        then (expectationValue
                ((psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).comp
                  ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
                    (psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint))
                d.result.ρ).re
        else 0) := by
    intro d
    congr 1; ext i
    simp only [hg_def]
    rw [hσ_stable d i]
  simp_rw [hσ_rw]

  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  -- STEP 5: Propagation — E(Kᵢ∘postB∘Kᵢ†, ρ') ≤ E(K'₀∘postB∘K'₀†, ρ')
  -- Uses hExpectMono (expectation monotonicity for effects) + hprop (Löwner bound)
  -- + trace cyclicity to convert KᵢBKᵢ† ≤ K'₀BK'₀† to the sandwich form
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  set K'₀ := psem.krausInterp F' ω.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  have hprop_bound : ∀ (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω)
      (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F)),
      (expectationValue
        ((psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).comp
          ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
            (psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint))
        d.result.ρ).re ≤
      (expectationValue
        ((psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).comp
          ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
            (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).adjoint))
        d.result.ρ).re := by
    intro d i
    -- Use trace cyclicity: E(K∘B∘K†, ρ) = E(B, K†ρK) on both sides
    rw [expectationValue_kraus_cycle, expectationValue_kraus_cycle]
    -- Now goal: E(postB, Kᵢ†ρ'Kᵢ) ≤ E(postB, K'₀†ρ'K'₀)
    -- Use hExpectMono with effect postB and hprop for the Löwner bound
    exact hExpectMono (interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB)
      ((psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
        (d.result.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i)))
      ((psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).adjoint.comp
        (d.result.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩)))
      (heff d.result.σ postB)
      (hprop d.result.σ i d.result.ρ d.result.is_partialDensityOp)

  -- Apply propagation bound inside the if-then-else
  have hprop_ite : ∀ d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω,
      (∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        if postψs i d.result.σ
        then (expectationValue
                ((psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).comp
                  ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
                    (psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint))
                d.result.ρ).re
        else 0) ≤
      (∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        if postψs i d.result.σ
        then (expectationValue
                ((psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).comp
                  ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
                    (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).adjoint))
                d.result.ρ).re
        else 0) := by
    intro d
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    split_ifs with h
    · exact hprop_bound d i
    · exact le_refl _

  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  -- STEP 6: Mutex — ∑ᵢ (if postψs_i then v else 0) ≤ (if ∃i then v else 0)
  -- Since at most one postψs_i is true (mutex), the sum has at most one nonzero term,
  -- which is ≤ v, which equals (if ∃i, postψs_i then v else 0) when some postψs_i holds.
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  have hmutex_bound : ∀ d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω,
      (∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        if postψs i d.result.σ
        then (expectationValue
                ((psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).comp
                  ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
                    (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).adjoint))
                d.result.ρ).re
        else 0) ≤
      (if (∃ i, postψs i d.result.σ)
       then (expectationValue
               ((psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).comp
                 ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
                   (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).adjoint))
               d.result.ρ).re
       else 0) := by
    intro d
    by_cases hex : ∃ i, postψs i d.result.σ
    · -- Some postψs_i holds: the if-exists is true
      rw [if_pos hex]
      obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := hex
      -- Mutex: only i₀ has postψs_i true, all others are false
      have honly : ∀ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F), postψs i d.result.σ → i = i₀ := by
        intro i hi
        by_contra hne
        exact hmutex i i₀ hne d.result.σ ⟨hi, hi₀⟩
      have hsingle : ∀ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F), i ≠ i₀ → ¬postψs i d.result.σ := by
        intro i hne hi; exact hne (honly i hi)
      -- The sum has only one nonzero term (at i₀), which equals the RHS
      have hsum_eq : (∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
          if postψs i d.result.σ
          then (expectationValue
                  ((psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).comp
                    ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
                      (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).adjoint))
                  d.result.ρ).re
          else 0) =
        (expectationValue
          ((psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).comp
            ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
              (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).adjoint))
          d.result.ρ).re := by
        rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single i₀]
        · rw [if_pos hi₀]
        · intro j hj; rw [if_neg (hsingle j hj)]
      linarith [hsum_eq]
    · -- No postψs_i holds: all terms are 0
      rw [if_neg hex]
      have hzero : (∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
          if postψs i d.result.σ
          then (expectationValue
                  ((psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).comp
                    ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
                      (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).adjoint))
                  d.result.ρ).re
          else 0) = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro i _
        rw [if_neg (by push_neg at hex; exact hex i)]
      linarith [hzero]

  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  -- STEP 7: Combine steps 5-6 into pointwise bound, then tsum_le_tsum
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  have hpointwise : ∀ d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω,
      (∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        if postψs i d.result.σ
        then (expectationValue
                ((psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).comp
                  ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
                    (psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint))
                d.result.ρ).re
        else 0) ≤
      (if (∃ i, postψs i d.result.σ)
       then (expectationValue
               ((psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).comp
                 ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
                   (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).adjoint))
               d.result.ρ).re
       else 0) := fun d => le_trans (hprop_ite d) (hmutex_bound d)

  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  -- STEP 8: σ-stability for F' — rewrite K'₀(d.result.σ) to K'₀(ω.σ) on RHS
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  have hσ'_rw : ∀ d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω,
      (if (∃ i, postψs i d.result.σ)
       then (expectationValue
               ((psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).comp
                 ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
                   (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).adjoint))
               d.result.ρ).re
       else 0) =
      (if (∃ i, postψs i d.result.σ)
       then (expectationValue
               (K'₀.comp ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp K'₀.adjoint))
               d.result.ρ).re
       else 0) := by
    intro d
    split_ifs with h
    · congr 1; congr 1; rw [hσ_stable' d]
    · rfl

  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  -- STEP 9: Match RHS with interpFormula_kraus for rank-1 F'
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  -- Helper: rank-1 sum collapse for F'
  have hrank1_collapse : ∀ d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω,
      (∑ i_1 : Fin (pcats.krausRank F'),
        (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' i_1).comp
          ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
            (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' i_1).adjoint)) =
      (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).comp
        ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
          (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).adjoint) := by
    intro d
    rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩]
    intro j hj; exfalso; apply hj
    have : j.val < 1 := hrank1 ▸ j.isLt; ext; omega

  -- Helper: each LHS finite sum term is nonneg
  have hLHS_nonneg : ∀ d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω,
      0 ≤ (∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        if postψs i d.result.σ
        then (expectationValue
                ((psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).comp
                  ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
                    (psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint))
                d.result.ρ).re
        else 0) := by
    intro d; apply Finset.sum_nonneg; intro i _
    split_ifs
    · rw [expectationValue_kraus_cycle]
      exact expectationValue_re_nonneg (heff d.result.σ postB)
        (hpdo_axiom F d.result.σ params qvarsF i d.result.ρ d.result.is_partialDensityOp)
    · exact le_refl 0

  -- Rewrite the RHS postcondExpectDeriv to the intermediate form
  -- postcondExpectDeriv unfolds to tsum, then:
  -- IsQE always true (heff), interpFormula_kraus unfolds, rank-1 collapse
  -- Unfold RHS and apply tsum_le_tsum
  unfold postcondExpectDeriv
  apply Summable.tsum_le_tsum
  · -- Pointwise bound
    intro d
    -- First, get to the intermediate form using propagation + mutex
    have hpw := le_trans (hprop_ite d) (hmutex_bound d)
    -- RHS after unfold: if (∃i, postψs_i σ) ∧ IsQE(...) then E(interpFormula .., ρ).re else 0
    -- The IsQE is always true, so the ∧ condition simplifies
    have hqe := heff d.result.σ
        (QuantumPredicateFormula.kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF')
    -- Rewrite the RHS if-then-else to match hmutex_bound's target
    -- The RHS (from unfolded postcondExpectDeriv) has form:
    -- if (∃i, ...) ∧ IsQE(interpFormula .. (.kraus ..)) then E(interpFormula ..) else 0
    -- Step 1: simplify ∧ IsQE (always true) to just (∃i, ...)
    -- Step 2: unfold interpFormula_kraus + rank-1 collapse to get K'₀∘B∘K'₀†
    -- The final RHS matches hmutex_bound's output, giving ≤
    calc (∑ i, _) ≤
        (if (∃ i, postψs i d.result.σ)
         then (expectationValue
                 ((psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).comp
                   ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
                     (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).adjoint))
                 d.result.ρ).re
         else 0) := hpw
      _ ≤ _ := by
        -- The RHS has form: if (∃i, ...) ∧ IsQE(K'₀∘B∘K'₀†) then E(K'₀∘B∘K'₀†, ρ') else 0
        -- where IsQE is always true. The ∧ true simplifies.
        -- We use le_of_eq to convert ≤ to =
        apply le_of_eq
        -- First eliminate IsQE ∧ true
        have hqe' : IsQuantumEffect
            (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ ∘ₗ
              interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB ∘ₗ
              LinearMap.adjoint (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩)) := by
          rw [← hrank1_collapse d, ← interpFormula_kraus]; exact hqe
        simp only [hqe', and_true, interpFormula_kraus, hrank1_collapse d]
  · -- LHS summability
    exact Summable.of_nonneg_of_le hLHS_nonneg
      (fun d => by
        have hpw := le_trans (hprop_ite d) (hmutex_bound d)
        have hqe := heff d.result.σ
            (QuantumPredicateFormula.kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF')
        have hqe' : IsQuantumEffect
            (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ ∘ₗ
              interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB ∘ₗ
              LinearMap.adjoint (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩)) := by
          rw [← hrank1_collapse d, ← interpFormula_kraus]; exact hqe
        calc (∑ i, _) ≤ _ := hpw
          _ ≤ _ := le_of_eq (by simp only [hqe', and_true, interpFormula_kraus, hrank1_collapse d]))
      hRHSSummable
  · convert hRHSSummable using 1; ext; simp
