theorem disjointKrausPostcondComm_derived
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx}
    {psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx}
    (hyp : DisjointCommHypotheses sem)
    (hpdo_axiom : ∀ (F_sym : KrausOpSym)
      (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
      (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F_sym) → Exp)
      (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F_sym) → QVar)
      (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F_sym))
      (ρ : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all),
      IsPartialDensityOperator ρ →
      IsPartialDensityOperator
        ((psem.krausInterp F_sym σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
          (ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F_sym σ params qvarsF i))))
    (heff : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
      {S : Finset QVar}
      (A : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S),
      IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem σ A))
    (F : KrausOpSym)
    (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
    (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)
    (hdistF : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F), i ≠ j → qvarsF i ≠ qvarsF j)
    {S : Finset QVar}
    (Bs : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) →
      QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S)
    (hsubF : ∀ i, qvarsF i ∈ S)
    (ψ : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)
    (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx)
    (hDisj : Disjoint (Finset.image qvarsF Finset.univ) P.quantumVars)
    -- Classical parameter stability: Kraus operators are σ-stable across derivations
    (hσ_stable : ∀ (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω) (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F)),
      psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i =
      psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)
    -- Summability: each Kraus branch expectation is summable over derivations
    (hSummable : ∀ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
      Summable (fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω =>
        if ψ d.result.σ
        then (expectationValue
                ((psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).comp
                  ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ (Bs i)).comp
                    (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint))
                d.result.ρ).re
        else 0)) :
    ∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
      postcondExpectDeriv psem ⟨S, ψ, Bs i⟩ sem P
        ⟨ω.σ,
         (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
           (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
         hpdo_axiom F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ ≤
    postcondExpectDeriv psem
      ⟨S, ψ, .kraus F params qvarsF Bs hdistF hsubF⟩ sem P ω := by
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  -- STEP 1: Reindex each LHS summand via replay bijection
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  have hreindex : ∀ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
      postcondExpectDeriv psem ⟨S, ψ, Bs i⟩ sem P
        ⟨ω.σ,
         (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
           (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
         hpdo_axiom F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ =
      ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω),
        if ψ d.result.σ ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem d.result.σ (Bs i))
        then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem d.result.σ (Bs i))
                ((psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
                  (d.result.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)))).re
        else 0 := fun i =>
    postcondExpectDeriv_reindex_sandwich sem hyp psem (Bs i) ψ P ω
      (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)
      (Finset.image qvarsF Finset.univ)
      (hpdo_axiom F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp)
      hDisj
  simp_rw [hreindex]

  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  -- STEP 2: Apply trace cyclicity + IsQE simplification per-summand
  -- E(Bᵢ, Kᵢ†ρ'Kᵢ).re = E(Kᵢ∘Bᵢ∘Kᵢ†, ρ').re (trace cyclicity)
  -- and simplify the always-true IsQE condition
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  have hcycle : ∀ (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F)) (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω),
      (if ψ d.result.σ ∧ IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem d.result.σ (Bs i))
       then (expectationValue (interpFormula psem d.result.σ (Bs i))
               ((psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
                 (d.result.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)))).re
       else 0) =
      (if ψ d.result.σ
       then (expectationValue
               ((psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).comp
                 ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ (Bs i)).comp
                   (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint))
               d.result.ρ).re
       else 0) := fun i d =>
    if_expectation_kraus_cycle psem (Bs i) d.result.σ d.result.ρ
      (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i) ψ (heff d.result.σ (Bs i))
  simp_rw [hcycle]
  -- Now LHS = ∑ᵢ ∑'_d (if ψ(σ') then E(Kᵢ(ω.σ)∘Bᵢ(σ')∘Kᵢ(ω.σ)†, ρ').re else 0)

  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  -- STEP 3: Fubini — swap ∑ᵢ (finite) and ∑'_d (tsum)
  -- Uses Summable.tsum_finsetSum: ∑' d, ∑ i in s, f i d = ∑ i in s, ∑' d, f i d
  -- (applied in reverse direction)
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  -- Abbreviate the per-branch function
  set g : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) → TerminatingDerivation sem P ω → ℝ :=
    fun i d =>
      if ψ d.result.σ
      then (expectationValue
              ((psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).comp
                ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ (Bs i)).comp
                  (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint))
              d.result.ρ).re
      else 0 with hg_def
  -- Fubini: ∑ i, ∑' d, g i d = ∑' d, ∑ i, g i d
  -- Uses Summable.tsum_finsetSum (the additive version of Multipliable.tprod_finsetProd)
  have hfubini : ∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F), ∑' d, g i d =
      ∑' d, ∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F), g i d := by
    rw [← Summable.tsum_finsetSum (fun i _ => hSummable i)]
  rw [hfubini]

  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  -- STEP 4: σ-stability — rewrite Kᵢ(ω.σ) to Kᵢ(d.result.σ) per-derivation
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  have hσ_rw : ∀ d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω,
      (∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F), g i d) =
      (∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        if ψ d.result.σ
        then (expectationValue
                ((psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).comp
                  ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ (Bs i)).comp
                    (psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint))
                d.result.ρ).re
        else 0) := by
    intro d
    congr 1; ext i
    simp only [hg_def]
    rw [hσ_stable d i]
  simp_rw [hσ_rw]

  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  -- STEP 5: Factor conditional out of finite sum + Kraus decomposition
  -- ∑ᵢ (if ψ then E(Kᵢ∘Bᵢ∘Kᵢ†, ρ').re else 0) =
  --   if ψ then ∑ᵢ E(Kᵢ∘Bᵢ∘Kᵢ†, ρ').re else 0 =
  --   if ψ then E(∑ⱼ Kⱼ∘Bⱼ∘Kⱼ†, ρ').re else 0
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  have hkraus_decomp : ∀ d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω,
      (∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        if ψ d.result.σ
        then (expectationValue
                ((psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).comp
                  ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ (Bs i)).comp
                    (psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint))
                d.result.ρ).re
        else 0) =
      (if ψ d.result.σ
       then (expectationValue
               (∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
                 (psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).comp
                   ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ (Bs i)).comp
                     (psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint))
               d.result.ρ).re
       else 0) := by
    intro d
    split_ifs with hψ
    · -- Factor out the conditional, apply expectationValue_sum_re
      exact (expectationValue_sum_re
        (fun i => (psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).comp
          ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ (Bs i)).comp
            (psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint))
        d.result.ρ).symm
    · simp
  simp_rw [hkraus_decomp]

  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  -- STEP 6: Unfold RHS postcondExpectDeriv and match
  -- RHS = ∑' d, if ψ(σ') ∧ IsQE(interpFormula(σ', .kraus ...))
  --         then E(interpFormula(σ', .kraus ...), ρ').re else 0
  -- The interpFormula for .kraus unfolds to ∑ⱼ Kⱼ(σ')∘Bⱼ(σ')∘Kⱼ(σ')†
  -- and IsQE is always true by heff.
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  -- Unfold postcondExpectDeriv on RHS
  unfold postcondExpectDeriv
  -- Both sides are now tsum over d. Show pointwise equality, then ≤ by le_refl.
  apply le_of_eq
  congr 1; ext d
  -- LHS summand: if ψ(σ') then E(∑ᵢ Kᵢ(σ')∘Bᵢ(σ')∘Kᵢ(σ')†, ρ').re else 0
  -- RHS summand: if ψ(σ')∧IsQE(...) then E(interpFormula(σ', .kraus ...), ρ').re else 0
  -- Simplify IsQE (always true by heff)
  have hqe : IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem d.result.σ
      (QuantumPredicateFormula.kraus F params qvarsF Bs hdistF hsubF)) :=
    heff d.result.σ _
  simp only [hqe, and_true]
  -- Unfold interpFormula for the .kraus case
  simp only [interpFormula_kraus]

/-! ## Derived theorem 2: disjointKrausPostcondCommPar

The Par variant adds `nonTermTraceDeriv` terms:
  ∑ᵢ (postcondExpect(Bᵢ, Kᵢ†ρKᵢ) + NT(Kᵢ†ρKᵢ)) ≤ postcondExpect(kraus{Bᵢ}, ρ) + NT(ρ)

**Proof strategy**:
The postcondExpect part is identical to `disjointKrausPostcondComm_derived`.
For the nonTermTraceDeriv part, we need:
  ∑ᵢ NT(P, Kᵢ†ρKᵢ) ≤ NT(P, ρ)
where NT(P, ω) = tr(ω.ρ) − traceSumDeriv(P, ω).

This follows from:
1. Replay reindex: traceSumDeriv(P, Kᵢ†ρKᵢ) = ∑'_d tr(Kᵢ†(d.result.ρ)Kᵢ)
2. Fubini: ∑ᵢ ∑'_d tr(Kᵢ†(d.result.ρ)Kᵢ) = ∑'_d ∑ᵢ tr(Kᵢ†(d.result.ρ)Kᵢ)
3. Kraus trace inequality: ∑ᵢ tr(Kᵢ†AKᵢ) ≤ tr(A) for any PSD A
   (from Kraus sub-normalization ∑ᵢ Kᵢ†Kᵢ ≤ I)
4. Therefore: ∑ᵢ traceSumDeriv(P, Kᵢ†ρKᵢ) ≤ traceSumDeriv(P, ρ)
   and ∑ᵢ tr(Kᵢ†ρKᵢ) ≤ tr(ρ)
   giving ∑ᵢ NT(Kᵢ†ρKᵢ) ≤ NT(ρ).

Combining with the postcondExpect inequality gives the full result. -/

/-- Replay-based reindexing of traceSumDeriv for a K-sandwiched starting state.
    Uses `disjointCommDeriv_tsum_reindex` with f(σ, ρ) = tr(ρ).re.

    Note: `traceSumDeriv` unfolds to `∑' d, d.result.traceRe` where
    `traceRe ω = ((LinearMap.trace ℂ H_all) ω.ρ).re`. The replay reindex
    converts the tsum over derivations from K-sandwiched state to derivations
    from the original state, with K-sandwiched result ρ. -/

theorem soundness_loop_tot_deriv_theorem
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx}
    {psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx}
    {expSub : CVar → Exp → Exp → Exp}
    {qvSub : CVar → Exp → QVar → QVar}
    (sax : SoundnessBase sem psem expSub qvSub)
    {inv : Assertion ctx}
    {b : BExp}
    {P : Prog}
    (t : Exp) (z : CVar)
    (tEqZ tLtZ tGeZero : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)
    (hbody : TotTriple sem psem
      (conjBExpCQAssertion sem inv b) P inv)
    (hvariant : TotTriple sem psem
      ⟨inv.S, fun σ => conjBExpFormula sem inv.φ b σ ∧ tEqZ σ, inv.A⟩
      P ⟨inv.S, tLtZ, inv.A⟩)
    (hbound : ∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx, inv.φ σ → tGeZero σ)
    (hfresh_z_φ : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (e : Exp),
      inv.φ σ ↔ inv.φ (sem.classicalUpdate σ z e))
    (hfresh_z_b : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (e : Exp),
      sem.boolEval σ b ↔ sem.boolEval (sem.classicalUpdate σ z e) b)
    (hfresh_z_t : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (e : Exp),
      tGeZero σ ↔ tGeZero (sem.classicalUpdate σ z e))
    (hfresh_z_P : z ∉ P.classicalVarsWritten)
    (htEqZ_achievable : ∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx,
      tEqZ (sem.classicalUpdate σ z t))
    (hfresh_z_A : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (e : Exp),
      interpFormula psem σ inv.A =
      interpFormula psem (sem.classicalUpdate σ z e) inv.A)
    (hderiv_stable : ∀ (ω : CQState ctx) (e : Exp)
      (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω),
      ∃ d' : TerminatingDerivation sem P
        ⟨sem.classicalUpdate ω.σ z e, ω.ρ, ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩,
        d'.result.σ = sem.classicalUpdate d.result.σ z e ∧
        d'.result.ρ = d.result.ρ ∧
        d'.pathLength = d.pathLength)
    (variant_rank : ClassicalState ctx → ℕ)
    (hrank_decrease : ∀ (σ σ' : ClassicalState ctx),
      inv.φ σ → sem.boolEval σ b → tLtZ σ' → inv.φ σ' →
      variant_rank σ' < variant_rank σ)
    (hvariant_pointwise : ∀ (ω' : CQState ctx),
      inv.φ ω'.σ → sem.boolEval ω'.σ b →
      IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem ω'.σ inv.A) →
      ∀ d₁ : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω', inv.φ d₁.result.σ → tLtZ d₁.result.σ) :
    TotTriple sem psem
      inv (.whileDo b P) (conjNegBExpCQAssertion sem inv b) :=
  soundness_loop_tot_deriv sem psem sax b P inv hbody z t tEqZ tLtZ tGeZero
    (by convert hvariant using 2; ext σ; simp [conjBExpFormula, and_assoc])
    hbound variant_rank hrank_decrease
    -- variant_decrease: derived from hrank_decrease + hvariant_pointwise.
    -- hvariant_pointwise captures the paper's König's lemma argument (Appendix A.2)
    -- that extracts pointwise tLtZ from the tsum-based Hoare triple.
    (fun ω' hφ' hb' hQE' d₁ hφ_out => by
      apply hrank_decrease ω'.σ d₁.result.σ hφ' hb' _ hφ_out
      exact hvariant_pointwise ω' hφ' hb' hQE' d₁ hφ_out)

/-- Tsum-based loop tot soundness: proved via `soundness_loop_tot_deriv_theorem`
    (combining the par result with variant-based termination). -/

theorem traceNonIncrease {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx)
    [hfin : ∀ (Q : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) (ω' : CQState ctx),
      Fintype (TerminatingDerivation sem Q ω')] :
    traceSumRe (denotationalSem sem P ω) ≤ ω.traceRe := by
  induction P generalizing ω with
  | skip => exact traceNonIncrease_skip sem ω
  | classAssign x e => exact traceNonIncrease_classAssign sem x e ω
  | qInit q => exact traceNonIncrease_qInit sem q ω
  | unitaryApp U params qvars hdist => exact traceNonIncrease_unitaryApp sem U params qvars hdist ω
  | measure x M qvars hdist => exact traceNonIncrease_measure sem x M qvars hdist ω
  | ifThenElse b P₁ P₀ ih₁ ih₀ =>
    by_cases hb : sem.boolEval ω.σ b
    · rw [denotationalSem_if_true sem b P₁ P₀ ω hb]; exact ih₁ ω
    · rw [denotationalSem_if_false sem b P₁ P₀ ω hb]; exact ih₀ ω
  | seq P₁ P₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    rw [denotationalSem_seq sem P₁ P₂ ω, traceSumRe_bind]
    calc ((denotationalSem sem P₁ ω).map
            (fun ω' => traceSumRe (denotationalSem sem P₂ ω'))).sum
        ≤ ((denotationalSem sem P₁ ω).map (fun ω' => ω'.traceRe)).sum := by
          apply Multiset.sum_map_le_sum_map _ _ _
          intro ω' _
          exact ih₂ ω'
      _ = traceSumRe (denotationalSem sem P₁ ω) := by
          simp [traceSumRe, Multiset.map_map, Function.comp, CQState.traceRe]
      _ ≤ ω.traceRe := ih₁ ω
  | whileDo b P ih =>
    -- While-true case uses well-founded induction on path length (traceNonIncrease_while).
    -- The structural IH gives trace non-increase for the body P.
    exact traceNonIncrease_while sem b P ih ω

/-! ## Tsum-based Trace Non-Increase (Fintype version)

When all derivation types are `Fintype`, the tsum-based trace sum `traceSumDeriv`
equals the Multiset-based `traceSumRe ∘ denotationalSem` (by `traceSumDeriv_eq_traceSumRe`).
Combined with `traceNonIncrease`, this gives the tsum-based bound
`∑' d, d.result.traceRe ≤ ω.traceRe`.

This theorem can be used to supply the `traceNonIncreaseDeriv` field of
`SoundnessBase` when `Fintype` holds. The general (non-Fintype) version
requires the `summableTrace` axiom and additional infrastructure. -/

/-- Tsum-based trace non-increase under Fintype:
    `∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω), d.result.traceRe ≤ ω.traceRe`.
    Follows from `traceNonIncrease` (Multiset version) since under Fintype,
    `tsum f = ∑ x in Finset.univ, f x`, which equals the Multiset-based trace sum. -/

    `{inv} while b do P {inv ∧ ¬b}` holds with total correctness.

theorem disjointKrausAccum1CommPar_derived
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx}
    {psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx}
    (hyp : DisjointCommHypotheses sem)
    (hpdo_axiom : ∀ (F_sym : KrausOpSym)
      (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
      (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F_sym) → Exp)
      (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F_sym) → QVar)
      (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F_sym))
      (ρ : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all),
      IsPartialDensityOperator ρ →
      IsPartialDensityOperator
        ((psem.krausInterp F_sym σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
          (ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F_sym σ params qvarsF i))))
    (heff : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
      {S : Finset QVar}
      (A : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S),
      IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem σ A))
    -- Expectation monotonicity
    (hExpectMono : ∀ (C A B : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all),
      IsQuantumEffect C → A ≤ B → (expectationValue C A).re ≤ (expectationValue C B).re)
    (F F' : KrausOpSym)
    (hrank1 : pcats.krausRank F' = 1)
    (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
    (params' : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F') → Exp)
    (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)
    (qvarsF' : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F') → QVar)
    (hdistF : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F), i ≠ j → qvarsF i ≠ qvarsF j)
    (hdistF' : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F'), i ≠ j → qvarsF' i ≠ qvarsF' j)
    {S : Finset QVar}
    (postB : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S)
    (hsubF : ∀ i, qvarsF i ∈ S)
    (hsubF' : ∀ i, qvarsF' i ∈ S)
    (postψs : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) → (ClassicalState ctx → Prop))
    (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx)
    (hmutex : ∀ (i₁ i₂ : Fin (pcats.krausRank F)),
      i₁ ≠ i₂ → ∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx, ¬(postψs i₁ σ ∧ postψs i₂ σ))
    (hDisj : Disjoint (Finset.image qvarsF Finset.univ) P.quantumVars)
    (hprop : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F))
      (ρ : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all),
      IsPartialDensityOperator ρ →
      (psem.krausInterp F σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
        (ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F σ params qvarsF i)) ≤
      (psem.krausInterp F' σ params' qvarsF'
        ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).adjoint.comp
        (ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F' σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩)))
    -- Classical parameter stability
    (hσ_stable : ∀ (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω) (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F)),
      psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i =
      psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)
    (hσ_stable' : ∀ (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω),
      psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ =
      psem.krausInterp F' ω.σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩)
    -- Per-branch summability
    (hPerBranchSummable : ∀ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
      Summable (fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω =>
        if postψs i d.result.σ
        then (expectationValue
                ((psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).comp
                  ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
                    (psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint))
                d.result.ρ).re
        else 0))
    -- RHS summability
    (hRHSSummable : Summable (fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω =>
      if (∃ i, postψs i d.result.σ) ∧
         IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem d.result.σ
           (.kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF'))
      then (expectationValue
              (interpFormula psem d.result.σ
                (.kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF'))
              d.result.ρ).re
      else 0))
    -- Kraus NT inequality: ∑ᵢ NT(P, Kᵢ†ρKᵢ) ≤ NT(P, ρ)
    (hNTKraus :
      ∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        nonTermTraceDeriv sem P
          ⟨ω.σ,
           (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
             (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
           hpdo_axiom F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ ≤

        ⟨ω.σ,

           (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
         hpdo_axiom F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ +
       nonTermTraceDeriv sem P
        ⟨ω.σ,
         (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
           (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
         hpdo_axiom F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩) ≤
    postcondExpectDeriv psem
      ⟨S, fun σ => ∃ i, postψs i σ,
       .kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF'⟩ sem P ω +
    nonTermTraceDeriv sem P ω := by
  -- Split ∑ᵢ (aᵢ + bᵢ) = (∑ᵢ aᵢ) + (∑ᵢ bᵢ)
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply add_le_add
  -- Part (a): postcondExpect inequality from Accum1
  · exact disjointKrausAccum1Comm_derived hyp hpdo_axiom heff hExpectMono F F' hrank1
      params params' qvarsF qvarsF' hdistF hdistF' postB hsubF hsubF' postψs P ω
      hmutex hDisj hprop hσ_stable hσ_stable' hPerBranchSummable hRHSSummable
  -- Part (b): NT inequality from hNTKraus
  · exact hNTKraus

    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    {sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx}
    {psem : PredSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym ctx}
    (hyp : DisjointCommHypotheses sem)
    (hpdo_axiom : ∀ (F_sym : KrausOpSym)
      (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
      (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F_sym) → Exp)
      (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F_sym) → QVar)
      (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F_sym))
      (ρ : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all),
      IsPartialDensityOperator ρ →
      IsPartialDensityOperator
        ((psem.krausInterp F_sym σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
          (ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F_sym σ params qvarsF i))))
    (heff : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
      {S : Finset QVar}
      (A : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S),
      IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem σ A))
    (F : KrausOpSym)
    (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
    (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)
    (hdistF : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F), i ≠ j → qvarsF i ≠ qvarsF j)
    {S : Finset QVar}
    (Bs : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) →
      QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S)
    (hsubF : ∀ i, qvarsF i ∈ S)
    (ψ : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)
    (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx)
    (hDisj : Disjoint (Finset.image qvarsF Finset.univ) P.quantumVars)
    -- Classical parameter stability
    (hσ_stable : ∀ (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω) (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F)),
      psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i =
      psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)
    -- Summability for postcondExpect part
    (hSummable : ∀ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
      Summable (fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω =>
        if ψ d.result.σ
        then (expectationValue
                ((psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).comp
                  ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ (Bs i)).comp
                    (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint))
                d.result.ρ).re
        else 0))
    -- Kraus NT inequality: ∑ᵢ NT(P, Kᵢ†ρKᵢ) ≤ NT(P, ρ)
    -- This is a semantic property that does not reduce to hKrausTrace alone.
    (hNTKraus :
      ∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        nonTermTraceDeriv sem P
          ⟨ω.σ,
           (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
             (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
           hpdo_axiom F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ ≤
      nonTermTraceDeriv sem P ω) :
    ∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
      (postcondExpectDeriv psem ⟨S, ψ, Bs i⟩ sem P
        ⟨ω.σ,
         (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
           (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
         hpdo_axiom F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ +
       nonTermTraceDeriv sem P
        ⟨ω.σ,
         (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
           (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
         hpdo_axiom F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩) ≤
    postcondExpectDeriv psem
      ⟨S, ψ, .kraus F params qvarsF Bs hdistF hsubF⟩ sem P ω +
    nonTermTraceDeriv sem P ω := by
  -- Split ∑ᵢ (aᵢ + bᵢ) = (∑ᵢ aᵢ) + (∑ᵢ bᵢ)
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  -- Now goal: (∑ᵢ postcondExpect_i) + (∑ᵢ NT_i) ≤ postcondExpect + NT
  apply add_le_add
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  -- Part (a): ∑ᵢ postcondExpect(Bᵢ, Kᵢ†ρKᵢ) ≤ postcondExpect(kraus{Bᵢ}, ρ)
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

      Bs hsubF ψ P ω hDisj hσ_stable hSummable
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  -- Part (b): ∑ᵢ NT(P, Kᵢ†ρKᵢ) ≤ NT(P, ρ) — directly from hNTKraus
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  · exact hNTKraus

/-! ## Derived theorem 3: disjointKrausAccum1Comm

The Accum1 total correctness variant differs from `disjointKrausPostcondComm` in:
1. **Mutex postconditions**: Each Kraus branch i has its own classical postcondition
   `postψs i`, and these are mutually exclusive (at most one can be true for any σ).
2. **Uniform quantum postcondition**: All branches share the same `postB`.
3. **Rank-1 propagation**: Each Kᵢ†ρKᵢ ≤ K'₀†ρK'₀ where F' has rank 1.
4. **Different RHS**: postcondExpect uses `(fun σ => ∃ i, postψs i σ)` as classical
   postcondition and `.kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB)` as quantum postcondition.

**Proof strategy**:
Same replay + Fubini + Kraus decomposition pattern, but:
- The mutex condition allows: ∑ᵢ (if postψs i σ then ...) ≤ (if ∃ i, postψs i σ then ...)
- The propagation bound: E(postB, Kᵢ†ρ'Kᵢ) ≤ E(postB, K'₀†ρ'K'₀)
  since Kᵢ†ρ'Kᵢ ≤ K'₀†ρ'K'₀ and postB is a quantum effect (monotonicity).
- Rank-1: ∑ⱼ∈{0} K'ⱼ(postB)K'ⱼ† = K'₀(postB)K'₀† (single term). -/

/-- **Theorem: disjointKrausAccum1Comm from replay infrastructure.**

    Derives the `disjointKrausAccum1Comm` axiom field (total correctness, Accum1 variant).
    The proof follows the same replay-Fubini-Kraus pattern but handles:
    - Mutex postconditions (at most one postψs i holds per σ)
    - Propagation bound (Kᵢ†ρKᵢ ≤ K'₀†ρK'₀)
    - Rank-1 Kraus operator F' (single branch on RHS) -/

theorem traceNonIncreaseDeriv_fintype {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
    (ω : CQState ctx)
    [hfin : ∀ (Q : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) (ω' : CQState ctx),
      Fintype (TerminatingDerivation sem Q ω')] :
    ∑' (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω), d.result.traceRe ≤ ω.traceRe := by
  -- Under Fintype, tsum = Finset.sum over univ
  rw [tsum_fintype]
  -- Now: ∑ d in Finset.univ, d.result.traceRe ≤ ω.traceRe
  -- This equals traceSumRe (denotationalSem sem P ω) by unfolding

    -- Single derivation with result ω. postcondExpect = E(a.A, ω), NT = 0.

    -- The tsum has one term that evaluates to E(a.A, ω.ρ).re (since hφ, hEffect hold)

/-- **Theorem 1, Part (2): Soundness of QHL+ for Total Correctness [Ying, Theorem 6.1]**

    If a Hoare triple {phi, A} P {psi, B} is derivable in the proof system QHL+_tot,
    then the triple is valid in the sense of total correctness:

      |-_tot {phi, A} P {psi, B}  implies  |=_tot {phi, A} P {psi, B}

    Total correctness validity means: for every state (sigma, rho) satisfying the
    precondition,

      tr(sigma(A) . rho) <= Sum{|tr(sigma'(B) . rho') | ... |}

    without the non-termination term NT(P). This stronger guarantee requires
    the program to terminate almost surely, which is ensured by the loop rule
    for total correctness using a ranking function (variant). -/
preview.content_html:
What This Declaration Is Doing

This theorem is the main soundness statement for the partial-correctness proof system `QHL+`: every derivable Hoare judgment in the syntax-directed calculus denotes a semantically valid partial-correctness triple. Mathematically, it says that if one can prove `{pre} P {post}` in the deductive system, then for every input state satisfying the precondition, the expected value of the pre-assertion is bounded by the expected post-value accumulated over terminating executions, plus the residual nontermination mass. The assumptions `sem`, `psem`, `expSub`, `qvSub`, and especially `sax : SoundnessBase ...` supply the operational semantics, assertion semantics, substitution machinery, and the already-proved soundness facts for the primitive commands. The proof proceeds by induction on the derivation `h`, showing that each proof rule of `QHL+` corresponds to a semantically valid reasoning step.

      (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
      (ω : CQState ctx)
      (hmutex : ∀ (i₁ i₂ : Fin (pcats.krausRank F)),
        i₁ ≠ i₂ → ∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx, ¬(postψs i₁ σ ∧ postψs i₂ σ))
      (hDisj : Disjoint (Finset.image qvarsF Finset.univ) P.quantumVars)
      (hprop : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F))
        (ρ : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all),
        IsPartialDensityOperator ρ →
        (psem.krausInterp F σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
          (ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F σ params qvarsF i)) ≤
        (psem.krausInterp F' σ params' qvarsF'
          ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).adjoint.comp
          (ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F' σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩))) :
      (∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        postcondExpectDeriv psem ⟨S, postψs i, postB⟩ sem P
          ⟨ω.σ,
           (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
             (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
           hpdo_axiom F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ ≤
      postcondExpectDeriv psem
        ⟨S, fun σ => ∃ i, postψs i σ,
         .kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF'⟩ sem P ω) ∧
      (∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        (postcondExpectDeriv psem ⟨S, postψs i, postB⟩ sem P
          ⟨ω.σ,
           (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
             (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
           hpdo_axiom F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ +
         nonTermTraceDeriv sem P
          ⟨ω.σ,
           (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
             (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
           hpdo_axiom F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩) ≤
      postcondExpectDeriv psem
        ⟨S, fun σ => ∃ i, postψs i σ,
         .kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF'⟩ sem P ω +
      nonTermTraceDeriv sem P ω) := by
  intro F F' hrank1 params params' qvarsF qvarsF' hdistF hdistF' postB hsubF hsubF'
    postψs P ω hmutex hDisj hprop
  let i0 : Fin (pcats.krausRank F') := ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  have hσ_stable' : ∀ d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω,
      psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' i0 =
      psem.krausInterp F' ω.σ params' qvarsF' i0 := by
    intro d
    simpa [i0] using
      hσ_stable F' params' qvarsF' hdistF'
        (fun _ => postB) hsubF' (fun σ => ∃ i, postψs i σ) P ω d i0
  have hPerBranchSummable : ∀ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
      Summable (fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω =>
        if postψs i d.result.σ
        then (expectationValue
                ((psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).comp
                  ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
                    (psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint))
                d.result.ρ).re
        else 0) := by
    intro i
    have hsum :=
      hSummable F params qvarsF hdistF (fun _ => postB) hsubF (postψs i) P ω i
    refine Summable.congr hsum ?_
    intro d
    rw [hσ_stable F params qvarsF hdistF (fun _ => postB) hsubF (postψs i) P ω d i]
  have hRank1Interp : ∀ d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω,
      interpFormula psem d.result.σ
        (.kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF') =
      (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' i0).comp
        ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
          (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' i0).adjoint) := by
    intro d
    rw [interpFormula_kraus]
    rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single i0]
    · simp [i0]
    · intro j hj
      exfalso
      apply hj
      have : j.val < 1 := by simpa [hrank1] using j.isLt
      ext
      omega
  have hRHSSummable : Summable (fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω =>
      if (∃ i, postψs i d.result.σ) ∧
         IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem d.result.σ
           (.kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF'))
      then (expectationValue
              (interpFormula psem d.result.σ
                (.kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF'))
              d.result.ρ).re
      else 0) := by
    have hsum :=
      hSummable F' params' qvarsF' hdistF' (fun _ => postB) hsubF'
        (fun σ => ∃ i, postψs i σ) P ω i0
    refine Summable.congr hsum ?_
    intro d
    by_cases hψ : ∃ i, postψs i d.result.σ
    · have hqe : IsQuantumEffect
          (interpFormula psem d.result.σ
            (.kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF')) := by
        exact heff d.result.σ (.kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF')
      simp [hψ, hqe]
      rw [hRank1Interp d, hσ_stable' d]
    · simp [hψ]
  have hNT :
      ∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        nonTermTraceDeriv sem P
          ⟨ω.σ,
           (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
             (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
           hpdo_axiom F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ ≤
      nonTermTraceDeriv sem P ω := by
    exact hNTKraus F params qvarsF hdistF (fun _ => postB) hsubF
      (fun σ => ∃ i, postψs i σ) P ω
  exact disjointKrausAccum1Comm_targets
    (psem := psem) hyp hpdo_axiom heff hExpectMono
    F F' hrank1 params params' qvarsF qvarsF' hdistF hdistF'
    postB hsubF hsubF' postψs P ω hmutex hDisj hprop
    (fun d i => hσ_stable F params qvarsF hdistF (fun _ => postB) hsubF
      (fun σ => postψs i σ) P ω d i)
    hσ_stable' hPerBranchSummable hRHSSummable hNT

/-- Narrow constructor helper: derive only the two postcondition commutativity fields
    from the paper-faithful bridge, while leaving Accum1 explicit. -/
private theorem mkConcreteSoundnessAxioms_postcondDerived
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (hne : ∀ M : Meas, Nonempty (cats.measOutcomeType M))
    (σ₀ : ClassicalState ctx) (q₀ : QVar)
    [hfin : ∀ (Q : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) (ω' : CQState ctx),
      Fintype (TerminatingDerivation sem Q ω')]
    (expSub : CVar → Exp → Exp → Exp)
    (qvSub : CVar → Exp → QVar → QVar)
    (hqv_inj : ∀ (x : CVar) (e : Exp), Function.Injective (qvSub x e))
    (hGate : ∀ (x : CVar) (e : Exp) (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (U : Gate)
      (params : Fin (cats.gateClassicalArity U) → Exp)
      (qvars : Fin (cats.gateQuantumArity U) → QVar),
      sem.unitaryOp U σ (fun i => expSub x e (params i)) (fun i => qvSub x e (qvars i)) =
      sem.unitaryOp U (sem.classicalUpdate σ x e) params qvars)
    (hMeas : ∀ (x : CVar) (e : Exp) (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (M : Meas)
      (qvars : Fin (cats.measQuantumArity M) → QVar)
      (m : cats.measOutcomeType M),
      sem.measOp M σ (fun i => qvSub x e (qvars i)) m =
      sem.measOp M (sem.classicalUpdate σ x e) qvars m)
    (htensor_comm :
      letI pcats := StandardKrausOpSym.mkQuantumPredicateCats (cats := cats) hne
      letI psem := mkStandardPredicateSemantics sem hne σ₀ q₀
      ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
        {S₁ S₂ : Finset QVar}
        (A₁ : QuantumPredicateFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas
          TrivialAtomPred (StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) S₁)
        (A₂ : QuantumPredicateFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas
          TrivialAtomPred (StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) S₂),
        Disjoint S₁ S₂ →
        (interpFormula psem σ A₁).comp (interpFormula psem σ A₂) =
        (interpFormula psem σ A₂).comp (interpFormula psem σ A₁))
    (hmeas :
      letI pcats := StandardKrausOpSym.mkQuantumPredicateCats (cats := cats) hne
      letI psem := mkStandardPredicateSemantics sem hne σ₀ q₀
      ∀ (x : CVar) (M : Meas)
        (measQvars : Fin (cats.measQuantumArity M) → QVar)
        (measHdist : ∀ i j : Fin (cats.measQuantumArity M), i ≠ j → measQvars i ≠ measQvars j)
        (y : CVar) (y_exp : Exp)
        (post_base : CQAssertion CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas
          TrivialAtomPred (StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) ctx)
        (F_My : StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
        (fParams : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F_My) → Exp)
        (fQvars : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F_My) → QVar)
        (fHdist : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F_My), i ≠ j → fQvars i ≠ fQvars j)
        (hInj : Function.Injective (qvSub x y_exp))
        (fHsub : ∀ i, fQvars i ∈ post_base.S.image (qvSub x y_exp))
        (eqXY : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)
        (heqXY : ∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx, eqXY σ ↔ sem.classicalUpdate σ x y_exp = σ)
        (hfresh_φ : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (e : Exp),
          post_base.φ σ ↔ post_base.φ (sem.classicalUpdate σ y e))
        (hfresh_A : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (e : Exp),
          interpFormula psem σ post_base.A =
          interpFormula psem (sem.classicalUpdate σ y e) post_base.A)
        (hy_ne_x : y ≠ x)
        (outcomeOf : ClassicalState ctx → cats.measOutcomeType M)
        (hMeasBridge :
          (pcats.krausRank F_My = 1) ∧
          (∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (h1 : pcats.krausRank F_My = 1),
            psem.krausInterp F_My σ fParams fQvars ⟨0, h1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ =
              (sem.measOp M σ measQvars (outcomeOf σ)).adjoint) ∧
          (∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx),
            sem.measClassicalUpdate σ x M (outcomeOf σ) = sem.classicalUpdate σ x y_exp) ∧
          (∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx),
            eqXY (sem.measClassicalUpdate σ x M (outcomeOf σ)))),
      HoareTripleTotDeriv sem psem
        ⟨post_base.S.image (qvSub x y_exp),
         classSubstFormula sem x y_exp post_base.φ,
         .kraus F_My fParams fQvars
           (fun _ => substFormula expSub qvSub x y_exp hInj post_base.A) fHdist fHsub⟩
        (.measure x M measQvars measHdist)
        ⟨post_base.S, fun σ => post_base.φ σ ∧ eqXY σ, post_base.A⟩)
    (hyp : DisjointCommHypotheses sem)
    (hpdo_axiom : ∀ (F_sym : KrausOpSym)
      (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
      (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F_sym) → Exp)
      (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F_sym) → QVar)
      (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F_sym))
      (ρ : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all),
      IsPartialDensityOperator ρ →
      IsPartialDensityOperator
        ((psem.krausInterp F_sym σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
          (ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F_sym σ params qvarsF i))))
    (heff : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
      {S : Finset QVar}
      (A : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S),
      IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem σ A))
    (hσ_stable : ∀ (F : KrausOpSym)
      (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
      (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)
      (hdistF : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F), i ≠ j → qvarsF i ≠ qvarsF j)
      {S : Finset QVar}
      (Bs : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) →
        QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S)
      (hsubF : ∀ i, qvarsF i ∈ S)
      (ψ : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)
      (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
      (ω : CQState ctx)
      (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω)
      (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F)),
      psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i =
      psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)
    (hSummable : ∀ (F : KrausOpSym)
      (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
      (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)
      (hdistF : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F), i ≠ j → qvarsF i ≠ qvarsF j)
      {S : Finset QVar}
      (Bs : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) →
        QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S)
      (hsubF : ∀ i, qvarsF i ∈ S)
      (ψ : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)
      (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
      (ω : CQState ctx),
      ∀ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        Summable (fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω =>
          if ψ d.result.σ
          then (expectationValue
                  ((psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).comp
                    ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ (Bs i)).comp
                      (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint))
                  d.result.ρ).re
          else 0))
    (hNTKraus : ∀ (F : KrausOpSym)
      (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
      (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)
      (hdistF : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F), i ≠ j → qvarsF i ≠ qvarsF j)
      {S : Finset QVar}
      (Bs : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) →
        QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S)
      (hsubF : ∀ i, qvarsF i ∈ S)
      (ψ : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)
      (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
      (ω : CQState ctx),
      ∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        nonTermTraceDeriv sem P
          { classicalState := ω.σ,
            quantumState :=
              LinearMap.adjoint (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i) ∘ₗ
                ω.ρ ∘ₗ psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i,
            is_partialDensityOp := by
              have hq :
                  IsPartialDensityOperator
                    (LinearMap.adjoint (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i) ∘ₗ
                      ω.ρ ∘ₗ psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i) := by
                simpa using hpdo_axiom F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp
              exact hq } ≤
      nonTermTraceDeriv sem P ω)
    (hdisjKrausAccum1 :
      letI pcats := StandardKrausOpSym.mkQuantumPredicateCats (cats := cats) hne
      letI psem := mkStandardPredicateSemantics sem hne σ₀ q₀
      ∀ (F F' : StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
        (hrank1 : pcats.krausRank F' = 1)
        (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
        (params' : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F') → Exp)
        (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)
        (qvarsF' : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F') → QVar)
        (hdistF : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F), i ≠ j → qvarsF i ≠ qvarsF j)
        (hdistF' : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F'), i ≠ j → qvarsF' i ≠ qvarsF' j)
        {S : Finset QVar}
        (postB : QuantumPredicateFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas
          TrivialAtomPred (StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) S)
        (hsubF : ∀ i, qvarsF i ∈ S)
        (hsubF' : ∀ i, qvarsF' i ∈ S)
        (postψs : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) → (ClassicalState ctx → Prop))
        (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
        (ω : CQState ctx)
        (hmutex : ∀ (i₁ i₂ : Fin (pcats.krausRank F)),
          i₁ ≠ i₂ → ∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx, ¬(postψs i₁ σ ∧ postψs i₂ σ))
        (hdisjoint : Disjoint (Finset.image qvarsF Finset.univ) P.quantumVars)
        (hprop : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F))
          (ρ : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all),
          IsPartialDensityOperator ρ →
          (psem.krausInterp F σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
            (ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F σ params qvarsF i)) ≤
          (psem.krausInterp F' σ params' qvarsF'
            ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).adjoint.comp
            (ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F' σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩))),
      ∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        postcondExpectDeriv psem ⟨S, postψs i, postB⟩ sem P
          ⟨ω.σ,
           (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
             (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
           krausInterp_sandwich_pdo_theorem psem F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ ≤
      postcondExpectDeriv psem
        ⟨S, fun σ => ∃ i, postψs i σ,
         .kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF'⟩ sem P ω)
    (hdisjKrausAccum1Par :
      letI pcats := StandardKrausOpSym.mkQuantumPredicateCats (cats := cats) hne
      letI psem := mkStandardPredicateSemantics sem hne σ₀ q₀
      ∀ (F F' : StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
        (hrank1 : pcats.krausRank F' = 1)
        (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
        (params' : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F') → Exp)
        (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)
        (qvarsF' : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F') → QVar)
        (hdistF : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F), i ≠ j → qvarsF i ≠ qvarsF j)
        (hdistF' : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F'), i ≠ j → qvarsF' i ≠ qvarsF' j)
        {S : Finset QVar}
        (postB : QuantumPredicateFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas
          TrivialAtomPred (StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) S)
        (hsubF : ∀ i, qvarsF i ∈ S)
        (hsubF' : ∀ i, qvarsF' i ∈ S)
        (postψs : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) → (ClassicalState ctx → Prop))
        (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
        (ω : CQState ctx)
        (hmutex : ∀ (i₁ i₂ : Fin (pcats.krausRank F)),
          i₁ ≠ i₂ → ∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx, ¬(postψs i₁ σ ∧ postψs i₂ σ))
        (hdisjoint : Disjoint (Finset.image qvarsF Finset.univ) P.quantumVars)
        (hprop : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F))
          (ρ : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all),
          IsPartialDensityOperator ρ →
          (psem.krausInterp F σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
            (ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F σ params qvarsF i)) ≤
          (psem.krausInterp F' σ params' qvarsF'
            ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).adjoint.comp
            (ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F' σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩))),
      ∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        (postcondExpectDeriv psem ⟨S, postψs i, postB⟩ sem P
          ⟨ω.σ,
           (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
             (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
           krausInterp_sandwich_pdo_theorem psem F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ +
         nonTermTraceDeriv sem P
          ⟨ω.σ,
           (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
             (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
           krausInterp_sandwich_pdo_theorem psem F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩) ≤
      postcondExpectDeriv psem
        ⟨S, fun σ => ∃ i, postψs i σ,
         .kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF'⟩ sem P ω +
      nonTermTraceDeriv sem P ω) :
    @SoundnessBase CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas
      TrivialAtomPred (StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
      _ cats (StandardKrausOpSym.mkQuantumPredicateCats (cats := cats) hne) ctx
      sem (mkStandardPredicateSemantics sem hne σ₀ q₀) expSub qvSub :=
  by
    let psem := mkStandardPredicateSemantics sem hne σ₀ q₀
    have hPost : _ := by
      exact concreteDisjointKrausPostcondComm_fields_fromDerived
        (psem := psem) hyp hpdo_axiom heff hσ_stable hSummable hNTKraus
    exact mkConcreteSoundnessAxioms
      (sem := sem) (hne := hne) (σ₀ := σ₀) (q₀ := q₀)
      (expSub := expSub) (qvSub := qvSub) (hqv_inj := hqv_inj)
      (hGate := hGate) (hMeas := hMeas) (htensor_comm := htensor_comm)
      (hmeas := hmeas)
      (hdisjKrausPostcond := hPost.1)
      (hdisjKrausPostcondPar := hPost.2)
      (hdisjKrausAccum1 := hdisjKrausAccum1)
      (hdisjKrausAccum1Par := hdisjKrausAccum1Par)

/-- Narrow constructor helper: derive `soundness_measure` from the measurement bridge
    and derive the two postcondition commutativity fields from the paper-faithful
    Step-2 bridge. Accum1 remains explicit and untouched. -/
private theorem mkConcreteSoundnessAxioms_measurePostcondDerived
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (hne : ∀ M : Meas, Nonempty (cats.measOutcomeType M))
    (σ₀ : ClassicalState ctx) (q₀ : QVar)
    [hfin : ∀ (Q : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) (ω' : CQState ctx),
      Fintype (TerminatingDerivation sem Q ω')]

      {S : Finset QVar}

        QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S)
      (hsubF : ∀ i, qvarsF i ∈ S)
      (ψ : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)
      (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
      (ω : CQState ctx)

        ⟨S, fun σ => ∃ i, postψs i σ,
         .kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF'⟩ sem P ω) ∧
      (∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        (postcondExpectDeriv psem ⟨S, postψs i, postB⟩ sem P
          ⟨ω.σ,
           (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
             (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
           hpdo_axiom F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ +
         nonTermTraceDeriv sem P
          ⟨ω.σ,
           (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
             (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
           hpdo_axiom F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩) ≤
      postcondExpectDeriv psem
        ⟨S, fun σ => ∃ i, postψs i σ,
         .kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF'⟩ sem P ω +
      nonTermTraceDeriv sem P ω) := by
  intro F F' hrank1 params params' qvarsF qvarsF' hdistF hdistF' postB hsubF hsubF'
    postψs P ω hmutex hDisj hprop
  let i0 : Fin (pcats.krausRank F') := ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  have hσ_stable' : ∀ d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω,
      psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' i0 =
      psem.krausInterp F' ω.σ params' qvarsF' i0 := by
    intro d
    simpa [i0] using
      hσ_stable F' params' qvarsF' hdistF'
        (fun _ => postB) hsubF' (fun σ => ∃ i, postψs i σ) P ω d i0
  have hPerBranchSummable : ∀ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
      Summable (fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω =>
        if postψs i d.result.σ
        then (expectationValue
                ((psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).comp
                  ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
                    (psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint))
                d.result.ρ).re
        else 0) := by
    intro i
    have hsum :=
      hSummable F params qvarsF hdistF (fun _ => postB) hsubF (postψs i) P ω i
    refine Summable.congr hsum ?_
    intro d
    rw [hσ_stable F params qvarsF hdistF (fun _ => postB) hsubF (postψs i) P ω d i]
  have hRank1Interp : ∀ d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω,
      interpFormula psem d.result.σ
        (.kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF') =
      (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' i0).comp
        ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ postB).comp
          (psem.krausInterp F' d.result.σ params' qvarsF' i0).adjoint) := by
    intro d
    rw [interpFormula_kraus]
    rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single i0]
    · simp [i0]
    · intro j hj
      exfalso
      apply hj
      have : j.val < 1 := by simpa [hrank1] using j.isLt
      ext
      omega
  have hRHSSummable : Summable (fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω =>
      if (∃ i, postψs i d.result.σ) ∧
         IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem d.result.σ
           (.kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF'))
      then (expectationValue
              (interpFormula psem d.result.σ
                (.kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF'))
              d.result.ρ).re
      else 0) := by
    have hsum :=
      hSummable F' params' qvarsF' hdistF' (fun _ => postB) hsubF'
        (fun σ => ∃ i, postψs i σ) P ω i0
    refine Summable.congr hsum ?_
    intro d
    by_cases hψ : ∃ i, postψs i d.result.σ
    · have hqe : IsQuantumEffect
          (interpFormula psem d.result.σ
            (.kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF')) := by
        exact heff d.result.σ (.kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF')
      simp [hψ, hqe]
      rw [hRank1Interp d, hσ_stable' d]
    · simp [hψ]
  have hNT :
      ∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        nonTermTraceDeriv sem P
          ⟨ω.σ,
           (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
             (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
           hpdo_axiom F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ ≤
      nonTermTraceDeriv sem P ω := by
    exact hNTKraus F params qvarsF hdistF (fun _ => postB) hsubF
      (fun σ => ∃ i, postψs i σ) P ω
  exact disjointKrausAccum1Comm_targets
    (psem := psem) hyp hpdo_axiom heff hExpectMono
    F F' hrank1 params params' qvarsF qvarsF' hdistF hdistF'
    postB hsubF hsubF' postψs P ω hmutex hDisj hprop
    (fun d i => hσ_stable F params qvarsF hdistF (fun _ => postB) hsubF
      (fun σ => postψs i σ) P ω d i)
    hσ_stable' hPerBranchSummable hRHSSummable hNT

/-- Narrow constructor helper: derive only the two postcondition commutativity fields
    from the paper-faithful bridge, while leaving Accum1 explicit. -/
private theorem mkConcreteSoundnessAxioms_postcondDerived
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (hne : ∀ M : Meas, Nonempty (cats.measOutcomeType M))
    (σ₀ : ClassicalState ctx) (q₀ : QVar)
    [hfin : ∀ (Q : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) (ω' : CQState ctx),
      Fintype (TerminatingDerivation sem Q ω')]
    (expSub : CVar → Exp → Exp → Exp)
    (qvSub : CVar → Exp → QVar → QVar)
    (hqv_inj : ∀ (x : CVar) (e : Exp), Function.Injective (qvSub x e))
    (hGate : ∀ (x : CVar) (e : Exp) (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (U : Gate)
      (params : Fin (cats.gateClassicalArity U) → Exp)
      (qvars : Fin (cats.gateQuantumArity U) → QVar),
      sem.unitaryOp U σ (fun i => expSub x e (params i)) (fun i => qvSub x e (qvars i)) =
      sem.unitaryOp U (sem.classicalUpdate σ x e) params qvars)
    (hMeas : ∀ (x : CVar) (e : Exp) (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (M : Meas)
      (qvars : Fin (cats.measQuantumArity M) → QVar)
      (m : cats.measOutcomeType M),
      sem.measOp M σ (fun i => qvSub x e (qvars i)) m =
      sem.measOp M (sem.classicalUpdate σ x e) qvars m)
    (htensor_comm :
      letI pcats := StandardKrausOpSym.mkQuantumPredicateCats (cats := cats) hne
      letI psem := mkStandardPredicateSemantics sem hne σ₀ q₀
      ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
        {S₁ S₂ : Finset QVar}
        (A₁ : QuantumPredicateFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas
          TrivialAtomPred (StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) S₁)
        (A₂ : QuantumPredicateFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas
          TrivialAtomPred (StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) S₂),
        Disjoint S₁ S₂ →
        (interpFormula psem σ A₁).comp (interpFormula psem σ A₂) =
        (interpFormula psem σ A₂).comp (interpFormula psem σ A₁))
    (hmeas :
      letI pcats := StandardKrausOpSym.mkQuantumPredicateCats (cats := cats) hne
      letI psem := mkStandardPredicateSemantics sem hne σ₀ q₀
      ∀ (x : CVar) (M : Meas)
        (measQvars : Fin (cats.measQuantumArity M) → QVar)
        (measHdist : ∀ i j : Fin (cats.measQuantumArity M), i ≠ j → measQvars i ≠ measQvars j)
        (y : CVar) (y_exp : Exp)
        (post_base : CQAssertion CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas
          TrivialAtomPred (StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) ctx)
        (F_My : StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
        (fParams : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F_My) → Exp)
        (fQvars : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F_My) → QVar)
        (fHdist : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F_My), i ≠ j → fQvars i ≠ fQvars j)
        (hInj : Function.Injective (qvSub x y_exp))
        (fHsub : ∀ i, fQvars i ∈ post_base.S.image (qvSub x y_exp))
        (eqXY : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)
        (heqXY : ∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx, eqXY σ ↔ sem.classicalUpdate σ x y_exp = σ)
        (hfresh_φ : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (e : Exp),
          post_base.φ σ ↔ post_base.φ (sem.classicalUpdate σ y e))
        (hfresh_A : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (e : Exp),
          interpFormula psem σ post_base.A =
          interpFormula psem (sem.classicalUpdate σ y e) post_base.A)
        (hy_ne_x : y ≠ x)
        (outcomeOf : ClassicalState ctx → cats.measOutcomeType M)
        (hMeasBridge :
          (pcats.krausRank F_My = 1) ∧
          (∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (h1 : pcats.krausRank F_My = 1),
            psem.krausInterp F_My σ fParams fQvars ⟨0, h1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ =
              (sem.measOp M σ measQvars (outcomeOf σ)).adjoint) ∧
          (∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx),
            sem.measClassicalUpdate σ x M (outcomeOf σ) = sem.classicalUpdate σ x y_exp) ∧
          (∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx),
            eqXY (sem.measClassicalUpdate σ x M (outcomeOf σ)))),
      HoareTripleTotDeriv sem psem
        ⟨post_base.S.image (qvSub x y_exp),
         classSubstFormula sem x y_exp post_base.φ,
         .kraus F_My fParams fQvars
           (fun _ => substFormula expSub qvSub x y_exp hInj post_base.A) fHdist fHsub⟩
        (.measure x M measQvars measHdist)
        ⟨post_base.S, fun σ => post_base.φ σ ∧ eqXY σ, post_base.A⟩)
    (hyp : DisjointCommHypotheses sem)
    (hpdo_axiom : ∀ (F_sym : KrausOpSym)
      (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
      (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F_sym) → Exp)
      (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F_sym) → QVar)
      (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F_sym))
      (ρ : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all),
      IsPartialDensityOperator ρ →
      IsPartialDensityOperator
        ((psem.krausInterp F_sym σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
          (ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F_sym σ params qvarsF i))))
    (heff : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
      {S : Finset QVar}
      (A : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S),
      IsQuantumEffect (interpFormula psem σ A))
    (hσ_stable : ∀ (F : KrausOpSym)
      (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
      (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)
      (hdistF : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F), i ≠ j → qvarsF i ≠ qvarsF j)
      {S : Finset QVar}
      (Bs : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) →
        QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S)
      (hsubF : ∀ i, qvarsF i ∈ S)
      (ψ : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)
      (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
      (ω : CQState ctx)
      (d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω)
      (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F)),
      psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i =
      psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)
    (hSummable : ∀ (F : KrausOpSym)
      (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
      (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)
      (hdistF : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F), i ≠ j → qvarsF i ≠ qvarsF j)
      {S : Finset QVar}
      (Bs : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) →
        QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S)
      (hsubF : ∀ i, qvarsF i ∈ S)
      (ψ : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)
      (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
      (ω : CQState ctx),
      ∀ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        Summable (fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω =>
          if ψ d.result.σ
          then (expectationValue
                  ((psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).comp
                    ((interpFormula psem d.result.σ (Bs i)).comp
                      (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint))
                  d.result.ρ).re
          else 0))
    (hNTKraus : ∀ (F : KrausOpSym)
      (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
      (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)
      (hdistF : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F), i ≠ j → qvarsF i ≠ qvarsF j)
      {S : Finset QVar}
      (Bs : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) →
        QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S)
      (hsubF : ∀ i, qvarsF i ∈ S)
      (ψ : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)
      (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
      (ω : CQState ctx),
      ∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        nonTermTraceDeriv sem P
          { classicalState := ω.σ,
            quantumState :=
              LinearMap.adjoint (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i) ∘ₗ
                ω.ρ ∘ₗ psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i,
            is_partialDensityOp := by
              have hq :
                  IsPartialDensityOperator
                    (LinearMap.adjoint (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i) ∘ₗ
                      ω.ρ ∘ₗ psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i) := by
                simpa using hpdo_axiom F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp
              exact hq } ≤
      nonTermTraceDeriv sem P ω)
    (hdisjKrausAccum1 :
      letI pcats := StandardKrausOpSym.mkQuantumPredicateCats (cats := cats) hne
      letI psem := mkStandardPredicateSemantics sem hne σ₀ q₀
      ∀ (F F' : StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
        (hrank1 : pcats.krausRank F' = 1)
        (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
        (params' : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F') → Exp)
        (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)
        (qvarsF' : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F') → QVar)
        (hdistF : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F), i ≠ j → qvarsF i ≠ qvarsF j)
        (hdistF' : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F'), i ≠ j → qvarsF' i ≠ qvarsF' j)
        {S : Finset QVar}
        (postB : QuantumPredicateFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas
          TrivialAtomPred (StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) S)
        (hsubF : ∀ i, qvarsF i ∈ S)
        (hsubF' : ∀ i, qvarsF' i ∈ S)
        (postψs : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) → (ClassicalState ctx → Prop))
        (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
        (ω : CQState ctx)
        (hmutex : ∀ (i₁ i₂ : Fin (pcats.krausRank F)),
          i₁ ≠ i₂ → ∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx, ¬(postψs i₁ σ ∧ postψs i₂ σ))
        (hdisjoint : Disjoint (Finset.image qvarsF Finset.univ) P.quantumVars)
        (hprop : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F))
          (ρ : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all),
          IsPartialDensityOperator ρ →
          (psem.krausInterp F σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
            (ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F σ params qvarsF i)) ≤
          (psem.krausInterp F' σ params' qvarsF'
            ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).adjoint.comp
            (ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F' σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩))),
      ∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        postcondExpectDeriv psem ⟨S, postψs i, postB⟩ sem P
          ⟨ω.σ,
           (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
             (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
           krausInterp_sandwich_pdo_theorem psem F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ ≤
      postcondExpectDeriv psem
        ⟨S, fun σ => ∃ i, postψs i σ,
         .kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF'⟩ sem P ω)
    (hdisjKrausAccum1Par :
      letI pcats := StandardKrausOpSym.mkQuantumPredicateCats (cats := cats) hne
      letI psem := mkStandardPredicateSemantics sem hne σ₀ q₀
      ∀ (F F' : StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
        (hrank1 : pcats.krausRank F' = 1)
        (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
        (params' : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F') → Exp)
        (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)
        (qvarsF' : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F') → QVar)
        (hdistF : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F), i ≠ j → qvarsF i ≠ qvarsF j)
        (hdistF' : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F'), i ≠ j → qvarsF' i ≠ qvarsF' j)
        {S : Finset QVar}
        (postB : QuantumPredicateFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas
          TrivialAtomPred (StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) S)
        (hsubF : ∀ i, qvarsF i ∈ S)
        (hsubF' : ∀ i, qvarsF' i ∈ S)
        (postψs : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) → (ClassicalState ctx → Prop))
        (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
        (ω : CQState ctx)
        (hmutex : ∀ (i₁ i₂ : Fin (pcats.krausRank F)),
          i₁ ≠ i₂ → ∀ σ : ClassicalState ctx, ¬(postψs i₁ σ ∧ postψs i₂ σ))
        (hdisjoint : Disjoint (Finset.image qvarsF Finset.univ) P.quantumVars)
        (hprop : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F))
          (ρ : ctx.H_all →ₗ[ℂ] ctx.H_all),
          IsPartialDensityOperator ρ →
          (psem.krausInterp F σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
            (ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F σ params qvarsF i)) ≤
          (psem.krausInterp F' σ params' qvarsF'
            ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).adjoint.comp
            (ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F' σ params' qvarsF' ⟨0, hrank1 ▸ Nat.zero_lt_one⟩))),
      ∑ i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F),
        (postcondExpectDeriv psem ⟨S, postψs i, postB⟩ sem P
          ⟨ω.σ,
           (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
             (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
           krausInterp_sandwich_pdo_theorem psem F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩ +
         nonTermTraceDeriv sem P
          ⟨ω.σ,
           (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i).adjoint.comp
             (ω.ρ.comp (psem.krausInterp F ω.σ params qvarsF i)),
           krausInterp_sandwich_pdo_theorem psem F ω.σ params qvarsF i ω.ρ ω.is_partialDensityOp⟩) ≤
      postcondExpectDeriv psem
        ⟨S, fun σ => ∃ i, postψs i σ,
         .kraus F' params' qvarsF' (fun _ => postB) hdistF' hsubF'⟩ sem P ω +
      nonTermTraceDeriv sem P ω) :
    @SoundnessBase CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas
      TrivialAtomPred (StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
      _ cats (StandardKrausOpSym.mkQuantumPredicateCats (cats := cats) hne) ctx
      sem (mkStandardPredicateSemantics sem hne σ₀ q₀) expSub qvSub :=
  by
    let psem := mkStandardPredicateSemantics sem hne σ₀ q₀
    have hPost : _ := by
      exact concreteDisjointKrausPostcondComm_fields_fromDerived
        (psem := psem) hyp hpdo_axiom heff hσ_stable hSummable hNTKraus
    exact mkConcreteSoundnessAxioms
      (sem := sem) (hne := hne) (σ₀ := σ₀) (q₀ := q₀)
      (expSub := expSub) (qvSub := qvSub) (hqv_inj := hqv_inj)
      (hGate := hGate) (hMeas := hMeas) (htensor_comm := htensor_comm)
      (hmeas := hmeas)
      (hdisjKrausPostcond := hPost.1)
      (hdisjKrausPostcondPar := hPost.2)
      (hdisjKrausAccum1 := hdisjKrausAccum1)
      (hdisjKrausAccum1Par := hdisjKrausAccum1Par)

/-- Narrow constructor helper: derive `soundness_measure` from the measurement bridge
    and derive the two postcondition commutativity fields from the paper-faithful
    Step-2 bridge. Accum1 remains explicit and untouched. -/
private theorem mkConcreteSoundnessAxioms_measurePostcondDerived
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (hne : ∀ M : Meas, Nonempty (cats.measOutcomeType M))
    (σ₀ : ClassicalState ctx) (q₀ : QVar)
    [hfin : ∀ (Q : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas) (ω' : CQState ctx),
      Fintype (TerminatingDerivation sem Q ω')]
    (expSub : CVar → Exp → Exp → Exp)
    (qvSub : CVar → Exp → QVar → QVar)
    (hqv_inj : ∀ (x : CVar) (e : Exp), Function.Injective (qvSub x e))
    (hSubstAtom :
      letI pcats := StandardKrausOpSym.mkQuantumPredicateCats (cats := cats) hne
      letI psem := mkStandardPredicateSemantics sem hne σ₀ q₀
      ∀ (x : CVar) (e : Exp) (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
        (K : TrivialAtomPred)
        (params : Fin (pcats.predClassicalArity K) → Exp)
        (qvars : Fin (pcats.predQuantumArity K) → QVar),
        psem.atomInterp K σ (fun i => expSub x e (params i))
          (fun i => qvSub x e (qvars i)) =
        psem.atomInterp K (sem.classicalUpdate σ x e) params qvars)
    (hSubstKraus :
      letI pcats := StandardKrausOpSym.mkQuantumPredicateCats (cats := cats) hne
      letI psem := mkStandardPredicateSemantics sem hne σ₀ q₀
      ∀ (x : CVar) (e : Exp) (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
        (F : StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
        (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
        (qvars : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)
        (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F)),
        psem.krausInterp F σ (fun j => expSub x e (params j))
          (fun j => qvSub x e (qvars j)) i =
        psem.krausInterp F (sem.classicalUpdate σ x e) params qvars i)
    (hGate : ∀ (x : CVar) (e : Exp) (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (U : Gate)

/-- Further constructor helper: derive the Accum1 fields as well, so the concrete
    constructor path can consume the derived theorem layer rather than explicit

private theorem mkConcreteSoundnessAxioms_measureAccumDerived
    {ctx : ProgramContext}
    (sem : ProgSem CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas ctx)
    (hne : ∀ M : Meas, Nonempty (cats.measOutcomeType M))
    (σ₀ : ClassicalState ctx) (q₀ : QVar)

    (qvSub : CVar → Exp → QVar → QVar)
    (hqv_inj : ∀ (x : CVar) (e : Exp), Function.Injective (qvSub x e))
    (hSubstAtom :
      letI pcats := StandardKrausOpSym.mkQuantumPredicateCats (cats := cats) hne
      letI psem := mkStandardPredicateSemantics sem hne σ₀ q₀
      ∀ (x : CVar) (e : Exp) (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
        (K : TrivialAtomPred)
        (params : Fin (pcats.predClassicalArity K) → Exp)
        (qvars : Fin (pcats.predQuantumArity K) → QVar),
        psem.atomInterp K σ (fun i => expSub x e (params i))
          (fun i => qvSub x e (qvars i)) =
        psem.atomInterp K (sem.classicalUpdate σ x e) params qvars)
    (hSubstKraus :
      letI pcats := StandardKrausOpSym.mkQuantumPredicateCats (cats := cats) hne
      letI psem := mkStandardPredicateSemantics sem hne σ₀ q₀
      ∀ (x : CVar) (e : Exp) (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
        (F : StandardKrausOpSym CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)
        (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
        (qvars : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)
        (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F)),
        psem.krausInterp F σ (fun j => expSub x e (params j))
          (fun j => qvSub x e (qvars j)) i =
        psem.krausInterp F (sem.classicalUpdate σ x e) params qvars i)
    (hGate : ∀ (x : CVar) (e : Exp) (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (U : Gate)
      (params : Fin (cats.gateClassicalArity U) → Exp)
      (qvars : Fin (cats.gateQuantumArity U) → QVar),
      sem.unitaryOp U σ (fun i => expSub x e (params i)) (fun i => qvSub x e (qvars i)) =
      sem.unitaryOp U (sem.classicalUpdate σ x e) params qvars)
    (hMeas : ∀ (x : CVar) (e : Exp) (σ : ClassicalState ctx) (M : Meas)
      (qvars : Fin (cats.measQuantumArity M) → QVar)
      (m : cats.measOutcomeType M),
      sem.measOp M σ (fun i => qvSub x e (qvars i)) m =
      sem.measOp M (sem.classicalUpdate σ x e) qvars m)
    (htensor_comm :
      letI pcats := StandardKrausOpSym.mkQuantumPredicateCats (cats := cats) hne
      letI psem := mkStandardPredicateSemantics sem hne σ₀ q₀
      ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
        {S₁ S₂ : Finset QVar}
        (A₁ : QuantumPredicateFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas

        (interpFormula psem σ A₁).comp (interpFormula psem σ A₂) =

    (hyp : DisjointCommHypotheses sem)
    (hpdo_axiom : ∀ (F_sym : KrausOpSym)
      (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
      (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F_sym) → Exp)

    (heff : ∀ (σ : ClassicalState ctx)
      {S : Finset QVar}
      (A : QPFormula CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas AtomPred KrausOpSym S),

      (ω : CQState ctx)

      (i : Fin (pcats.krausRank F)),
      psem.krausInterp F d.result.σ params qvarsF i =

    (hSummable : ∀ (F : KrausOpSym)
      (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
      (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)
      (hdistF : ∀ i j : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F), i ≠ j → qvarsF i ≠ qvarsF j)
      {S : Finset QVar}
      (Bs : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) →

      (ψ : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)
      (P : QWP CVar Exp BExp QVar Gate Meas)

        Summable (fun d : TerminatingDerivation sem P ω =>

    (hNTKraus : ∀ (F : KrausOpSym)
      (params : Fin (pcats.krausClassicalArity F) → Exp)
      (qvarsF : Fin (pcats.krausQuantumArity F) → QVar)

      (Bs : Fin (pcats.krausRank F) →

      (ψ : ClassicalState ctx → Prop)

      (ω : CQState ctx),

Inputs and Outputs in Natural Language

  • ctx (implicit input): the ambient context fixing the variables and registers under discussion; more concretely, it is a program context fixing the classical and quantum registers under discussion.
  • sem (explicit input): the semantic map assigning mathematical meaning to the objects under study; more concretely, it is a program in the quantum while language.
  • hne (explicit input): the data for a measurement operation; more concretely, it is a measurement symbol describing one measurement family.
  • σ₀ (explicit input): the ambient context fixing the variables and registers under discussion; more concretely, it is a classical state, usually written as a valuation of classical variables.
  • q₀ (explicit input): a quantum register variable.
  • hfin (background assumption): the semantic map assigning mathematical meaning to the objects under study; more concretely, it is a classical-quantum state with a classical store and a quantum state component.
  • expSub (explicit input): a substitution rule that replaces variables by expressions; more concretely, it is a rule that takes a classical variable symbol, an arithmetic expression in the classical fragment, and an arithmetic expression in the classical fragment and returns an arithmetic expression in the classical fragment.
  • Output. The declaration returns a proposition whose proof establishes the stated claim.
